transliteration_converted: Bismi Allahi ar-raḥmani ar-raḥim.
Al-ḥamdu Lillahi rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Ar-raḥmani ar-raḥim.
Maliki yawmi ad-din.
ʼiyaka naɛbudu wa ʼiyaka nastaɛin.
Ahdina aṣ-ṣiraṭa al-mustaqim.
Ṣiraṭa al-laḏina ʼanɛamta ɛalayhim ɣayri al-maɣḍubi ɛalayhim wa la aḍ-ḍallin.
ʼalif-lam-mim.
Ḏalika al-kitabu la rayba fihi hudan lilmuttaqin.
Al-laḏina yuʼminuna bil-ɣaybi wa yuqimuna aṣ-ṣalata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun.
Wa al-laḏina yuʼminuna bima ʼunzila ʼilayka wa ma ʼunzila min qablika wa bil-ʼaxirati hum yuqinun.
ʼulaʼika ɛala hudan min rabbihim wa ʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru sawaʼun ɛalayhim ʼa ʼanḏartahum ʼam lam tunḏirhum la yuʼminun.
Xatama Allahu ɛala qulubihim wa ɛala samɛihim wa ɛala ʼabṣarihim ɣicawatun wa lahum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa mina an-nasi man yaqulu ʼamanna Billahi wa bil-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa ma hum bimuʼminin.
Yuxadiɛuna Allaha wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ma yaxdaɛuna ʼilla ʼanfusahum wa ma yacɛurun.
Fi qulubihim maraḍun fazadahum Allahu maraḍan wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun bima kanu yakḏibun.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum la tufsidu fi al-ʼarḍi qalu ʼinnama naḥnu muṣliḥun.
ʼala ʼinnahum hum al-mufsiduna wa lakin la yacɛurun.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum ʼaminu kama ʼamana an-nasu qalu ʼanuʼminu kama ʼamana as-sufahaʼu ʼala ʼinnahum hum as-sufahaʼu wa lakin la yaɛlamun.
Wa ʼiḏa laqu al-laḏina ʼamanu qalu ʼamanna wa ʼiḏa xalaw ʼila cayaṭinihim qalu ʼinna maɛakum ʼinnama naḥnu mustahziʼun.
Allahu yastahziʼu bihim wa yamudduhum fi ṭuɣyanihim yaɛmahun.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina actaraw aḍ-ḍalalata bil-huda fama rabiḥat tijaratuhum wa ma kanu muhtadin.
Maṯaluhum kamaṯali al-laḏi astawqada naran falamma ʼaḍaʼat ma ḥawlahu ḏahaba Allahu binurihim wa tarakahum fi ḏ̣ulumatin la yubṣirun.
Ṣummun bukmun ɛumyun fahum la yarjiɛun.
ʼaw kaṣayyibin mina as-samaʼi fihi ḏ̣ulumatun wa raɛdun wa barqun yajɛaluna ʼaṣabiɛahum fi ʼaḏanihim mina aṣ-ṣawaɛiqi ḥaḏara al-mawti wa Allahu muḥiṭun bil-kafirin.
Yakadu al-barqu yaxṭafu ʼabṣarahum kullama ʼaḍaʼa lahum macaw fihi wa ʼiḏa ʼaḏ̣lama ɛalayhim qamu wa law caʼa Allahu laḏahaba bisamɛihim wa ʼabṣarihim ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu aɛbudu rabbakum al-laḏi xalaqakum wa al-laḏina min qablikum laɛallakum tattaqun.
Al-laḏi jaɛala lakum al-ʼarḍa firacan wa as-samaʼa binaʼan wa ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼaxraja bihi mina aṯ-ṯamarati rizqan lakum fala tajɛalu Lillahi ʼandadan wa ʼantum taɛlamun.
Wa ʼin kuntum fi raybin mimma nazzalna ɛala ɛabdina faʼtu bisuratin min miṯlihi wa adɛu cuhadaʼakum min duni Allahi ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Faʼin lam tafɛalu wa lan tafɛalu fa attaqu an-nara allati waquduha an-nasu wa al-ḥijaratu ʼuɛiddat lilkafirin.

Wa baccir al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati ʼanna lahum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu kullama ruziqu minha min ṯamaratin rizqan qalu haḏa al-laḏi ruziqna min qablu wa ʼutu bihi mutacabihan wa lahum fiha ʼazwajun muṭahharatun wa hum fiha xalidun.

ʼinna Allaha la yastaḥyi ʼan yaḍriba maṯalan ma baɛuḍatan fama fawqaha faʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu fayaɛlamuna ʼannahu al-ḥaqqu min rabbihim wa ʼamma al-laḏina kafaru fayaquluna maḏa ʼarada Allahu bihaḏa maṯalan yuḍillu bihi kaṯiran wa yahdi bihi kaṯiran wa ma yuḍillu bihi ʼilla al-fasiqin.
Al-laḏina yanquḍuna ɛahda Allahi min baɛdi miṯaqihi wa yaqṭaɛuna ma ʼamara Allahu bihi ʼan yuṣala wa yufsiduna fi al-ʼarḍi ʼulaʼika hum al-xasirun.
Kayfa takfuruna Billahi wa kuntum ʼamwatan faʼaḥyakum ṯumma yumitukum ṯumma yuḥyikum ṯumma ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Huwa al-laḏi xalaqa lakum ma fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan ṯumma astawa ʼila as-samaʼi fasawwahunna sabɛa samawatin wa huwa bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.

Wa ʼiḏ qala rabbuka lilmalaʼikati ʼinni jaɛilun fi al-ʼarḍi xalifatan qalu ʼatajɛalu fiha man yufsidu fiha wa yasfiku ad-dimaʼa wa naḥnu nusabbiḥu biḥamdika wa nuqaddisu laka qala ʼinni ʼaɛlamu ma la taɛlamun.
Wa ɛallama ʼadama al-ʼasmaʼa kullaha ṯumma ɛaraḍahum ɛala al-malaʼikati faqala ʼanbiʼuni biʼasmaʼi haʼuulaʼ ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Qalu subḥanaka la ɛilma lana ʼilla ma ɛallamtana ʼinnaka ʼanta al-ɛalimu al-ḥakim.
Qala ya ʼadamu ʼanbiʼhum biʼasmaʼihim falamma ʼanbaʼahum biʼasmaʼihim qala ʼalam ʼaqul lakum ʼinni ʼaɛlamu ɣayba as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ʼaɛlamu ma tubduna wa ma kuntum taktumun.
Wa ʼiḏ qulna lilmalaʼikati asjudu liʼdama fasajadu ʼilla ʼiblisa ʼaba wa astakbara wa kana mina al-kafirin.
Wa qulna ya ʼadamu askun ʼanta wa zawjuka al-jannata wa kula minha raɣadan ḥayṯu ciʼtuma wa la taqraba haḏihi ac-cajarata fatakuna mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Faʼazallahuma ac-cayṭanu ɛanha faʼaxrajahuma mimma kana fihi wa qulna ahbiṭu baɛḍukum libaɛḍin ɛaduwun wa lakum fi al-ʼarḍi mustaqarrun wa mataɛun ʼila ḥinin.
Fatalaqqa ʼadamu min rabbihi kalimatin fataba ɛalayhi ʼinnahu huwa at-tawwabu ar-raḥim.
Qulna ahbiṭu minha jamiɛan faʼimma yaʼtiyannakum minni hudan faman tabiɛa hudaya fala xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biʼayatina ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
Ya bani ʼisraʼila aḏkuru niɛmati allati ʼanɛamtu ɛalaykum wa ʼawfu biɛahdi ʼufi biɛahdikum wa ʼiyaya farhabun.
Wa ʼaminu bima ʼanzaltu muṣaddiqan lima maɛakum wa la takunu ʼawwala kafirin bihi wa la tactaru biʼayati ṯamanan qalilan wa ʼiyaya fa attaqun.
Wa la talbisu al-ḥaqqa bil-baṭili wa taktumu al-ḥaqqa wa ʼantum taɛlamun.
Wa ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatu az-zakata wa arkaɛu maɛa ar-rakiɛin.
ʼataʼmuruna an-nasa bil-birri wa tansawna ʼanfusakum wa ʼantum tatluna al-kitaba ʼafala taɛqilun.
Wa astaɛinu biṣ-ṣabri wa aṣ-ṣalati wa ʼinnaha lakabiratun ʼilla ɛala al-xaciɛin.
Al-laḏina yaḏ̣unnuna ʼannahum mulaqu rabbihim wa ʼannahum ʼilayhi rajiɛun.
Ya bani ʼisraʼila aḏkuru niɛmati allati ʼanɛamtu ɛalaykum wa ʼanni faḍḍaltukum ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Wa attaqu yawman la tajzi nafsun ɛan nafsin cayʼan wa la yuqbalu minha cafaɛatun wa la yuʼxaḏu minha ɛadlun wa la hum yunṣarun.
Wa ʼiḏ najjaynakum min ʼali firɛawna yasumunakum suʼa al-ɛaḏabi yuḏabbiḥuna ʼabnaʼakum wa yastaḥyuna nisaʼakum wa fi ḏalikum balaʼun min rabbikum ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa ʼiḏ faraqna bikum al-baḥra faʼanjaynakum wa ʼaɣraqna ʼala firɛawna wa ʼantum tanḏ̣urun.
Wa ʼiḏ waɛadna musa ʼarbaɛina laylatan ṯumma attaxaḏtum al-ɛijla min baɛdihi wa ʼantum ḏ̣alimun.
Ṯumma ɛafawna ɛankum min baɛdi ḏalika laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼatayna musa al-kitaba wa al-furqana laɛallakum tahtadun.

Wa ʼiḏ qala musa liqawmihi ya qawmi ʼinnakum ḏ̣alamtum ʼanfusakum biattixaḏikum al-ɛijla fatubu ʼila bariʼikum faqtulu ʼanfusakum ḏalikum xayrun lakum ɛinda bariʼikum fataba ɛalaykum ʼinnahu huwa at-tawwabu ar-raḥim.
Wa ʼiḏ qultum ya musa lan nuʼmina laka ḥatta nara Allaha jahratan faʼaxaḏatkum aṣ-ṣaɛiqatu wa ʼantum tanḏ̣urun.
Ṯumma baɛaṯnakum min baɛdi mawtikum laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa ḏ̣allalna ɛalaykum al-ɣamama wa ʼanzalna ɛalaykum al-manna wa as-salwa kulu min ṭayyibati ma razaqnakum wa ma ḏ̣alamuna wa lakin kanu ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.
Wa ʼiḏ qulna adxulu haḏihi al-qaryata fakulu minha ḥayṯu ciʼtum raɣadan wa adxulu al-baba sujjadan wa qulu ḥiṭṭatun naɣfir lakum xaṭayakum wa sanazidu al-muḥsinin.
Fabaddala al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu qawlan ɣayra al-laḏi qila lahum faʼanzalna ɛala al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu rijzan mina as-samaʼi bima kanu yafsuqun.

Wa ʼiḏ astasqa musa liqawmihi faqulna aḍrib biɛaṣaka al-ḥajara fanfajarat minhu aṯnata ɛacrata ɛaynan qad ɛalima kullu ʼunasin macrabahum kulu wa acrabu min rizqi Allahi wa la taɛṯaw fi al-ʼarḍi mufsidin.

Wa ʼiḏ qultum ya musa lan naṣbira ɛala ṭaɛamin waḥidin fadɛu lana rabbaka yuxrij lana mimma tunbitu al-ʼarḍu min baqliha wa qiṯṯaʼiha wa fumiha wa ɛadasiha wa baṣaliha qala ʼatastabdiluna al-laḏi huwa ʼadna bial-laḏi huwa xayrun ahbiṭu miṣran faʼinna lakum ma saʼaltum wa ḍuribat ɛalayhim aḏ-ḏillatu wa al-maskanatu wa baʼu biɣaḍabin mina Allahi ḏalika biʼannahum kanu yakfuruna biʼayati Allahi wa yaqtuluna an-nabiyina biɣayri al-ḥaqqi ḏalika bima ɛaṣaw wa kanu yaɛtadun.

ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa al-laḏina hadu wa an-naṣara wa aṣ-ṣabiʼina man ʼamana Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan falahum ʼajruhum ɛinda rabbihim wa la xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏna miṯaqakum wa rafaɛna fawqakum aṭ-ṭura xuḏu ma ʼataynakum biquwatin wa aḏkuru ma fihi laɛallakum tattaqun.
Ṯumma tawallaytum min baɛdi ḏalika falawla faḍlu Allahi ɛalaykum wa raḥmatuhu lakuntum mina al-xasirin.
Wa laqad ɛalimtum al-laḏina aɛtadaw minkum fi as-sabti faqulna lahum kunu qiradatan xasiʼin.
Fajaɛalnaha nakalan lima bayna yadayha wa ma xalfaha wa mawɛiḏ̣atan lilmuttaqin.
Wa ʼiḏ qala musa liqawmihi ʼinna Allaha yaʼmurukum ʼan taḏbaḥu baqaratan qalu ʼatattaxiḏuna huzuan qala ʼaɛuḏu Billahi ʼan ʼakuna mina al-jahilin.
Qalu adɛu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma hiya qala ʼinnahu yaqulu ʼinnaha baqaratun la fariḍun wa la bikrun ɛawanun bayna ḏalika fafɛalu ma tuʼmarun.
Qalu adɛu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma lawnuha qala ʼinnahu yaqulu ʼinnaha baqaratun ṣafraʼu faqiɛun lawnuha tasurru an-naḏ̣irin.
Qalu adɛu lana rabbaka yubayyin lana ma hiya ʼinna al-baqara tacabaha ɛalayna wa ʼinna ʼin caʼa Allahu lamuhtadun.
Qala ʼinnahu yaqulu ʼinnaha baqaratun la ḏalulun tuṯiru al-ʼarḍa wa la tasqi al-ḥarṯa musallamatun la ciyata fiha qalu al-ʼana jiʼta bil-ḥaqqi faḏabaḥuha wa ma kadu yafɛalun.
Wa ʼiḏ qataltum nafsan fa addaraʼtum fiha wa Allahu muxrijun ma kuntum taktumun.
Faqulna aḍribuhu bibaɛḍiha kaḏalika yuḥyi Allahu al-mawta wa yurikum ʼayatihi laɛallakum taɛqilun.

Ṯumma qasat qulubukum min baɛdi ḏalika fahiya kalḥijarati ʼaw ʼacaddu qaswatan wa ʼinna mina al-ḥijarati lama yatafajjaru minhu al-ʼanharu wa ʼinna minha lama yaccaqqaqu fayaxruju minhu al-maʼu wa ʼinna minha lama yahbiṭu min xacyati Allahi wa ma Allahu biɣafilin ɛamma taɛmalun.
ʼafataṭmaɛuna ʼan yuʼminu lakum wa qad kana fariqun minhum yasmaɛuna kalama Allahi ṯumma yuḥarrifunahu min baɛdi ma ɛaqaluhu wa hum yaɛlamun.
Wa ʼiḏa laqu al-laḏina ʼamanu qalu ʼamanna wa ʼiḏa xala baɛḍuhum ʼila baɛḍin qalu ʼatuḥaddiṯunahum bima fataḥa Allahu ɛalaykum liyuḥajjukum bihi ɛinda rabbikum ʼafala taɛqilun.
ʼawala yaɛlamuna ʼanna Allaha yaɛlamu ma yusirruna wa ma yuɛlinun.
Wa minhum ʼummiyuna la yaɛlamuna al-kitaba ʼilla ʼamaniya wa ʼin hum ʼilla yaḏ̣unnun.
Fawaylun lillaḏina yaktubuna al-kitaba biʼaydihim ṯumma yaquluna haḏa min ɛindi Allahi liyactaru bihi ṯamanan qalilan fawaylun lahum mimma katabat ʼaydihim wa waylun lahum mimma yaksibun.
Wa qalu lan tamassana an-naru ʼilla ʼayyaman maɛdudatan qul ʼattaxaḏtum ɛinda Allahi ɛahdan falan yuxlifa Allahu ɛahdahu ʼam taquluna ɛala Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
Bala man kasaba sayyiʼatan wa ʼaḥaṭat bihi xaṭiʼatuhu faʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati hum fiha xalidun.

Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏna miṯaqa bani ʼisraʼila la taɛbuduna ʼilla Allaha wa bil-walidayni ʼiḥsanan wa ḏi al-qurba wa al-yatama wa al-masakini wa qulu lilnnasi ḥusnan wa ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatu az-zakata ṯumma tawallaytum ʼilla qalilan minkum wa ʼantum muɛriḍun.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏna miṯaqakum la tasfikuna dimaʼakum wa la tuxrijuna ʼanfusakum min diyarikum ṯumma ʼaqrartum wa ʼantum tac/hadun.

Ṯumma ʼantum haʼuulaʼ taqtuluna ʼanfusakum wa tuxrijuna fariqan minkum min diyarihim taḏ̣aharuna ɛalayhim bil-ʼiṯmi wa al-ɛudwani wa ʼin yaʼtukum ʼusara tufaduhum wa huwa muḥarramun ɛalaykum ʼixrajuhum ʼa fatuʼminuna bibaɛḍi al-kitabi wa takfuruna bibaɛḍin fama jazaʼu man yafɛalu ḏalika minkum ʼilla xizyun fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa yawma al-qiyamati yuradduna ʼila ʼacaddi al-ɛaḏabi wa ma Allahu biɣafilin ɛamma taɛmalun.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina actaraw al-ḥayata ad-dunya bil-ʼaxirati fala yuxaffafu ɛanhum al-ɛaḏabu wa la hum yunṣarun.

Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-kitaba wa qaffayna min baɛdihi bir-rusuli wa ʼatayna ɛisa abna maryama al-bayyinati wa ʼayyadnahu biruḥi al-qudusi ʼa fakullama jaʼakum rasulun bima la tahwa ʼanfusukum astakbartum fafariqan kaḏḏabtum wa fariqan taqtulun.
Wa qalu qulubuna ɣulfun bal laɛanahum Allahu bikufrihim faqalilan ma yuʼminun.
Wa lamma jaʼahum kitabun min ɛindi Allahi muṣaddiqun lima maɛahum wa kanu min qablu yastaftiḥuna ɛala al-laḏina kafaru falamma jaʼahum ma ɛarafu kafaru bihi falaɛnatu Allahi ɛala al-kafirin.
Biʼsa ma actaraw bihi ʼanfusahum ʼan yakfuru bima ʼanzala Allahu baɣyan ʼan yunazzila Allahu min faḍlih ɛala man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi fabaʼu biɣaḍabin ɛala ɣaḍabin wa lilkafirina ɛaḏabun muhinun.

Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum ʼaminu bima ʼanzala Allahu qalu nuʼminu bima ʼunzila ɛalayna wa yakfuruna bima waraʼahu wa huwa al-ḥaqqu muṣaddiqan lima maɛahum qul falima taqtuluna ʼanbiyaʼa Allahi min qablu ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Wa laqad jaʼakum musa bil-bayyinati ṯumma attaxaḏtum al-ɛijla min baɛdihi wa ʼantum ḏ̣alimun.

Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏna miṯaqakum wa rafaɛna fawqakum aṭ-ṭura xuḏu ma ʼataynakum biquwatin wa asmaɛu qalu samiɛna wa ɛaṣayna wa ʼucribu fi qulubihim al-ɛijla bikufrihim qul biʼsama yaʼmurukum bihi ʼimanukum ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Qul ʼin kanat lakum ad-daru al-ʼaxiratu ɛinda Allahi xaliṣatan min duni an-nasi fatamannaw al-mawta ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Wa lan yatamannawhu ʼabadan bima qaddamat ʼaydihim wa Allahu ɛalimun biḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Wa latajidannahum ʼaḥraṣa an-nasi ɛala ḥayatin wa mina al-laḏina ʼacraku yawaddu ʼaḥaduhum law yuɛammaru ʼalfa sanatin wa ma huwa bimuzaḥziḥihi mina al-ɛaḏabi ʼan yuɛammara wa Allahu baṣirun bima yaɛmalun.
Qul man kana ɛaduwan lijibrila faʼinnahu nazzalahu ɛala qalbika biʼiḏni Allahi muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi wa hudan wa bucra lilmuʼminin.
Man kana ɛaduwan Lillahi wa malaʼikatihi wa rusulihi wa jibrila wa mikala faʼinna Allaha ɛaduwun lilkafirin.
Wa laqad ʼanzalna ʼilayka ʼayatin bayyinatin wa ma yakfuru biha ʼilla al-fasiqun.
ʼawa kullama ɛahadu ɛahdan nabaḏahu fariqun minhum bal ʼakṯaruhum la yuʼminun.
Wa lamma jaʼahum rasulun min ɛindi Allahi muṣaddiqun lima maɛahum nabaḏa fariqun mina al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba kitaba Allahi waraʼa ḏ̣uhurihim kaʼannahum la yaɛlamun.

Wa attabaɛu ma tatlu ac-cayaṭinu ɛala mulki sulaymana wa ma kafara sulaymanu wa lakinna ac-cayaṭina kafaru yuɛallimuna an-nasa as-siḥra wa ma ʼunzila ɛala al-malakayni bibabila haruta wa maruta wa ma yuɛallimani min ʼaḥadin ḥatta yaqula ʼinnama naḥnu fitnatun fala takfur fayataɛallamuna minhuma ma yufarriquna bihi bayna al-marʼi wa zawjihi wa ma hum biḍarrina bihi min ʼaḥadin ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi wa yataɛallamuna ma yaḍurruhum wa la yanfaɛuhum wa laqad ɛalimu laman actarahu ma lahu fi al-ʼaxirati min xalaqin wa labiʼsa ma caraw bihi ʼanfusahum law kanu yaɛlamun.
Wa law ʼannahum ʼamanu wa attaqaw lamaṯubatun min ɛindi Allahi xayrun law kanu yaɛlamun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la taqulu raɛina wa qulu anḏ̣urna wa asmaɛu wa lilkafirina ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Ma yawaddu al-laḏina kafaru min ʼahli al-kitabi wa la al-mucrikina ʼan yunazzala ɛalaykum min xayrin min rabbikum wa Allahu yaxtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yacaʼu wa Allahu ḏu al-faḍli al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Ma nansax min ʼayatin ʼaw nunsiha naʼti bixayrin minha ʼaw miṯliha ʼalam taɛlam ʼanna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
ʼalam taɛlam ʼanna Allaha lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma lakum min duni Allahi min wa liyin wa la naṣirin.
ʼam turiduna ʼan tasʼalu rasulakum kama suʼila musa min qablu wa man yatabaddal al-kufra bil-ʼimani faqad ḍalla sawaʼa as-sabil.

Wadda kaṯirun min ʼahli al-kitabi law yaruddunakum min baɛdi ʼimanikum kuffaran ḥasadan min ɛindi ʼanfusihim min baɛdi ma tabayyana lahum al-ḥaqqu faɛfu wa aṣfaḥu ḥatta yaʼtiya Allahu biʼamrihi ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatu az-zakata wa ma tuqaddimu liʼnfusikum min xayrin tajiduhu ɛinda Allahi ʼinna Allaha bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
Wa qalu lan yadxula al-jannata ʼilla man kana hudan ʼaw naṣara tilka ʼamaniyuhum qul hatu burhanakum ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Bala man ʼaslama wajhahu Lillahi wa huwa muḥsinun falahu ʼajruhu ɛinda rabbihi wa la xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.

Wa qalat al-yahudu laysat an-naṣara ɛala cayʼin wa qalat an-naṣara laysat al-yahudu ɛala cayʼin wa hum yatluna al-kitaba kaḏalika qala al-laḏina la yaɛlamuna miṯla qawlihim fa-Allahu yaḥkumu baynahum yawma al-qiyamati fima kanu fihi yaxtalifun.

Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman manaɛa masajida Allahi ʼan yuḏkara fiha asmuhu wa saɛa fi xarabiha ʼulaʼika ma kana lahum ʼan yadxuluha ʼila xaʼifina lahum fi ad-dunya xizyun wa lahum fi al-ʼaxirati ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa Lillahi al-macriqu wa al-maɣribu faʼaynama tuwallu faṯamma wajhu Allahi ʼinna Allaha wasiɛun ɛalimun.
Wa qalu attaxaḏa Allahu waladan subḥanahu bal lahu ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi kullun lahu qanitun.
Badiɛu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ʼiḏa qaḍa ʼamran faʼinnama yaqulu lahu kun fayakun.
Wa qala al-laḏina la yaɛlamuna lawla yukallimuna Allahu ʼaw taʼtina ʼayatun kaḏalika qala al-laḏina min qablihim miṯla qawlihim tacabahat qulubuhum qad bayyanna al-ʼayati liqawmin yuqinun.
ʼinna ʼarsalnaka bil-ḥaqqi baciran wa naḏiran wa la tusʼalu ɛan ʼaṣḥabi al-jaḥim.

Wa lan tarḍa ɛanka al-yahudu wa la an-naṣara ḥatta tattabiɛa millatahum qul ʼinna huda Allahi huwa al-huda wa laʼin attabaɛta ʼahwaʼahum baɛda al-laḏi jaʼaka mina al-ɛilmi ma laka mina Allahi min wa liyin wa la naṣirin.
Al-laḏina ʼataynahum al-kitaba yatlunahu ḥaqqa tilawatihi ʼulaʼika yuʼminuna bihi wa man yakfur bihi faʼulaʼika hum al-xasirun.
Ya bani ʼisraʼila aḏkuru niɛmati allati ʼanɛamtu ɛalaykum wa ʼanni faḍḍaltukum ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Wa attaqu yawman la tajzi nafsun ɛan nafsin cayʼan wa la yuqbalu minha ɛadlun wa la tanfaɛuha cafaɛatun wa la hum yunṣarun.
Wa ʼiḏ abtala ʼibrahima rabbuhu bikalimatin faʼatammahunna qala ʼinni jaɛiluka lilnnasi ʼimaman qala wa min ḏurriyati qala la yanalu ɛahdi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Wa ʼiḏ jaɛalna al-bayta maṯabatan lilnnasi wa ʼamnan wa attaxiḏu min maqami ʼibrahima muṣallan wa ɛahidna ʼila ʼibrahima wa ʼismaɛila ʼan ṭahhira bayti lilṭṭaʼifina wa al-ɛakifina wa ar-rukkaɛi as-sujud.

Wa ʼiḏ qala ʼibrahimu rabbi ajɛal haḏa baladan ʼaminan wa arzuq ʼahlahu mina aṯ-ṯamarati man ʼamana minhum Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri qala wa man kafara faʼumattiɛuhu qalilan ṯumma ʼaḍṭarruhu ʼila ɛaḏabi an-nari wa biʼsa al-maṣir.
Wa ʼiḏ yarfaɛu ʼibrahimu al-qawaɛida mina al-bayti wa ʼismaɛilu rabbana taqabbal minna ʼinnaka ʼanta as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Rabbana wa ajɛalna muslimayni laka wa min ḏurriyatina ʼummatan muslimatan laka wa ʼarina manasikana wa tub ɛalayna ʼinnaka ʼanta at-tawwabu ar-raḥim.
Rabbana wa abɛaṯ fihim rasulan minhum yatlu ɛalayhim ʼayatika wa yuɛallimuhum al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa yuzakkihim ʼinnaka ʼanta al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Wa man yarɣabu ɛan millati ʼibrahima ʼilla man safiha nafsahu wa laqad aṣṭafaynahu fi ad-dunya wa ʼinnahu fi al-ʼaxirati lamina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
ʼiḏ qala lahu rabbuhu ʼaslim qala ʼaslamtu lirabbi al-ɛalamin.
Wa waṣṣa biha ʼibrahimu banihi wa yaɛqubu ya baniya ʼinna Allaha aṣṭafa lakum ad-dina fala tamutunna ʼilla wa ʼantum muslimun.

ʼam kuntum cuhadaʼa ʼiḏ ḥaḍara yaɛquba al-mawtu ʼiḏ qala libanihi ma taɛbuduna min baɛdi qalu naɛbudu ʼilahaka wa ʼilaha ʼabaʼika ʼibrahima wa ʼismaɛila wa ʼisḥaqa ʼilahan waḥidan wa naḥnu lahu muslimun.
Tilka ʼummatun qad xalat laha ma kasabat wa lakum ma kasabtum wa la tusʼaluna ɛamma kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa qalu kunu hudan ʼaw naṣara tahtadu qul bal millata ʼibrahima ḥanifan wa ma kana mina al-mucrikin.

Qulu ʼamanna Billahi wa ma ʼunzila ʼilayna wa ma ʼunzila ʼila ʼibrahima wa ʼismaɛila wa ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba wa al-ʼasbaṭi wa ma ʼutiya musa wa ɛisa wa ma ʼutiya an-nabiyuna min rabbihim la nufarriqu bayna ʼaḥadin minhum wa naḥnu lahu muslimun.
Faʼin ʼamanu bimiṯli ma ʼamantum bihi faqad ahtadaw wa ʼin tawallaw faʼinnama hum fi ciqaqin fasayakfikahum Allahu wa huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Ṣibɣata Allahi wa man ʼaḥsanu mina Allahi ṣibɣatan wa naḥnu lahu ɛabidun.
Qul ʼatuḥajjunana fi Allahi wa huwa rabbuna wa rabbukum wa lana ʼaɛmaluna wa lakum ʼaɛmalukum wa naḥnu lahu muxliṣun.

ʼam taquluna ʼinna ʼibrahima wa ʼismaɛila wa ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba wa al-ʼasbaṭa kanu hudan ʼaw naṣara qul ʼaʼantum ʼaɛlamu ʼam Allahu wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman katama cahadatan ɛindahu mina Allahi wa ma Allahu biɣafilin ɛamma taɛmalun.
Tilka ʼummatun qad xalat laha ma kasabat wa lakum ma kasabtum wa la tusʼaluna ɛamma kanu yaɛmalun.
Sayaqulu as-sufahaʼu mina an-nasi ma wa llahum ɛan qiblatihim allati kanu ɛalayha qul Lillahi al-macriqu wa al-maɣribu yahdi man yacaʼu ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.

Wa kaḏalika jaɛalnakum ʼummatan wasaṭan litakunu cuhadaʼa ɛala an-nasi wa yakuna ar-rasulu ɛalaykum cahidan wa ma jaɛalna al-qiblata allati kunta ɛalayha ʼilla linaɛlama man yattabiɛu ar-rasula mimman yanqalibu ɛala ɛaqibayhi wa ʼin kanat lakabiratan ʼilla ɛala al-laḏina hada Allahu wa ma kana Allahu liyuḍiɛa ʼimanakum ʼinna Allaha bin-nasi laraʼufun raḥimun.

Qad nara taqalluba wajhika fi as-samaʼi falanuwalliyannaka qiblatan tarḍaha fawalli wajhaka caṭra al-masjidi al-ḥarami wa ḥayṯu ma kuntum fawallu wujuhakum caṭrahu wa ʼinna al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba layaɛlamuna ʼannahu al-ḥaqqu min rabbihim wa ma Allahu biɣafilin ɛamma yaɛmalun.

Wa laʼin ʼatayta al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba bikulli ʼayatin ma tabiɛu qiblataka wa ma ʼanta bitabiɛin qiblatahum wa ma baɛḍuhum bitabiɛin qiblata baɛḍin wa laʼin attabaɛta ʼahwaʼahum min baɛdi ma jaʼaka mina al-ɛilmi ʼinnaka ʼiḏan lamina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Al-laḏina ʼataynahum al-kitaba yaɛrifunahu kama yaɛrifuna ʼabnaʼahum wa ʼinna fariqan minhum layaktumuna al-ḥaqqa wa hum yaɛlamun.
Al-ḥaqqu min rabbika fala takunanna mina al-mumtarin.
Wa likullin wijhatun huwa muwalliha fastabiqu al-xayrati ʼayna ma takunu yaʼti bikum Allahu jamiɛan ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa min ḥayṯu xarajta fawalli wajhaka caṭra al-masjidi al-ḥarami wa ʼinnahu lalḥaqqu min rabbika wa ma Allahu biɣafilin ɛamma taɛmalun.

Wa min ḥayṯu xarajta fawalli wajhaka caṭra al-masjidi al-ḥarami wa ḥayṯu ma kuntum fawallu wujuhakum caṭrahu liʼalla yakuna lilnnasi ɛalaykum ḥujjatun ʼilla al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu minhum fala taxcawhum wa axcawni wa liʼatimma niɛmati ɛalaykum wa laɛallakum tahtadun.
Kama ʼarsalna fikum rasulan minkum yatlu ɛalaykum ʼayatina wa yuzakkikum wa yuɛallimukum al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa yuɛallimukum ma lam takunu taɛlamun.
Faḏkuruni ʼaḏkurkum wa ackuru li wa la takfurun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu astaɛinu biṣ-ṣabri wa aṣ-ṣalati ʼinna Allaha maɛa aṣ-ṣabirin.
Wa la taqulu liman yuqtalu fi sabili Allahi ʼamwatun bal ʼaḥyaʼun wa lakin la tacɛurun.
Wa lanabluwannakum bicayʼin mina al-xawfi wa al-juɛi wa naqṣin mina al-ʼamwli wa al-ʼanfusi wa aṯ-ṯamarati wa baccir aṣ-ṣabirin.
Al-laḏina ʼiḏa ʼaṣabat/hum muṣibatun qalu ʼinna Lillahi wa ʼinna ʼilayhi rajiɛun.
ʼulaʼika ɛalayhim ṣalawatun min rabbihim wa raḥmatun wa ʼulaʼika hum al-muhtadun.
ʼinna aṣ-ṣafa wa al-marwata min caɛaʼiri Allahi faman ḥajja al-bayta ʼaw aɛtamara fala junaḥa ɛalayhi ʼan yaṭṭawwafa bihima wa man taṭawwaɛa xayran faʼinna Allaha cakirun ɛalimun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yaktumuna ma ʼanzalna mina al-bayyinati wa al-huda min baɛdi ma bayyannahu lilnnasi fi al-kitabi ʼulaʼika yalɛanuhum Allahu wa yalɛanuhum al-laɛinun.
ʼilla al-laḏina tabu wa ʼaṣlaḥu wa bayyanu faʼulaʼika ʼatubu ɛalayhim wa ʼana at-tawwabu ar-raḥim.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru wa matu wa hum kuffarun ʼulaʼika ɛalayhim laɛnatu Allahi wa al-malaʼikati wa an-nasi ʼajmaɛin.
Xalidina fiha la yuxaffafu ɛanhum al-ɛaḏabu wa la hum yunḏ̣arun.
Wa ʼilahukum ʼilahun waḥidun la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa ar-raḥmanu ar-raḥim.

ʼinna fi xalqi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa axtilafi al-layli wa an-nahari wa al-fulki allati tajri fi al-baḥri bima yanfaɛu an-nasa wa ma ʼanzala Allahu mina as-samaʼi min maʼin faʼaḥya bihi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha wa baṯṯa fiha min kulli dabbatin wa taṣrifi ar-riyaḥi wa as-saḥabi al-musaxxari bayna as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi lʼayatin liqawmin yaɛqilun.

Wa mina an-nasi man yattaxiḏu min duni Allahi ʼandadan yuḥibbunahum kaḥubbi Allahi wa al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼacaddu ḥubban Lillahi wa law yara al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu ʼiḏ yarawna al-ɛaḏaba ʼanna al-quwata Lillahi jamiɛan wa ʼanna Allaha cadidu al-ɛaḏab.
ʼiḏ tabarraʼa al-laḏina attubiɛu mina al-laḏina attabaɛu wa raʼaw al-ɛaḏaba wa taqaṭṭaɛat bihim al-ʼasbab.
Wa qala al-laḏina attabaɛu law ʼanna lana karratan fanatabarraʼa minhum kama tabarraʼu minna kaḏalika yurihim Allahu ʼaɛmalahum ḥasaratin ɛalayhim wa ma hum bixarijina mina an-nar.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu kulu mimma fi al-ʼarḍi ḥalalan ṭayyiban wa la tattabiɛu xuṭuwati ac-cayṭani ʼinnahu lakum ɛaduwun mubin.
ʼinnama yaʼmurukum bis-suʼi wa al-faḥcaʼi wa ʼan taqulu ɛala Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum attabiɛu ma ʼanzala Allahu qalu bal nattabiɛu ma ʼalfayna ɛalayhi ʼabaʼana ʼawalaw kana ʼabaʼuuhum la yaɛqiluna cayʼan wa la yahtadun.
Wa maṯalu al-laḏina kafaru kamaṯali al-laḏi yanɛiqu bima la yasmaɛu ʼilla duɛaʼan wa nidaʼan ṣummun bukmun ɛumyun fahum la yaɛqilun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu kulu min ṭayyibati ma razaqnakum wa ackuru Lillahi ʼin kuntum ʼiyahu taɛbudun.
ʼinnama ḥarrama ɛalaykum al-maytata wa ad-dama wa laḥma al-xinziri wa ma ʼuhilla bihi liɣayri Allahi faman aḍṭurra ɣayra baɣin wa la ɛadin fala ʼiṯma ɛalayhi ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.

ʼinna al-laḏina yaktumuna ma ʼanzala Allahu mina al-kitabi wa yactaruna bihi ṯamanan qalilan ʼulaʼika ma yaʼkuluna fi buṭunihim ʼilla an-nara wa la yukallimuhum Allahu yawma al-qiyamati wa la yuzakkihim wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina actaraw aḍ-ḍalalata bil-huda wa al-ɛaḏaba bil-maɣfirati fama ʼaṣbarahum ɛala an-nar.
Ḏalika biʼanna Allaha nazzala al-kitaba bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼinna al-laḏina axtalafu fi al-kitabi lafi ciqaqin baɛidin.

Laysa al-birra ʼan tuwallu wujuhakum qibala al-macriqi wa al-maɣribi wa lakinna al-birra man ʼamana Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa al-malaʼikati wa al-kitabi wa an-nabiyina wa ʼata al-mala ɛala ḥubbihi ḏawi al-qurba wa al-yatama wa al-masakina wa abna as-sabili wa as-saʼilina wa fi ar-riqabi wa ʼaqama aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼata az-zakata wa al-mufuna biɛahdihim ʼiḏa ɛahadu wa aṣ-ṣabirina fi al-baʼsaʼi wa aḍ-ḍarraʼi wa ḥina al-baʼsi ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ṣadaqu wa ʼulaʼika hum al-muttaqun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu kutiba ɛalaykum al-qiṣaṣu fi al-qatla al-ḥurru bil-ḥurri wa al-ɛabdu bil-ɛabdi wa al-ʼunṯa bil-ʼunṯa faman ɛufiya lahu min ʼaxihi cayʼun fa attibaɛun bil-maɛrufi wa ʼadaʼun ʼilayhi biʼiḥsanin ḏalika taxfifun min rabbikum wa raḥmatun faman aɛtada baɛda ḏalika falahu ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa lakum fi al-qiṣaṣi ḥayatun ya ʼuli al-ʼalbabi laɛallakum tattaqun.
Kutiba ɛalaykum ʼiḏa ḥaḍara ʼaḥadakum al-mawtu ʼin taraka xayran al-waṣiyatu lilwalidayni wa al-ʼaqrabina bil-maɛrufi ḥaqqan ɛala al-muttaqin.
Faman baddalahu baɛdama samiɛahu faʼinnama ʼiṯmuhu ɛala al-laḏina yubaddilunahu ʼinna Allaha samiɛun ɛalimun.
Faman xafa min muṣin janafan ʼaw ʼiṯman faʼaṣlaḥa baynahum fala ʼiṯma ɛalayhi ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu kutiba ɛalaykum aṣ-ṣiyamu kama kutiba ɛala al-laḏina min qablikum laɛallakum tattaqun.

ʼayyaman maɛdudatin faman kana minkum mariḍan ʼaw ɛala safarin faɛiddatun min ʼayyamin ʼuxara wa ɛala al-laḏina yuṭiqunahu fidyatun ṭaɛamu miskinin faman taṭawwaɛa xayran fahuwa xayrun lahu wa ʼan taṣumu xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.

Cahru ramaḍana al-laḏi ʼunzila fihi al-qurʼanu hudan lilnnasi wa bayyinatin mina al-huda wa al-furqani faman cahida minkum ac-cahra falyaṣumhu wa man kana mariḍan ʼaw ɛala safarin faɛiddatun min ʼayyamin ʼuxara yuridu Allahu bikum al-yusra wa la yuridu bikum al-ɛusra wa litukmilu al-ɛiddata wa litukabbiru Allaha ɛala ma hadakum wa laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa ʼiḏa saʼalaka ɛibadi ɛanni faʼinni qaribun ʼujibu daɛwata ad-daɛi ʼiḏa daɛani falyastajibu li wa liuʼminu bi laɛallahum yarcudun.

ʼuḥilla lakum laylata aṣ-ṣiyami ar-rafaṯu ʼila nisaʼikum hunna libasun lakum wa ʼantum libasun lahunna ɛalima Allahu ʼannakum kuntum taxtanuna ʼanfusakum fataba ɛalaykum wa ɛafa ɛankum falʼana baciruhunna wa abtaɣu ma kataba Allahu lakum wa kulu wa acrabu ḥatta yatabayyana lakum al-xayṭu al-ʼabyaḍu mina al-xayṭi al-ʼaswadi mina al-fajri ṯumma ʼatimmu aṣ-ṣiyama ʼila al-layli wa la tubaciruhunna wa ʼantum ɛakifuna fi al-masajidi tilka ḥududu Allahi fala taqrabuha kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu ʼayatihi lilnnasi laɛallahum yattaqun.
Wa la taʼkulu ʼamwalakum baynakum bil-baṭili wa tudlu biha ʼila al-ḥukkami litaʼkulu fariqan min ʼamwali an-nasi bil-ʼiṯmi wa ʼantum taɛlamun.

Yasʼalunaka ɛan al-ʼahillati qul hiya mawaqitu lilnnasi wa al-ḥajji wa laysa al-birru biʼan taʼtu al-buyuta min ḏ̣uhuriha wa lakinna al-birra man attaqa wa ʼtu al-buyuta min ʼabwabiha wa attaqu Allaha laɛallakum tufliḥun.
Wa qatilu fi sabili Allahi al-laḏina yuqatilunakum wa la taɛtadu ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu al-muɛtadin.

Waqtuluhum ḥayṯu ṯaqiftumuhum wa ʼaxrijuhum min ḥayṯu ʼaxrajukum wa al-fitnatu ʼacaddu mina al-qatli wa la tuqatiluhum ɛinda al-masjidi al-ḥarami ḥatta yuqatilukum fihi faʼin qatalukum faqtuluhum kaḏalika jazaʼu al-kafirin.
Faʼin antahaw faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa qatiluhum ḥatta la takuna fitnatun wa yakuna ad-dinu Lillahi faʼin antahaw fala ɛudwana ʼilla ɛala aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Ac-cahru al-ḥaramu bic-cahri al-ḥarami wa al-ḥurumatu qiṣaṣun faman aɛtada ɛalaykum faɛtadu ɛalayhi bimiṯli ma aɛtada ɛalaykum wa attaqu Allaha wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha maɛa al-muttaqin.
Wa ʼanfiqu fi sabili Allahi wa la tulqu biʼaydikum ʼila at-tahlukati wa ʼaḥsinu ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muḥsinin.

Wa ʼatimmu al-ḥajja wa al-ɛumrata Lillahi faʼin ʼuḥṣirtum fama astaysara mina al-hadyi wa la taḥliqu ruʼsakum ḥatta yabluɣa al-hadyu maḥillahu faman kana minkum mariḍan ʼaw bihi ʼaḏan min raʼsihi fafidyatun min ṣiyamin ʼaw ṣadaqatin ʼaw nusukin faʼiḏa ʼamintum faman tamattaɛa bil-ɛumrati ʼila al-ḥajji fama astaysara mina al-hadyi faman lam yajid faṣiyamu ṯalaṯati ʼayyamin fi al-ḥajji wa sabɛatin ʼiḏa rajaɛtum tilka ɛacaratun kamilatun ḏalika liman lam yakun ʼahluhu ḥaḍiri al-masjidi al-ḥarami wa attaqu Allaha wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqab.

Al-ḥajju ʼac/hurun maɛlumatun faman faraḍa fihinna al-ḥajja fala rafaṯa wa la fusuqa wa la jidala fi al-ḥajji wa ma tafɛalu min xayrin yaɛlamhu Allahu wa tazawwadu faʼinna xayra az-zadi at-taqwa wa attaquni ya ʼuli al-ʼalbab.
Laysa ɛalaykum junaḥun ʼan tabtaɣu faḍlan min rabbikum faʼiḏa ʼafaḍtum min ɛarafatin faḏkuru Allaha ɛinda al-macɛari al-ḥarami wa aḏkuruhu kama hadakum wa ʼin kuntum min qablihi lamina aḍ-ḍallin.
Ṯumma ʼafiḍu min ḥayṯu ʼafaḍa an-nasu wa astaɣfiru Allaha ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Faʼiḏa qaḍaytum manasikakum faḏkuru Allaha kaḏikrikum ʼabaʼakum ʼaw ʼacadda ḏikran famina an-nasi man yaqulu rabbana ʼatina fi ad-dunya wa ma lahu fi al-ʼaxirati min xalaqin.
Wa minhum man yaqulu rabbana ʼatina fi ad-dunya ḥasanatan wa fi al-ʼaxirati ḥasanatan wa qina ɛaḏaba an-nar.
ʼulaʼika lahum naṣibun mimma kasabu wa Allahu sariɛu al-ḥisab.
Wa aḏkuru Allaha fi ʼayyamin maɛdudatin faman taɛajjala fi yawmayni fala ʼiṯma ɛalayhi wa man taʼaxxara fala ʼiṯma ɛalayhi liman attaqa wa attaqu Allaha wa aɛlamu ʼannakum ʼilayhi tuḥcarun.
Wa mina an-nasi man yuɛjibuka qawluhu fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa yuc/hidu Allaha ɛala ma fi qalbihi wa huwa ʼaladdu al-xiṣam.
Wa ʼiḏa tawalla saɛa fi al-ʼarḍi liyufsida fiha wa yuhlika al-ḥarṯa wa an-nasla wa Allahu la yuḥibbu al-fasad.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahu attaqi Allaha ʼaxaḏat/hu al-ɛizzatu bil-ʼiṯmi faḥasbuhu jahannamu wa labiʼsa al-mihad.
Wa mina an-nasi man yacri nafsahu abtiɣaʼa marḍati Allahi wa Allahu raʼufun bil-ɛibad.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu adxulu fi as-silmi kaffatan wa la tattabiɛu xuṭuwati ac-cayṭani ʼinnahu lakum ɛaduwun mubinun.
Faʼin zalaltum min baɛdi ma jaʼatkum al-bayyinatu faɛlamu ʼanna Allaha ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Hal yanḏ̣uruna ʼilla ʼan yaʼtiyahum Allahu fi ḏ̣ulalin mina al-ɣamami wa al-malaʼikatu wa quḍiya al-ʼamru wa ʼila Allahi turjaɛu al-ʼumur.
Sal bani ʼisraʼila kam ʼataynahum min ʼayatin bayyinatin wa man yubaddil niɛmata Allahi min baɛdi ma jaʼat/hu faʼinna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Zuyyina lillaḏina kafaru al-ḥayatu ad-dunya wa yasxaruna mina al-laḏina ʼamanu wa al-laḏina attaqaw fawqahum yawma al-qiyamati wa Allahu yarzuqu man yacaʼu biɣayri ḥisabin.

Kana an-nasu ʼummatan waḥidatan fabaɛaṯa Allahu an-nabiyina mubaccirina wa munḏirina wa ʼanzala maɛahum al-kitaba bil-ḥaqqi liyaḥkuma bayna an-nasi fima axtalafu fihi wa ma axtalafa fihi ʼilla al-laḏina ʼutuhu min baɛdi ma jaʼat/hum al-bayyinatu baɣyan baynahum fahada Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu lima axtalafu fihi mina al-ḥaqqi biʼiḏnihi wa Allahu yahdi man yacaʼu ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.

ʼam ḥasibtum ʼan tadxulu al-jannata wa lamma yaʼtikum maṯalu al-laḏina xalaw min qablikum massat/hum al-baʼsaʼu wa aḍ-ḍarraʼu wa zulzilu ḥatta yaqula ar-rasulu wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu mata naṣru Allahi ʼala ʼinna naṣra Allahi qaribun.
Yasʼalunaka maḏa yunfiquna qul ma ʼanfaqtum min xayrin falilwalidayni wa al-ʼaqrabina wa al-yatama wa al-masakini wa abni as-sabili wa ma tafɛalu min xayrin faʼinna Allaha bihi ɛalimun.
Kutiba ɛalaykum al-qitalu wa huwa kurhun lakum wa ɛasa ʼan takrahu cayʼan wa huwa xayrun lakum wa ɛasa ʼan tuḥibbu cayʼan wa huwa carrun lakum wa Allahu yaɛlamu wa ʼantum la taɛlamun.

Yasʼalunaka ɛan ac-cahri al-ḥarami qitalin fihi qul qitalun fihi kabirun wa ṣaddun ɛan sabili Allahi wa kufrun bihi wa al-masjidi al-ḥarami wa ʼixraju ʼahlihi minhu ʼakbaru ɛinda Allahi wa al-fitnatu ʼakbaru mina al-qatli wa la yazaluna yuqatilunakum ḥatta yaruddukum ɛan dinikum ʼin astaṭaɛu wa man yartadid minkum ɛan dinihi fayamut wa huwa kafirun faʼulaʼika ḥabiṭat ʼaɛmaluhum fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa al-laḏina hajaru wa jahadu fi sabili Allahi ʼulaʼika yarjuna raḥmata Allahi wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.

Yasʼalunaka ɛan al-xamri wa al-maysiri qul fihima ʼiṯmun kabirun wa manafiɛu lilnnasi wa ʼiṯmuhuma ʼakbaru min nafɛihima wa yasʼalunaka maḏa yunfiquna qul al-ɛafwa kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum al-ʼayati laɛallakum tatafakkarun.

Fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa yasʼalunaka ɛan al-yatama qul ʼiṣlaḥun lahum xayrun wa ʼin tuxaliṭuhum faʼixwanukum wa Allahu yaɛlamu al-mufsida mina al-muṣliḥi wa law caʼa Allahu laʼaɛnatakum ʼinna Allaha ɛazizun ḥakimun.

Wa la tankiḥu al-mucrikati ḥatta yuʼminna wa laʼamatun muʼminatun xayrun min mucrikatin wa law ʼaɛjabatkum wa la tunkiḥu al-mucrikina ḥatta yuʼminu wa laɛabdun muʼminun xayrun min mucrikin wa law ʼaɛjabakum ʼulaʼika yadɛuna ʼila an-nari wa Allahu yadɛu ʼila al-jannati wa al-maɣfirati biʼiḏnihi wa yubayyinu ʼayatihi lilnnasi laɛallahum yataḏakkarun.

Wa yasʼalunaka ɛan al-maḥiḍi qul huwa ʼaḏan faɛtazilu an-nisaʼ fi al-maḥiḍi wa la taqrabuhunna ḥatta yaṭhurna faʼiḏa taṭahharna faʼtuhunna min ḥayṯu ʼamarakum Allahu ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu at-tawwabina wa yuḥibbu al-mutaṭahhirin.
Nisaʼuukum ḥarṯun lakum faʼtu ḥarṯakum ʼanna ciʼtum wa qaddimu liʼnfusikum wa attaqu Allaha wa aɛlamu ʼannakum mulaquhu wa baccir al-muʼminin.
Wa la tajɛalu Allaha ɛurḍatan liʼymanikum ʼan tabarru wa tattaqu wa tuṣliḥu bayna an-nasi wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.
La yuʼaxiḏukum Allahu bil-laɣwi fi ʼaymanikum wa lakin yuʼaxiḏukum bima kasabat qulubukum wa Allahu ɣafurun ḥalimun.
Lillaḏina yuʼluna min nisaʼihim tarabbuṣu ʼarbaɛati ʼac/hurin faʼin faʼu faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa ʼin ɛazamu aṭ-ṭalaqa faʼinna Allaha samiɛun ɛalimun.

Wa al-muṭallaqatu yatarabbaṣna biʼanfusihinna ṯalaṯata quruʼin wa la yaḥillu lahunna ʼan yaktumna ma xalaqa Allahu fi ʼarḥamihinna ʼin kunna yuʼminna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa buɛulatuhunna ʼaḥaqqu biraddihinna fi ḏalika ʼin ʼaradu ʼiṣlaḥan wa lahunna miṯlu al-laḏi ɛalayhinna bil-maɛrufi wa lilrrijali ɛalayhinna darajatun wa Allahu ɛazizun ḥakimun.

Aṭ-ṭalaqu marratani faʼimsakun bimaɛrufin ʼaw tasriḥun biʼiḥsanin wa la yaḥillu lakum ʼan taʼxuḏu mimma ʼataytumuhunna cayʼan ʼilla ʼan yaxafa ʼalla yuqima ḥududa Allahi faʼin xiftum ʼalla yuqima ḥududa Allahi fala junaḥa ɛalayhima fima aftadat bihi tilka ḥududu Allahi fala taɛtaduha wa man yataɛadda ḥududa Allahi faʼulaʼika hum aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.

Faʼin ṭallaqaha fala taḥillu lahu min baɛdu ḥatta tankiḥa zawjan ɣayrahu faʼin ṭallaqaha fala junaḥa ɛalayhima ʼan yatarajaɛa ʼin ḏ̣anna ʼan yuqima ḥududa Allahi wa tilka ḥududu Allahi yubayyinuha liqawmin yaɛlamun.

Wa ʼiḏa ṭallaqtum an-nisaʼ fabalaɣna ʼajalahunna faʼamsikuhunna bimaɛrufin ʼaw sarriḥuhunna bimaɛrufin wa la tumsikuhunna ḍiraran litaɛtadu wa man yafɛal ḏalika faqad ḏ̣alama nafsahu wa la tattaxiḏu ʼayati Allahi huzuan wa aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum wa ma ʼanzala ɛalaykum mina al-kitabi wa al-ḥikmati yaɛiḏ̣ukum bihi wa attaqu Allaha wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.

Wa ʼiḏa ṭallaqtum an-nisaʼ fabalaɣna ʼajalahunna fala taɛḍuluhunna ʼan yankiḥna ʼazwajahunna ʼiḏa taraḍaw baynahum bil-maɛrufi ḏalika yuɛaḏ̣u bihi man kana minkum yuʼminu Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri ḏalikum ʼazka lakum wa ʼaṭharu wa Allahu yaɛlamu wa ʼantum la taɛlamun.

Wa al-walidatu yurḍiɛna ʼawladahunna ḥawlayni kamilayni liman ʼarada ʼan yutimma ar-raḍaɛata wa ɛala al-mawludi lahu rizquhunna wa kiswatuhunna bil-maɛrufi la tukallafu nafsun ʼilla wusɛaha la tuḍarra wa a-datun biwaladiha wa la mawludun lahu biwaladihi wa ɛala al-wariṯi miṯlu ḏalika faʼin ʼarada fiṣalan ɛan taraḍin minhuma wa tacawurin fala junaḥa ɛalayhima wa ʼin ʼaradtum ʼan tastarḍiɛu ʼawladakum fala junaḥa ɛalaykum ʼiḏa sallamtum ma ʼataytum bil-maɛrufi wa attaqu Allaha wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.

Wa al-laḏina yutawaffawna minkum wa yaḏaruna ʼazwajan yatarabbaṣna biʼanfusihinna ʼarbaɛata ʼac/hurin wa ɛacran faʼiḏa balaɣna ʼajalahunna fala junaḥa ɛalaykum fima faɛalna fi ʼanfusihinna bil-maɛrufi wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabirun.

Wa la junaḥa ɛalaykum fima ɛarraḍtum bihi min xiṭbati an-nisaʼ ʼaw ʼaknantum fi ʼanfusikum ɛalima Allahu ʼannakum sataḏkurunahunna wa lakin la tuwaɛiduhunna sirran ʼilla ʼan taqulu qawlan maɛrufan wa la taɛzimu ɛuqdata an-nikaḥi ḥatta yabluɣa al-kitabu ʼajalahu wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha yaɛlamu ma fi ʼanfusikum faḥḏaruhu wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha ɣafurun ḥalimun.

La junaḥa ɛalaykum ʼin ṭallaqtum an-nisaʼ ma lam tamassuhunna ʼaw tafriḍu lahunna fariḍatan wa mattiɛuhunna ɛala al-musiɛi qadaruhu wa ɛala al-muqtiri qadaruhu mataɛan bil-maɛrufi ḥaqqan ɛala al-muḥsinin.

Wa ʼin ṭallaqtumuhunna min qabli ʼan tamassuhunna wa qad faraḍtum lahunna fariḍatan faniṣfu ma faraḍtum ʼilla ʼan yaɛfuna ʼaw yaɛfuwa al-laḏi biyadihi ɛuqdatu an-nikaḥi wa ʼan taɛfu ʼaqrabu lilttaqwa wa la tansaw al-faḍla baynakum ʼinna Allaha bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
Ḥafiḏ̣u ɛala aṣ-ṣalawati wa aṣ-ṣalati al-wusṭa wa qumu Lillahi qanitin.
Faʼin xiftum farijalan ʼaw rukbanan faʼiḏa ʼamintum faḏkuru Allaha kama ɛallamakum ma lam takunu taɛlamun.

Wa al-laḏina yutawaffawna minkum wa yaḏaruna ʼazwajan waṣiyatan liʼzwajihim mataɛan ʼila al-ḥawli ɣayra ʼixrajin faʼin xarajna fala junaḥa ɛalaykum fi ma faɛalna fi ʼanfusihinna min maɛrufin wa Allahu ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Wa lilmuṭallaqati mataɛun bil-maɛrufi ḥaqqan ɛala al-muttaqin.
Kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ʼayatihi laɛallakum taɛqilun.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina xaraju min diyarihim wa hum ʼulufun ḥaḏara al-mawti faqala lahum Allahu mutu ṯumma ʼaḥyahum ʼinna Allaha laḏu faḍlin ɛala an-nasi wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yackurun.
Wa qatilu fi sabili Allahi wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha samiɛun ɛalimun.
Man ḏa al-laḏi yuqriḍu Allaha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍaɛifahu lahu ʼaḍɛafan kaṯiratan wa Allahu yaqbiḍu wa yabsuṭu wa ʼilayhi turjaɛun.

ʼalam tara ʼila al-malaʼi min bani ʼisraʼila min baɛdi musa ʼiḏ qalu linabiyin lahum abɛaṯ lana malikan nuqatil fi sabili Allahi qala hal ɛasaytum ʼin kutiba ɛalaykum al-qitalu ʼalla tuqatilu qalu wa ma lana ʼalla nuqatila fi sabili Allahi wa qad ʼuxrijna min diyarina wa ʼabnaʼina falamma kutiba ɛalayhim al-qitalu tawallaw ʼilla qalilan minhum wa Allahu ɛalimun biḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Wa qala lahum nabiyuhum ʼinna Allaha qad baɛaṯa lakum ṭaluta malikan qalu ʼanna yakunu lahu al-mulku ɛalayna wa naḥnu ʼaḥaqqu bil-mulki minhu wa lam yuʼta saɛatan mina al-mali qala ʼinna Allaha aṣṭafahu ɛalaykum wa zadahu basṭatan fi al-ɛilmi wa al-jismi wa Allahu yuʼti mulkahu man yacaʼu wa Allahu wasiɛun ɛalimun.

Wa qala lahum nabiyuhum ʼinna ʼayata mulkihi ʼan yaʼtiyakum at-tabutu fihi sakinatun min rabbikum wa baqiyatun mimma taraka ʼalu musa wa ʼalu haruna taḥmiluhu al-malaʼikatu ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan lakum ʼin kuntum muʼminin.

Falamma faṣala ṭalutu bil-junudi qala ʼinna Allaha mubtalikum binaharin faman cariba minhu falaysa minni wa man lam yaṭɛamhu faʼinnahu minni ʼilla man aɣtarafa ɣurfatan biyadihi facaribu minhu ʼilla qalilan minhum falamma jawazahu huwa wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu qalu la ṭaqata lana al-yawma bijaluta wa junudihi qala al-laḏina yaḏ̣unnuna ʼannahum mulaqu Allahi kam min fiʼatin qalilatin ɣalabat fiʼatan kaṯiratan biʼiḏni Allahi wa Allahu maɛa aṣ-ṣabirin.
Wa lamma barazu lijaluta wa junudihi qalu rabbana ʼafriɣ ɛalayna ṣabran wa ṯabbit ʼaqdamana wa anṣurna ɛala al-qawmi al-kafirin.

Fahazamuhum biʼiḏni Allahi wa qatala dawudu jaluta wa ʼatahu Allahu al-mulka wa al-ḥikmata wa ɛallamahu mimma yacaʼu wa lawla dafɛu Allahi an-nasa baɛḍahum bibaɛḍin lafasadat al-ʼarḍu wa lakinna Allaha ḏu faḍlin ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Tilka ʼayatu Allahi natluha ɛalayka bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼinnaka lamina al-mursalin.

Tilka ar-rusulu faḍḍalna baɛḍahum ɛala baɛḍin minhum man kallama Allahu wa rafaɛa baɛḍahum darajatin wa ʼatayna ɛisa abna maryama al-bayyinati wa ʼayyadnahu biruḥi al-qudusi wa law caʼa Allahu ma aqtatala al-laḏina min baɛdihim min baɛdi ma jaʼat/hum al-bayyinatu wa lakin axtalafu faminhum man ʼamana wa minhum man kafara wa law caʼa Allahu ma aqtatalu wa lakinna Allaha yafɛalu ma yurid.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼanfiqu mimma razaqnakum min qabli ʼan yaʼtiya yawmun la bayɛun fihi wa la xullatun wa la cafaɛatun wa al-kafiruna hum aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.

Allahu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa al-ḥayyu al-qayyumu la taʼxuḏuhu sinatun wa la nawmun lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi man ḏa al-laḏi yacfaɛu ɛindahu ʼilla biʼiḏnihi yaɛlamu ma bayna ʼaydihim wa ma xalfahum wa la yuḥiṭuna bicayʼin min ɛilmihi ʼilla bima caʼa wasiɛa kursiyuhu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa la yaʼuduhu ḥifḏ̣uhuma wa huwa al-ɛaliyu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
La ʼikraha fi ad-dini qad tabayyana ar-rucdu mina al-ɣayyi faman yakfur biṭ-ṭaɣuti wa yuʼmin Billahi faqad astamsaka bil-ɛurwati al-wuṯqa la anfiṣama laha wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.

Allahu wa liyu al-laḏina ʼamanu yuxrijuhum mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼila an-nur wa al-laḏina kafaru ʼawliyaʼuuhum aṭ-ṭaɣutu yuxrijunahum mina an-nur ʼila aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.

ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏi ḥajja ʼibrahima fi rabbihi ʼan ʼatahu Allahu al-mulka ʼiḏ qala ʼibrahimu rabbi al-laḏi yuḥyi wa yumitu qala ʼana ʼuḥyi wa ʼumitu qala ʼibrahimu faʼinna Allaha yaʼti bic-camsi mina al-macriqi faʼti biha mina al-maɣribi fabuhita al-laḏi kafara wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

ʼaw kallaḏi marra ɛala qaryatin wa hiya xawiyatun ɛala ɛuruciha qala ʼanna yuḥyi haḏihi Allahu baɛda mawtiha faʼamatahu Allahu miaʼata ɛamin ṯumma baɛaṯahu qala kam labiṯta qala labiṯtu yawman ʼaw baɛḍa yawmin qala bal labiṯta miaʼata ɛamin fanḏ̣ur ʼila ṭaɛamika wa carabika lam yatasannah wa anḏ̣ur ʼila ḥimarika wa linajɛalaka ʼayatan lilnnasi wa anḏ̣ur ʼila al-ɛiḏ̣ami kayfa nuncizuha ṯumma naksuha laḥman falamma tabayyana lahu qala ʼaɛlamu ʼanna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.

Wa ʼiḏ qala ʼibrahimu rabbi ʼarini kayfa tuḥyi al-mawta qala ʼawalam tuʼmin qala bala wa lakin liyaṭmaʼinna qalbi qala faxuḏ ʼarbaɛatan mina aṭ-ṭayri faṣurhunna ʼilayka ṯumma ajɛal ɛala kulli jabalin minhunna juzʼan ṯumma adɛuhunna yaʼtinaka saɛyan wa aɛlam ʼanna Allaha ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Maṯalu al-laḏina yunfiquna ʼamwalahum fi sabili Allahi kamaṯali ḥabbatin ʼanbatat sabɛa sanabila fi kulli sunbulatin miaʼatu ḥabbatin wa Allahu yuḍaɛifu liman yacaʼu wa Allahu wasiɛun ɛalimun.
Al-laḏina yunfiquna ʼamwalahum fi sabili Allahi ṯumma la yutbiɛuna ma ʼanfaqu mannan wa la ʼaḏan lahum ʼajruhum ɛinda rabbihim wa la xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Qawlun maɛrufun wa maɣfiratun xayrun min ṣadaqatin yatbaɛuha ʼaḏan wa Allahu ɣaniyun ḥalimun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tubṭilu ṣadaqatikum bil-manni wa al-ʼaḏa kallaḏi yunfiqu malahu riʼaʼa an-nasi wa la yuʼminu Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri famaṯaluhu kamaṯali ṣafwanin ɛalayhi turabun faʼaṣabahu wa abilun fatarakahu ṣaldan la yaqdiruna ɛala cayʼin mimma kasabu wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma al-kafirin.

Wa maṯalu al-laḏina yunfiquna ʼamwalahum abtiɣaʼa marḍati Allahi wa taṯbitan min ʼanfusihim kamaṯali jannatin birabwatin ʼaṣabaha wa abilun faʼatat ʼukulaha ḍiɛfayni faʼin lam yuṣibha wa abilun faṭallun wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.

ʼayawaddu ʼaḥadukum ʼan takuna lahu jannatun min naxilin wa ʼaɛnabin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu lahu fiha min kulli aṯ-ṯamarati wa ʼaṣabahu al-kibaru wa lahu ḏurriyatun ḍuɛafaʼu faʼaṣabaha ʼiɛṣarun fihi narun faḥtaraqat kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum al-ʼayati laɛallakum tatafakkarun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼanfiqu min ṭayyibati ma kasabtum wa mimma ʼaxrajna lakum mina al-ʼarḍi wa la tayammamu al-xabiṯa minhu tunfiquna wa lastum biʼaxiḏihi ʼilla ʼan tuɣmiḍu fihi wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha ɣaniyun ḥamidun.
Ac-cayṭanu yaɛidukum al-faqra wa yaʼmurukum bil-faḥcaʼi wa Allahu yaɛidukum maɣfiratan minhu wa faḍlan wa Allahu wasiɛun ɛalimun.
Yuʼti al-ḥikmata man yacaʼu wa man yuʼta al-ḥikmata faqad ʼutiya xayran kaṯiran wa ma yaḏḏakkaru ʼilla ʼulu al-ʼalbab.
Wa ma ʼanfaqtum min nafaqatin ʼaw naḏartum min naḏrin faʼinna Allaha yaɛlamuhu wa ma lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina min ʼanṣarin.
ʼin tubdu aṣ-ṣadaqati faniɛimma hiya wa ʼin tuxfuha wa tuʼtuha al-fuqaraʼa fahuwa xayrun lakum wa yukaffiru ɛankum min sayyiʼatikum wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabirun.

Laysa ɛalayka hudahum wa lakinna Allaha yahdi man yacaʼu wa ma tunfiqu min xayrin faliʼanfusikum wa ma tunfiquna ʼilla abtiɣaʼa wajhi Allahi wa ma tunfiqu min xayrin yuwaffa ʼilaykum wa ʼantum la tuḏ̣lamun.

Lilfuqaraʼi al-laḏina ʼuḥṣiru fi sabili Allahi la yastaṭiɛuna ḍarban fi al-ʼarḍi yaḥsabuhum al-jahilu ʼaɣniyaʼa mina at-taɛaffufi taɛrifuhum bisimahum la yasʼaluna an-nasa ʼilḥafan wa ma tunfiqu min xayrin faʼinna Allaha bihi ɛalimun.
Al-laḏina yunfiquna ʼamwalahum bil-layli wa an-nahari sirran wa ɛalaniyatan falahum ʼajruhum ɛinda rabbihim wa la xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.

Al-laḏina yaʼkuluna ar-riba la yaqumuna ʼilla kama yaqumu al-laḏi yataxabbaṭuhu ac-cayṭanu mina al-massi ḏalika biʼannahum qalu ʼinnama al-bayɛu miṯlu ar-riba wa ʼaḥalla Allahu al-bayɛa wa ḥarrama ar-riba faman jaʼahu mawɛiḏ̣atun min rabbihi fantaha falahu ma salafa wa ʼamruhu ʼila Allahi wa man ɛada faʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
Yamḥaqu Allahu ar-riba wa yurbi aṣ-ṣadaqati wa Allahu la yuḥibbu kulla kaffarin ʼaṯimin.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼataw az-zakata lahum ʼajruhum ɛinda rabbihim wa la xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu Allaha wa ḏaru ma baqiya mina ar-riba ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Faʼin lam tafɛalu faʼḏanu biḥarbin mina Allahi wa rasulihi wa ʼin tubtum falakum ruʼsu ʼamwalikum la taḏ̣limuna wa la tuḏ̣lamun.
Wa ʼin kana ḏu ɛusratin fanaḏ̣iratun ʼila maysaratin wa ʼan taṣaddaqu xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.
Wa attaqu yawman turjaɛuna fihi ʼila Allahi ṯumma tuwaffa kullu nafsin ma kasabat wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa tadayantum bidaynin ʼila ʼajalin musamman faktubuhu wa liaktub baynakum katibun bil-ɛadli wa la yaʼba katibun ʼan yaktuba kama ɛallamahu Allahu falyaktub wa liumlil al-laḏi ɛalayhi al-ḥaqqu wa liattaqi Allaha rabbahu wa la yabxas minhu cayʼan faʼin kana al-laḏi ɛalayhi al-ḥaqqu safihan ʼaw ḍaɛifan ʼaw la yastaṭiɛu ʼan yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyuhu bil-ɛadli wa astac/hidu cahidayni min rijalikum faʼin lam yakuna rajulayni farajulun wa amraʼatani mimman tarḍawna mina ac-cuhadaʼi ʼan taḍilla ʼiḥdahuma fatuḏakkira ʼiḥdahuma al-ʼuxra wa la yaʼba ac-cuhadaʼu ʼiḏa ma duɛu wa la tasʼamu ʼan taktubuhu ṣaɣiran ʼaw kabiran ʼila ʼajalihi ḏalikum ʼaqsaṭu ɛinda Allahi wa ʼaqwamu lilccahadati wa ʼadna ʼalla tartabu ʼilla ʼan takuna tijaratan ḥaḍiratan tudirunaha baynakum falaysa ɛalaykum junaḥun ʼalla taktubuha wa ʼac/hidu ʼiḏa tabayaɛtum wa la yuḍarra katibun wa la cahidun wa ʼin tafɛalu faʼinnahu fusuqun bikum wa attaqu Allaha wa yuɛallimukum Allahu wa Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.

Wa ʼin kuntum ɛala safarin wa lam tjidu katiban farihanun maqbuḍatun faʼin ʼamina baɛḍukum baɛḍan falyuʼaddi al-laḏi aʼutumina ʼamanatahu wa liattaqi Allaha rabbahu wa la taktumu ac-cahadata wa man yaktumha faʼinnahu ʼaṯimun qalbuhu wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna ɛalimun.
Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼin tubdu ma fi ʼanfusikum ʼaw tuxfuhu yuḥasibkum bihi Allahu fayaɣfiru liman yacaʼu wa yuɛaḏḏibu man yacaʼu wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.

ʼamana ar-rasulu bima ʼunzila ʼilayhi min rabbihi wa al-muʼminuna kullun ʼamana Billahi wa malaʼikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ʼaḥadin min rusulihi wa qalu samiɛna wa ʼaṭaɛna ɣufranaka rabbana wa ʼilayka al-maṣir.

La yukallifu Allahu nafsan ʼilla wusɛaha laha ma kasabat wa ɛalayha ma aktasabat rabbana la tuʼaxiḏna ʼin nasina ʼaw ʼaxṭaʼna rabbana wa la taḥmil ɛalayna ʼiṣran kama ḥamaltahu ɛala al-laḏina min qablina rabbana wa la tuḥammilna ma la ṭaqata lana bihi wa aɛfu ɛanna wa aɣfir lana wa arḥamna ʼanta mawlana fanṣurna ɛala al-qawmi al-kafirin.
ʼalif-lam-mim.
Allahu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa al-ḥayyu al-qayyum.
Nazzala ɛalayka al-kitaba bil-ḥaqqi muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi wa ʼanzala at-tawrata wa al-ʼinjil.
Min qablu hudan lilnnasi wa ʼanzala al-furqana ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru biʼayati Allahi lahum ɛaḏabun cadidun wa Allahu ɛazizun ḏu antiqamin.
ʼinna Allaha la yaxfa ɛalayhi cayʼun fi al-ʼarḍi wa la fi as-samaʼ.
Huwa al-laḏi yuṣawwirukum fi al-ʼarḥami kayfa yacaʼu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.

Huwa al-laḏi ʼanzala ɛalayka al-kitaba minhu ʼayatun muḥkamatun hunna ʼummu al-kitabi wa ʼuxaru mutacabihatun faʼamma al-laḏina fi qulubihim zayɣun fayattabiɛuna ma tacabaha minhu abtiɣaʼa al-fitnati wa abtiɣaʼa taʼwilihi wa ma yaɛlamu taʼwilahu ʼilla Allahu wa ar-rasixuna fi al-ɛilmi yaquluna ʼamanna bihi kullun min ɛindi rabbina wa ma yaḏḏakkaru ʼilla ʼulu al-ʼalbab.
Rabbana la tuziɣ qulubana baɛda ʼiḏ hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka raḥmatan ʼinnaka ʼanta al-wahhab.
Rabbana ʼinnaka jamiɛu an-nasi liyawmin la rayba fihi ʼinna Allaha la yuxlifu al-miɛad.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru lan tuɣniya ɛanhum ʼamwaluhum wa la ʼawladuhum mina Allahi cayʼan wa ʼulaʼika hum wa qudu an-nar.
Kadaʼbi ʼali firɛawna wa al-laḏina min qablihim kaḏḏabu biʼayatina faʼaxaḏahum Allahu biḏunubihim wa Allahu cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Qul lillaḏina kafaru satuɣlabuna wa tuḥcaruna ʼila jahannama wa biʼsa al-mihad.

Qad kana lakum ʼayatun fi fiʼatayni at-taqata fiʼatun tuqatilu fi sabili Allahi wa ʼuxra kafiratun yarawnahum miṯlayhim raʼya al-ɛayni wa Allahu yuʼayyidu binaṣrihi man yacaʼu ʼinna fi ḏalika laɛibratan liʼwli al-ʼabṣar.

Zuyyina lilnnasi ḥubbu ac-cahawati mina an-nisaʼ wa al-banina wa al-qanaṭiri al-muqanṭarati mina aḏ-ḏahabi wa al-fiḍḍati wa al-xayli al-musawwamati wa al-ʼanɛam wa al-ḥarṯi ḏalika mataɛu al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa Allahu ɛindahu ḥusnu al-maʼab.

Qul ʼaʼuunabbiʼukum bixayrin min ḏalikum lillaḏina attaqaw ɛinda rabbihim jannatun tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha wa ʼazwajun muṭahharatun wa riḍwanun mina Allahi wa Allahu baṣirun bil-ɛibad.
Al-laḏina yaquluna rabbana ʼinnana ʼamanna faɣfir lana ḏunubana wa qina ɛaḏaba an-nar.
Aṣ-ṣabirina wa aṣ-ṣadiqina wa al-qanitina wa al-munfiqina wa al-mustaɣfirina bil-ʼasḥar.
Cahida Allahu ʼannahu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa wa al-malaʼikatu wa ʼulu al-ɛilmi qaʼiman bil-qisṭi la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
ʼinna ad-dina ɛinda Allahi al-ʼislamu wa ma axtalafa al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba ʼilla min baɛdi ma jaʼahum al-ɛilmu baɣyan baynahum wa man yakfur biʼayati Allahi faʼinna Allaha sariɛu al-ḥisab.

Faʼin ḥajjuka faqul ʼaslamtu wajhi Lillahi wa man attabaɛani wa qul lillaḏina ʼutu al-kitaba wa al-ʼummiyina ʼaʼaslamtum faʼin ʼaslamu faqad ahtadaw wa ʼin tawallaw faʼinnama ɛalayka al-balaɣu wa Allahu baṣirun bil-ɛibad.
ʼinna al-laḏina yakfuruna biʼayati Allahi wa yaqtuluna an-nabiyina biɣayri ḥaqqin wa yaqtuluna al-laḏina yaʼmuruna bil-qisṭi mina an-nasi fabaccirhum biɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ḥabiṭat ʼaɛmaluhum fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa ma lahum min naṣirin.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina ʼutu naṣiban mina al-kitabi yudɛawna ʼila kitabi Allahi liyaḥkuma baynahum ṯumma yatawalla fariqun minhum wa hum muɛriḍun.
Ḏalika biʼannahum qalu lan tamassana an-naru ʼilla ʼayyaman maɛdudatin wa ɣarrahum fi dinihim ma kanu yaftarun.
Fakayfa ʼiḏa jamaɛnahum liyawmin la rayba fihi wa wuffiyat kullu nafsin ma kasabat wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
Qul al-lahumma malika al-mulki tuʼti al-mulka man tacaʼu wa tanziɛu al-mulka mimman tacaʼu wa tuɛizzu man tacaʼu wa tuḏillu man tacaʼu biyadika al-xayru ʼinnaka ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Tuliju al-layla fi an-nahari wa tuliju an-nahara fi al-layli wa tuxriju al-ḥayya mina al-mayyiti wa tuxriju al-mayyita mina al-ḥayyi wa tarzuqu man tacaʼu biɣayri ḥisabin.

La yattaxiḏ al-muʼminuna al-kafirina ʼawliyaʼa min duni al-muʼminina wa man yafɛal ḏalika falaysa mina Allahi fi cayʼin ʼilla ʼan tattaqu minhum tuqatan wa yuḥaḏḏirukum Allahu nafsahu wa ʼila Allahi al-maṣir.
Qul ʼin tuxfu ma fi ṣudurikum ʼaw tubduhu yaɛlamhu Allahu wa yaɛlamu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Yawma tajidu kullu nafsin ma ɛamilat min xayrin muḥḍaran wa ma ɛamilat min suʼin tawaddu law ʼanna baynaha wa baynahu ʼamadan baɛidan wa yuḥaḏḏirukum Allahu nafsahu wa Allahu raʼufun bil-ɛibad.
Qul ʼin kuntum tuḥibbuna Allaha fa attabiɛuni yuḥbibkum Allahu wa yaɣfir lakum ḏunubakum wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Qul ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa ar-rasula faʼin tawallaw faʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu al-kafirin.
ʼinna Allaha aṣṭafa ʼadama wa nuḥan wa ʼala ʼibrahima wa ʼali ɛimran ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Ḏurriyatan baɛḍuha min baɛḍin wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.
ʼiḏ qalat amraʼatu ɛimrana rabbi ʼinni naḏartu laka ma fi baṭni muḥarraran fataqabbal minni ʼinnaka ʼanta as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.

Falamma waḍaɛat/ha qalat rabbi ʼinni waḍaɛtuha ʼunṯa wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima waḍaɛat wa laysa aḏ-ḏakaru kalʼunṯa wa ʼinni sammaytuha maryama wa ʼinni ʼuɛiḏuha bika wa ḏurriyataha mina ac-cayṭani ar-rajim.

Fataqabbalaha rabbuha biqabulin ḥasanin wa ʼanbataha nabatan ḥasanan wa kaffalaha zakariya kullama daxala ɛalayha zakariya al-miḥraba wajada ɛindaha rizqan qala ya maryamu ʼanna laki haḏa qalat huwa min ɛindi Allahi ʼinna Allaha yarzuqu man yacaʼu biɣayri ḥisabin.
Hunalika daɛa zakariya rabbahu qala rabbi hab li min ladunka ḏurriyatan ṭayyibatan ʼinnaka samiɛu ad-duɛaʼ.
Fanadat/hu al-malaʼikatu wa huwa qaʼimun yuṣalli fi al-miḥrabi ʼanna Allaha yubacciruka biyaḥya muṣaddiqan bikalimatin mina Allahi wa sayyidan wa ḥaṣuran wa nabiyan mina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Qala rabbi ʼanna yakunu li ɣulamun wa qad balaɣani al-kibaru wa amraʼati ɛaqirun qala kaḏalika Allahu yafɛalu ma yacaʼ.
Qala rabbi ajɛal li ʼayatan qala ʼayatuka ʼalla tukallima an-nasa ṯalaṯata ʼayyamin ʼilla ramzan wa aḏkur rabbaka kaṯiran wa sabbiḥ bil-ɛaciyi wa al-ʼibkar.
Wa ʼiḏ qalat al-malaʼikatu ya maryamu ʼinna Allaha aṣṭafaki wa ṭahharaki wa aṣṭafaki ɛala nisaʼi al-ɛalamin.
Ya maryamu aqnuti lirabbiki wa asjudi wa arkaɛi maɛa ar-rakiɛin.
Ḏalika min ʼnbaʼi al-ɣaybi nuḥihi ʼilayka wa ma kunta ladayhim ʼiḏ yulquna ʼaqlamahum ʼayyuhum yakfulu maryama wa ma kunta ladayhim ʼiḏ yaxtaṣimun.
ʼiḏ qalat al-malaʼikatu ya maryamu ʼinna Allaha yubacciruki bikalimatin minhu asmuhu al-masiḥu ɛisa abnu maryama wajihan fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa mina al-muqarrabin.
Wa yukallimu an-nasa fi al-mahdi wa kahlan wa mina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Qalat rabbi ʼanna yakunu li waladun wa lam yamsasni bacarun qala kaḏaliki Allahu yaxluqu ma yacaʼu ʼiḏa qaḍa ʼamran faʼinnama yaqulu lahu kun fayakun.
Wa yuɛallimuhu al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa at-tawrata wa al-ʼinjil.

Wa rasulan ʼila bani ʼisraʼila ʼanni qad jiʼtukum biʼayatin min rabbikum ʼanni ʼaxluqu lakum mina aṭ-ṭini kahayʼati aṭ-ṭayri faʼanfuxu fihi fayakunu ṭayran biʼiḏni Allahi wa ʼubriʼu al-ʼakmaha wa al-ʼabraṣa wa ʼuḥyi al-mawta biʼiḏni Allahi wa ʼunabbiʼukum bima taʼkuluna wa ma taddaxiruna fi buyutikum ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan lakum ʼin kuntum muʼminyn.
Wa muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina at-tawrati wa liʼaḥilla lakum baɛḍa al-laḏi ḥurrima ɛalaykum wa jiʼtukum biʼayatin min rabbikum fa attaqu Allaha wa ʼaṭiɛun.
ʼinna Allaha rabbi wa rabbukum faɛbuduhu haḏa ṣiraṭun mustaqimun.
Falamma ʼaḥassa ɛisa minhum al-kufra qala man ʼanṣari ʼila Allahi qala al-ḥawariyuna naḥnu ʼanṣaru Allahi ʼamanna Billahi wa ac/had biʼanna muslimun.
Rabbana ʼamanna bima ʼanzalta wa attabaɛna ar-rasula faktubna maɛa ac-cahidin.
Wa makaru wa makara Allahu wa Allahu xayru al-makirin.

ʼiḏ qala Allahu ya ɛisa ʼinni mutawaffika wa rafiɛuka ʼilayya wa muṭahhiruka mina al-laḏina kafaru wa jaɛilu al-laḏina attabaɛuka fawqa al-laḏina kafaru ʼila yawmi al-qiya mati ṯumma ʼilayya marjiɛukum faʼaḥkumu baynakum fima kuntum fihi taxtalifun.
Faʼamma al-laḏina kafaru faʼuɛaḏḏibuhum ɛaḏaban cadidan fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa ma lahum min naṣirin.
Wa ʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati fayuwaffihim ʼujurahum wa Allahu la yuḥibbu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Ḏalika natluhu ɛalyka mina al-ʼayati wa aḏ-ḏikri al-ḥakim.
ʼinna maṯala ɛisa ɛinda Allahi kamaṯali ʼadama xalaqahu min turabin ṯumma qala lahu kun fayakun.
Al-ḥaqqu min rabbika fala takun mina al-mumtarin.

Faman ḥajjaka fihi min baɛdi ma jaʼaka mina al-ɛilmi faqul taɛalaw nadɛu ʼabnaʼana wa ʼabnaʼakum wa nisaʼana wa nisaʼakum wa ʼanfusana wa ʼanfusakum ṯumma nabtahil fanajɛal laɛnata Allahi ɛala al-kaḏibin.
ʼinna haḏa lahuwa al-qaṣaṣu al-ḥaqqu wa ma min ʼilahin ʼilla Allahu wa ʼinna Allaha lahuwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Faʼin tawallaw faʼinna Allaha ɛalimun bil-mufsidin.

Qul ya ʼahla al-kitabi taɛalaw ʼila kalimatin sawaʼin baynana wa baynakum ʼalla naɛbuda ʼilla Allaha wa la nucrika bihi cayʼan wa la yattaxiḏa baɛḍuna baɛḍan ʼarbaban min duni Allahi faʼin tawallaw faqulu ac/hadu biʼanna muslimun.
Ya ʼahla al-kitabi lima tuḥajjuna fi ʼibrahima wa ma ʼunzilat at-tawratu wa al-ʼinjilu ʼilla min baɛdihi ʼafala taɛqilun.
Haʼantum haʼuulaʼ ḥajajtum fima lakum bihi ɛilmun falima tuḥajjuna fima laysa lakum bihi ɛilmun wa Allahu yaɛlamu wa ʼantum la taɛlamun.
Ma kana ʼibrahimu yahudiyan wa la naṣraniyan wa lakin kana ḥanifan musliman wa ma kana mina al-mucrikin.
ʼinna ʼawla an-nasi biʼibrahima lallaḏina attabaɛuhu wa haḏa an-nabiyu wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa Allahu wa liyu al-muʼminin.
Waddat ṭaʼifatun min ʼahli al-kitabi law yuḍillunakum wa ma yuḍilluna ʼilla ʼanfusahum wa ma yacɛurun.
Ya ʼahla al-kitabi lima takfuruna biʼayati Allahi wa ʼantum tac/hadun.
Ya ʼahla al-kitabi lima talbisuna al-ḥaqqa bil-baṭili wa taktumuna al-ḥaqqa wa ʼantum taɛlamun.
Wa qalat ṭaʼifatun min ʼahli al-kitabi ʼaminu bial-laḏi ʼunzila ɛala al-laḏina ʼamanu wajha an-nahari wa akfuru ʼaxirahu laɛallahum yarjiɛun.

Wa la tuʼminu ʼilla liman tabiɛa dinakum qul ʼinna al-huda huda Allahi ʼan yuʼta ʼaḥadun miṯla ma ʼutitum ʼaw yuḥajjukum ɛinda rabbikum qul ʼinna al-faḍla biyadi Allahi yuʼtihi man yacaʼu wa Allahu wasiɛun ɛalimun.
Yaxtaṣṣu biraḥmatihi man yacaʼu wa Allahu ḏu al-faḍli al-ɛaḏ̣im.

Wa min ʼahli al-kitabi man ʼin taʼmanhu biqinṭarin yuʼaddihi ʼilayka wa minhum man ʼin taʼmanhu bidinarin la yuʼaddihi ʼilayka ʼilla ma dumta ɛalayhi qaʼiman ḏalika biʼannahum qalu laysa ɛalayna fi al-ʼummiyina sabilun wa yaquluna ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba wa hum yaɛlamun.
Bala man ʼawfa biɛahdihi wa attaqa faʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muttaqin.

ʼinna al-laḏina yactaruna biɛahdi Allahi wa ʼaymanihim ṯamanan qalilan ʼulaʼika la xalaqa lahum fi al-ʼaxirati wa la yukallimuhum Allahu wa la yanḏ̣uru ʼilayhim yawma al-qiyamati wa la yuzakkihim wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.

Wa ʼinna minhum lafariqan yalwuna ʼalsinatahum bil-kitabi litaḥsabuhu mina al-kitabi wa ma huwa mina al-kitabi wa yaquluna huwa min ɛindi Allahi wa ma huwa min ɛindi Allahi wa yaquluna ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba wa hum yaɛlamun.

Ma kana libacarin ʼan yuʼtiyahu Allahu al-kitaba wa al-ḥukma wa an-nubuwata ṯumma yaqula lilnnasi kunu ɛibadan li min duni Allahi wa lakin kunu rabbaniyina bima kuntum tuɛallimuna al-kitaba wa bima kuntum tadrusun.
Wa la yaʼmurakum ʼan tattaxiḏu al-malaʼikata wa an-nabiyina ʼarbaban ʼayaʼmurukum bil-kufri baɛda ʼiḏ ʼantum muslimun.

Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏa Allahu miṯaqa an-nabiyina lama ʼataytukum min kitabin wa ḥikmatin ṯumma jaʼakum rasulun muṣaddiqun lima maɛakum latuʼminunna bihi wa latanṣurunnahu qala ʼaʼaqrartum wa ʼaxaḏtum ɛala ḏalikum ʼiṣri qalu ʼaqrarna qala fac/hadu wa ʼana maɛakum mina ac-cahidin.
Faman tawalla baɛda ḏalika faʼulaʼika hum al-fasiqun.
ʼafaɣayra dini Allahi yabɣuna wa lahu ʼaslama man fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ṭawɛan wa karhan wa ʼilayhi yurjaɛun.

Qul ʼamanna Billahi wa ma ʼunzila ɛalayna wa ma ʼunzila ɛala ʼibrahima wa ʼismaɛila wa ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba wa al-ʼasbaṭi wa ma ʼutiya musa wa ɛisa wa an-nabiyuna min rabbihim la nufarriqu bayna ʼaḥadin minhum wa naḥnu lahu muslimun.
Wa man yabtaɣi ɣayra al-ʼislami dinan falan yuqbala minhu wa huwa fi al-ʼaxirati mina al-xasirin.
Kayfa yahdi Allahu qawman kafaru baɛda ʼimanihim wa cahidu ʼanna ar-rasula ḥaqqun wa jaʼahum al-bayyinatu wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
ʼulaʼika jazaʼuuhum ʼanna ɛalayhim laɛnata Allahi wa al-malaʼikati wa an-nasi ʼajmaɛin.
Xalidina fiha la yuxaffafu ɛanhum al-ɛaḏabu wa la hum yunḏ̣arun.
ʼilla al-laḏina tabu min baɛdi ḏalika wa ʼaṣlaḥu faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru baɛda ʼimanihim ṯumma azdadu kufran lan tuqbala tawbatuhum wa ʼulaʼika hum aḍ-ḍallun.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru wa matu wa hum kuffarun falan yuqbala min ʼaḥadihim milʼu al-ʼarḍi ḏahaban wa law aftada bihi ʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun wa ma lahum min naṣirin.
Lan tanalu al-birra ḥatta tunfiqu mimma tuḥibbuna wa ma tunfiqu min cayʼin faʼinna Allaha bihi ɛalimun.
Kullu aṭ-ṭaɛami kana ḥillan libani ʼisraʼila ʼilla ma ḥarrama ʼisraʼilu ɛala nafsihi min qabli ʼan tunazzala at-tawratu qul faʼtu bit-tawrati fatluha ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Faman aftara ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba min baɛdi ḏalika faʼulaʼika hum aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.
Qul ṣadaqa Allahu fa attabiɛu millata ʼibrahima ḥanifan wa ma kana mina al-mucrikin.
ʼinna ʼawwala baytin wuḍiɛa lilnnasi lallaḏi bibakkata mubarakan wa hudan lilɛalamin.
Fihi ʼayatun bayyinatun maqamu ʼibrahima wa man daxalahu kana ʼaminan wa Lillahi ɛala an-nasi ḥijju al-bayti man astaṭaɛa ʼilayhi sabilan wa man kafara faʼinna Allaha ɣaniyun ɛan al-ɛalamin.
Qul ya ʼahla al-kitabi lima takfuruna biʼayati Allahi wa Allahu cahidun ɛala ma taɛmalun.
Qul ya ʼahla al-kitabi lima taṣudduna ɛan sabili Allahi man ʼamana tabɣunaha ɛiwajan wa ʼantum cuhadaʼu wa ma Allahu biɣafilin ɛamma taɛmalun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼin tuṭiɛu fariqan mina al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba yaruddukum baɛda ʼimanikum kafirin.
Wa kayfa takfuruna wa ʼantum tutla ɛalaykum ʼayatu Allahi wa fikum rasuluhu wa man yaɛtaṣim Billahi faqad hudiya ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu Allaha ḥaqqa tuqatihi wa la tamutunna ʼilla wa ʼantum muslimun.

Wa aɛtaṣimu biḥabli Allahi jamiɛan wa la tafarraqu wa aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum ʼiḏ kuntum ʼaɛdaʼan faʼallafa bayna qulubikum faʼaṣbaḥtum biniɛmatihi ʼixwanan wa kuntum ɛala cafa ḥufratin mina an-nari faʼanqaḏakum minha kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ʼayatihi laɛallakum tahtadun.
Wa ltakun minkum ʼummatun yadɛuna ʼila al-xayri wa yaʼmuruna bil-maɛrufi wa yanhawna ɛan al-munkari wa ʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
Wa la takunu kallaḏina tafarraqu wa axtalafu min baɛdi ma jaʼahum al-bayyinatu wa ʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Yawma tabyaḍḍu wujuhun wa taswaddu wujuhun faʼamma al-laḏina aswaddat wujuhuhum ʼakafartum baɛda ʼimanikum faḏuqu al-ɛaḏaba bima kuntum takfurun.
Wa ʼamma al-laḏina abyaḍḍat wujuhuhum fafi raḥmati Allahi hum fiha xalidun.
Tilka ʼayatu Allahi natluha ɛalayka bil-ḥaqqi wa ma Allahu yuridu ḏ̣ulman lilɛalamin.
Wa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼila Allahi turjaɛu al-ʼumur.

Kuntum xayra ʼummatin ʼuxrijat lilnnasi taʼmuruna bil-maɛrufi wa tanhawna ɛan al-munkari wa tuʼminuna Billahi wa law ʼamana ʼahlu al-kitabi lakana xayran lahum minhum al-muʼminuna wa ʼakṯaruhum al-fasiqun.
Lan yaḍurrukum ʼilla ʼaḏan wa ʼin yuqatilukum yuwallukum al-ʼadbara ṯumma la yunṣarun.

Ḍuribat ɛalayhim aḏ-ḏillatu ʼayna ma ṯuqifu ʼilla biḥablin mina Allahi wa ḥablin mina an-nasi wa baʼu biɣaḍabin mina Allahi wa ḍuribat ɛalayhim al-maskanatu ḏalika biʼannahum kanu yakfuruna biʼayati Allahi wa yaqtuluna al-ʼanbiyaʼa biɣayri ḥaqqin ḏalika bima ɛaṣaw wa kanu yaɛtadun.
Laysu sawaʼan min ʼahli al-kitabi ʼummatun qaʼimatun yatluna ʼayati Allahi ʼanaʼa al-layli wa hum yasjudun.
yuʼminuna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa yaʼmuruna bil-maɛrufi wa yanhawna ɛan al-munkari wa yusariɛuna fi al-xayrati wa ʼulaʼika mina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Wa ma yafɛalu min xayrin falan yukfaruhu wa Allahu ɛalimun bil-muttaqin.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru lan tuɣniya ɛanhum ʼamwaluhum wa la ʼawladuhum mina Allahi cayʼan wa ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
Maṯalu ma yunfiquna fi haḏihi al-ḥayati ad-dunya kamaṯali riḥin fiha ṣirrun ʼaṣabat ḥarṯa qawmin ḏ̣alamu ʼanfusahum faʼahlakat/hu wa ma ḏ̣alamahum Allahu wa lakin ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tattaxiḏu biṭanatan min dunikum la yaʼlunakum xabalan wa ddu ma ɛanittum qad badat al-baɣḍaʼu min ʼafwahihim wa ma tuxfi ṣuduruhum ʼakbaru qad bayyanna lakum al-ʼayati ʼin kuntum taɛqilun.

Haʼantum ʼulaʼi tuḥibbunahum wa la yuḥibbunakum wa tuʼminuna bil-kitabi kullihi wa ʼiḏa laqukum qalu ʼamanna wa ʼiḏa xalaw ɛaḍḍu ɛalaykum al-ʼanamila mina al-ɣayḏ̣i qul mutu biɣayḏ̣ikum ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
ʼin tamsaskum ḥasanatun tasuʼhum wa ʼin tuṣibkum sayyiʼatun yafraḥu biha wa ʼin taṣbiru wa tattaqu la yaḍurrukum kayduhum cayʼan ʼinna Allaha bima yaɛmaluna muḥiṭun.
Wa ʼiḏ ɣadawta min ʼahlika tubawwiʼu al-muʼminina maqaɛida lilqitali wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.
ʼiḏ hammat ṭaʼifatani minkum ʼan tafcala wa Allahu waliyuhuma wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkal al-muʼminun.
Wa laqad naṣarakum Allahu bibadrin wa ʼantum ʼaḏillatun fa attaqu Allaha laɛallakum tackurun.
ʼiḏ taqulu lilmuʼminina ʼalan yakfiyakum ʼan yumiddakum rabbukum biṯalaṯati ʼalafin mina al-malaʼikati munzalin.
Bala ʼin taṣbiru wa tattaqu wa yaʼtukum min fawrihim haḏa yumdidkum rabbukum bixamsati ʼalafin mina al-malaʼikati musawwimin.
Wa ma jaɛalahu Allahu ʼilla bucra lakum wa litaṭmaʼinna qulubukum bihi wa ma an-naṣru ʼilla min ɛindi Allahi al-ɛazizi al-ḥakim.
Liyaqṭaɛa ṭarafan mina al-laḏina kafaru ʼaw yakbitahum fayanqalibu xaʼibin.
Laysa laka mina al-ʼamri cayʼun ʼaw yatuba ɛalayhim ʼaw yuɛaḏḏibahum faʼinnahum ḏ̣alimun.
Wa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi yaɣfiru liman yacaʼu wa yuɛaḏḏibu man yacaʼu wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la taʼkulu ar-riba ʼaḍɛafan muḍaɛafatan wa attaqu Allaha laɛallakum tufliḥun.
Wa attaqu an-nara allati ʼuɛiddat lilkafirin.
Wa ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa ar-rasula laɛallakum turḥamun.
Wa sariɛu ʼila maɣfiratin min rabbikum wa jannatin ɛarḍuha as-samawatu wa al-ʼarḍu ʼuɛiddat lilmuttaqin.
Al-laḏina yunfiquna fi as-sarraʼi wa aḍ-ḍarraʼi wa al-kaḏ̣imina al-ɣayḏ̣a wa al-ɛafina ɛan an-nasi wa Allahu yuḥibbu al-muḥsinin.
Wa al-laḏina ʼiḏa faɛalu faḥicatan ʼaw ḏ̣alamu ʼanfusahum ḏakaru Allaha fastaɣfaru liḏunubihim wa man yaɣfiru aḏ-ḏunuba ʼilla Allahu wa lam yuṣirru ɛala ma faɛalu wa hum yaɛlamun.
ʼulaʼika jazaʼuuhum maɣfiratun min rabbihim wa jannatun tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha wa niɛma ʼajru al-ɛamilin.
Qad xalat min qablikum sunanun fasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fanḏ̣urw kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mukaḏḏibin.
Haḏa bayanun lilnnasi wa hudan wa mawɛiḏ̣atun lilmuttaqin.
Wa la tahinu wa la taḥzanu wa ʼantum al-ʼaɛlawna ʼin kuntum muʼminin.

ʼin yamsaskum qarḥun faqad massa al-qawma qarḥun miṯluhu wa tilka al-ʼayyamu nudawiluha bayna an-nasi wa liyaɛlama Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa yattaxiḏa minkum cuhadaʼa wa Allahu la yuḥibbu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa liyumaḥḥiṣa Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa yamḥaqa al-kafirin.
ʼam ḥasibtum ʼan tadxulu al-jannata wa lamma yaɛlam Allahu al-laḏina jahadu minkum wa yaɛlama aṣ-ṣabirin.
Wa laqad kuntum tatamannawn al-mawta min qabli ʼan talqawhu faqad raʼaytumuhu wa ʼantum tanḏ̣urun.

Wa ma muḥammadun ʼilla rasulun qad xalat min qablihi ar-rusulu ʼafaʼin mata ʼaw qutila anqalabtum ɛala ʼaɛqabikum wa man yanqalib ɛala ɛaqibayhi falan yaḍurra Allaha cayʼan wa sayajzi Allahu ac-cakirin.
Wa ma kana linafsin ʼan tamuta ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi kitaban muʼajjalan wa man yurid ṯawaba ad-dunya nuʼtihi minha wa man yurid ṯawaba al-ʼaxirati nuʼtihi minha wa sanajzi ac-cakirin.
Wa kaʼayyin min nabiyin qatala maɛahu ribbiyuna kaṯirun fama wahanu lima ʼaṣabahum fi sabili Allahi wa ma ḍaɛufu wa ma astakanu wa Allahu yuḥibbu aṣ-ṣabirin.
Wa ma kana qawlahum ʼilla ʼan qalu rabbana aɣfir lana ḏunubana wa ʼisrafana fi ʼamrina wa ṯabbit ʼaqdamana wa anṣurna ɛala al-qawmi al-kafirin.
Faʼatahum Allahu ṯawaba ad-dunya wa ḥusna ṯawabi al-ʼaxirati wa Allahu yuḥibbu al-muḥsinin.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼin tuṭiɛu al-laḏina kafaru yaruddukum ɛala ʼaɛqabikum fatanqalibu xasirin.
Bal Allahu mawlakum wa huwa xayru an-naṣirin.
Sanulqi fi qulubi al-laḏina kafaru ar-ruɛba bima ʼacraku Billahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sulṭanan wa maʼwahum an-naru wa biʼsa maṯwa aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Wa laqad ṣadaqakum Allahu waɛdahu ʼiḏ taḥussunahum biʼiḏnihi ḥatta ʼiḏa faciltum wa tanazaɛtum fi al-ʼamri wa ɛaṣaytum min baɛdi ma ʼarakum ma tuḥibbuna minkum man yuridu ad-dunya wa minkum man yuridu al-ʼaxirata ṯumma ṣarafakum ɛanhum liyabtaliyakum wa laqad ɛafa ɛankum wa Allahu ḏu faḍlin ɛala al-muʼminin.
ʼiḏ tuṣɛiduna wa la talwuna ɛala ʼaḥadin wa ar-rasulu yadɛukum fi ʼuxrakum faʼaṯabakum ɣamman biɣammin likayla taḥzanu ɛala ma fatakum wa la ma ʼaṣabakum wa Allahu xabirun bima taɛmalun.

Ṯumma ʼanzala ɛalaykum min baɛdi al-ɣammi ʼamanatan nuɛasan yaɣca ṭaʼifatan minkum wa ṭaʼifatun qad ʼahammat/hum ʼanfusuhum yaḏ̣unnuna Billahi ɣayra al-ḥaqqi ḏ̣anna al-jahiliyati yaquluna hal lana mina al-ʼamri min cayʼin qul ʼinna al-ʼamra kullahu Lillahi yuxfuna fi ʼanfusihim ma la yubduna laka yaquluna law kana lana mina al-ʼamri cayʼun ma qutilna hahuna qul law kuntum fi buyutikum labaraza al-laḏina kutiba ɛalayhim al-qatlu ʼila maḍajiɛihim wa liyabtaliya Allahu ma fi ṣudurikum wa liyumaḥḥiṣa ma fi qulubikum wa Allahu ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
ʼinna al-laḏina tawallaw minkum yawma at-taqa al-jamɛani ʼinnama astazallahum ac-cayṭanu bibaɛḍi ma kasabu wa laqad ɛafa Allahu ɛanhum ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun ḥalimun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la takunu kallaḏina kafaru wa qalu liʼxwanihim ʼiḏa ḍarabu fi al-ʼarḍi ʼaw kanu ɣuzzan law kanu ɛindana ma matu wa ma qutilu liyajɛala Allahu ḏalika ḥasratan fi qulubihim wa Allahu yuḥyi wa yumitu wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
Wa laʼin qutiltum fi sabili Allahi ʼaw muttum lamaɣfiratun mina Allahi wa raḥmatun xayrun mimma yajmaɛun.
Wa laʼin muttum ʼaw qutiltum laʼila Allahi tuḥcarun.

Fabima raḥmatin mina Allahi linta lahum wa law kunta faḏ̣ḏ̣an ɣaliḏ̣a al-qalbi lanfaḍḍu min ḥawlika faɛfu ɛanhum wa astaɣfir lahum wa cawirhum fi al-ʼamri faʼiḏa ɛazamta fatawakkal ɛala Allahi ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-mutawakkilin.
ʼin yanṣurkum Allahu fala ɣaliba lakum wa ʼin yaxḏulkum faman ḏa al-laḏi yanṣurukum min baɛdihi wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkal al-muʼminun.
Wa ma kana linabiyin ʼan yaɣulla wa man yaɣlul yaʼti bima ɣalla yawma al-qiyamati ṯumma tuwaffa kullu nafsin ma kasabat wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
ʼafaman attabaɛa riḍwana Allahi kaman baʼa bisaxaṭin mina Allahi wa maʼwahu jahannamu wa biʼsa al-maṣir.
Hum darajatun ɛinda Allahi wa Allahu baṣirun bima yaɛmalun.
Laqad manna Allahu ɛala al-muʼminina ʼiḏ baɛaṯa fihim rasulan min ʼanfusihim yatlu ɛalayhim ʼayatihi wa yuzakkihim wa yuɛallimuhum al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa ʼin kanu min qablu lafi ḍalalin mubinin.
ʼawalamma ʼaṣabatkum muṣibatun qad ʼaṣabtum miṯlayha qultum ʼanna haḏa qul huwa min ɛindi ʼanfusikum ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa ma ʼaṣabakum yawma at-taqa al-jamɛani fabiʼiḏni Allahi wa liyaɛlama al-muʼminin.

Wa liyaɛlama al-laḏina nafaqu wa qila lahum taɛalaw qatilu fi sabili Allahi ʼaw adfaɛu qalu law naɛlamu qitalan lattabaɛnakum hum lilkufri yawmaʼiḏin ʼaqrabu minhum lilʼimani yaquluna biʼafwhihim ma laysa fi qulubihim wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima yaktumun.
Al-laḏina qalu liʼxwanihim wa qaɛadu law ʼaṭaɛuna ma qutilu qul fadraʼu ɛan ʼanfusikum al-mawta ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Wa la taḥsabanna al-laḏina qutilu fi sabili Allahi ʼamwatan bal ʼaḥyaʼun ɛinda rabbihim yurzaqun.
Fariḥina bima ʼatahum Allahu min faḍlihi wa yastabciruna bial-laḏina lam yalḥaqu bihim min xalfihim ʼalla xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Yastabciruna biniɛmatin mina Allahi wa faḍlin wa ʼanna Allaha la yuḍiɛu ʼajra al-muʼminin.
Al-laḏina astajabu Lillahi wa ar-rasuli min baɛdi ma ʼaṣabahum al-qarḥu lillaḏina ʼaḥsanu minhum wa attaqaw ʼajrun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Al-laḏina qala lahum an-nasu ʼinna an-nasa qad jamaɛu lakum faxcawhum fazadahum ʼimanan wa qalu ḥasbuna Allahu wa niɛma al-wakil.
Fanqalabu biniɛmatin mina Allahi wa faḍlin lam yamsas/hum suʼn wa attabaɛu riḍwana Allahi wa Allahu ḏu faḍlin ɛaḏ̣imin.
ʼinnama ḏalikum ac-cayṭanu yuxawwifu ʼawliyaʼahu fala taxafuhum wa xafuni ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Wa la yaḥzunka al-laḏina yusariɛuna fi al-kufri ʼinnahum lan yaḍurru Allaha cayʼan yuridu Allahu ʼalla yajɛala lahum ḥaḏ̣ḏ̣an fi al-ʼaxirati wa lahum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
ʼinna al-laḏina actaraw al-kufra bil-ʼimani lan yaḍurru Allaha cayʼan wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa la yaḥsabanna al-laḏina kafaru ʼannama numli lahum xayrun liʼnfusihim ʼinnama numli lahum liyazdadu ʼiṯman wa lahum ɛaḏabun muhinun.

Ma kana Allahu liyaḏara al-muʼminina ɛala ma ʼantum ɛalayhi ḥatta yamiza al-xabiṯa mina aṭ-ṭayyibi wa ma kana Allahu liyuṭliɛakum ɛala al-ɣaybi wa lakinna Allaha yajtabi min rusulihi man yacaʼu faʼaminu Billahi wa rusulihi wa ʼin tuʼminu wa tattaqu falakum ʼajrun ɛaḏ̣imun.

Wa la yaḥsabanna al-laḏina yabxaluna bima ʼatahum Allahu min faḍlihi huwa xayran lahum bal huwa carrun lahum sayuṭawwaquna ma baxilu bihi yawma al-qiyamati wa Lillahi miraṯu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabirun.
Laqad samiɛa Allahu qawla al-laḏina qalu ʼinna Allaha faqirun wa naḥnu ʼaɣniyaʼu sanaktubu ma qalu wa qatlahum al-ʼanbiyaʼa biɣayri ḥaqqin wa naqulu ḏuqu ɛaḏaba al-ḥariq.
Ḏalika bima qaddamat ʼaydikum wa ʼanna Allaha laysa biḏ̣allamin lilɛabid.

Al-laḏina qalu ʼinna Allaha ɛahida ʼilayna ʼalla nuʼmina lirasulin ḥatta yaʼtiyana biqurbanin taʼkuluhu an-naru qul qad jaʼakum rusulun min qabli bil-bayyinati wa bial-laḏi qultum falima qataltumuhum ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Faʼin kaḏḏabuka faqad kuḏḏiba rusulun min qablika jaʼu bil-bayyinati wa az-zuburi wa al-kitabi al-munir.
Kullu nafsin ḏaʼiqatu al-mawti wa ʼinnama tuwaffawna ʼujurakum yawma al-qiyamati faman zuḥziḥa ɛan an-nari wa ʼudxila al-jannata faqad faza wa ma al-ḥayatu ad-dunya ʼilla mataɛu al-ɣurur.

Latublawunna fi ʼamwalikum wa ʼanfusikum wa latasmaɛunna mina al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba min qablikum wa mina al-laḏina ʼacraku ʼaḏan kaṯiran wa ʼin taṣbiru wa tattaqu faʼinna ḏalika min ɛazmi al-ʼumur.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏa Allahu miṯaqa al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba latubayyinunnahu lilnnasi wa la taktumunahu fanabaḏuhu waraʼa ḏ̣uhurihim wa actaraw bihi ṯamanan qalilan fabiʼsa ma yactarun.
La taḥsabanna al-laḏina yafraḥuna bima ʼataw wa yuḥibbuna ʼan yuḥmadu bima lam yafɛalu fala taḥsabannahum bimafazatin mina al-ɛaḏabi wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
ʼinna fi xalqi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa axtilafi al-layli wa an-nahari lʼayatin liʼwli al-ʼalbab.
Al-laḏina yaḏkuruna Allaha qiyaman wa quɛudan wa ɛala junubihim wa yatafakkaruna fi xalqi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi rabbana ma xalaqta haḏa baṭilan subḥanaka faqina ɛaḏaba an-nar.
Rabbana ʼinnaka man tudxil an-nara faqad ʼaxzaytahu wa ma lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina min ʼanṣarin.
Rabbana ʼinnana samiɛna munadian yunadi lilʼimani ʼan ʼaminu birabbikum faʼamanna rabbana faɣfir lana ḏunubana wa kaffir ɛanna sayyiʼatina wa tawaffana maɛa al-ʼabrar.
Rabbana wa ʼatina ma waɛadtana ɛala rusulika wa la tuxzina yawma al-qiyamati ʼinnaka la tuxlifu al-miɛad.

Fastajaba lahum rabbuhum ʼanni la ʼuḍiɛu ɛamala ɛamilin minkum min ḏakarin ʼaw ʼunṯa baɛḍukum min baɛḍin fa-al-laḏina hajaru wa ʼuxriju min diyarihim wa ʼuḏu fi sabili wa qatalu wa qutilu laʼukaffiranna ɛanhum sayyiʼatihim wa laʼudxilannahum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu ṯawaban min ɛindi Allahi wa Allahu ɛindahu ḥusnu aṯ-ṯawab.
La yaɣurrannaka taqallubu al-laḏina kafaru fi al-bilad.
Mataɛun qalilun ṯumma maʼwahum jahannamu wa biʼsa al-mihad.
Lakin al-laḏina attaqaw rabbahum lahum jannatun tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha nuzulan min ɛindi Allahi wa ma ɛinda Allahi xayrun lilʼabrar.

Wa ʼinna min ʼahli al-kitabi laman yuʼminu Billahi wa ma ʼunzila ʼilaykum wa ma ʼunzila ʼilayhim xaciɛina Lillahi la yactaruna biʼayati Allahi ṯamanan qalilan ʼulaʼika lahum ʼajruhum ɛinda rabbihim ʼinna Allaha sariɛu al-ḥisab.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu aṣbiru wa ṣabiru wa rabiṭu wa attaqu Allaha laɛallakum tufliḥun.

Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu attaqu rabbakum al-laḏi xalaqakum min nafsin waḥidatin wa xalaqa minha zawjaha wa baṯṯa minhuma rijalan kaṯiran wa nisaʼan wa attaqu Allaha al-laḏi tatasaʼaluna bihi wa al-ʼarḥama ʼinna Allaha kana ɛalaykum raqiban.
Wa ʼatu al-yatama ʼamwalahum wa la tatabaddalu al-xabiṯa biṭ-ṭayyibi wa la taʼkulu ʼamwalahum ʼila ʼamwalikum ʼinnahu kana ḥuban kabiran.
Wa ʼin xiftum ʼalla tuqsiṭu fi al-yatama fankiḥu ma ṭaba lakum mina an-nisaʼ maṯna wa ṯulaṯa wa rubaɛa faʼin xiftum ʼalla taɛdilu fawaḥidatan ʼaw ma malakat ʼaymanukum ḏalika ʼadna ʼalla taɛul.
Wa ʼatu an-nisaʼ ṣaduqatihinna niḥlatan faʼin ṭibna lakum ɛan cayʼin minhu nafsan fakuluhu haniʼan mariʼan.
Wa la tuʼtu as-sufahaʼa ʼamwalakum allati jaɛala Allahu lakum qiyaman wa arzuquhum fiha wa aksuhum wa qulu lahum qawlan maɛrufan.

Wa abtalu al-yatama ḥatta ʼiḏa balaɣu an-nikaḥa faʼin ʼanastum minhum rucdan fadfaɛu ʼilayhim ʼamwalahum wa la taʼkuluha ʼisrafan wa bidaran ʼan yakbaru wa man kana ɣaniyan falyastaɛfif wa man kana faqiran falyaʼkul bil-maɛrufi faʼiḏa dafaɛtum ʼilayhim ʼamwalahum faʼac/hidu ɛalayhim wa kafa Billahi ḥasiban.
Lilrrijali naṣibun mimma taraka al-walidani wa al-ʼaqrabuna wa lilnnisaʼi naṣibun mimma taraka al-walidani wa al-ʼaqrabuna mimma qalla minhu ʼaw kaṯura naṣiban mafruḍan.
Wa ʼiḏa ḥaḍara al-qismata ʼulu al-qurba wa al-yatama wa al-masakinu farzuquhum minhu wa qulu lahum qawlan maɛrufan.
Wa liaxca al-laḏina law taraku min xalfihim ḏurriyatan ḍiɛafan xafu ɛalayhim falyattaqu Allaha wa liaqulu qawlan sadidan.
ʼinna al-laḏina yaʼkuluna ʼamwala al-yatama ḏ̣ulman ʼinnama yaʼkuluna fi buṭunihim naran wa sayaṣlawna saɛiran.

Yuṣikum Allahu fi ʼawladikum lilḏḏakari miṯlu ḥaḏ̣ḏ̣i al-ʼunṯayayni faʼin kunna nisaʼan fawqa aṯnatayni falahunna ṯuluṯa ma taraka wa ʼin kanat waḥidatan falaha an-niṣfu wa liʼabawayhi likulli waḥidin minhuma as-sudusu mimma taraka ʼin kana lahu waladun faʼin lam yakun lahu waladun wa wariṯahu ʼabawahu faliʼammihi aṯ-ṯuluṯu faʼin kana lahu ʼixwatun faliʼammihi as-sudusu min baɛdi waṣiyatin yuṣi biha ʼaw daynin ʼabaʼuukum wa ʼabnaʼuukum la tadruna ʼayyuhum ʼaqrabu lakum nafɛan fariḍatan mina Allahi ʼinna Allaha kana ɛaliman ḥakiman.

Wa lakum niṣfu ma taraka ʼazwajukum ʼin lam yakun lahunna waladun faʼin kana lahunna waladun falakum ar-rubuɛu mimma tarakna min baɛdi waṣiyatin yuṣina biha ʼaw daynin wa lahunna ar-rubuɛu mimma taraktum ʼin lam yakun lakum waladun faʼin kana lakum waladun falahunna aṯ-ṯumunu mimma taraktum min baɛdi waṣiyatin tuṣuna biha ʼaw daynin wa ʼin kana rajulun yuraṯu kalalatan ʼaw amraʼatun wa lahu ʼaxun ʼaw ʼuxtun falikulli waḥidin minhuma as-sudusu faʼin kanu ʼakṯara min ḏalika fahum curakaʼu fi aṯ-ṯuluṯi min baɛdi waṣiyatin yuṣa biha ʼaw daynin ɣayra muḍarrin waṣiyatan mina Allahi wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥalimun.
Tilka ḥududu Allahi wa man yuṭiɛ Allaha wa rasulahu yudxilhu jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha wa ḏalika al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa man yaɛṣi Allaha wa rasulahu wa yataɛadda ḥududahu yudxilhu naran xalidan fiha wa lahu ɛaḏabun muhinun.
Wa al-lati yaʼtina al-faḥicata min nisaʼikum fastac/hidu ɛalayhinna ʼarbaɛatan minkum faʼin cahidu faʼamsikuhunna fi al-buyuti ḥatta yatawaffahunna al-mawtu ʼaw yajɛala Allahu lahunna sabilan.
Wa al-laḏani yaʼtiyaniha minkum faʼaḏuhuma faʼin taba wa ʼaṣlaḥa faʼaɛriḍu ɛanhuma ʼinna Allaha kana tawwaban raḥiman.
