ʼinnama at-tawbat ɛala Allahi lillaḏina yaɛmaluna as-suʼa bijahalatin ṯumma yatubuna min qaribin faʼulaʼika yatubu Allahu ɛalayhim wa kana Allahu ɛaliman ḥakiman.
Wa laysat at-tawbat lillaḏina yaɛmaluna as-sayyiʼati ḥatta ʼiḏa ḥaḍara ʼaḥadahum al-mawtu qala ʼinni tubtu al-ʼana wa la al-laḏina yamutuna wa hum kuffarun ʼulaʼika ʼaɛtadna lahum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la yaḥillu lakum ʼan tariṯu an-nisaʼ karhan wa la taɛḍuluhunna litaḏ/habu bibaɛḍi ma ʼataytumuhunna ʼilla ʼan yaʼtina bifaḥicatin mubayyinatin wa ɛaciruhunna bil-maɛrufi faʼin karihtumuhunna faɛasa ʼan takrahu cayʼan wa yajɛala Allahu fihi xayran kaṯiran.
Wa ʼin ʼaradtum astibdala zawjin makana zawjin wa ʼataytum ʼiḥdahunna qinṭaran fala taʼxuḏu minhu cayʼan ʼataʼxuḏunahu buhtanan wa ʼiṯman mubinan.
Wa kayfa taʼxuḏunahu wa qad ʼafḍa baɛḍukum ʼila baɛḍin wa ʼaxaḏna minkum miṯaqan ɣaliḏ̣an.
Wa la tankiḥu ma nakaḥa ʼabaʼuukum mina an-nisaʼ ʼilla ma qad salafa ʼinnahu kana faḥicatan wa maqtan wa saʼa sabilan.

Ḥurrimat ɛalaykum ʼummahatukum wa banatukum wa ʼaxawatukum wa ɛammatukum wa xalatukum wa banatu al-ʼaxi wa banatu al-ʼuxti wa ʼummahatukum al-lati ʼarḍaɛnakum wa ʼaxawatukum mina ar-raḍaɛati wa ʼummahatu nisaʼikum wa rabaʼibukum al-lati fi ḥujurikum min nisaʼikum al-lati daxaltum bihinna faʼin lam takunu daxaltum bihinna fala junaḥa ɛalaykum wa ḥalaʼilu ʼabnaʼikum al-laḏina min ʼaṣlabikum wa ʼan tajmaɛu bayna al-ʼuxtayni ʼilla ma qad salafa ʼinna Allaha kana ɣafuran raḥiman.

Wa al-muḥṣanatu mina an-nisaʼ ʼilla ma malakat ʼaymanukum kitaba Allahi ɛalaykum wa ʼuḥilla lakum ma waraʼa ḏalikum ʼan tabtaɣu biʼamwalikum muḥṣinina ɣayra musafiḥina fama astamtaɛtum bihi minhunna faʼatuhunna ʼujurahunna fariḍatan wa la junaḥa ɛalaykum fima taraḍaytum bihi min baɛdi al-fariḍati ʼinna Allaha kana ɛaliman ḥakiman.

Wa man lam yastaṭiɛ minkum ṭawlan ʼan yankiḥa al-muḥṣanati al-muʼminati famin ma malakat ʼaymanukum min fatayatikum al-muʼminati wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu biʼimanikum baɛḍukum min baɛḍin fankiḥuhunna biʼiḏni ʼhlihinna wa ʼatuhunna ʼujurahunna bil-maɛrufi muḥṣanatin ɣayra musafiḥatin wa la muttaxiḏati ʼaxdanin faʼiḏa ʼuḥṣinna faʼin ʼatayna bifaḥicatin faɛalayhinna niṣfu ma ɛala al-muḥṣanati mina al-ɛaḏabi ḏalika liman xaciya al-ɛanata minkum wa ʼan taṣbiru xayrun lakum wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Yuridu Allahu liyubayyina lakum wa yahdiyakum sunana al-laḏina min qablikum wa yatuba ɛalaykum wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
Wa Allahu yuridu ʼan yatuba ɛalaykum wa yuridu al-laḏina yattabiɛuna ac-cahawati ʼan tamilu maylan ɛaḏ̣iman.
Yuridu Allahu ʼan yuxaffifa ɛankum wa xuliqa al-ʼinsanu ḍaɛifan.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la taʼkulu ʼamwalakum baynakum bil-baṭili ʼilla ʼan takuna tijaratan ɛan taraḍin minkum wa la taqtulu ʼanfusakum ʼinna Allaha kana bikum raḥiman.
Wa man yafɛal ḏalika ɛudwanan wa ḏ̣ulman fasawfa nuṣlihi naran wa kana ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasiran.
ʼin tajtanibu kabaʼira ma tunhawna ɛanhu nukaffir ɛankum sayyiʼatikum wa nudxilkum mudxalan kariman.

Wa la tatamannaw ma faḍḍala Allahu bihi baɛḍakum ɛala baɛḍin lilrrijali naṣibun mimma aktasabu wa lilnnisaʼi naṣibun mimma aktasabna wa asʼalu Allaha min faḍlihi ʼinna Allaha kana bikulli cayʼin ɛaliman.
Wa likullin jaɛalna mawaliya mimma taraka al-walidani wa al-ʼaqrabuna wa al-laḏina ɛaqadat ʼaymanukum faʼatuhum naṣibahum ʼinna Allaha kana ɛala kulli cayʼin cahidan.

Ar-rijalu qawwamuna ɛala an-nisaʼ bima faḍḍala Allahu baɛḍahum ɛala baɛḍin wa bima ʼanfaqu min ʼamwalihim falṣṣaliḥatu qanitatun ḥafiḏ̣atun lilɣaybi bima ḥafiḏ̣a Allahu wa al-lati taxafuna nucuzahunna faɛiḏ̣uhunna wa ahjuruhunna fi al-maḍajiɛi wa aḍribuhunna faʼin ʼaṭaɛnakum fala tabɣu ɛalayhinna sabilan ʼinna Allaha kana ɛaliyan kabiran.
Wa ʼin xiftum ciqaqa baynihima fabɛaṯu ḥakaman min ʼahlihi wa ḥakaman min ʼahliha ʼin yurida ʼiṣlaḥan yuwaffiq Allahu baynahuma ʼinna Allaha kana ɛaliman xabiran.

Wa aɛbudu Allaha wa la tucriku bihi cayʼan wa bil-walidayni ʼiḥsanan wa biḏi al-qurba wa al-yatama wa al-masakini wa al-jari ḏi al-qurba wa al-jari al-junubi wa aṣ-ṣaḥibi bil-janbi wa abni as-sabili wa ma malakat ʼaymanukum ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu man kana muxtalan faxuran.
Al-laḏina yabxaluna wa yaʼmuruna an-nasa bil-buxli wa yaktumuna ma ʼatahum Allahu min faḍlihi wa ʼaɛtadna lilkafirina ɛaḏaban muhinan.
Wa al-laḏina yunfiquna ʼamwalahum riʼaʼa an-nasi wa la yuʼminuna Billahi wa la bil-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa man yakun ac-cayṭanu lahu qarinan fasaʼa qarinan.
Wa maḏa ɛalayhim law ʼamanu Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa ʼanfaqu mimma razaqahum Allahu wa kana Allahu bihim ɛaliman.
ʼinna Allaha la yaḏ̣limu miṯqala ḏarratin wa ʼin takun ḥasanatan yuḍaɛifha wa yuʼti min ladunhu ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Fakayfa ʼiḏa jiʼna min kulli ʼummatin bicahidin wa jiʼna bika ɛala haʼuulaʼ cahidan.
Yawmaʼiḏin yawaddu al-laḏina kafaru wa ɛaṣaw ar-rasula law tusawwa bihim al-ʼarḍu wa la yaktumuna Allaha ḥadiṯan.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la taqrabu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼantum sukara ḥatta taɛlamu ma taquluna wa la junuban ʼilla ɛabiri sabilin ḥatta taɣtasilu wa ʼin kuntum marḍa ʼaw ɛala safarin ʼaw jaʼa ʼaḥadun minkum mina al-ɣaʼiṭi ʼaw lamastum an-nisaʼ falam tajidu maʼan fatayammamu ṣaɛidan ṭayyiban famsaḥu biwujuhikum wa ʼaydikum ʼinna Allaha kana ɛafuwan ɣafuran.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina ʼutu naṣiban mina al-kitabi yactaruna aḍ-ḍalalata wa yuriduna ʼan taḍillu as-sabil.
Wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu biʼaɛdaʼikum wa kafa Billahi waliyan wa kafa Billahi naṣiran.

Mina al-laḏina hadu yuḥarrifuna al-kalima ɛan mawaḍiɛihi wa yaquluna samiɛna wa ɛaṣayna wa asmaɛ ɣayra musmaɛin wa raɛina layyan biʼalsinatihim wa ṭaɛnan fi ad-dini wa law ʼannahum qalu samiɛna wa ʼaṭaɛna wa asmaɛ wa anḏ̣urna lakana xayran lahum wa ʼaqwama wa lakin laɛanahum Allahu bikufrihim fala yuʼminuna ʼilla qalilan.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba ʼaminu bima nazzalna muṣaddiqan lima maɛakum min qabli ʼan naṭmisa wujuhan fanaruddaha ɛala ʼadbariha ʼaw nalɛanahum kama laɛanna ʼaṣḥaba as-sabti wa kana ʼamru Allahi mafɛulan.
ʼinna Allaha la yaɣfiru ʼan yucraka bihi wa yaɣfiru ma duna ḏalika liman yacaʼu wa man yucrik Billahi faqad aftara ʼiṯman ɛaḏ̣iman.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina yuzakkuna ʼanfusahum bal Allahu yuzakki man yacaʼu wa la yuḏ̣lamuna fatilan.
Anḏ̣ur kayfa yaftaruna ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba wa kafa bihi ʼiṯman mubinan.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina ʼutu naṣiban mina al-kitabi yuʼminuna bil-jibti wa aṭ-ṭaɣuti wa yaquluna lillaḏina kafaru haʼuulaʼ ʼahda mina al-laḏina ʼamanu sabilan.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina laɛanahum Allahu wa man yalɛan Allahu falan tajida lahu naṣiran.
ʼam lahum naṣibun mina al-mulki faʼiḏan la yuʼtuna an-nasa naqiran.
ʼam yaḥsuduna an-nasa ɛala ma ʼatahum Allahu min faḍlihi faqad ʼatayna ʼala ʼibrahima al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa ʼataynahum mulkan ɛaḏ̣iman.
Faminhum man ʼamana bihi wa minhum man ṣadda ɛanhu wa kafa bijahannama saɛiran.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru biʼayatina sawfa nuṣlihim naran kullama naḍijat juluduhum baddalnahum juludan ɣayraha liyaḏuqu al-ɛaḏaba ʼinna Allaha kana ɛazizan ḥakiman.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati sanudxiluhum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ʼabadan lahum fiha ʼazwajun muṭahharatun wa nudxiluhum ḏ̣illa ḏ̣alilan.
ʼinna Allaha yaʼmurukum ʼan tuʼaddu al-ʼamanati ʼila ʼahliha wa ʼiḏa ḥakamtum bayna an-nasi ʼan taḥkumu bil-ɛadli ʼinna Allaha niɛimma yaɛiḏ̣ukum bihi ʼinna Allaha kana samiɛan baṣiran.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa ʼaṭiɛu ar-rasula wa ʼuli al-ʼamri minkum faʼin tanazaɛtum fi cayʼin farudduhu ʼila Allahi wa ar-rasuli ʼin kuntum tuʼminuna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri ḏalika xayrun wa ʼaḥsanu taʼwilan.

ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina yazɛumuna ʼannahum ʼamanu bima ʼunzila ʼilayka wa ma ʼunzila min qablika yuriduna ʼan yataḥakamu ʼila aṭ-ṭaɣuti wa qad ʼumiru ʼan yakfuru bihi wa yuridu ac-cayṭanu ʼan yuḍillahum ḍalalan baɛidan.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum taɛalaw ʼila ma ʼanzala Allahu wa ʼila ar-rasuli raʼayta al-munafiqina yaṣudduna ɛanka ṣududan.
Fakayfa ʼiḏa ʼaṣabat/hum muṣibatun bima qaddamat ʼaydihim ṯumma jaʼuka yaḥlifuna Billahi ʼin ʼaradna ʼilla ʼiḥsanan wa tawfiqan.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina yaɛlamu Allahu ma fi qulubihim faʼaɛriḍ ɛanhum wa ɛiḏ̣hum wa qul lahum fi ʼanfusihim qawlan baliɣan.
Wa ma ʼarsalna min rasulin ʼilla liyuṭaɛa biʼiḏni Allahi wa law ʼannahum ʼiḏ ḏ̣alamu ʼanfusahum jaʼuka fastaɣfaru Allaha wa astaɣfara lahum ar-rasulu lawajadu Allaha tawwaban raḥiman.
Fala wa rabbika la yuʼminuna ḥatta yuḥakkimuka fima cajara baynahum ṯumma la yajidu fi ʼanfusihim ḥarajan mimma qaḍayta wa yusallimu tasliman.
Wa law ʼanna katabna ɛalayhim ʼan aqtulu ʼanfusakum ʼaw axruju min diyarikum ma faɛaluhu ʼilla qalilun minhum wa law ʼannahum faɛalu ma yuɛaḏ̣una bihi lakana xayran lahum wa ʼacadda taṯbitan.
Wa ʼiḏan laʼataynahum min ladunna ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Wa lahadaynahum ṣiraṭan mustaqiman.
Wa man yuṭiɛ Allaha wa ar-rasula faʼulaʼika maɛa al-laḏina ʼanɛama Allahu ɛalayhim mina an-nabiyina wa aṣ-ṣiddiqina wa ac-cuhadaʼi wa aṣ-ṣaliḥina wa ḥasuna ʼulaʼika rafiqan.
Ḏalika al-faḍlu mina Allahi wa kafa Billahi ɛaliman.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu xuḏu ḥiḏrakum fanfiru ṯubatin ʼaw anfiru jamiɛan.
Wa ʼinna minkum laman layubaṭṭiʼanna faʼin ʼaṣabatkum muṣibatun qala qad ʼanɛama Allahu ɛalayya ʼiḏ lam ʼakun maɛahum cahidan.
Wa laʼin ʼaṣabakum faḍlun mina Allahi layaqulanna kaʼan lam takun baynakum wa baynahu mawaddatun ya laytani kuntu maɛahum faʼafuza fawzan ɛaḏ̣iman.
Falyuqatil fi sabili Allahi al-laḏina yacruna al-ḥayata ad-dunya bil-ʼaxirati wa man yuqatil fi sabili Allahi fayuqtal ʼaw yaɣlib fasawfa nuʼtihi ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.

Wa ma lakum la tuqatiluna fi sabili Allahi wa al-mustaḍɛafina mina ar-rijali wa an-nisaʼ wa al-wildani al-laḏina yaquluna rabbana ʼaxrijna min haḏihi al-qaryati aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimi ʼahluha wa ajɛal lana min ladunka waliyan wa ajɛal lana min ladunka naṣiran.
Al-laḏina ʼamanu yuqatiluna fi sabili Allahi wa al-laḏina kafaru yuqatiluna fi sabili aṭ-ṭaɣuti faqatilu ʼawliyaʼa ac-cayṭani ʼinna kayda ac-cayṭani kana ḍaɛifan.

ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina qila lahum kuffu ʼaydiyakum wa ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatu az-zakata falamma kutiba ɛalayhim al-qitalu ʼiḏa fariqun minhum yaxcawna an-nasa kaxacyati Allahi ʼaw ʼacadda xacyatan wa qalu rabbana lima katabta ɛalayna al-qitala lawla ʼaxxartana ʼila ʼajalin qaribin qul mataɛu ad-dunya qalilun wa al-ʼaxiratu xayrun liman attaqa wa la tuḏ̣lamuna fatilan.

ʼaynama takunu yudrikkum al-mawtu wa law kuntum fi burujin mucayyadatin wa ʼin tuṣibhum ḥasanatun yaqulu haḏihi min ɛindi Allahi wa ʼin tuṣibhum sayyiʼatun yaqulu haḏihi min ɛindika qul kullun min ɛindi Allahi famali haʼuulaʼ al-qawmi la yakaduna yafqahuna ḥadiṯan.
Ma ʼaṣabaka min ḥasanatin famina Allahi wa ma ʼaṣabaka min sayyiʼatin famin nafsika wa ʼarsalnaka lilnnasi rasulan wa kafa Billahi cahidan.
Man yuṭiɛ ar-rasula faqad ʼaṭaɛa Allaha wa man tawalla fama ʼarsalnaka ɛalayhim ḥafiḏ̣an.
Wa yaquluna ṭaɛatun faʼiḏa barazu min ɛindika bayyata ṭaʼifatun minhum ɣayra al-laḏi taqulu wa Allahu yaktubu ma yubayyituna faʼaɛriḍ ɛanhum wa tawakkal ɛala Allahi wa kafa Billahi wa kilan.
ʼafala yatadabbaruna al-qurʼana wa law kana min ɛindi ɣayri Allahi lawajadu fihi axtilafan kaṯiran.

Wa ʼiḏa jaʼahum ʼamrun mina al-ʼamni ʼaw al-xawfi ʼaḏaɛu bihi wa law radduhu ʼila ar-rasuli wa ʼila ʼuli al-ʼamri minhum laɛalimahu al-laḏina yastanbiṭunahu minhum wa lawla faḍlu Allahi ɛalaykum wa raḥmatuhu lattabaɛtum ac-cayṭana ʼilla qalilan.
Faqatil fi sabili Allahi la tukallafu ʼilla nafsaka wa ḥarriḍ al-muʼminina ɛasa Allahu ʼan yakuffa baʼsa al-laḏina kafaru wa Allahu ʼacaddu baʼsan wa ʼacaddu tankilan.
Man yacfaɛ cafaɛatan ḥasanatan yakun lahu naṣibun minha wa man yacfaɛ cafaɛatan sayyiʼatan yakun lahu kiflun minha wa kana Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin muqitan.
Wa ʼiḏa ḥuyyitum bitaḥiyatin faḥayyu biʼaḥsana minha ʼaw rudduha ʼinna Allaha kana ɛala kulli cayʼin ḥasiban.
Allahu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa layajmaɛannakum ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati la rayba fihi wa man ʼaṣdaqu mina Allahi ḥadiṯan.
Fama lakum fi al-munafiqina fiʼatayni wa Allahu ʼarkasahum bima kasabu ʼaturiduna ʼan tahdu man ʼaḍalla Allahu wa man yuḍlil Allahu falan tajida lahu sabilan.

Wa ddu law takfuruna kama kafaru fatakununa sawaʼan fala tattaxiḏu minhum ʼawliyaʼa ḥatta yuhajiru fi sabili Allahi faʼin tawallaw faxuḏuhum waqtuluhum ḥayṯu wajadtumuhum wa la tattaxiḏu minhum waliyan wa la naṣiran.

ʼilla al-laḏina yaṣiluna ʼila qawmin baynakum wa baynahum miṯaqun ʼaw jaʼukum ḥaṣirat ṣuduruhum ʼan yuqatilukum ʼaw yuqatilu qawmahum wa law caʼa Allahu lasallaṭahum ɛalaykum falaqatalukum faʼin aɛtazalukum falam yuqatilukum wa ʼalqaw ʼilaykum as-salama fama jaɛala Allahu lakum ɛalayhim sabilan.

Satajiduna ʼaxarina yuriduna ʼan yaʼmanukum wa yaʼmanu qawmahum kulla ma ruddu ʼila al-fitnati ʼurkisu fiha faʼin lam yaɛtazilukum wa yulqu ʼilaykum as-salama wa yakuffu ʼaydiyahum faxuḏuhum waqtuluhum ḥayṯu ṯaqiftumuhum wa ʼulaʼikum jaɛalna lakum ɛalayhim sulṭanan mubinan.

Wa ma kana limuʼminin ʼan yaqtula muʼminan ʼilla xaṭaʼan wa man qatala muʼminan xaṭaʼan fataḥriru raqabatin muʼminatin wa diyatun musallamatun ʼila ʼahlihi ʼilla ʼan yaṣṣaddaqu faʼin kana min qawmin ɛaduwin lakum wa huwa muʼminun fataḥriru raqabatin muʼminatin wa ʼin kana min qawmin baynakum wa baynahum miṯaqun fadiyatun musallamatun ʼila ʼahlihi wa taḥriru raqabatin muʼminatin faman lam yajid faṣiyamu cahrayni mutatabiɛayni tawbatan mina Allahi wa kana Allahu ɛaliman ḥakiman.
Wa man yaqtul muʼminan mutaɛammidan fajazaʼuuhu jahannamu xalidan fiha wa ɣaḍiba Allahu ɛalayhi wa laɛanahu wa ʼaɛadda lahu ɛaḏaban ɛaḏ̣iman.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa ḍarabtum fi sabili Allahi fatabayyanu wa la taqulu liman ʼalqa ʼilaykum as-salama lasta muʼminan tabtaɣuna ɛaraḍa al-ḥayati ad-dunya faɛinda Allahi maɣanimu kaṯiratun kaḏalika kuntum min qablu famanna Allahu ɛalaykum fatabayyanu ʼinna Allaha kana bima taɛmaluna xabiran.

La yastawi al-qaɛiduna mina al-muʼminina ɣayru ʼuli aḍ-ḍarari wa al-mujahiduna fi sabili Allahi biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim faḍḍala Allahu al-mujahidina biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim ɛala al-qaɛidina darajatan wa kullan waɛada Allahu al-ḥusna wa faḍḍala Allahu al-mujahidina ɛala al-qaɛidina ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Darajatin minhu wa maɣfiratan wa raḥmatan wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.

ʼinna al-laḏina tawaffahum al-malaʼikatu ḏ̣alimi ʼanfusihim qalu fima kuntum qalu kunna mustaḍɛafina fi al-ʼarḍi qalu ʼalam takun ʼarḍu Allahi wasiɛatan fatuhajiru fiha faʼulaʼika maʼwahum jahannamu wa saʼat maṣiran.
ʼilla al-mustaḍɛafina mina ar-rijali wa an-nisaʼ wa al-wildani la yastaṭiɛuna ḥilatan wa la yahtaduna sabilan.
Faʼulaʼika ɛasa Allahu ʼan yaɛfuwa ɛanhum wa kana Allahu ɛafuwan ɣafuran.

Wa man yuhajir fi sabili Allahi yajid fi al-ʼarḍi muraɣaman kaṯiran wa saɛatan wa man yaxruj min baytihi muhajiran ʼila Allahi wa rasulihi ṯumma yudrik/hu al-mawtu faqad waqaɛa ʼajruhu ɛala Allahi wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.
Wa ʼiḏa ḍarabtum fi al-ʼarḍi falaysa ɛalaykum junaḥun ʼan taqṣuru mina aṣ-ṣalati ʼin xiftum ʼan yaftinakum al-laḏina kafaru ʼinna al-kafirina kanu lakum ɛaduwan mubinan.

Wa ʼiḏa kunta fihim faʼaqamta lahum aṣ-ṣalata faltaqum ṭaʼifatun minhum maɛaka wa liaʼxuḏu ʼasliḥatahum faʼiḏa sajadu falyakunu min waraʼikum wa ltaʼti ṭaʼifatun ʼuxra lam yuṣallu falyuṣallu maɛaka wa liaʼxuḏu ḥiḏrahum wa ʼasliḥatahum wadda al-laḏina kafaru law taɣfuluna ɛan ʼasliḥatikum wa ʼamtiɛatikum fayamiluna ɛalaykum maylatan waḥidatan wa la junaḥa ɛalaykum ʼin kana bikum ʼaḏan min maṭarin ʼaw kuntum marḍa ʼan taḍaɛu ʼasliḥatakum wa xuḏu ḥiḏrakum ʼinna Allaha ʼaɛadda lilkafirina ɛaḏaban muhinan.
Faʼiḏa qaḍaytum aṣ-ṣalata faḏkuru Allaha qiyaman wa quɛudan wa ɛala junubikum faʼiḏa aṭmaʼnantum faʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata ʼinna aṣ-ṣalata kanat ɛala al-muʼminina kitaban mawqutan.
Wa la tahinu fi abtiɣaʼi al-qawmi ʼin takunu taʼlamuna faʼinnahum yaʼlamuna kama taʼlamuna wa tarjuna mina Allahi ma la yarjuna wa kana Allahu ɛaliman ḥakiman.
ʼinna ʼanzalna ʼilayka al-kitaba bil-ḥaqqi litaḥkuma bayna an-nasi bima ʼaraka Allahu wa la takun lilxaʼinina xaṣiman.
Wa astaɣfir Allaha ʼinna Allaha kana ɣafuran raḥiman.
Wa la tujadil ɛan al-laḏina yaxtanuna ʼanfusahum ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu man kana xawwanan ʼaṯiman.
Yastaxfuna mina an-nasi wa la yastaxfuna mina Allahi wa huwa maɛahum ʼiḏ yubayyituna ma la yarḍa mina al-qawli wa kana Allahu bima yaɛmaluna muḥiṭan.
Haʼantum haʼuulaʼ jadaltum ɛanhum fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya faman yujadilu Allaha ɛanhum yawma al-qiyamati ʼam man yakunu ɛalayhim wa kilan.
Wa man yaɛmal suʼan ʼaw yaḏ̣lim nafsahu ṯumma yastaɣfir Allaha yajid Allaha ɣafuran raḥiman.
Wa man yaksib ʼiṯman faʼinnama yaksibuhu ɛala nafsihi wa kana Allahu ɛaliman ḥakiman.
Wa man yaksib xaṭiʼatan ʼaw ʼiṯman ṯumma yarmi bihi bariʼan faqad aḥtamala buhtanan wa ʼiṯman mubinan.

Wa lawla faḍlu Allahi ɛalayka wa raḥmatuhu lahammat ṭaʼifatun minhum ʼan yuḍilluka wa ma yuḍilluna ʼilla ʼanfusahum wa ma yaḍurrunaka min cayʼin wa ʼanzala Allahu ɛalayka al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa ɛallamaka ma lam takun taɛlamu wa kana faḍlu Allahi ɛalayka ɛaḏ̣iman.
La xayra fi kaṯirin min najwahum ʼilla man ʼamara biṣadaqatin ʼaw maɛrufin ʼaw ʼiṣlaḥin bayna an-nasi wa man yafɛal ḏalika abtiɣaʼa marḍati Allahi fasawfa nuʼtihi ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Wa man yucaqiq ar-rasula min baɛdi ma tabayyana lahu al-huda wa yattabiɛ ɣayra sabili al-muʼminina nuwallihi ma tawalla wa nuṣlihi jahannama wa saʼat maṣiran.
ʼinna Allaha la yaɣfiru ʼan yucraka bihi wa yaɣfiru ma duna ḏalika liman yacaʼu wa man yucrik Billahi faqad ḍalla ḍalalan baɛidan.
ʼin yadɛuna min dunihi ʼilla ʼinaṯan wa ʼin yadɛuna ʼilla cayṭanan maridan.
Laɛanahu Allahu wa qala laʼattaxiḏanna min ɛibadika naṣiban mafruḍan.

Wa laʼuḍillannahum wa laʼumanniyannahum wa laʼamurannahum falayubattikunna ʼaḏana al-ʼanɛam wa laʼamurannahum falayuɣayyirunna xalqa Allahi wa man yattaxiḏ ac-cayṭana waliyan min duni Allahi faqad xasira xusranan mubinan.
Yaɛiduhum wa yumannihim wa ma yaɛiduhum ac-cayṭanu ʼilla ɣururan.
ʼulaʼika maʼwahum jahannamu wa la yajiduna ɛanha maḥiṣan.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati sanudxiluhum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ʼabadan waɛda Allahi ḥaqqan wa man ʼaṣdaqu mina Allahi qilan.
Laysa biʼamaniyikum wa la ʼamaniyi ʼahli al-kitabi man yaɛmal suʼan yujza bihi wa la yajid lahu min duni Allahi waliyan wa la naṣiran.
Wa man yaɛmal mina aṣ-ṣaliḥati min ḏakarin ʼaw ʼunṯa wa huwa muʼminun faʼulaʼika yadxuluna al-jannata wa la yuḏ̣lamuna naqiran.
Wa man ʼaḥsanu dinan mimman ʼaslama wajhahu Lillahi wa huwa muḥsinun wa attabaɛa millata ʼibrahima ḥanifan wa attaxaḏa Allahu ʼibrahima xalilan.
Wa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa kana Allahu bikulli cayʼin muḥiṭan.

Wa yastaftunaka fi an-nisaʼ qul Allahu yuftikum fihinna wa ma yutla ɛalaykum fi al-kitabi fi yatama an-nisaʼ al-lati la tuʼtunahunna ma kutiba lahunna wa tarɣabuna ʼan tankiḥuhunna wa al-mustaḍɛafina mina al-wildani wa ʼan taqumu lilyatama bil-qisṭi wa ma tafɛalu min xayrin faʼinna Allaha kana bihi ɛaliman.

Wa ʼin amraʼatun xafat min baɛliha nucuzan ʼaw ʼiɛraḍan fala junaḥa ɛalayhima ʼan yuṣliḥa baynahuma ṣulḥan wa aṣ-ṣulḥu xayrun wa ʼuḥḍirat al-ʼanfusu ac-cuḥḥa wa ʼin tuḥsinu wa tattaqu faʼinna Allaha kana bima taɛmaluna xabiran.
Wa lan tastaṭiɛu ʼan taɛdilu bayna an-nisaʼ wa law ḥaraṣtum fala tamilu kulla al-mayli fataḏaruha kalmuɛallaqati wa ʼin tuṣliḥu wa tattaqu faʼinna Allaha kana ɣafuran raḥiman.
Wa ʼin yatafarraqa yuɣni Allahu kulla min saɛatihi wa kana Allahu wasiɛan ḥakiman.

Wa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa laqad waṣṣayna al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba min qablikum wa ʼiyakum ʼan attaqu Allaha wa ʼin takfuru faʼinna Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa kana Allahu ɣaniyan ḥamidan.
Wa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa kafa Billahi wa kilan.
ʼin yacaʼ yuḏ/hibkum ʼayyuha an-nasu wa yaʼti biʼaxarina wa kana Allahu ɛala ḏalika qadiran.
Man kana yuridu ṯawaba ad-dunya faɛinda Allahi ṯawabu ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa kana Allahu samiɛan baṣiran.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu kunu qawwamina bil-qisṭi cuhadaʼa Lillahi wa law ɛala ʼanfusikum ʼaw al-walidayni wa al-ʼaqrabina ʼin yakun ɣaniyan ʼaw faqiran fa-Allahu ʼawla bihima fala tattabiɛu al-hawa ʼan taɛdilu wa ʼin talwu ʼaw tuɛriḍu faʼinna Allaha kana bima taɛmaluna xabiran.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼaminu Billahi wa rasulihi wa al-kitabi al-laḏi nazzala ɛala rasulihi wa al-kitabi al-laḏi ʼanzala min qablu wa man yakfur Billahi wa malaʼikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri faqad ḍalla ḍalalan baɛidan.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu ṯumma kafaru ṯumma ʼamanu ṯumma kafaru ṯumma azdadu kufran lam yakun Allahu liyaɣfira lahum wa la liyahdiyahum sabilan.
Baccir al-munafiqina biʼanna lahum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.
Al-laḏina yattaxiḏuna al-kafirina ʼawliyaʼa min duni al-muʼminina ʼayabtaɣuna ɛindahum al-ɛizzata faʼinna al-ɛizzata Lillahi jamiɛan.

Wa qad nazzala ɛalaykum fi al-kitabi ʼan ʼiḏa samiɛtum ʼayati Allahi yukfaru biha wa yustahzaʼu biha fala taqɛudu maɛahum ḥatta yaxuḍu fi ḥadiṯin ɣayrihi ʼinnakum ʼiḏan miṯluhum ʼinna Allaha jamiɛu al-munafiqina wa al-kafirina fi jahannama jamiɛan.

Al-laḏina yatarabbaṣuna bikum faʼin kana lakum fatḥun mina Allahi qalu ʼalam nakun maɛakum wa ʼin kana lilkafirina naṣibun qalu ʼalam nastaḥwiḏ ɛalaykum wa namnaɛkum mina al-muʼminina fa-Allahu yaḥkumu baynakum yawma al-qiyamati wa lan yajɛala Allahu lilkafirina ɛala al-muʼminina sabilan.
ʼinna al-munafiqina yuxadiɛuna Allaha wa huwa xadiɛuhum wa ʼiḏa qamu ʼila aṣ-ṣalati qamu kusala yuraʼuna an-nasa wa la yaḏkuruna Allaha ʼilla qalilan.
Muḏabḏabina bayna ḏalika la ʼila haʼuulaʼ wa la ʼila haʼuulaʼ wa man yuḍlil Allahu falan tajida lahu sabilan.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tattaxiḏu al-kafirina ʼawliyaʼa min duni al-muʼminina ʼaturiduna ʼan tajɛalu Lillahi ɛalaykum sulṭanan mubinan.
ʼinna al-munafiqina fi ad-darki al-ʼasfali mina an-nari wa lan tajida lahum naṣiran.
ʼilla al-laḏina tabu wa ʼaṣlaḥu wa aɛtaṣamu Billahi wa ʼaxlaṣu dinahum Lillahi faʼulaʼika maɛa al-muʼminina wa sawfa yuʼti Allahu al-muʼminina ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Ma yafɛalu Allahu biɛaḏabikum ʼin cakartum wa ʼamantum wa kana Allahu cakiran ɛaliman.
La yuḥibbu Allahu al-jahra bis-suʼi mina al-qawli ʼilla man ḏ̣ulima wa kana Allahu samiɛan ɛaliman.
ʼin tubdu xayran ʼaw tuxfuhu ʼaw taɛfu ɛan suʼin faʼinna Allaha kana ɛafuwan qadiran.
ʼinna al-laḏina yakfuruna Billahi wa rusulihi wa yuriduna ʼan yufarriqu bayna Allahi wa rusulihi wa yaquluna nuʼminu bibaɛḍin wa nakfuru bibaɛḍin wa yuriduna ʼan yattaxiḏu bayna ḏalika sabilan.
ʼulaʼika hum al-kafiruna ḥaqqan wa ʼaɛtadna lilkafirina ɛaḏaban muhinan.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu Billahi wa rusulihi wa lam yufarriqu bayna ʼaḥadin minhum ʼulaʼika sawfa yuʼtihim ʼujurahum wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.

Yasʼaluka ʼahlu al-kitabi ʼan tunazzila ɛalayhim kitaban mina as-samaʼi faqad saʼalu musa ʼakbara min ḏalika faqalu ʼarina Allaha jahratan faʼaxaḏat/hum aṣ-ṣaɛiqatu biḏ̣ulmihim ṯumma attaxaḏu al-ɛijla min baɛdi ma jaʼat/hum al-bayyinatu faɛafawna ɛan ḏalika wa ʼatayna musa sulṭanan mubinan.
Wa rafaɛna fawqahum aṭ-ṭura bimiṯaqihim wa qulna lahum adxulu al-baba sujjadan wa qulna lahum la taɛdu fi as-sabti wa ʼaxaḏna minhum miṯaqan ɣaliḏ̣an.
Fabima naqḍihim miṯaqahum wa kufrihim biʼayati Allahi wa qatlihim al-ʼanbiyaʼa biɣayri ḥaqqin wa qawlihim qulubuna ɣulfun bal ṭabaɛa Allahu ɛalayha bikufrihim fala yuʼminuna ʼilla qalilan.
Wa bikufrihim wa qawlihim ɛala maryama buhtanan ɛaḏ̣iman.

Wa qawlihim ʼinna qatalna al-masiḥa ɛisa abna maryama rasula Allahi wa ma qataluhu wa ma ṣalabuhu wa lakin cubbiha lahum wa ʼinna al-laḏina axtalafu fihi lafi cakkin minhu ma lahum bihi min ɛilmin ʼilla attibaɛa aḏ̣-ḏ̣anni wa ma qataluhu yaqinan.
Bal rafaɛahu Allahu ʼilayhi wa kana Allahu ɛazizan ḥakiman.
Wa ʼin min ʼahli al-kitabi ʼilla layuʼminanna bihi qabla mawtihi wa yawma al-qiyamati yakunu ɛalayhim cahidan.
Fabiḏ̣ulmin mina al-laḏina hadu ḥarramna ɛalayhim ṭayyibatin ʼuḥillat lahum wa biṣaddihim ɛan sabili Allahi kaṯiran.
Wa ʼaxḏihim ar-riba wa qad nuhu ɛanhu wa ʼaklihim ʼamwala an-nasi bil-baṭili wa ʼaɛtadna lilkafirina minhum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.

Lakin ar-rasixuna fi al-ɛilmi minhum wa al-muʼminuna yuʼminuna bima ʼunzila ʼilayka wa ma ʼunzila min qablika wa al-muqimina aṣ-ṣalata wa al-muʼtuna az-zakata wa al-muʼminuna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri ʼulaʼika sanuʼtihim ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.

ʼinna ʼawḥayna ʼilayka kama ʼawḥayna ʼila nuḥin wa an-nabiyina min baɛdihi wa ʼawḥayna ʼila ʼibrahima wa ʼismaɛila wa ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba wa al-ʼasbaṭi wa ɛisa wa ʼayyuba wa yunis wa haruna wa sulaymana wa ʼatayna dawuda zaburan.
Wa rusulan qad qaṣaṣnahum ɛalayka min qablu wa rusulan lam naqṣuṣhum ɛalayka wa kallama Allahu musa takliman.
Rusulan mubaccirina wa munḏirina liʼlla yakuna lilnnasi ɛala Allahi ḥujjatun baɛda ar-rusuli wa kana Allahu ɛazizan ḥakiman.
Lakin Allahu yac/hadu bima ʼanzala ʼilayka ʼanzalahu biɛilmihi wa al-malaʼikatu yac/haduna wa kafa Billahi cahidan.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru wa ṣaddu ɛan sabili Allahi qad ḍallu ḍalalan baɛidan.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru wa ḏ̣alamu lam yakun Allahu liyaɣfira lahum wa la liyahdiyahum ṭariqan.
ʼilla ṭariqa jahannama xalidina fiha ʼabadan wa kana ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasiran.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu qad jaʼakum ar-rasulu bil-ḥaqqi min rabbikum faʼaminu xayran lakum wa ʼin takfuru faʼinna Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa kana Allahu ɛaliman ḥakiman.

Ya ʼahla al-kitabi la taɣlu fi dinikum wa la taqulu ɛala Allahi ʼilla al-ḥaqqa ʼinnama al-masiḥu ɛisa abnu maryama rasulu Allahi wa kalimatuhu ʼalqaha ʼila maryama wa ruḥun minhu faʼaminu Billahi wa rusulihi wa la taqulu ṯalaṯatun antahu xayran lakum ʼinnama Allahu ʼilahun waḥidun subḥanahu ʼan yakuna lahu waladun lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa kafa Billahi wa kilan.
Lan yastankifa al-masiḥu ʼan yakuna ɛabdan Lillahi wa la al-malaʼikatu al-muqarrabuna wa man yastankif ɛan ɛibadatihi wa yastakbir fasayaḥcuruhum ʼilayhi jamiɛan.

Faʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati fayuwaffihim ʼujurahum wa yaziduhum min faḍlihi wa ʼamma al-laḏina astankafu wa astakbaru fayuɛaḏḏibuhum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman wa la yajiduna lahum min duni Allahi waliyan wa la naṣiran.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu qad jaʼakum burhanun min rabbikum wa ʼanzalna ʼilaykum nuran mubinan.
Faʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu Billahi wa aɛtaṣamu bihi fasayudxiluhum fi raḥmatin minhu wa faḍlin wa yahdihim ʼilayhi ṣiraṭan mustaqiman.

Yastaftunaka qul Allahu yuftikum fi al-kalalati ʼin amruʼun halaka laysa lahu waladun wa lahu ʼuxtun falaha niṣfu ma taraka wa huwa yariṯuha ʼin lam yakun laha waladun faʼin kanata aṯnatayni falahuma aṯ-ṯuluṯani mimma taraka wa ʼin kanu ʼixwatan rijalan wa nisaʼan falilḏḏakari miṯlu ḥaḏ̣ḏ̣i al-ʼunṯayayni yubayyinu Allahu lakum ʼan taḍillu wa Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼawfu bil-ɛuqudi ʼuḥillat lakum bahimatu al-ʼanɛam ʼilla ma yutla ɛalaykum ɣayra muḥilli aṣ-ṣaydi wa ʼantum ḥurumun ʼinna Allaha yaḥkumu ma yurid.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tuḥillu caɛaʼira Allahi wa la ac-cahra al-ḥarama wa la al-hadya wa la al-qalaʼida wa la ʼammina al-bayta al-ḥarama yabtaɣuna faḍlan min rabbihim wa riḍwanan wa ʼiḏa ḥalaltum faṣṭadu wa la yajrimannakum canaʼanu qawmin ʼan ṣaddukum ɛan al-masjidi al-ḥarami ʼan taɛtadu wa taɛawanu ɛala al-birri wa at-taqwa wa la taɛawanu ɛala al-ʼiṯmi wa al-ɛudwani wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqab.

Ḥurrimat ɛalaykum al-maytatu wa ad-damu wa laḥmu al-xinziri wa ma ʼuhilla liɣayri Allahi bihi wa al-munxaniqatu wa al-mawquḏatu wa al-mutaraddiyatu wa an-naṭiḥatu wa ma ʼakala as-sabuɛu ʼilla ma ḏakkaytum wa ma ḏubiḥa ɛala an-nuṣubi wa ʼan tastaqsimu bil-ʼazlami ḏalikum fisqun al-yawma yaʼisa al-laḏina kafaru min dinikum fala taxcawhum wa axcawni al-yawma ʼakmaltu lakum dinakum wa ʼatmamtu ɛalaykum niɛmati wa raḍitu lakum al-ʼislama dinan faman aḍṭurra fi maxmaṣatin ɣayra mutajanifin lʼiṯmin faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.

Yasʼalunaka maḏa ʼuḥilla lahum qul ʼuḥilla lakum aṭ-ṭayyibatu wa ma ɛallamtum mina al-jawariḥi mukallibina tuɛallimunahunna mimma ɛallamakum Allahu fakulu mimma ʼamsakna ɛalaykum wa aḏkuru asma Allahi ɛalayhi wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha sariɛu al-ḥisab.

Al-yawma ʼuḥilla lakum aṭ-ṭayyibatu wa ṭaɛamu al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba ḥillun lakum wa ṭaɛamukum ḥillun lahum wa al-muḥṣanatu mina al-muʼminati wa al-muḥṣanatu mina al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba min qablikum ʼiḏa ʼataytumuhunna ʼujurahunna muḥṣinina ɣayra musafiḥina wa la muttaxiḏi ʼaxdanin wa man yakfur bil-ʼimani faqad ḥabiṭa ɛamaluhu wa huwa fi al-ʼaxirati mina al-xasirin.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa qumtum ʼila aṣ-ṣalati faɣsilu wujuhakum wa ʼaydiyakum ʼila al-marafiqi wa amsaḥu biruʼsikum wa ʼarjulakum ʼila al-kaɛbayni wa ʼin kuntum junuban fa aṭṭahharu wa ʼin kuntum marḍa ʼaw ɛala safarin ʼaw jaʼa ʼaḥadun minkum mina al-ɣaʼiṭi ʼaw lamastum an-nisaʼ falam tajidu maʼan fatayammamu ṣaɛidan ṭayyiban famsaḥu biwujuhikum wa ʼaydikum minhu ma yuridu Allahu liyajɛala ɛalaykum min ḥarajin wa lakin yuridu liyuṭahhirakum waliyutimma niɛmatahu ɛalaykum laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum wa miṯaqahu al-laḏi wa aṯaqakum bihi ʼiḏ qultum samiɛna wa ʼaṭaɛna wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu kunu qawwamina Lillahi cuhadaʼa bil-qisṭi wa la yajrimannakum canaʼanu qawmin ɛala ʼalla taɛdilu aɛdilu huwa ʼaqrabu lilttaqwa wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha xabirun bima taɛmalun.
Waɛada Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lahum maɣfiratun wa ʼajrun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biʼayatina ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jaḥim.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum ʼiḏ hamma qawmun ʼan yabsuṭu ʼilaykum ʼaydiyahum fakaffa ʼaydiyahum ɛankum wa attaqu Allaha wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkal al-muʼminun.

Wa laqad ʼaxaḏa Allahu miṯaqa bani ʼisraʼila wa baɛaṯna minhum aṯnay ɛacara naqiban wa qala Allahu ʼinni maɛakum laʼin ʼaqamtum aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼataytum az-zakata wa ʼamantum birusuli wa ɛazzartumuhum wa ʼaqraḍtum Allaha qarḍan ḥasanan laʼukaffiranna ɛankum sayyiʼatikum wa laʼudxilannakum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu faman kafara baɛda ḏalika minkum faqad ḍalla sawaʼa as-sabil.

Fabima naqḍihim miṯaqahum laɛannahum wa jaɛalna qulubahum qasiyatan yuḥarrifuna al-kalima ɛan mawaḍiɛihi wa nasu ḥaḏ̣ḏ̣an mimma ḏukkiru bihi wa la tazalu taṭṭaliɛu ɛala xaʼinatin minhum ʼilla qalilan minhum faɛfu ɛanhum wa aṣfaḥ ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muḥsinin.

Wa mina al-laḏina qalu ʼinna naṣara ʼaxaḏna miṯaqahum fanasu ḥaḏ̣ḏ̣an mimma ḏukkiru bihi faʼaɣrayna baynahum al-ɛadawata wa al-baɣḍaʼa ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati wa sawfa yunabbiʼuhum Allahu bima kanu yaṣnaɛun.
Ya ʼahla al-kitabi qad jaʼakum rasuluna yubayyinu lakum kaṯiran mimma kuntum tuxfuna mina al-kitabi wa yaɛfu ɛan kaṯirin qad jaʼakum mina Allahi nurun wa kitabun mubinun.
Yahdi bihi Allahu man attabaɛa riḍwanahu subula as-salami wa yuxrijuhum mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼila an-nur biʼiḏnihi wa yahdihim ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.

Laqad kafara al-laḏina qalu ʼinna Allaha huwa al-masiḥu abnu maryama qul faman yamliku mina Allahi cayʼan ʼin ʼarada ʼan yuhlika al-masiḥa abna maryama wa ʼummahu wa man fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan wa Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma baynahuma yxluqu ma yacaʼu wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.

Wa qalat al-yahudu wa an-naṣara naḥnu ʼabnaʼu Allahi wa ʼaḥibbaʼuuhu qul falima yuɛaḏḏibukum biḏunubikum bal ʼantum bacarun mimman xalaqa yaɣfiru liman yacaʼu wa yuɛaḏḏibu man yacaʼu wa Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma baynahuma wa ʼilayhi al-maṣir.

Ya ʼahla al-kitabi qad jaʼakum rasuluna yubayyinu lakum ɛala fatratin mina ar-rusuli ʼan taqulu ma jaʼana min bacirin wa la naḏirin faqad jaʼakum bacirun wa naḏirun wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa ʼiḏ qala musa liqawmihi ya qawmi aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum ʼiḏ jaɛala fikum ʼanbiyaʼa wa jaɛalakum mulukan wa ʼatakum ma lam yuʼti ʼaḥadan mina al-ɛalamin.
Ya qawmi adxulu al-ʼarḍa al-muqaddasata allati kataba Allahu lakum wa la tartaddu ɛala ʼadbarikum fatanqalibu xasirin.
Qalu ya musa ʼinna fiha qawman jabbarina wa ʼinna lan nadxulaha ḥatta yaxruju minha faʼin yaxruju minha faʼinna daxilun.
Qala rajulani mina al-laḏina yaxafuna ʼanɛama Allahu ɛalayhima adxulu ɛalayhim al-baba faʼiḏa daxaltumuhu faʼinnakum ɣalibuna wa ɛala Allahi fatawakkalu ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Qalu ya musa ʼinna lan nadxulaha ʼabadan ma damu fiha faḏ/hab ʼanta wa rabbuka faqatila ʼinna hahuna qaɛidun.
Qala rabbi ʼinni la ʼamliku ʼilla nafsi wa ʼaxi fafruq baynana wa bayna al-qawmi al-fasiqin.
Qala faʼinnaha muḥarramatun ɛalayhim ʼarbaɛina sanatan yatihuna fi al-ʼarḍi fala taʼsa ɛala al-qawmi al-fasiqin.
Wa atlu ɛalayhim nabaʼa abnay ʼadama bil-ḥaqqi ʼiḏ qarraba qurbanan fatuqubbila min ʼaḥadihima wa lam yutaqabbal mina al-ʼaxari qala laʼaqtulannaka qala ʼinnama yataqabbalu Allahu mina al-muttaqin.
Laʼin basaṭta ʼilayya yadaka litaqtulani ma ʼana bibasiṭin yadi ʼilayka liʼqtulaka ʼinni ʼaxafu Allaha rabba al-ɛalamin.
ʼinni ʼuridu ʼan tabuʼa biʼiṯmi wa ʼiṯmika fatakuna min ʼaṣḥabi an-nari wa ḏalika jazaʼu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Faṭawwaɛat lahu nafsuhu qatla ʼaxihi faqatalahu faʼaṣbaḥa mina al-xasirin.
Fabaɛaṯa Allahu ɣuraban yabḥaṯu fi al-ʼarḍi liyuriyahu kayfa yuwari sawʼata ʼaxihi qala ya waylata ʼaɛajaztu ʼan ʼakuna miṯla haḏa al-ɣurabi faʼuwariya sawʼata ʼaxi faʼaṣbaḥa mina an-nadimin.

Min ʼajli ḏalika katabna ɛala bani ʼisraʼila ʼannahu man qatala nafsan biɣayri nafsin ʼaw fasadin fi al-ʼarḍi fakaʼannama qatala an-nasa jamiɛan wa man ʼaḥyaha fakaʼannama ʼaḥya an-nasa jamiɛan wa laqad jaʼat/hum rusuluna bil-bayyinati ṯumma ʼinna kaṯiran minhum baɛda ḏalika fi al-ʼarḍi lamusrifun.

ʼinnama jazaʼu al-laḏina yuḥaribuna Allaha wa rasulahu wa yasɛawna fi al-ʼarḍi fasadan ʼan yuqattalu ʼaw yuṣallabu ʼaw tuqaṭṭaɛa ʼaydihim wa ʼarjuluhum min xilafin ʼaw yunfaw mina al-ʼarḍi ḏalika lahum xizyun fi ad-dunya wa lahum fi al-ʼaxirati ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
ʼilla al-laḏina tabu min qabli ʼan taqdiru ɛalayhim faɛlamu ʼanna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu Allaha wa abtaɣu ʼilayhi al-wasilata wa jahidu fi sabilihi laɛallakum tufliḥun.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru law ʼanna lahum ma fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan wa miṯlahu maɛahu liyaftadu bihi min ɛaḏabi yawmi al-qiyamati ma tuqubbila minhum wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Yuriduna ʼan yaxruju mina an-nari wa ma hum bixarijina minha wa lahum ɛaḏabun muqimun.
Wa as-sariqu wa as-sariqatu faqṭaɛu ʼaydiyahuma jazaʼan bima kasaba nakalan mina Allahi wa Allahu ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Faman taba min baɛdi ḏ̣ulmihi wa ʼaṣlaḥa faʼinna Allaha yatubu ɛalayhi ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼalam taɛlam ʼanna Allaha lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yuɛaḏḏibu man yacaʼu wa yaɣfiru liman yacaʼu wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.

Ya ʼayyuha ar-rasulu la yaḥzunka al-laḏina yusariɛuna fi al-kufri mina al-laḏina qalu ʼamanna biʼafwahihim wa lam tuʼmin qulubuhum wa mina al-laḏina hadu sammaɛuna lilkaḏibi sammaɛuna liqawmin ʼaxarina lam yaʼtuka yuḥarrifuna al-kalima min baɛdi mawaḍiɛihi yaquluna ʼin ʼutitum haḏa faxuḏuhu wa ʼin lam tuʼtawhu faḥḏaru wa man yurid Allahu fitnatahu falan tamlika lahu mina Allahi cayʼan ʼulaʼika al-laḏina lam yurid Allahu ʼan yuṭahhira qulubahum lahum fi ad-dunya xizyun wa lahum fi al-ʼaxirati ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.

Sammaɛuna lilkaḏibi ʼakkaluna lilssuḥti faʼin jaʼuka faḥkum baynahum ʼaw ʼaɛriḍ ɛanhum wa ʼin tuɛriḍ ɛanhum falan yaḍurruka cayʼan wa ʼin ḥakamta faḥkum baynahum bil-qisṭi ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muqsiṭin.
Wa kayfa yuḥakkimunaka wa ɛindahum at-tawratu fiha ḥukmu Allahi ṯumma yatawallawna min baɛdi ḏalika wa ma ʼulaʼika bil-muʼminin.

ʼinna ʼanzalna at-tawrata fiha hudan wa nurun yaḥkumu biha an-nabiyuna al-laḏina ʼaslamu lillaḏina hadu wa ar-rabbaniyuna wa al-ʼaḥbaru bima astuḥfiḏ̣u min kitabi Allahi wa kanu ɛalayhi cuhadaʼa fala taxcaw an-nasa wa axcawni wa la tactaru biʼayati ṯamanan qalilan wa man lam yaḥkum bima ʼanzala Allahu faʼulaʼika hum al-kafirun.

Wa katabna ɛalayhim fiha ʼanna an-nafsa bin-nafsi wa al-ɛayna bil-ɛayni wa al-ʼanfa bil-ʼanfi wa al-ʼuḏuna bil-ʼuḏuni wa as-sinna bis-sinni wa al-juruḥa qiṣaṣun faman taṣaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaratun lahu wa man lam yaḥkum bima ʼanzala Allahu faʼulaʼika hum aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.

Wa qaffayna ɛala ʼaṯarihim biɛisa abni maryama muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina at-tawrati wa ʼataynahu al-ʼinjila fihi hudan wa nurun wa muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina at-tawrati wa hudan wa mawɛiḏ̣atan lilmuttaqin.
Wa liaḥkum ʼahlu al-ʼinjili bima ʼanzala Allahu fihi wa man lam yaḥkum bima ʼanzala Allahu faʼulaʼika hum al-fasiqun.

Wa ʼanzalna ʼilayka al-kitaba bil-ḥaqqi muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi mina al-kitabi wa muhayminan ɛalayhi faḥkum baynahum bima ʼanzala Allahu wa la tattabiɛ ʼahwaʼahum ɛamma jaʼaka mina al-ḥaqqi likullin jaɛalna minkum cirɛatan wa minhajan wa law caʼa Allahu lajaɛalakum ʼummatan waḥidatan wa lakin liyabluwakum fi ma ʼatakum fastabiqu al-xayrati ʼila Allahi marjiɛukum jamiɛan fayunabbiʼukum bima kuntum fihi taxtalifun.

Wa ʼan aḥkum baynahum bima ʼanzala Allahu wa la tattabiɛ ʼahwaʼahum wa aḥḏarhum ʼan yaftinuka ɛan baɛḍi ma ʼanzala Allahu ʼilayka faʼin tawallaw faɛlam ʼannama yuridu Allahu ʼan yuṣibahum bibaɛḍi ḏunubihim wa ʼinna kaṯiran mina an-nasi lafasiqun.
ʼafaḥukma al-jahiliyati yabɣuna wa man ʼaḥsanu mina Allahi ḥukman liqawmin yuqinun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tattaxiḏu al-yahuda wa an-naṣara ʼawliyaʼa baɛḍuhum ʼawliyaʼu baɛḍin wa man yatawallahum minkum faʼinnahu minhum ʼinna Allaha la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Fatara al-laḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun yusariɛuna fihim yaquluna naxca ʼan tuṣibana daʼiratun faɛasa Allahu ʼan yaʼtiya bil-fatḥi ʼaw ʼamrin min ɛindihi fayuṣbiḥu ɛala ma ʼasarru fi ʼanfusihim nadimin.
Wa yaqulu al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼahaʼuulaʼ al-laḏina ʼaqsamu Billahi jahda ʼaymanihim ʼinnahum lamaɛakum ḥabiṭat ʼaɛmaluhum faʼaṣbaḥu xasirin.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu man yartadda minkum ɛan dinihi fasawfa yaʼti Allahu biqawmin yuḥibbuhum wa yuḥibbunahu ʼaḏillatin ɛala al-muʼminina ʼaɛizzatin ɛala al-kafirina yujahiduna fi sabili Allahi wa la yaxafuna lawmata laʼimin ḏalika faḍlu Allahi yuʼtihi man yacaʼu wa Allahu wasiɛun ɛalimun.
ʼinnama wa liyukum Allahu wa rasuluhu wa al-laḏina ʼamanu al-laḏina yuqimuna aṣ-ṣalata wa yuʼtuna az-zakata wa hum rakiɛun.
Wa man yatawalla Allaha wa rasulahu wa al-laḏina ʼamanu faʼinna ḥizba Allahi hum al-ɣalibun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tattaxiḏu al-laḏina attaxaḏu dinakum huzuan wa laɛiban mina al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba min qablikum wa al-kuffara ʼawliyaʼa wa attaqu Allaha ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Wa ʼiḏa nadaytum ʼila aṣ-ṣalati attaxaḏuha huzuan wa laɛiban ḏalika biʼannahum qawmun la yaɛqilun.
Qul ya ʼahla al-kitabi hal tanqimuna minna ʼilla ʼan ʼamanna Billahi wa ma ʼunzila ʼilayna wa ma ʼunzila min qablu wa ʼanna ʼakṯarakum fasiqun.

Qul hal ʼunabbiʼukum bicarrin min ḏalika maṯubatan ɛinda Allahi man laɛanahu Allahu wa ɣaḍiba ɛalayhi wa jaɛala minhum al-qiradata wa al-xanazira wa ɛabada aṭ-ṭaɣuta ʼulaʼika carrun makanan wa ʼaḍallu ɛan sawaʼi as-sabil.
Wa ʼiḏa jaʼukum qalu ʼamanna wa qad daxalu bil-kufri wa hum qad xaraju bihi wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima kanu yaktumun.
Wa tara kaṯiran minhum yusariɛuna fi al-ʼiṯmi wa al-ɛudwani wa ʼaklihim as-suḥta labiʼsa ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Lawla yanhahum ar-rabbaniyuna wa al-ʼaḥbaru ɛan qawlihim al-ʼiṯma wa ʼaklihim as-suḥta labiʼsa ma kanu yaṣnaɛun.

Wa qalat al-yahudu yadu Allahi maɣlulatun ɣullat ʼaydihim wa luɛinu bima qalu bal yadahu mabsuṭatani yunfiqu kayfa yacaʼu wa layazidanna kaṯiran minhum ma ʼunzila ʼilayka min rabbika ṭuɣyanan wa kufran wa ʼalqayna baynahum al-ɛadawata wa al-baɣḍaʼa ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati kullama ʼawqadu naran lilḥarbi ʼaṭfaʼaha Allahu wa yasɛawna fi al-ʼarḍi fasadan wa Allahu la yuḥibbu al-mufsidin.
Wa law ʼanna ʼahla al-kitabi ʼamanu wa attaqaw lakaffarna ɛanhum sayyiʼatihim wa laʼadxalnahum jannati an-naɛim.
Wa law ʼannahum ʼaqamu at-tawrata wa al-ʼinjila wa ma ʼunzila ʼilayhim min rabbihim laʼakalu min fawqihim wa min taḥti ʼarjulihim minhum ʼummatun muqtaṣidatun wa kaṯirun minhum saʼa ma yaɛmalun.
Ya ʼayyuha ar-rasulu balliɣ ma ʼunzila ʼilayka min rabbika wa ʼin lam tafɛal fama ballaɣta risalatahu wa Allahu yaɛṣimuka mina an-nasi ʼinna Allaha la yahdi al-qawma al-kafirin.

Qul ya ʼahla al-kitabi lastum ɛala cayʼin ḥatta tuqimu at-tawrata wa al-ʼinjila wa ma ʼunzila ʼilaykum min rabbikum wa layazidanna kaṯiran minhum ma ʼunzila ʼilayka min rabbika ṭuɣyanan wa kufran fala taʼsa ɛala al-qawmi al-kafirin.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa al-laḏina hadu wa aṣ-ṣabiʼuna wa an-naṣara man ʼamana Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan fala xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Laqad ʼaxaḏna miṯaqa bani ʼisraʼila wa ʼarsalna ʼilayhim rusulan kullama jaʼahum rasulun bima la tahwa ʼanfusuhum fariqan kaḏḏabu wa fariqan yaqtulun.
Wa ḥasibu ʼalla takuna fitnatun faɛamu wa ṣammu ṯumma taba Allahu ɛalayhim ṯumma ɛamu wa ṣammu kaṯirun minhum wa Allahu baṣirun bima yaɛmalun.

Laqad kafara al-laḏina qalu ʼinna Allaha huwa al-masiḥu abnu maryama wa qala al-masiḥu ya bani ʼisraʼila aɛbudu Allaha rabbi wa rabbakum ʼinnahu man yucrik Billahi faqad ḥarrama Allahu ɛalayhi al-jannata wa maʼwahu an-naru wa ma lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina min ʼanṣarin.
Laqad kafara al-laḏina qalu ʼinna Allaha ṯaliṯu ṯalaṯatin wa ma min ʼilahin ʼilla ʼilahun waḥidun wa ʼin lam yantahu ɛamma yaquluna layamassanna al-laḏina kafaru minhum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
ʼafala yatubuna ʼila Allahi wa yastaɣfirunahu wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ma al-masiḥu abnu maryama ʼilla rasulun qad xalat min qablihi ar-rusulu wa ʼummuhu ṣiddiqatun kana yaʼkulani aṭ-ṭaɛama anḏ̣ur kayfa nubayyinu lahum al-ʼayati ṯumma anḏ̣ur ʼanna yuʼfakun.
Qul ʼataɛbuduna min duni Allahi ma la yamliku lakum ḍarran wa la nafɛan wa Allahu huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Qul ya ʼahla al-kitabi la taɣlu fi dinikum ɣayra al-ḥaqqi wa la tattabiɛu ʼahwaʼa qawmin qad ḍallu min qablu wa ʼaḍallu kaṯiran wa ḍallu ɛan sawaʼi as-sabil.
Luɛina al-laḏina kafaru min bani ʼisraʼila ɛala lisani dawuda wa ɛisa abni maryama ḏalika bima ɛaṣaw wa kanu yaɛtadun.
Kanu la yatanahawna ɛan munkarin faɛaluhu labiʼsa ma kanu yafɛalun.
Tara kaṯiran minhum yatawallawna al-laḏina kafaru labiʼsa ma qaddamat lahum ʼanfusuhum ʼan saxiṭa Allahu ɛalayhim wa fi al-ɛaḏabi hum xalidun.
Wa law kanu yuʼminuna Billahi wa an-nabiyi wa ma ʼunzila ʼilayhi ma attaxaḏuhum ʼawliyaʼa wa lakinna kaṯiran minhum fasiqun.

Latajidanna ʼacadda an-nasi ɛadawatan lillaḏina ʼamanu al-yahuda wa al-laḏina ʼacraku wa latajidanna ʼaqrabahum mawaddatan lillaḏina ʼamanu al-laḏina qalu ʼinna naṣara ḏalika biʼanna minhum qissisina wa ruhbanan wa ʼannahum la yastakbirun.
Wa ʼiḏa samiɛu ma ʼunzila ʼila ar-rasuli tara ʼaɛyunahum tafiḍu mina ad-damɛi mimma ɛarafu mina al-ḥaqqi yaquluna rabbana ʼamanna faktubna maɛa ac-cahidin.
Wa ma lana la nuʼminu Billahi wa ma jaʼana mina al-ḥaqqi wa naṭmaɛu ʼan yudxilana rabbuna maɛa al-qawmi aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Faʼaṯabahum Allahu bima qalu jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha wa ḏalika jazaʼu al-muḥsinin.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biʼayatina ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jaḥim.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tuḥarrimu ṭayyibati ma ʼaḥalla Allahu lakum wa la taɛtadu ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu al-muɛtadin.
Wa kulu mimma razaqakum Allahu ḥalalan ṭayyiban wa attaqu Allaha al-laḏi ʼantum bihi muʼminun.

La yuʼaxiḏukum Allahu bil-laɣwi fi ʼaymanikum wa lakin yuʼaxiḏukum bima ɛaqqadtum al-ʼimana fakaffaratuhu ʼiṭɛamu ɛacarati masakina min ʼawsaṭi ma tuṭɛimuna ʼahlikum ʼaw kiswatuhum ʼaw taḥriru raqabatin faman lam yajid faṣiyamu ṯalaṯati ʼayyamin ḏalika kaffaratu ʼaymanikum ʼiḏa ḥalaftum wa aḥfaḏ̣u ʼaymanakum kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ʼayatihi laɛallakum tackurun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼinnama al-xamru wa al-maysiru wa al-ʼanṣabu wa al-ʼazlamu rijsun min ɛamali ac-cayṭani fajtanibuhu laɛallakum tufliḥun.
ʼinnama yuridu ac-cayṭanu ʼan yuqiɛa baynakum al-ɛadawata wa al-baɣḍaʼa fi al-xamri wa al-maysiri wa yaṣuddakum ɛan ḏikri Allahi wa ɛan aṣ-ṣalati fahal ʼantum muntahun.
Wa ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa ʼaṭiɛu ar-rasula wa aḥḏaru faʼin tawallaytum faɛlamu ʼannama ɛala rasulina al-balaɣu al-mubin.
Laysa ɛala al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati junaḥun fima ṭaɛimu ʼiḏa ma attaqaw wa ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati ṯumma attaqaw wa ʼamanu ṯumma attaqaw wa ʼaḥsanu wa Allahu yuḥibbu al-muḥsinin.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu layabluwannakum Allahu bicayʼin mina aṣ-ṣaydi tanaluhu ʼaydikum wa rimaḥukum liyaɛlama Allahu man yaxafuhu bil-ɣaybi faman aɛtada baɛda ḏalika falahu ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la taqtulu aṣ-ṣayda wa ʼantum ḥurumun wa man qatalahu minkum mutaɛammidan fajazaʼun miṯlu ma qatala mina an-naɛami yaḥkumu bihi ḏawa ɛadlin minkum hadyan baliɣa al-kaɛbati ʼaw kaffaratun ṭaɛamu masakina ʼaw ɛadlu ḏalika ṣiyaman liyaḏuqa wabala ʼamrihi ɛafa Allahu ɛamma salafa wa man ɛada fayantaqimu Allahu minhu wa Allahu ɛazizun ḏu antiqamin.
ʼuḥilla lakum ṣaydu al-baḥri wa ṭaɛamuhu mataɛan lakum wa lilssayyarati wa ḥurrima ɛalaykum ṣaydu al-barri ma dumtum ḥuruman wa attaqu Allaha al-laḏi ʼilayhi tuḥcarun.

Jaɛala Allahu al-kaɛbata al-bayta al-ḥarama qiyaman lilnnasi wa ac-cahra al-ḥarama wa al-hadya wa al-qalaʼida ḏalika litaɛlamu ʼanna Allaha yaɛlamu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼanna Allaha bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqabi wa ʼanna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ma ɛala ar-rasuli ʼilla al-balaɣu wa Allahu yaɛlamu ma tubduna wa ma taktumun.
Qul la yastawi al-xabiṯu wa aṭ-ṭayyibu wa law ʼaɛjabaka kaṯratu al-xabiṯi fa attaqu Allaha ya ʼuli al-ʼalbabi laɛallakum tufliḥun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tasʼalu ɛan ʼacyaʼa ʼin tubda lakum tasuʼkum wa ʼin tasʼalu ɛanha ḥina yunazzalu al-qurʼanu tubda lakum ɛafa Allahu ɛanha wa Allahu ɣafurun ḥalimun.
Qad saʼalaha qawmun min qablikum ṯumma ʼaṣbaḥu biha kafirin.
Ma jaɛala Allahu min baḥiratin wa la saʼibatin wa la waṣilatin wa la ḥamin wa lakinna al-laḏina kafaru yaftaruna ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba wa ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛqilun.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum taɛalaw ʼila ma ʼanzala Allahu wa ʼila ar-rasuli qalu ḥasbuna ma wajadna ɛalayhi ʼabaʼana ʼawalaw kana ʼabaʼuuhum la yaɛlamuna cayʼan wa la yahtadun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ɛalaykum ʼanfusakum la yaḍurrukum man ḍalla ʼiḏa ahtadaytum ʼila Allahi marjiɛukum jamiɛan fayunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu cahadatu baynikum ʼiḏa ḥaḍara ʼaḥadakum al-mawtu ḥina al-waṣiyati aṯnani ḏawa ɛadlin minkum ʼaw ʼaxarani min ɣayrikum ʼin ʼantum ḍarabtum fi al-ʼarḍi faʼaṣabatkum muṣibatu al-mawti taḥbisunahuma min baɛdi aṣ-ṣalati fayuqsimani Billahi ʼin artabtum la nactari bihi ṯamanan wa law kana ḏa qurba wa la naktumu cahadata Allahi ʼinna ʼiḏan lamina al-ʼaṯimin.

Faʼin ɛuṯira ɛala ʼannahuma astaḥaqqa ʼiṯman faʼaxarani yaqumani maqamahuma mina al-laḏina astaḥaqqa ɛalayhim al-ʼawlayani fayuqsimani Billahi lacahadatuna ʼaḥaqqu min cahadatihima wa ma aɛtadayna ʼinna ʼiḏan lamina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Ḏalika ʼadna ʼan yaʼtu bic-cahadati ɛala wajhiha ʼaw yaxafu ʼan turadda ʼaymanun baɛda ʼaymanihim wa attaqu Allaha wa asmaɛu wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma al-fasiqin.
Yawma yajmaɛu Allahu ar-rusula fayaqulu maḏa ʼujibtum qalu la ɛilma lana ʼinnaka ʼanta ɛallamu al-ɣuyub.

ʼiḏ qala Allahu ya ɛisa abna maryama aḏkur niɛmati ɛalayka wa ɛala wa a-datika ʼiḏ ʼayyadttuka biruḥi al-qudusi tukallimu an-nasa fi al-mahdi wa kahlan wa ʼiḏ ɛallamtuka al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa at-tawrata wa al-ʼinjila wa ʼiḏ taxluqu mina aṭ-ṭini kahayʼati aṭ-ṭayri biʼiḏni fatanfuxu fiha fatakunu ṭayran biʼiḏni wa tubriʼu al-ʼakmaha wa al-ʼabraṣa biʼiḏni wa ʼiḏ tuxriju al-mawta biʼiḏni wa ʼiḏ kafaftu bani ʼisraʼila ɛanka ʼiḏ jiʼtahum bil-bayyinati faqala al-laḏina kafaru minhum ʼin haḏa ʼilla siḥrun mubinun.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼawḥaytu ʼila al-ḥawariyina ʼan ʼaminu bi wa birasuli qalu ʼamanna wa ac/had biʼannana muslimun.
ʼiḏ qala al-ḥawariyuna ya ɛisa abna maryama hal yastaṭiɛu rabbuka ʼan yunazzila ɛalayna maʼidatan mina as-samaʼi qala attaqu Allaha ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Qalu nuridu ʼan naʼkula minha wa taṭmaʼinna qulubuna wa naɛlama ʼan qad ṣadaqtana wa nakuna ɛalayha mina ac-cahidin.
Qala ɛisa abnu maryama al-lahumma rabbana ʼanzil ɛalayna maʼidatan mina as-samaʼi takunu lana ɛidan liʼwwalina wa ʼaxirina wa ʼayatan minka wa arzuqna wa ʼanta xayru ar-raziqin.
Qala Allahu ʼinni munazziluha ɛalaykum faman yakfur baɛdu minkum faʼinni ʼuɛaḏḏibuhu ɛaḏaban la ʼuɛaḏḏibuhu ʼaḥadan mina al-ɛalamin.

Wa ʼiḏ qala Allahu ya ɛisa abna maryama ʼaʼanta qulta lilnnasi attaxiḏuni wa ʼummi ʼilahayni min duni Allahi qala subḥanaka ma yakunu li ʼan ʼaqula ma laysa li biḥaqqin ʼin kuntu qultuhu faqad ɛalimtahu taɛlamu ma fi nafsi wa la ʼaɛlamu ma fi nafsika ʼinnaka ʼanta ɛallamu al-ɣuyub.

Ma qultu lahum ʼilla ma ʼamartani bihi ʼan aɛbudu Allaha rabbi wa rabbakum wa kuntu ɛalayhim cahidan ma dumtu fihim falamma tawaffaytani kunta ʼanta ar-raqiba ɛalayhim wa ʼanta ɛala kulli cayʼin cahidun.
ʼin tuɛaḏḏibhum faʼinnahum ɛibaduka wa ʼin taɣfir lahum faʼinnaka ʼanta al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Qala Allahu haḏa yawmu yanfaɛu aṣ-ṣadiqina ṣidquhum lahum jannatun tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ʼabadan raḍiya Allahu ɛanhum wa raḍu ɛanhu ḏalika al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma fihinna wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa jaɛala aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati wa an-nur ṯumma al-laḏina kafaru birabbihim yaɛdilun.
Huwa al-laḏi xalaqakum min ṭinin ṯumma qaḍa ʼajalan wa ʼajalun musamman ɛindahu ṯumma ʼantum tamtarun.
Wa huwa Allahu fi as-samawati wa fi al-ʼarḍi yaɛlamu sirrakum wa jahrakum wa yaɛlamu ma taksibun.
Wa ma taʼtihim min ʼayatin min ʼayati rabbihim ʼilla kanu ɛanha muɛriḍin.
Faqad kaḏḏabu bil-ḥaqqi lamma jaʼahum fasawfa yaʼtihim ʼanbaʼu ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.

ʼalam yaraw kam ʼahlakna min qablihim min qarnin makkannahum fi al-ʼarḍi ma lam numakkin lakum wa ʼarsalna as-samaʼa ɛalayhim midraran wa jaɛalna al-ʼanhara tajri min taḥtihim faʼahlaknahum biḏunubihim wa ʼancaʼna min baɛdihim qarnan ʼaxarin.
Wa law nazzalna ɛalayka kitaban fi qirṭasin falamasuhu biʼaydihim laqala al-laḏina kafaru ʼin haḏa ʼilla siḥrun mubinun.
Wa qalu lawla ʼunzila ɛalayhi malakun wa law ʼanzalna malakan laquḍiya al-ʼamru ṯumma la yunḏ̣arun.
Wa law jaɛalnahu malakan lajaɛalnahu rajulan wa lalabasna ɛalayhim ma yalbisun.
Wa laqad astuhziʼa birusulin min qablika faḥaqa bial-laḏina saxiru minhum ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Qul siru fi al-ʼarḍi ṯumma anḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mukaḏḏibin.
Qul liman ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi qul Lillahi kataba ɛala nafsihi ar-raḥmata layajmaɛannakum ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati la rayba fihi al-laḏina xasiru ʼanfusahum fahum la yuʼminun.
Wa lahu ma sakana fi al-layli wa an-nahari wa huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Qul ʼaɣayra Allahi ʼattaxiḏu waliyan faṭiri as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa huwa yuṭɛimu wa la yuṭɛamu qul ʼinni ʼumirtu ʼan ʼakuna ʼawwala man ʼaslama wa la takunanna mina al-mucrikin.
Qul ʼinni ʼaxafu ʼin ɛaṣaytu rabbi ɛaḏaba yawmin ɛaḏ̣imin.
Man yuṣraf ɛanhu yawmaʼiḏin faqad raḥimahu wa ḏalika al-fawzu al-mubin.
Wa ʼin yamsaska Allahu biḍurrin fala kacifa lahu ʼilla huwa wa ʼin yamsaska bixayrin fahuwa ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa huwa al-qahiru fawqa ɛibadihi wa huwa al-ḥakimu al-xabir.

Qul ʼayyu cayʼin ʼakbaru cahadatan qul Allahu cahidun bayni wa baynakum wa ʼuḥiya ʼilayya haḏa al-qurʼanu liʼnḏirakum bihi wa man balaɣa ʼaʼinnakum latac/haduna ʼanna maɛa Allahi ʼalihatan ʼuxra qul la ʼac/hadu qul ʼinnama huwa ʼilahun waḥidun wa ʼinnani bariʼun mimma tucrikun.
Al-laḏina ʼataynahum al-kitaba yaɛrifunahu kama yaɛrifuna ʼabnaʼahum al-laḏina xasiru ʼanfusahum fahum la yuʼminun.
Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼaw kaḏḏaba biʼayatihi ʼinnahu la yufliḥu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.
Wa yawma naḥcuruhum jamiɛan ṯumma naqulu lillaḏina ʼacraku ʼayna curakaʼuukum al-laḏina kuntum tazɛumun.
Ṯumma lam takun fitnatuhum ʼilla ʼan qalu wa al-lahi rabbina ma kunna mucrikin.
Anḏ̣ur kayfa kaḏabu ɛala ʼanfusihim wa ḍalla ɛanhum ma kanu yaftarun.

Wa minhum man yastamiɛu ʼilayka wa jaɛalna ɛala qulubihim ʼakinnatan ʼan yafqahuhu wa fi ʼaḏanihim waqran wa ʼin yaraw kulla ʼayatin la yuʼminu biha ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼuka yujadilunaka yaqulu al-laḏina kafaru ʼin haḏa ʼilla ʼasaṭiru al-ʼawwalin.
Wa hum yanhawna ɛanhu wa yanʼawna ɛanhu wa ʼin yuhlikuna ʼilla ʼanfusahum wa ma yacɛurun.
Wa law tara ʼiḏ wuqifu ɛala an-nari faqalu ya laytana nuraddu wa la nukaḏḏiba biʼayati rabbina wa nakuna mina al-muʼminin.
Bal bada lahum ma kanu yuxfuna min qablu wa law ruddu laɛadu lima nuhu ɛanhu wa ʼinnahum lakaḏibun.
Wa qalu ʼin hiya ʼilla ḥayatuna ad-dunya wa ma naḥnu bimabɛuṯin.
Wa law tara ʼiḏ wuqifu ɛala rabbihim qala ʼalaysa haḏa bil-ḥaqqi qalu bala wa rabbina qala faḏuqu al-ɛaḏaba bima kuntum takfurun.
Qad xasira al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biliqaʼi Allahi ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼat/hum as-saɛatu baɣtatan qalu ya ḥasratana ɛala ma farraṭna fiha wa hum yaḥmiluna ʼawzarahum ɛala ḏ̣uhurihim ʼala saʼa ma yazirun.
Wa ma al-ḥayatu ad-dunya ʼilla laɛibun wa lahwun wa lalddaru al-ʼaxiratu xayrun lillaḏina yattaquna ʼafala taɛqilun.
Qad naɛlamu ʼinnahu layaḥzunuka al-laḏi yaquluna faʼinnahum la yukaḏḏibunaka wa lakinna aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina biʼayati Allahi yajḥadun.
Wa laqad kuḏḏibat rusulun min qablika faṣabaru ɛala ma kuḏḏibu wa ʼuḏu ḥatta ʼatahum naṣruna wa la mubaddila likalimati Allahi wa laqad jaʼaka min nabaʼi al-mursalin.

Wa ʼin kana kabura ɛalayka ʼiɛraḍuhum faʼin astaṭaɛta ʼan tabtaɣiya nafaqan fi al-ʼarḍi ʼaw sullaman fi as-samaʼi fataʼtiyahum biʼayatin wa law caʼa Allahu lajamaɛahum ɛala al-huda fala takunanna mina al-jahilin.
ʼinnama yastajibu al-laḏina yasmaɛuna wa al-mawta yabɛaṯuhum Allahu ṯumma ʼilayhi yurjaɛun.
Wa qalu lawla nuzzila ɛalayhi ʼayatun min rabbihi qul ʼinna Allaha qadirun ɛala ʼan yunazzila ʼayatan wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
Wa ma min dabbatin fi al-ʼarḍi wa la ṭaʼirin yaṭiru bijanaḥayhi ʼilla ʼumamun ʼamṯalukum ma farraṭna fi al-kitabi min cayʼin ṯumma ʼila rabbihim yuḥcarun.
Wa al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina ṣummun wa bukmun fi aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati man yacaʼ Allahu yuḍlilhu wa man yacaʼ yajɛalhu ɛala ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Qul ʼaraʼaytakum ʼin ʼatakum ɛaḏabu Allahi ʼaw ʼatatkum as-saɛatu ʼaɣayra Allahi tadɛuna ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Bal ʼiyahu tadɛuna fayakcifu ma tadɛuna ʼilayhi ʼin caʼa wa tansawna ma tucrikun.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna ʼila ʼumamin min qablika faʼaxaḏnahum bil-baʼsaʼi wa aḍ-ḍarraʼi laɛallahum yataḍarraɛun.
Falawla ʼiḏ jaʼahum baʼsuna taḍarraɛu wa lakin qasat qulubuhum wa zayyana lahum ac-cayṭanu ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Falamma nasu ma ḏukkiru bihi fataḥna ɛalayhim ʼabwaba kulli cayʼin ḥatta ʼiḏa fariḥu bima ʼutu ʼaxaḏnahum baɣtatan faʼiḏa hum mublisun.
Faquṭiɛa dabiru al-qawmi al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu wa al-ḥamdu Lillahi rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ʼin ʼaxaḏa Allahu samɛakum wa ʼabṣarakum wa xatama ɛala qulubikum man ʼilahun ɣayru Allahi yaʼtikum bihi anḏ̣ur kayfa nuṣarrifu al-ʼayati ṯumma hum yaṣdifun.
Qul ʼaraʼaytakum ʼin ʼatakum ɛaḏabu Allahi baɣtatan ʼaw jahratan hal yuhlaku ʼilla al-qawmu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.
Wa ma nursilu al-mursalina ʼilla mubaccirina wa munḏirina faman ʼamana wa ʼaṣlaḥa fala xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Wa al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina yamassuhum al-ɛaḏabu bima kanu yafsuqun.
Qul la ʼaqulu lakum ɛindi xazaʼinu Allahi wa la ʼaɛlamu al-ɣayba wa la ʼaqulu lakum ʼinni malakun ʼin ʼattabiɛu ʼilla ma yuḥa ʼilayya qul hal yastawi al-ʼaɛma wa al-baṣiru ʼafala tatafakkarun.
Wa ʼanḏir bihi al-laḏina yaxafuna ʼan yuḥcaru ʼila rabbihim laysa lahum min dunihi wa liyun wa la cafiɛun laɛallahum yattaqun.
Wa la taṭrud al-laḏina yadɛuna rabbahum bil-ɣadati wa al-ɛaciyi yuriduna wajhahu ma ɛalayka min ḥisabihim min cayʼin wa ma min ḥisabika ɛalayhim min cayʼin fataṭrudahum fatakuna mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa kaḏalika fatanna baɛḍahum bibaɛḍin liyaqulu ʼahaʼuulaʼ manna Allahu ɛalayhim min baynina ʼalaysa Allahu biʼaɛlama bic-cakirin.

Wa ʼiḏa jaʼaka al-laḏina yuʼminuna biʼayatina faqul salamun ɛalaykum kataba rabbukum ɛala nafsihi ar-raḥmata ʼannahu man ɛamila minkum suʼan bijahalatin ṯumma taba min baɛdihi wa ʼaṣlaḥa faʼannahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa kaḏalika nufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati wa litastabina sabilu al-mujrimin.
Qul ʼinni nuhitu ʼan ʼaɛbuda al-laḏina tadɛuna min duni Allahi qul la ʼattabiɛu ʼahwaʼakum qad ḍalaltu ʼiḏan wa ma ʼana mina al-muhtadin.
Qul ʼinni ɛala bayyinatin min rabbi wa kaḏḏabtum bihi ma ɛindi ma tastaɛjiluna bihi ʼin al-ḥukmu ʼilla Lillahi yaquṣṣu al-ḥaqqa wa huwa xayru al-faṣilin.
Qul law ʼanna ɛindi ma tastaɛjiluna bihi laquḍiya al-ʼamru bayni wa baynakum wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu biḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Wa ɛindahu mafatiḥu al-ɣaybi la yaɛlamuha ʼilla huwa wa yaɛlamu ma fi al-barri wa al-baḥri wa ma tasquṭu min waraqatin ʼilla yaɛlamuha wa la ḥabbatin fi ḏ̣ulumati al-ʼarḍi wa la raṭbin wa la ya bisin ʼilla fi kitabin mubinin.
Wa huwa al-laḏi yatawaffakum bil-layli wa yaɛlamu ma jaraḥtum bin-nahari ṯumma yabɛaṯukum fihi liyuqḍa ʼajalun musamman ṯumma ʼilayhi marjiɛukum ṯumma yunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Wa huwa al-qahiru fawqa ɛibadihi wa yursilu ɛalaykum ḥafaḏ̣atan ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼa ʼaḥadakum al-mawtu tawaffat/hu rusuluna wa hum la yufarriṭun.
Ṯumma ruddu ʼila Allahi mawlahum al-ḥaqqi ʼala lahu al-ḥukmu wa huwa ʼasraɛu al-ḥasibin.
Qul man yunajjikum min ḏ̣ulumati al-barri wa al-baḥri tadɛunahu taḍarruɛan wa xufyatan laʼin ʼanjana min haḏihi lanakunanna mina ac-cakirin.
Qul Allahu yunajjikum minha wa min kulli karbin ṯumma ʼantum tucrikun.
Qul huwa al-qadiru ɛala ʼan yabɛaṯa ɛalaykum ɛaḏaban min fawqikum ʼaw min taḥti ʼarjulikum ʼaw yalbisakum ciyaɛan wa yuḏiqa baɛḍakum baʼsa baɛḍin anḏ̣ur kayfa nuṣarrifu al-ʼayati laɛallahum yafqahun.
Wa kaḏḏaba bihi qawmuka wa huwa al-ḥaqqu qul lastu ɛalaykum biwakilin.
Likulli nabaʼiin mustaqarrun wa sawfa taɛlamun.
Wa ʼiḏa raʼayta al-laḏina yaxuḍuna fi ʼayatina faʼaɛriḍ ɛanhum ḥatta yaxuḍu fi ḥadiṯin ɣayrihi wa ʼimma yunsiyannaka ac-cayṭanu fala taqɛud baɛda aḏ-ḏikra maɛa al-qawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa ma ɛala al-laḏina yattaquna min ḥisabihim min cayʼin wa lakin ḏikra laɛallahum yattaqun.

Wa ḏari al-laḏina attaxaḏu dinahum laɛiban wa lahwan wa ɣarrat/hum al-ḥayatu ad-dunya wa ḏakkir bihi ʼan tubsala nafsun bima kasabat laysa laha min duni Allahi wa liyun wa la cafiɛun wa ʼin taɛdil kulla ɛadlin la yuʼxaḏ minha ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ʼubsilu bima kasabu lahum carabun min ḥamimin wa ɛaḏabun ʼalimun bima kanu yakfurun.

Qul ʼanadɛu min duni Allahi ma la yanfaɛuna wa la yaḍurruna wa nuraddu ɛala ʼaɛqabina baɛda ʼiḏ hadana Allahu kallaḏi astahwat/hu ac-cayaṭinu fi al-ʼarḍi ḥayrana lahu ʼaṣḥabun yadɛunahu ʼila al-huda aʼtina qul ʼinna huda Allahi huwa al-huda wa ʼumirna linuslima lirabbi al-ɛalamin.
Wa ʼan ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa attaquhu wa huwa al-laḏi ʼilayhi tuḥcarun.

Wa huwa al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa bil-ḥaqqi wa yawma yaqulu kun fayakunu qawluhu al-ḥaqqu wa lahu al-mulku yawma yunfaxu fi aṣ-ṣuri ɛalimu al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati wa huwa al-ḥakimu al-xabir.
Wa ʼiḏ qala ʼibrahimu liʼabihi ʼazara ʼatattaxiḏu ʼaṣnaman ʼalihatan ʼinni ʼaraka wa qawmaka fi ḍalalin mubinin.
Wa kaḏalika nuri ʼibrahima malakuta as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa liyakuna mina al-muqinin.
Falamma janna ɛalayhi al-laylu raʼa kawkaban qala haḏa rabbi falamma ʼafala qala la ʼuḥibbu al-ʼafilin.
Falamma raʼa al-qamara baziɣan qala haḏa rabbi falamma ʼafala qala laʼin lam yahdini rabbi laʼakunanna mina al-qawmi aḍ-ḍallin.
Falamma raʼa ac-camsa baziɣatan qala haḏa rabbi haḏa ʼakbaru falamma ʼafalat qala ya qawmi ʼinni bariʼun mimma tucrikun.
ʼinni wajjahtu wajhi lillaḏi faṭara as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa ḥanifan wa ma ʼana mina al-mucrikin.
Wa ḥajjahu qawmuhu qala ʼatuḥajjuni fi Allahi wa qad hadani wa la ʼaxafu ma tucrikuna bihi ʼilla ʼan yacaʼa rabbi cayʼan wasiɛa rabbi kulla cayʼin ɛilman ʼafala tataḏakkarun.
Wa kayfa ʼaxafu ma ʼacraktum wa la taxafuna ʼannakum ʼacraktum Billahi ma lam yunazzil bihi ɛalaykum sulṭanan faʼayyu al-fariqayni ʼaḥaqqu bil-ʼamni ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.
Al-laḏina ʼamanu wa lam yalbisu ʼimanahum biḏ̣ulmin ʼulaʼika lahum al-ʼamnu wa hum muhtadun.
Wa tilka ḥujjatuna ʼataynaha ʼibrahima ɛala qawmihi narfaɛu darajatin man nacaʼu ʼinna rabbaka ḥakimun ɛalimun.
Wa wahabna lahu ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba kullan hadayna wa nuḥan hadayna min qablu wa min ḏurriyatihi dawuda wa sulaymana wa ʼayyuba wa yusufa wa musa wa haruna wa kaḏalika najzi al-muḥsinin.
Wa zakariya wa yaḥya wa ɛisa wa ʼilyasa kullun mina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Wa ʼismaɛila wa al-yasaɛa wa yunis wa luṭan wa kullan faḍḍalna ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Wa min ʼabaʼihim wa ḏurriyatihim wa ʼixwanihim wa ajtabaynahum wa hadaynahum ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Ḏalika huda Allahi yahdi bihi man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi wa law ʼacraku laḥabiṭa ɛanhum ma kanu yaɛmalun.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ʼataynahum al-kitaba wa al-ḥukma wa an-nubuwata faʼin yakfur biha haʼuulaʼ faqad wa kkalna biha qawman laysu biha bikafirin.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina hada Allahu fabihudahum aqtadihi qul la ʼasʼalukum ɛalayhi ʼajran ʼin huwa ʼilla ḏikra lilɛalamin.

Wa ma qadaru Allaha ḥaqqa qadrihi ʼiḏ qalu ma ʼanzala Allahu ɛala bacarin min cayʼin qul man ʼanzala al-kitaba al-laḏi jaʼa bihi musa nuran wa hudan lilnnasi tajɛalunahu qaraṭisa tubdunaha wa tuxfuna kaṯiran wa ɛullimtum ma lam taɛlamu ʼantum wa la ʼabaʼuukum qul Allahu ṯumma ḏarhum fi xawḍihim yalɛabun.
Wa haḏa kitabun ʼanzalnahu mubarakun muṣaddiqu al-laḏi bayna yadayhi wa litunḏira ʼumma al-qura wa man ḥawlaha wa al-laḏina yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati yuʼminuna bihi wa hum ɛala ṣalatihim yuḥafiḏ̣un.

Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼaw qala ʼuḥiya ʼilayya wa lam yuḥa ʼilayhi cayʼun wa man qala saʼunzilu miṯla ma ʼanzala Allahu wa law tara ʼiḏ aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna fi ɣamarati al-mawti wa al-malaʼikatu basiṭu ʼaydihim ʼaxriju ʼanfusakum al-yawma tujzawna ɛaḏaba al-huni bima kuntum taquluna ɛala Allahi ɣayra al-ḥaqqi wa kuntum ɛan ʼayatihi tastakbirun.

Wa laqad jiʼtumuna furada kama xalaqnakum ʼawwala marratin wa taraktum ma xawwalnakum waraʼa ḏ̣uhurikum wa ma nara maɛakum cufaɛaʼakum al-laḏina zaɛamtum ʼannahum fikum curakaʼu laqad taqaṭṭaɛa baynakum wa ḍalla ɛankum ma kuntum tazɛumun.
ʼinna Allaha faliqu al-ḥabbi wa an-nawa yuxriju al-ḥayya mina al-mayyiti wa muxriju al-mayyiti mina al-ḥayyi ḏalikum Allahu faʼanna tuʼfakun.
Faliqu al-ʼiṣbaḥi wa jaɛala al-layla sakanan wa ac-camsa wa al-qamara ḥusbanan ḏalika taqdiru al-ɛazizi al-ɛalim.
Wa huwa al-laḏi jaɛala lakum an-nujuma litahtadu biha fi ḏ̣ulumati al-barri wa al-baḥri qad faṣṣalna al-ʼayati liqawmin yaɛlamun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi ʼancaʼakum min nafsin waḥidatin famustaqarrun wa mustawdaɛun qad faṣṣalna al-ʼayati liqawmin yafqahun.

Wa huwa al-laḏi ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼaxrajna bihi nabata kulli cayʼin faʼaxrajna minhu xaḍiran nuxriju minhu ḥabban mutarakiban wa mina an-naxli min ṭalɛiha qinwanun daniyatun wa jannatin min ʼaɛnabin wa az-zaytuna wa ar-rummana muctabihan wa ɣayra mutacabihin anḏ̣uru ʼila ṯamarihi ʼiḏa ʼaṯmara wa yanɛihi ʼinna fi ḏalikum lʼayatin liqawmin yuʼminun.
Wa jaɛalu Lillahi curakaʼa al-jinna wa xalaqahum wa xaraqu lahu banina wa banatin biɣayri ɛilmin subḥanahu wa taɛala ɛamma yaṣifun.
Badiɛu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼanna yakunu lahu waladun wa lam takun lahu ṣaḥibatun wa xalaqa kulla cayʼin wa huwa bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Ḏalikum Allahu rabbukum la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa xaliqu kulli cayʼin faɛbuduhu wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin wa kilun.
La tudrikuhu al-ʼabṣaru wa huwa yudriku al-ʼabṣara wa huwa al-laṭifu al-xabir.
Qad jaʼakum baṣaʼiru min rabbikum faman ʼabṣara falinafsihi wa man ɛamiya faɛalayha wa ma ʼana ɛalaykum biḥafiḏ̣in.
Wa kaḏalika nuṣarrifu al-ʼayati wa liyaqulu darasta wa linubayyinahu liqawmin yaɛlamun.
Attabiɛ ma ʼuḥiya ʼilayka min rabbika la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa wa ʼaɛriḍ ɛan al-mucrikin.
Wa law caʼa Allahu ma ʼacraku wa ma jaɛalnaka ɛalayhim ḥafiḏ̣an wa ma ʼanta ɛalayhim biwakilin.
Wa la tasubbu al-laḏina yadɛuna min duni Allahi fayasubbu Allaha ɛadwan biɣayri ɛilmin kaḏalika zayyanna likulli ʼummatin ɛamalahum ṯumma ʼila rabbihim marjiɛuhum fayunabbiʼuhum bima kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa ʼaqsamu Billahi jahda ʼaymanihim laʼin jaʼat/hum ʼayatun layuʼminunna biha qul ʼinnama al-ʼayatu ɛinda Allahi wa ma yucɛirukum ʼannaha ʼiḏa jaʼat la yuʼminun.
Wa nuqallibu ʼafʼidatahum wa ʼabṣarahum kama lam yuʼminu bihi ʼawwala marratin wa naḏaruhum fi ṭuɣyanihim yaɛmahun.
Wa law ʼannana nazzalna ʼilayhim al-malaʼikata wa kallamahum al-mawta wa ḥacarna ɛalayhim kulla cayʼin qubulan ma kanu liyuʼminu ʼilla ʼan yacaʼa Allahu wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum yajhalun.
Wa kaḏalika jaɛalna likulli nabiyin ɛaduwan cayaṭina al-ʼinsi wa al-jinni yuḥi baɛḍuhum ʼila baɛḍin zuxrufa al-qawli ɣururan wa law caʼa rabbuka ma faɛaluhu faḏarhum wa ma yaftarun.
Wa litaṣɣa ʼilayhi ʼafʼidatu al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati wa liyarḍawhu wa liyaqtarifu ma hum muqtarifun.

ʼafaɣayra Allahi ʼabtaɣi ḥakaman wa huwa al-laḏi ʼanzala ʼilaykum al-kitaba mufaṣṣalan wa al-laḏina ʼataynahum al-kitaba yaɛlamuna ʼannahu munazzalun min rabbika bil-ḥaqqi fala takunanna mina al-mumtarin.
Wa tammat kalimatu rabbika ṣidqan wa ɛadlan la mubaddila likalimatihi wa huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Wa ʼin tuṭiɛ ʼakṯara man fi al-ʼarḍi yuḍilluka ɛan sabili Allahi ʼin yattabiɛuna ʼilla aḏ̣-ḏ̣anna wa ʼin hum ʼilla yaxruṣun.
ʼinna rabbaka huwa ʼaɛlamu man yaḍillu ɛan sabilihi wa huwa ʼaɛlamu bil-muhtadin.
Fakulu mimma ḏukira asmu Allahi ɛalayhi ʼin kuntum biʼayatihi muʼminin.

Wa ma lakum ʼalla taʼkulu mimma ḏukira asmu Allahi ɛalayhi wa qad faṣṣala lakum ma ḥarrama ɛalaykum ʼilla ma aḍṭurirtum ʼilayhi wa ʼinna kaṯiran layuḍilluna biʼahwaʼihim biɣayri ɛilmin ʼinna rabbaka huwa ʼaɛlamu bil-muɛtadin.
Wa ḏaru ḏ̣ahira al-ʼiṯmi wa baṭinahu ʼinna al-laḏina yaksibuna al-ʼiṯma sayujzawna bima kanu yaqtarifun.
Wa la taʼkulu mimma lam yuḏkar asmu Allahi ɛalayhi wa ʼinnahu lafisqun wa ʼinna ac-cayaṭina layuḥuna ʼila ʼawliyaʼihim liyujadilukum wa ʼin ʼaṭaɛtumuhum ʼinnakum lamucrikun.
ʼawaman kana maytan faʼaḥyaynahu wa jaɛalna lahu nuran yamci bihi fi an-nasi kaman maṯaluhu fi aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati laysa bixarijin minha kaḏalika zuyyina lilkafirina ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa kaḏalika jaɛalna fi kulli qaryatin ʼakabira mujrimiha liyamkuru fiha wa ma yamkuruna ʼilla biʼanfusihim wa ma yacɛurun.

Wa ʼiḏa jaʼat/hum ʼayatun qalu lan nuʼmina ḥatta nuʼta miṯla ma ʼutiya rusulu Allahi Allahu ʼaɛlamu ḥayṯu yajɛalu risalatahu sayuṣibu al-laḏina ʼajramu ṣaɣarun ɛinda Allahi wa ɛaḏabun cadidun bima kanu yamkurun.

Faman yurid Allahu ʼan yahdiyahu yacraḥ ṣadrahu lilʼislami wa man yurid ʼan yuḍillahu yajɛal ṣadrahu ḍayyiqan ḥarajan kaʼannama yaṣṣaɛɛadu fi as-samaʼi kaḏalika yajɛalu Allahu ar-rijsa ɛala al-laḏina la yuʼminun.
Wa haḏa ṣiraṭu rabbika mustaqiman qad faṣṣalna al-ʼayati liqawmin yaḏḏakkarun.
Lahum daru as-salami ɛinda rabbihim wa huwa waliyuhum bima kanu yaɛmalun.

Wa yawma yaḥcuruhum jamiɛan ya maɛcara al-jinni qad astakṯartum mina al-ʼinsi wa qala ʼawliyaʼuuhum mina al-ʼinsi rabbana astamtaɛa baɛḍuna bibaɛḍin wa balaɣna ʼajalana al-laḏi ʼajjalta lana qala an-naru maṯwakum xalidina fiha ʼilla ma caʼa Allahu ʼinna rabbaka ḥakimun ɛalimun.
Wa kaḏalika nuwalli baɛḍa aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina baɛḍan bima kanu yaksibun.

Ya maɛcara al-jinni wa al-ʼinsi ʼalam yaʼtikum rusulun minkum yaquṣṣuna ɛalaykum ʼaya ti wa yunḏirunakum liqaʼa yawmikum haḏa qalu cahidna ɛala ʼanfusina wa ɣarrat/hum al-ḥaya atu ad-dunya wa cahidu ɛala ʼanfusihim ʼannahum kanu kafirin.
Ḏalika ʼan lam yakun rabbuka muhlika al-qura biḏ̣ulmin wa ʼahluha ɣafilun.
Wa likullin darajatun mimma ɛamilu wa ma rabbuka biɣafilin ɛamma yaɛmalun.
Wa rabbuka al-ɣaniyu ḏu ar-raḥmati ʼin yacaʼ yuḏ/hibkum wa yastaxlif min baɛdikum ma yacaʼu kama ʼancaʼakum min ḏurriyati qawmin ʼaxarin.
ʼinna ma tuɛaduna laʼatin wa ma ʼantum bimuɛjizin.
Qul ya qawmi aɛmalu ɛala makanatikum ʼinni ɛamilun fasawfa taɛlamuna man takunu lahu ɛaqibatu ad-dari ʼinnahu la yufliḥu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.

Wa jaɛalu Lillahi mimma ḏaraʼa mina al-ḥarṯi wa al-ʼanɛam naṣiban faqalu haḏa Lillahi bizaɛmihim wa haḏa licurakaʼina fama kana licurakaʼihim fala yaṣilu ʼila Allahi wa ma kana Lillahi fahuwa yaṣilu ʼila curakaʼihim saʼa ma yaḥkumun.
Wa kaḏalika zayyana likaṯirin mina al-mucrikina qatla ʼawladihim curakaʼuuhum liyurduhum wa liyalbisu ɛalayhim dinahum wa law caʼa Allahu ma faɛaluhu faḏarhum wa ma yaftarun.

Wa qalu haḏihi ʼanɛamun wa ḥarṯun ḥijrun la yaṭɛamuha ʼilla man nacaʼu bizaɛmihim wa ʼanɛamun ḥurrimat ḏ̣uhuruha wa ʼanɛamun la yaḏkuruna asma Allahi ɛalayha aftiraʼan ɛalayhi sayajzihim bima kanu yaftarun.
Wa qalu ma fi buṭuni haḏihi al-ʼanɛam xaliṣatun liḏukurina wa muḥarramun ɛala ʼazwajina wa ʼin yakun maytatan fahum fihi curakaʼu sayajzihim waṣfahum ʼinnahu ḥakimun ɛalimun.
Qad xasira al-laḏina qatalu ʼawladahum safahan biɣayri ɛilmin wa ḥarramu ma razaqahum Allahu aftiraʼan ɛala Allahi qad ḍallu wa ma kanu muhtadin.

Wa huwa al-laḏi ʼancaʼa jannatin maɛrucatin wa ɣayra maɛrucatin wa an-naxla wa az-zarɛa muxtalifan ʼukuluhu wa az-zaytuna wa ar-rummana mutacabihan wa ɣayra mutacabihin kulu min ṯamarihi ʼiḏa ʼaṯmara wa ʼatu ḥaqqahu yawma ḥaṣadihi wa la tusrifu ʼinnahu la yuḥibbu al-musrifin.
Wa mina al-ʼanɛam ḥamulatan wa farcan kulu mimma razaqakum Allahu wa la tattabiɛu xuṭuwati ac-cayṭani ʼinnahu lakum ɛaduwun mubinun.
Ṯamaniyata ʼazwajin mina aḍ-ḍaʼni aṯnayni wa mina al-maɛzi aṯnayni qul ʼalḏḏakarayni ḥarrama ʼam al-ʼunṯayayni ʼamma actamalat ɛalayhi ʼarḥamu al-ʼunṯayayni nabbiʼuni biɛilmin ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.

Wa mina al-ʼibili aṯnayni wa mina al-baqari aṯnayni qul ʼalḏḏakarayni ḥarrama ʼam al-ʼunṯayayni ʼamma actamalat ɛalayhi ʼarḥamu al-ʼunṯayayni ʼam kuntum cuhadaʼa ʼiḏ waṣṣakum Allahu bihaḏa faman ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban liyuḍilla an-nasa biɣayri ɛilmin ʼinna Allaha la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Qul la ʼajidu fi ma ʼuḥiya ʼilayya muḥarraman ɛala ṭaɛimin yaṭɛamuhu ʼilla ʼan yakuna maytatan ʼaw daman masfuḥan ʼaw laḥma xinzirin faʼinnahu rijsun ʼaw fisqan ʼuhilla liɣayri Allahi bihi faman aḍṭurra ɣayra baɣin wa la ɛadin faʼinna rabbaka ɣafurun raḥimun.

Wa ɛala al-laḏina hadu ḥarramna kulla ḏi ḏ̣ufurin wa mina al-baqari wa al-ɣanami ḥarramna ɛalayhim cuḥumahuma ʼilla ma ḥamalat ḏ̣uhuruhuma ʼaw al-ḥawaya ʼaw ma axtalaṭa biɛaḏ̣min ḏalika jazaynahum bibaɣyihim wa ʼinna laṣadiqun.
Faʼin kaḏḏabuka faqul rabbukum ḏu raḥmatin wasiɛatin wa la yuraddu baʼsuhu ɛan al-qawmi al-mujrimin.

Sayaqulu al-laḏina ʼacraku law caʼa Allahu ma ʼacrakna wa la ʼabaʼuuna wa la ḥarramna min cayʼin kaḏalika kaḏḏaba al-laḏina min qablihim ḥatta ḏaqu baʼsana qul hal ɛindakum min ɛilmin fatuxrijuhu lana ʼin tattabiɛuna ʼilla aḏ̣-ḏ̣anna wa ʼin ʼantum ʼilla taxruṣun.
Qul falillahi al-ḥujjatu al-baliɣatu falaw caʼa lahadakum ʼajmaɛin.

Qul halumma cuhadaʼakum al-laḏina yac/haduna ʼanna Allaha ḥarrama haḏa faʼin cahidu fala tac/had maɛahum wa la tattabiɛ ʼahwaʼa al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati wa hum birabbihim yaɛdilun.

Qul taɛalaw ʼatlu ma ḥarrama rabbukum ɛalaykum ʼalla tucriku bihi cayʼan wa bil-walidayni ʼiḥsanan wa la taqtulu ʼawladakum min ʼimlaqin naḥnu narzuqukum wa ʼiyahum wa la taqrabu al-fawaḥica ma ḏ̣ahara minha wa ma baṭana wa la taqtulu an-nafsa allati ḥarrama Allahu ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi ḏalikum waṣṣakum bihi laɛallakum taɛqilun.

Wa la taqrabu mala al-yatimi ʼilla bi-ati hiya ʼaḥsanu ḥatta yabluɣa ʼacuddahu wa ʼawfu al-kayla wa al-mizana bil-qisṭi la nukallifu nafsan ʼilla wusɛaha wa ʼiḏa qultum faɛdilu wa law kana ḏa qurba wa biɛahdi Allahi ʼawfu ḏalikum waṣṣakum bihi laɛallakum taḏakkarun.
Wa ʼanna haḏa ṣiraṭi mustaqiman fa attabiɛuhu wa la tattabiɛu as-subula fatafarraqa bikum ɛan sabilihi ḏalikum waṣṣakum bihi laɛallakum tattaqun.
Ṯumma ʼatayna musa al-kitaba tamaman ɛala al-laḏi ʼaḥsana wa tafṣilan likulli cayʼin wa hudan wa raḥmatan laɛallahum biliqaʼi rabbihim yuʼminun.
Wa haḏa kitabun ʼanzalnahu mubarakun fa attabiɛuhu wa attaqu laɛallakum turḥamun.
ʼan taqulu ʼinnama ʼunzila al-kitabu ɛala ṭaʼifatayni min qablina wa ʼin kunna ɛan dirasatihim laɣafilin.

ʼaw taqulu law ʼanna ʼunzila ɛalayna al-kitabu lakunna ʼahda minhum faqad jaʼakum bayyinatun min rabbikum wa hudan wa raḥmatun faman ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman kaḏḏaba biʼayati Allahi wa ṣadafa ɛanha sanajzi al-laḏina yaṣdifuna ɛan ʼayatina suʼa al-ɛaḏabi bima kanu yaṣdifun.

Hal yanḏ̣uruna ʼilla ʼan taʼtiyahum al-malaʼikatu ʼaw yaʼtiya rabbuka ʼaw yaʼtiya baɛḍu ʼayati rabbika yawma yaʼti baɛḍu ʼayati rabbika la yanfaɛu nafsan ʼimanuha lam takun ʼamanat min qablu ʼaw kasabat fi ʼimaniha xayran qul antaḏ̣iru ʼinna muntaḏ̣irun.
ʼinna al-laḏina farraqu dinahum wa kanu ciyaɛan lasta minhum fi cayʼin ʼinnama ʼamruhum ʼila Allahi ṯumma yunabbiʼuhum bima kanu yafɛalun.
Man jaʼa bil-ḥasanati falahu ɛacru ʼamṯaliha wa man jaʼa bis-sayyiʼati fala yujza ʼilla miṯlaha wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
Qul ʼinnani hadani rabbi ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin dinan qiyaman millata ʼibrahima ḥanifan wa ma kana mina al-mucrikin.
Qul ʼinna ṣalati wa nusuki wa maḥyay wa mamati Lillahi rabbi al-ɛalamin.
La carika lahu wa biḏalika ʼumirtu wa ʼana ʼawwalu al-muslimin.

Qul ʼaɣayra Allahi ʼabɣi rabban wa huwa rabbu kulli cayʼin wa la taksibu kullu nafsin ʼilla ɛalayha wa la taziru waziratun wizra ʼuxra ṯumma ʼila rabbikum marjiɛukum fayunabbiʼukum bima kuntum fihi taxtalifun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi jaɛalakum xalaʼifa al-ʼarḍi wa rafaɛa baɛḍakum fawqa baɛḍin darajatin liyabluwakum fi ma ʼatakum ʼinna rabbaka sariɛu al-ɛiqabi wa ʼinnahu laɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼalif-lam-mim-ṣad.
Kitabun ʼunzila ʼilayka fala yakun fi ṣadrika ḥarajun minhu litunḏira bihi wa ḏikra lilmuʼminin.
Attabiɛu ma ʼunzila ʼilaykum min rabbikum wa la tattabiɛu min dunihi ʼawliyaʼa qalilan ma taḏakkarun.
Wa kam min qaryatin ʼahlaknaha fajaʼaha baʼsuna bayatan ʼaw hum qaʼilun.
Fama kana daɛwahum ʼiḏ jaʼahum baʼsuna ʼilla ʼan qalu ʼinna kunna ḏ̣alimin.
Falanasʼalanna al-laḏina ʼursila ʼilayhim wa lanasʼalanna al-mursalin.
Falanaquṣṣanna ɛalayhim biɛilmin wa ma kunna ɣaʼibin.
Wa al-waznu yawmaʼiḏin al-ḥaqqu faman ṯaqulat mawazinuhu faʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
Wa man xaffat mawazinuhu faʼulaʼika al-laḏina xasiru ʼanfusahum bima kanu biʼayatina yaḏ̣limun.
Wa laqad makkannakum fi al-ʼarḍi wa jaɛalna lakum fiha maɛayica qalilan ma tackurun.
Wa laqad xalaqnakum ṯumma ṣawwarnakum ṯumma qulna lilmalaʼikati asjudu liʼdama fasajadu ʼilla ʼiblisa lam yakun mina as-sajidin.
Qala ma manaɛaka ʼalla tasjuda ʼiḏ ʼamartuka qala ʼana xayrun minhu xalaqtani min narin wa xalaqtahu min ṭinin.
Qala fahbiṭ minha fama yakunu laka ʼan tatakabbara fiha faxruj ʼinnaka mina aṣ-ṣaɣirin.
Qala ʼanḏ̣irni ʼila yawmi yubɛaṯun.
Qala ʼinnaka mina al-munḏ̣arin.
Qala fabima ʼaɣwaytani laʼaqɛudanna lahum ṣiraṭaka al-mustaqim.
Ṯumma laʼatiyannahum min bayni ʼaydihim wa min xalfihim wa ɛan ʼaymanihim wa ɛan camaʼilihim wa la tajidu ʼakṯarahum cakirin.
Qala axruj minha maḏʼuman madḥuran laman tabiɛaka minhum laʼamlaʼanna jahannama minkum ʼajmaɛin.
Wa yaʼadamu askun ʼanta wa zawjuka al-jannata fakula min ḥayṯu ciʼtuma wa la taqraba haḏihi ac-cajarata fatakuna mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Fawaswasa lahuma ac-cayṭanu liyubdiya lahuma ma wuriya ɛanhuma min sawʼatihima wa qala ma nahakuma rabbukuma ɛan haḏihi ac-cajarati ʼilla ʼan takuna malakayni ʼaw takuna mina al-xalidin.
Wa qasamahuma ʼinni lakuma lamina an-naṣiḥin.

Fadallahuma biɣururin falamma ḏaqa ac-cajarata badat lahuma sawʼatuhuma wa ṭafiqa yaxṣifani ɛalayhima min waraqi al-jannati wa nadahuma rabbuhuma ʼalam ʼanhakuma ɛan tilkuma ac-cajarati wa ʼaqul lakuma ʼinna ac-cayṭana lakuma ɛaduwun mubinun.
Qala rabbana ḏ̣alamna ʼanfusana wa ʼin lam taɣfir lana wa tarḥamna lanakunanna mina al-xasirin.
Qala ahbiṭu baɛḍukum libaɛḍin ɛaduwun wa lakum fi al-ʼarḍi mustaqarrun wa mataɛun ʼila ḥinin.
Qala fiha taḥyawna wa fiha tamutuna wa minha tuxrajun.
Ya bani ʼadama qad ʼanzalna ɛalaykum libasan yuwari sawʼatikum wa rican wa libasu at-taqwa ḏalika xayrun ḏalika min ʼaya ti Allahi laɛallahum yaḏḏakkarun.

Ya bani ʼadama la yaftinannakum ac-cayṭanu kama ʼaxraja ʼabawaykum mina al-jannati yanziɛu ɛanhuma libasahuma liyuriyahuma sawʼatihima ʼinnahu yarakum huwa wa qabiluhu min ḥayṯu la tarawnahum ʼinna jaɛalna ac-caya ṭina ʼawliya ʼa lillaḏina la yuʼminun.
Wa ʼiḏa faɛalu faḥicatan qalu wajadna ɛalayha ʼabaʼana wa Allahu ʼamarana biha qul ʼinna Allaha la yaʼmuru bil-faḥcaʼi ʼataquluna ɛala Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
Qul ʼamara rabbi bil-qisṭi wa ʼaqimu wujuhakum ɛinda kulli masjidin wa adɛuhu muxliṣina lahu ad-dina kama badaʼakum taɛudun.
Fariqan hada wa fariqan ḥaqqa ɛalayhim aḍ-ḍalalatu ʼinnahum attaxaḏu ac-cayaṭina ʼawliyaʼa min duni Allahi wa yaḥsabuna ʼannahum muhtadun.
Ya bani ʼadama xuḏu zinatakum ɛinda kulli masjidin wa kulu wa acrabu wa la tusrifu ʼinnahu la yuḥibbu al-musrifin.

Qul man ḥarrama zinata Allahi allati ʼaxraja liɛibadihi wa aṭ-ṭayyibati mina ar-rizqi qul hiya lillaḏina ʼamanu fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya xaliṣatan yawma al-qiyamati kaḏalika nufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati liqawmin yaɛlamun.

Qul ʼinnama ḥarrama rabbi al-fawaḥica ma ḏ̣ahara minha wa ma baṭana wa al-ʼiṯma wa al-baɣya biɣayri al-ḥaqqi wa ʼan tucriku Billahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sulṭanan wa ʼan taqulu ɛala Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
Wa likulli ʼummatin ʼajalun faʼiḏa jaʼa ʼajaluhum la yastaʼxiruna saɛatan wa la yastaqdimun.
Ya bani ʼadama ʼimma yaʼtiyannakum rusulun minkum yaquṣṣuna ɛalaykum ʼaya ti faman attaqa wa ʼaṣlaḥa fala xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Wa al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa astakbaru ɛanha ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.

Faman ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼaw kaḏḏaba biʼayatihi ʼulaʼika yanaluhum naṣibuhum mina al-kitabi ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼat/hum rusuluna yatawaffawnahum qalu ʼayna ma kuntum tadɛuna min duni Allahi qalu ḍallu ɛanna wa cahidu ɛala ʼanfusihim ʼannahum kanu kafirin.

Qala adxulu fi ʼumamin qad xalat min qablikum mina al-jinni wa al-ʼinsi fi an-nari kullama daxalat ʼummatun laɛanat ʼuxtaha ḥatta ʼiḏa addaraku fiha jamiɛan qalat ʼuxrahum liʼwlahum rabbana haʼuulaʼ ʼaḍalluna faʼatihim ɛaḏaban ḍiɛfan mina an-nari qala likullin ḍiɛfun wa lakin la taɛlamun.
Wa qalat ʼulahum liʼxrahum fama kana lakum ɛalayna min faḍlin faḏuqu al-ɛaḏaba bima kuntum taksibun.
ʼinna al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa astakbaru ɛanha la tufattaḥu lahum ʼabwabu as-samaʼi wa la yadxuluna al-jannata ḥatta yalija al-jamalu fi sammi al-xiyaṭi wa kaḏalika najzi al-mujrimin.
Lahum min jahannama mihadun wa min fawqihim ɣawacin wa kaḏalika najzi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati la nukallifu nafsan ʼilla wusɛaha ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati hum fiha xalidun.

Wa nazaɛna ma fi ṣudurihim min ɣillin tajri min taḥtihim al-ʼanharu wa qalu al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi hadana lihaḏa wa ma kunna linahtadiya lawla ʼan hadana Allahu laqad jaʼat rusulu rabbina bil-ḥaqqi wa nudu ʼan tilkum al-jannatu ʼuriṯtumuha bima kuntum taɛmalun.

Wa nada ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati ʼaṣḥaba an-nari ʼan qad wajadna ma waɛadana rabbuna ḥaqqan fahal wajadtum ma waɛada rabbukum ḥaqqan qalu naɛam faʼaḏḏana muʼaḏḏinun baynahum ʼan laɛnatu Allahi ɛala aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Al-laḏina yaṣudduna ɛan sabili Allahi wa yabɣunaha ɛiwajan wa hum bil-ʼaxirati kafirun.
Wa baynahuma ḥijabun wa ɛala al-ʼaɛraf rijalun yaɛrifuna kullan bisimahum wa nadaw ʼaṣḥaba al-jannati ʼan salamun ɛalaykum lam yadxuluha wa hum yaṭmaɛun.
Wa ʼiḏa ṣurifat ʼabṣaruhum tilqaʼa ʼaṣḥabi an-nari qalu rabbana la tajɛalna maɛa al-qawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa nada ʼaṣḥabu al-ʼaɛraf rijalan yaɛrifunahum bisimahum qalu ma ʼaɣna ɛankum jamɛukum wa ma kuntum tastakbirun.
ʼahaʼuulaʼ al-laḏina ʼaqsamtum la yanaluhum Allahu biraḥmatin adxulu al-jannata la xawfun ɛalaykum wa la ʼantum taḥzanun.
Wa nada ʼaṣḥabu an-nari ʼaṣḥaba al-jannati ʼan ʼafiḍu ɛalayna mina al-maʼi ʼaw mimma razaqakum Allahu qalu ʼinna Allaha ḥarramahuma ɛala al-kafirin.
Al-laḏina attaxaḏu dinahum lahwan wa laɛiban wa ɣarrat/hum al-ḥayatu ad-dunya falyawma nansahum kama nasu liqaʼa yawmihim haḏa wa ma kanu biʼayatina yajḥadun.
Wa laqad jiʼnahum bikitabin faṣṣalnahu ɛala ɛilmin hudan wa raḥmatan liqawmin yuʼminun.

Hal yanḏ̣uruna ʼilla taʼwilahu yawma yaʼti taʼwiluhu yaqulu al-laḏina nasuhu min qablu qad jaʼat rusulu rabbina bil-ḥaqqi fahal lana min cufaɛaʼa fayacfaɛu lana ʼaw nuraddu fanaɛmala ɣayra al-laḏi kunna naɛmalu qad xasiru ʼanfusahum wa ḍalla ɛanhum ma kanu yaftarun.

ʼinna rabbakum Allahu al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa fi sittati ʼayyamin ṯumma astawa ɛala al-ɛarci yuɣci al-layla an-nahara yaṭlubuhu ḥaṯiṯan wa ac-camsa wa al-qamara wa an-nujuma musaxxaratin biʼamrihi ʼala lahu al-xalqu wa al-ʼamru tabaraka Allahu rabbu al-ɛalamin.
Adɛu rabbakum taḍarruɛan wa xufyatan ʼinnahu la yuḥibbu al-muɛtadin.
Wa la tufsidu fi al-ʼarḍi baɛda ʼiṣlaḥiha wa adɛuhu xawfan wa ṭamaɛan ʼinna raḥmata Allahi qaribun mina al-muḥsinin.
