Wa huwa al-laḏi yursilu ar-riyaḥa bucran bayna yaday raḥmatihi ḥatta ʼiḏa ʼaqallat saḥaban ṯiqalan suqnahu libaladin mayyitin faʼanzalna bihi al-maʼa faʼaxrajna bihi min kulli aṯ-ṯamarati kaḏalika nuxriju al-mawta laɛallakum taḏakkarun.
Wa al-baladu aṭ-ṭayyibu yaxruju nabatuhu biʼiḏni rabbihi wa al-laḏi xabuṯa la yaxruju ʼilla nakidan kaḏalika nuṣarrifu al-ʼayati liqawmin yackurun.
Laqad ʼarsalna nuḥan ʼila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu ʼinni ʼaxafu ɛalaykum ɛaḏaba yawmin ɛaḏ̣imin.
Qala al-malaʼu min qawmihi ʼinna lanaraka fi ḍalalin mubinin.
Qala ya qawmi laysa bi ḍalalatun wa lakinni rasulun min rabbi al-ɛalamin.
ʼuballiɣukum risalati rabbi wa ʼanṣaḥu lakum wa ʼaɛlamu mina Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
ʼawaɛajibtum ʼan jaʼakum ḏikrun min rabbikum ɛala rajulin minkum liyunḏirakum wa litattaqu wa laɛallakum turḥamun.
Fakaḏḏabuhu faʼanjaynahu wa al-laḏina maɛahu fi al-fulki wa ʼaɣraqna al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina ʼinnahum kanu qawman ɛamin.
Wa ʼila ɛadin ʼaxahum hudan qala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu ʼafala tattaqun.
Qala al-malaʼu al-laḏina kafaru min qawmihi ʼinna lanaraka fi safahatin wa ʼinna lanaḏ̣unnuka mina al-kaḏibin.
Qala ya qawmi laysa bi safahatun wa lakinni rasulun min rabbi al-ɛalamin.
ʼuballiɣukum risalati rabbi wa ʼana lakum naṣiḥun ʼaminun.

ʼawaɛajibtum ʼan jaʼakum ḏikrun min rabbikum ɛala rajulin minkum liyunḏirakum wa aḏkuru ʼiḏ jaɛalakum xulafaʼa min baɛdi qawmi nuḥin wa zadakum fi al-xalqi basṭatan faḏkuru ʼalaʼa Allahi laɛallakum tufliḥun.
Qalu ʼajiʼtana linaɛbuda Allaha waḥdahu wa naḏara ma kana yaɛbudu ʼabaʼuuna faʼtina bima taɛiduna ʼin kunta mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Qala qad waqaɛa ɛalaykum min rabbikum rijsun wa ɣaḍabun ʼatujadilunani fi ʼasmaʼin sammaytumuha ʼantum wa ʼabaʼuukum ma nazzala Allahu biha min sulṭanin fantaḏ̣iru ʼinni maɛakum mina al-muntaḏ̣irin.
Faʼanjaynahu wa al-laḏina maɛahu biraḥmatin minna wa qaṭaɛna dabira al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa ma kanu muʼminin.

Wa ʼila ṯamuda ʼaxahum ṣaliḥan qala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu qad jaʼatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum haḏihi naqatu Allahi lakum ʼayatan faḏaruha taʼkul fi ʼarḍi Allahi wa la tamassuha bisuʼin fayaʼxuḏakum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa aḏkuru ʼiḏ jaɛalakum xulafaʼa min baɛdi ɛadin wa bawwaʼakum fi al-ʼarḍi tattaxiḏuna min suhuliha quṣuran wa tanḥituna al-jibala buyutan faḏkuru ʼalaʼa Allahi wa la taɛṯaw fi al-ʼarḍi mufsidin.
Qala al-malaʼu al-laḏina astakbaru min qawmihi lillaḏina astuḍɛifu liman ʼamana minhum ʼataɛlamuna ʼanna ṣaliḥan mursalun min rabbihi qalu ʼinna bima ʼursila bihi muʼminun.
Qala al-laḏina astakbaru ʼinna bial-laḏi ʼamantum bihi kafirun.
Faɛaqaru an-naqata wa ɛataw ɛan ʼamri rabbihim wa qalu ya ṣaliḥu aʼtina bima taɛiduna ʼin kunta mina al-mursalin.
Faʼaxaḏat/hum ar-rajfatu faʼaṣbaḥu fi darihim jaṯimin.
Fatawalla ɛanhum wa qala ya qawmi laqad ʼablaɣtukum risalata rabbi wa naṣaḥtu lakum wa lakin la tuḥibbuna an-naṣiḥin.
Wa luṭan ʼiḏ qala liqawmihi ʼataʼtuna al-faḥicata ma sabaqakum biha min ʼaḥadin mina al-ɛalamin.
ʼinnakum lataʼtuna ar-rijala cahwatan min duni an-nisaʼ bal ʼantum qawmun musrifun.
Wa ma kana jawaba qawmihi ʼilla ʼan qalu ʼaxrijuhum min qaryatikum ʼinnahum ʼunasun yataṭahharun.
Faʼanjaynahu wa ʼahlahu ʼilla amraʼatahu kanat mina al-ɣabirin.
Wa ʼamṭarna ɛalayhim maṭaran fanḏ̣ur kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mujrimin.

Wa ʼila madyana ʼaxahum cuɛayban qala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu qad jaʼatkum bayyinatun min rabbikum faʼawfu al-kayla wa al-mizana wa la tabxasu an-nasa ʼacya ʼahum wa la tufsidu fi al-ʼarḍi baɛda ʼiṣlaḥiha ḏalikum xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Wa la taqɛudu bikulli ṣiraṭin tuɛiduna wa taṣudduna ɛan sabili Allahi man ʼamana bihi wa tabɣunaha ɛiwajan wa aḏkuru ʼiḏ kuntum qalilan fakaṯṯarakum wa anḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mufsidin.
Wa ʼin kana ṭaʼifatun minkum ʼamanu bial-laḏi ʼursiltu bihi wa ṭaʼifatun lam yuʼminu faṣbiru ḥatta yaḥkuma Allahu baynana wa huwa xayru al-ḥakimin.
Qala al-malaʼu al-laḏina astakbaru min qawmihi lanuxrijannaka ya cuɛaybu wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛaka min qaryatina ʼaw lataɛudunna fi millatina qala ʼawalaw kunna karihin.

Qad aftarayna ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼin ɛudna fi millatikum baɛda ʼiḏ najjana Allahu minha wa ma yakunu lana ʼan naɛuda fiha ʼilla ʼan yacaʼa Allahu rabbuna wasiɛa rabbuna kulla cayʼin ɛilman ɛala Allahi tawakkalna rabbana aftaḥ baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼanta xayru al-fatiḥin.
Wa qala al-malaʼu al-laḏina kafaru min qawmihi laʼin attabaɛtum cuɛayban ʼinnakum ʼiḏan laxasirun.
Faʼaxaḏat/hum ar-rajfatu faʼaṣbaḥu fi darihim jaṯimin.
Al-laḏina kaḏḏabu cuɛayban kaʼan lam yaɣnaw fiha al-laḏina kaḏḏabu cuɛayban kanu hum al-xasirin.
Fatawalla ɛanhum wa qala ya qawmi laqad ʼablaɣtukum risalati rabbi wa naṣaḥtu lakum fakayfa ʼasa ɛala qawmin kafirin.
Wa ma ʼarsalna fi qaryatin min nabiyin ʼilla ʼaxaḏna ʼahlaha bil-baʼsaʼi wa aḍ-ḍarraʼi laɛallahum yaḍḍarraɛun.
Ṯumma baddalna makana as-sayyiʼati al-ḥasanata ḥatta ɛafaw wa qalu qad massa ʼabaʼana aḍ-ḍarraʼu wa as-sarraʼu faʼaxaḏnahum baɣtatan wa hum la yacɛurun.
Wa law ʼanna ʼahla al-qura ʼamanu wa attaqaw lafataḥna ɛalayhim barakatin mina as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi wa lakin kaḏḏabu faʼaxaḏnahum bima kanu yaksibun.
ʼafaʼamina ʼahlu al-qura ʼan yaʼtiyahum baʼsuna bayatan wa hum naʼimun.
ʼawa ʼamina ʼahlu al-qura ʼan yaʼtiyahum baʼsuna ḍuḥan wa hum yalɛabun.
ʼafaʼaminu makra Allahi fala yaʼmanu makra Allahi ʼilla al-qawmu al-xasirun.
ʼawalam yahdi lillaḏina yariṯuna al-ʼarḍa min baɛdi ʼahliha ʼan law nacaʼu ʼaṣabnahum biḏunubihim wa naṭbaɛu ɛala qulubihim fahum la yasmaɛun.
Tilka al-qura naquṣṣu ɛalayka min ʼanbaʼiha wa laqad jaʼat/hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati fama kanu liyuʼminu bima kaḏḏabu min qablu kaḏalika yaṭbaɛu Allahu ɛala qulubi al-kafirin.
Wa ma wajadna liʼkṯarihim min ɛahdin wa ʼin wajadna ʼakṯarahum lafasiqin.
Ṯumma baɛaṯna min baɛdihim musa biʼayatina ʼila firɛawna wa malaʼihi faḏ̣alamu biha fanḏ̣ur kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mufsidin.
Wa qala musa ya firɛawnu ʼinni rasulun min rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Ḥaqiqun ɛala ʼan la ʼaqula ɛala Allahi ʼilla al-ḥaqqa qad jiʼtukum bibayyinatin min rabbikum faʼarsil maɛi bani ʼisraʼil.
Qala ʼin kunta jiʼta biʼayatin faʼti biha ʼin kunta mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Faʼalqa ɛaṣahu faʼiḏa hiya ṯuɛbanun mubinun.
Wa nazaɛa yadahu faʼiḏa hiya bayḍaʼu lilnnaḏ̣irin.
Qala al-malaʼu min qawmi firɛawna ʼinna haḏa lasaḥirun ɛalimun.
Yuridu ʼan yuxrijakum min ʼarḍikum famaḏa taʼmurun.
Qalu ʼarjihi wa ʼaxahu wa ʼarsil fi al-madaʼini ḥacirin.
Yaʼtuka bikulli saḥirin ɛalimin.
Wa jaʼa as-saḥaratu firɛawna qalu ʼinna lana laʼajran ʼin kunna naḥnu al-ɣalibin.
Qala naɛam wa ʼinnakum lamina al-muqarrabin.
Qalu ya musa ʼimma ʼan tulqiya wa ʼimma ʼan nakuna naḥnu al-mulqin.
Qala ʼalqu falamma ʼalqaw saḥaru ʼaɛyuna an-nasi wa astarhabuhum wa jaʼu bisiḥrin ɛaḏ̣imin.
Wa ʼawḥayna ʼila musa ʼan ʼalqi ɛaṣaka faʼiḏa hiya talqafu ma yaʼfikun.
Fawaqaɛa al-ḥaqqu wa baṭala ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Faɣulibu hunalika wa anqalabu ṣaɣirin.
Wa ʼulqiya as-saḥaratu sajidin.
Qalu ʼamanna birabbi al-ɛalamin.
Rabbi musa wa harun.
Qala firɛawnu ʼamantum bihi qabla ʼan ʼaḏana lakum ʼinna haḏa lamakrun makartumuhu fi al-madinati lituxriju minha ʼahlaha fasawfa taɛlamun.
Laʼuqaṭṭiɛanna ʼaydiyakum wa ʼarjulakum min xilafin ṯumma laʼuṣallibannakum ʼajmaɛin.
Qalu ʼinna ʼila rabbina munqalibun.
Wa ma tanqimu minna ʼilla ʼan ʼamanna biʼayati rabbina lamma jaʼatna rabbana ʼafriɣ ɛalayna ṣabran wa tawaffana muslimin.
Wa qala al-malaʼu min qawmi firɛawna ʼataḏaru musa wa qawmahu liyufsidu fi al-ʼarḍi wa yaḏaraka wa ʼalihataka qala sanuqattilu ʼabnaʼahum wa nastaḥyi nisaʼahum wa ʼinna fawqahum qahirun.
Qala musa liqawmihi astaɛinu Billahi wa aṣbiru ʼinna al-ʼarḍa Lillahi yuriṯuha man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi wa al-ɛaqibatu lilmuttaqin.
Qalu ʼuḏina min qabli ʼan taʼtiyana wa min baɛdi ma jiʼtana qala ɛasa rabbukum ʼan yuhlika ɛaduwakum wa yastaxlifakum fi al-ʼarḍi fayanḏ̣ura kayfa taɛmalun.
Wa laqad ʼaxaḏna ʼala firɛawna bis-sinina wa naqṣin mina aṯ-ṯamarati laɛallahum yaḏḏakkarun.
Faʼiḏa jaʼat/humu al-ḥasanatu qalu lana haḏihi wa ʼin tuṣibhum sayyiʼatun yaṭṭayyaru bimusa wa man maɛahu ʼala ʼinnama ṭaʼiruhum ɛinda Allahi wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
Wa qalu mahma taʼtina bihi min ʼayatin litasḥarana biha fama naḥnu laka bimuʼminin.
Faʼarsalna ɛalayhimu aṭ-ṭufana wa al-jarada wa al-qummala wa aḍ-ḍafadiɛa wa ad-dama ʼayatin mufaṣṣalatin fastakbaru wa kanu qawman mujrimin.
Wa lamma waqaɛa ɛalayhim ar-rijzu qalu ya musa adɛu lana rabbaka bima ɛahida ɛindaka laʼin kacafta ɛanna ar-rijza lanuʼminanna laka wa lanursilanna maɛaka bani ʼisraʼil.
Falamma kacafna ɛanhumu ar-rijza ʼila ʼajalin hum baliɣuhu ʼiḏa hum yankuṯun.
Fantaqamna minhum faʼaɣraqnahum fi al-yammi biʼannahum kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa kanu ɛanha ɣafilin.

Wa ʼawraṯna al-qawma al-laḏina kanu yustaḍɛafuna macariqa al-ʼarḍi wa maɣaribaha allati barakna fiha wa tammat kalimatu rabbika al-ḥusna ɛala bani ʼisraʼila bima ṣabaru wa dammarna ma kana yaṣnaɛu firɛawnu wa qawmuhu wa ma kanu yaɛricun.
Wa jawazna bibani ʼisraʼila al-baḥra faʼataw ɛala qawmin yaɛkufuna ɛala ʼaṣnamin lahum qalu ya musa ajɛal lana ʼilahan kama lahum ʼalihatun qala ʼinnakum qawmun tajhalun.
ʼinna haʼuulaʼ mutabbarun ma hum fihi wa baṭilun ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Qala ʼaɣayra Allahi ʼabɣikum ʼilahan wa huwa faḍḍalakum ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼanjaynakum min ʼali firɛawna yasumunakum suʼa al-ɛaḏabi yuqattiluna ʼabnaʼakum wa yastaḥyuna nisaʼakum wa fi ḏalikum balaʼun min rabbikum ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa waɛadna musa ṯalaṯina laylatan wa ʼatmamnaha biɛacrin fatamma miqatu rabbihi ʼarbaɛina laylatan wa qala musa liʼxihi haruna axlufni fi qawmi wa ʼaṣliḥ wa la tattabiɛ sabila al-mufsidin.

Wa lamma jaʼa musa limiqatina wa kallamahu rabbuhu qala rabbi ʼarini ʼanḏ̣ur ʼilayka qala lan tarani wa lakin anḏ̣ur ʼila al-jabali faʼin astaqarra makanahu fasawfa tarani falamma tajalla rabbuhu liljabali jaɛalahu dakkan wa xarra musa ṣaɛiqan falamma ʼafaqa qala subḥanaka tubtu ʼilayka wa ʼana ʼawwalu al-muʼminin.
Qala ya musa ʼinni aṣṭafaytuka ɛala an-nasi birisalati wa bikalami faxuḏ ma ʼataytuka wa kun mina ac-cakirin.
Wa katabna lahu fi al-ʼalwaḥi min kulli cayʼin mawɛiḏ̣atan wa tafṣilan likulli cayʼin faxuḏ/ha biquwatin wa ʼmur qawmaka yaʼxuḏu biʼaḥsaniha saʼurikum dara al-fasiqin.

Saʼaṣrifu ɛan ʼayatiya al-laḏina yatakabbaruna fi al-ʼarḍi biɣayri al-ḥaqqi wa ʼin yaraw kulla ʼayatin la yuʼminu biha wa ʼin yaraw sabila ar-rucdi la yattaxiḏuhu sabilan wa ʼin yaraw sabila al-ɣayyi yattaxiḏuhu sabilan ḏalika biʼannahum kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa kanu ɛanha ɣafilin.
Wa al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa liqaʼi al-ʼaxirati ḥabiṭat ʼaɛmaluhum hal yujzawna ʼilla ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa attaxaḏa qawmu musa min baɛdihi min ḥuliyihim ɛijlan jasadan lahu xuwarun ʼalam yaraw ʼannahu la yukallimuhum wa la yahdihim sabilan attaxaḏuhu wa kanu ḏ̣alimin.
Wa lamma suqiṭa fi ʼaydihim wa raʼaw ʼannahum qad ḍallu qalu laʼin lam yarḥamna rabbuna wa yaɣfir lana lanakunanna mina al-xasirin.

Wa lamma rajaɛa musa ʼila qawmihi ɣaḍbana ʼasifan qala biʼsama xalaftumuni min baɛdi ʼaɛajiltum ʼamra rabbikum wa ʼalqa al-ʼalwaḥa wa ʼaxaḏa biraʼsi ʼaxihi yajurruhu ʼilayhi qala abna ʼumma ʼinna al-qawma astaḍɛafuni wa kadu yaqtulunani fala tucmit biya al-ʼaɛdaʼa wa la tajɛalni maɛa al-qawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Qala rabbi aɣfir li wa liʼaxi wa ʼadxilna fi raḥmatika wa ʼanta ʼarḥamu ar-raḥimin.
ʼinna al-laḏina attaxaḏu al-ɛijla sayanaluhum ɣaḍabun min rabbihim wa ḏillatun fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa kaḏalika najzi al-muftarin.
Wa al-laḏina ɛamilu as-sayyiʼati ṯumma tabu min baɛdiha wa ʼamanu ʼinna rabbaka min baɛdiha laɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa lamma sakata ɛan musa al-ɣaḍabu ʼaxaḏa al-ʼalwaḥa wa fi nusxatiha hudan wa raḥmatun lillaḏina hum lirabbihim yarhabun.

Wa axtara musa qawmahu sabɛina rajulan limiqatina falamma ʼaxaḏat/hum ar-rajfatu qala rabbi law ciʼta ʼahlaktahum min qablu wa ʼiyaya ʼatuhlikuna bima faɛala as-sufahaʼu minna ʼin hiya ʼilla fitnatuka tuḍillu biha man tacaʼu wa tahdi man tacaʼu ʼanta waliyuna faɣfir lana wa arḥamna wa ʼanta xayru al-ɣafirin.

Wa aktub lana fi haḏihi ad-dunya ḥasanatan wa fi al-ʼaxirati ʼinna hudna ʼilayka qala ɛaḏabi ʼuṣibu bihi man ʼacaʼu wa raḥmati wasiɛat kulla cayʼin fasaʼaktubuha lillaḏina yattaquna wa yuʼtuna az-zakata wa al-laḏina hum biʼayatina yuʼminun.

Al-laḏina yattabiɛuna ar-rasula an-nabiya al-ʼummiya al-laḏi yajidunahu maktuban ɛindahum fi at-tawrati wa al-ʼinjili yaʼmuruhum bil-maɛrufi wa yanhahum ɛan al-munkari wa yuḥillu lahum aṭ-ṭayyibati wa yuḥarrimu ɛalayhim al-xabaʼiṯa wa yaḍaɛu ɛanhum ʼiṣrahum wa al-ʼaɣlala allati kanat ɛalayhim fa-al-laḏina ʼamanu bihi wa ɛazzaruhu wa naṣaruhu wa attabaɛu an-nur al-laḏi ʼunzila maɛahu ʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.

Qul ya ʼayyuha an-nasu ʼinni rasulu Allahi ʼilaykum jamiɛan al-laḏi lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa yuḥyi wa yumitu faʼaminu Billahi wa rasulihi an-nabiyi al-ʼummiyi al-laḏi yuʼminu Billahi wa kalimatihi wa attabiɛuhu laɛallakum tahtadun.
Wa min qawmi musa ʼummatun yahduna bil-ḥaqqi wa bihi yaɛdilun.

Wa qaṭṭaɛnahumu aṯnatay ɛacrata ʼasbaṭan ʼumaman wa ʼawḥayna ʼila musa ʼiḏ astasqahu qawmuhu ʼan aḍrib biɛaṣaka al-ḥajara fanbajasat minhu aṯnata ɛacrata ɛaynan qad ɛalima kullu ʼunasin macrabahum wa ḏ̣allalna ɛalayhimu al-ɣamama wa ʼanzalna ɛalayhimu al-manna wa as-salwa kulu min ṭayyibati ma razaqnakum wa ma ḏ̣alamuna wa lakin kanu ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.
Wa ʼiḏ qila lahum askunu haḏihi al-qaryata wa kulu minha ḥayṯu ciʼtum wa qulu ḥiṭṭatun wa adxulu al-baba sujjadan naɣfir lakum xaṭiʼatikum sanazidu al-muḥsinin.
Fabaddala al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu minhum qawlan ɣayra al-laḏi qila lahum faʼarsalna ɛalayhim rijzan mina as-samaʼi bima kanu yaḏ̣limun.

Wa asʼalhum ɛan al-qaryati allati kanat ḥaḍirata al-baḥri ʼiḏ yaɛduna fi as-sabti ʼiḏ taʼtihim ḥitanuhum yawma sabtihim curraɛan wa yawma la yasbituna la taʼtihim kaḏalika nabluhum bima kanu yafsuqun.
Wa ʼiḏ qalat ʼummatun minhum lima taɛiḏ̣una qawman Allahu muhlikuhum ʼaw muɛaḏḏibuhum ɛaḏaban cadidan qalu maɛḏiratan ʼila rabbikum wa laɛallahum yattaqun.
Falamma nasu ma ḏukkiru bihi ʼanjayna al-laḏina yanhawna ɛan as-suʼi wa ʼaxaḏna al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu biɛaḏabin baʼisin bima kanu yafsuqun.
Falamma ɛataw ɛan ma nuhu ɛanhu qulna lahum kunu qiradatan xasiʼin.
Wa ʼiḏ taʼaḏḏana rabbuka layabɛaṯanna ɛalayhim ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati man yasumuhum suʼa al-ɛaḏabi ʼinna rabbaka lasariɛu al-ɛiqabi wa ʼinnahu laɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa qaṭṭaɛnahum fi al-ʼarḍi ʼumaman minhumu aṣ-ṣaliḥuna wa minhum duna ḏalika wa balawnahum bil-ḥasanati wa as-sayyiʼati laɛallahum yarjiɛun.

Faxalafa min baɛdihim xalfun wariṯu al-kitaba yaʼxuḏuna ɛaraḍa haḏa al-ʼadna wa yaquluna sayuɣfaru lana wa ʼin yaʼtihim ɛaraḍun miṯluhu yaʼxuḏuhu ʼalam yuʼxaḏ ɛalayhim miṯaqu al-kitabi ʼan la yaqulu ɛala Allahi ʼilla al-ḥaqqa wa darasu ma fihi wa ad-daru al-ʼaxiratu xayrun lillaḏina yattaquna ʼafala taɛqilun.
Wa al-laḏina yumassikuna bil-kitabi wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata ʼinna la nuḍiɛu ʼajra al-muṣliḥin.
Wa ʼiḏ nataqna al-jabala fawqahum kaʼannahu ḏ̣ullatun wa ḏ̣annu ʼannahu waqiɛun bihim xuḏu ma ʼataynakum biquwatin wa aḏkuru ma fihi laɛallakum tattaqun.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏa rabbuka min bani ʼadama min ḏ̣uhurihim ḏurriyatahum wa ʼac/hadahum ɛala ʼanfusihim ʼalastu birabbikum qalu bala cahidna ʼan taqulu yawma al-qiyamati ʼinna kunna ɛan haḏa ɣafilin.
ʼaw taqulu ʼinnama ʼacraka ʼabaʼuuna min qablu wa kunna ḏurriyatan min baɛdihim ʼafatuhlikuna bima faɛala al-mubṭilun.
Wa kaḏalika nufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati wa litastabina sabilu al-mujrimin.
Wa atlu ɛalayhim nabaʼa al-laḏi ʼataynahu ʼayatina fansalaxa minha faʼatbaɛahu ac-cayṭanu fakana mina al-ɣawin.

Wa law ciʼna larafaɛnahu biha wa lakinnahu ʼaxlada ʼila al-ʼarḍi wa attabaɛa hawahu famaṯaluhu kamaṯali al-kalbi ʼin taḥmil ɛalayhi yalhaṯ ʼaw tatruk/hu yalhaṯ ḏalika maṯalu al-qawmi al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina faqṣuṣi al-qaṣaṣa laɛallahum yatafakkarun.
Saʼa maṯalan al-qawmu al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa ʼanfusahum kanu yaḏ̣limun.
Man yahdi Allahu fahuwa al-muhtadi wa man yuḍlil faʼulaʼika hum al-xasirun.

Wa laqad ḏaraʼna lijahannama kaṯiran mina al-jinni wa al-ʼinsi lahum qulubun la yafqahuna biha wa lahum ʼaɛyunun la yubṣiruna biha wa lahum ʼaḏanun la yasmaɛuna biha ʼulaʼika kalʼanɛam bal hum ʼaḍallu ʼulaʼika humu al-ɣafilun.
Wa Lillahi al-ʼasmaʼu al-ḥusna fadɛuhu biha wa ḏaru al-laḏina yulḥiduna fi ʼasmaʼihi sayujzawna ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa mimman xalaqna ʼummatun yahduna bil-ḥaqqi wa bihi yaɛdilun.
Wa al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina sanastadrijuhum min ḥayṯu la yaɛlamun.
Wa ʼumli lahum ʼinna kaydi matinun.
ʼawalam yatafakkaru ma biṣaḥibihim min jinnatin ʼin huwa ʼilla naḏirun mubinun.
ʼawalam yanḏ̣uru fi malakuti as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma xalaqa Allahu min cayʼin wa ʼan ɛasa ʼan yakuna qad aqtaraba ʼajaluhum fabiʼayyi ḥadiṯin baɛdahu yuʼminun.
Man yuḍlili Allahu fala hadiya lahu wa yaḏaruhum fi ṭuɣyanihim yaɛmahun.

Yasʼalunaka ɛan as-saɛati ʼayyana mursaha qul ʼinnama ɛilmuha ɛinda rabbi la yujalliha liwaqtiha ʼilla huwa ṯaqulat fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi la taʼtikum ʼilla baɣtatan yasʼalunaka kaʼannaka ḥafiyun ɛanha qul ʼinnama ɛilmuha ɛinda Allahi wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Qul la ʼamliku linafsi nafɛan wa la ḍarran ʼilla ma caʼa Allahu wa law kuntu ʼaɛlamu al-ɣayba lastakṯartu mina al-xayri wa ma massaniya as-suʼ ʼin ʼana ʼilla naḏirun wa bacirun liqawmin yuʼminun.

Huwa al-laḏi xalaqakum min nafsin waḥidatin wa jaɛala minha zawjaha liyaskuna ʼilayha falamma taɣaccaha ḥamalat ḥamlan xafifan famarrat bihi falamma ʼaṯqalat daɛawa Allaha rabbahuma laʼin ʼataytana ṣaliḥan lanakunanna mina ac-cakirin.
Falamma ʼatahuma ṣaliḥan jaɛala lahu curakaʼa fima ʼatahuma fataɛala Allahu ɛamma yucrikun.
ʼayucrikuna ma la yaxluqu cayʼan wa hum yuxlaqun.
Wa la yastaṭiɛuna lahum naṣran wa la ʼanfusahum yanṣurun.
Wa ʼin tadɛuhum ʼila al-huda la yattabiɛukum sawaʼun ɛalaykum ʼadaɛawtumuhum ʼam ʼantum ṣamitun.
ʼinna al-laḏina tadɛuna min duni Allahi ɛibadun ʼamṯalukum fadɛuhum falyastajibu lakum ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
ʼalahum ʼarjulun yamcuna biha ʼam lahum ʼaydin yabṭicuna biha ʼam lahum ʼaɛyunun yubṣiruna biha ʼam lahum ʼaḏanun yasmaɛuna biha qul adɛu curakaʼakum ṯumma kiduni fala tunḏ̣irun.
ʼinna waliyiya Allahu al-laḏi nazzala al-kitaba wa huwa yatawalla aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Wa al-laḏina tadɛuna min dunihi la yastaṭiɛuna naṣrakum wa la ʼanfusahum yanṣurun.
Wa ʼin tadɛuhum ʼila al-huda la yasmaɛu wa tarahum yanḏ̣uruna ʼilayka wa hum la yubṣirun.
Xuḏ al-ɛafwa wa ʼmur bil-ɛurfi wa ʼaɛriḍ ɛan al-jahilin.
Wa ʼimma yanzaɣannaka mina ac-cayṭani nazɣun fastaɛiḏ Billahi ʼinnahu samiɛun ɛalimun.
ʼinna al-laḏina attaqaw ʼiḏa massahum ṭaʼifun mina ac-cayṭani taḏakkaru faʼiḏa hum mubṣirun.
Wa ʼixwanuhum yamuddunahum fi al-ɣayyi ṯumma la yuqṣirun.
Wa ʼiḏa lam taʼtihim biʼayatin qalu lawla ajtabaytaha qul ʼinnama ʼattabiɛu ma yuḥa ʼilayya min rabbi haḏa baṣaʼiru min rabbikum wa hudan wa raḥmatun liqawmin yuʼminun.
Wa ʼiḏa quriʼa al-qurʼanu fastamiɛu lahu wa ʼanṣitu laɛallakum turḥamun.
Wa aḏkur rabbaka fi nafsika taḍarruɛan wa xifatan wa duna al-jahri mina al-qawli bil-ɣuduwi wa al-ʼaṣali wa la takun mina al-ɣafilin.
ʼinna al-laḏina ɛinda rabbika la yastakbiruna ɛan ɛibadatihi wa yusabbiḥunahu wa lahu yasjudun.
Yasʼalunaka ɛan al-ʼanfal qul al-ʼanfal Lillahi wa ar-rasuli fa attaqu Allaha wa ʼaṣliḥu ḏata baynikum wa ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa rasulahu ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
ʼinnama al-muʼminuna al-laḏina ʼiḏa ḏukira Allahu wajilat qulubuhum wa ʼiḏa tuliyat ɛalayhim ʼayatuhu zadat/hum ʼimanan wa ɛala rabbihim yatawakkalun.
Al-laḏina yuqimuna aṣ-ṣalata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun.
ʼulaʼika hum al-muʼminuna ḥaqqan lahum darajatun ɛinda rabbihim wa maɣfiratun wa rizqun karimun.
Kama ʼaxrajaka rabbuka min baytika bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼinna fariqan mina al-muʼminina lakarihun.
Yujadilunaka fi al-ḥaqqi baɛdama tabayyana kaʼannama yusaquna ʼila al-mawti wa hum yanḏ̣urun.
Wa ʼiḏ yaɛidukum Allahu ʼiḥda aṭ-ṭaʼifatayni ʼannaha lakum wa tawadduna ʼanna ɣayra ḏati ac-cawkati takunu lakum wa yuridu Allahu ʼan yuḥiqqa al-ḥaqqa bikalimatihi wa yaqṭaɛa dabira al-kafirin.
Liyuḥiqqa al-ḥaqqa wa yubṭila al-baṭila wa law kariha al-mujrimun.
ʼiḏ tastaɣiṯuna rabbakum fastajaba lakum ʼanni mumiddukum biʼalfin mina al-malaʼikati murdifin.
Wa ma jaɛalahu Allahu ʼilla bucra wa litaṭmaʼinna bihi qulubukum wa ma an-naṣru ʼilla min ɛindi Allahi ʼinna Allaha ɛazizun ḥakimun.
ʼiḏ yuɣaccikumu an-nuɛasa ʼamanatan minhu wa yunazzilu ɛalaykum mina as-samaʼi maʼan liyuṭahhirakum bihi wa yuḏ/hiba ɛankum rijza ac-cayṭani wa liyarbiṭa ɛala qulubikum wa yuṯabbita bihi al-ʼaqdam.
ʼiḏ yuḥi rabbuka ʼila al-malaʼikati ʼanni maɛakum faṯabbitu al-laḏina ʼamanu saʼulqi fi qulubi al-laḏina kafaru ar-ruɛba faḍribu fawqa al-ʼaɛnaqi wa aḍribu minhum kulla bananin.
Ḏalika biʼannahum caqqu Allaha wa rasulahu wa man yucaqiqi Allaha wa rasulahu faʼinna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Ḏalikum faḏuquhu wa ʼanna lilkafirina ɛaḏaba an-nar.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa laqitum al-laḏina kafaru zaḥfan fala tuwalluhum al-ʼadbar.
Wa man yuwallihim yawmaʼiḏin duburahu ʼilla mutaḥarrifan liqitalin ʼaw mutaḥayyizan ʼila fiʼatin faqad baʼa biɣaḍabin mina Allahi wa maʼwahu jahannamu wa biʼsa al-maṣir.
Falam taqtuluhum wa lakinna Allaha qatalahum wa ma ramayta ʼiḏ ramayta wa lakinna Allaha rama wa liyubliya al-muʼminina minhu balaʼan ḥasanan ʼinna Allaha samiɛun ɛalimun.
Ḏalikum wa ʼanna Allaha muhinu kaydi al-kafirin.
ʼin tastaftiḥu faqad jaʼakum al-fatḥu wa ʼin tantahu fahuwa xayrun lakum wa ʼin taɛudu naɛud wa lan tuɣniya ɛankum fiʼatukum cayʼan wa law kaṯurat wa ʼanna Allaha maɛa al-muʼminin.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa rasulahu wa la tawallaw ɛanhu wa ʼantum tasmaɛun.
Wa la takunu kallaḏina qalu samiɛna wa hum la yasmaɛun.
ʼinna carra ad-dawabbi ɛinda Allahi aṣ-ṣummu al-bukmu al-laḏina la yaɛqilun.
Wa law ɛalima Allahu fihim xayran laʼasmaɛahum wa law ʼasmaɛahum latawallaw wa hum muɛriḍun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu astajibu Lillahi wa lilrrasuli ʼiḏa daɛakum lima yuḥyikum wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha yaḥulu bayna al-marʼi wa qalbihi wa ʼannahu ʼilayhi tuḥcarun.
Wa attaqu fitnatan la tuṣibanna al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu minkum xaṣṣatan wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Wa aḏkuru ʼiḏ ʼantum qalilun mustaḍɛafuna fi al-ʼarḍi taxafuna ʼan yataxaṭṭafakum an-nasu faʼawakum wa ʼayyadakum binaṣrihi wa razaqakum mina aṭ-ṭayyibati laɛallakum tackurun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la taxunu Allaha wa ar-rasula wa taxunu ʼamanatikum wa ʼantum taɛlamun.
Wa aɛlamu ʼannama ʼamwalukum wa ʼawladukum fitnatun wa ʼanna Allaha ɛindahu ʼajrun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼin tattaqu Allaha yajɛal lakum furqanan wa yukaffir ɛankum sayyiʼatikum wa yaɣfir lakum wa Allahu ḏu al-faḍli al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa ʼiḏ yamkuru bika al-laḏina kafaru liyuṯbituka ʼaw yaqtuluka ʼaw yuxrijuka wa yamkuruna wa yamkuru Allahu wa Allahu xayru al-makirin.
Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatuna qalu qad samiɛna law nacaʼu laqulna miṯla haḏa ʼin haḏa ʼilla ʼasaṭiru al-ʼawwalin.
Wa ʼiḏ qalu al-lahumma ʼin kana haḏa huwa al-ḥaqqa min ɛindika faʼamṭir ɛalayna ḥijaratan mina as-samaʼi ʼaw aʼtina biɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
Wa ma kana Allahu liyuɛaḏḏibahum wa ʼanta fihim wa ma kana Allahu muɛaḏḏibahum wa hum yastaɣfirun.
Wa ma lahum ʼalla yuɛaḏḏibahum Allahu wa hum yaṣudduna ɛan al-masjidi al-ḥarami wa ma kanu ʼawliyaʼahu ʼin ʼawliyaʼuuhu ʼilla al-muttaquna wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
Wa ma kana ṣalatuhum ɛinda al-bayti ʼilla mukaʼan wa taṣdiyatan faḏuqu al-ɛaḏaba bima kuntum takfurun.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru yunfiquna ʼamwalahum liyaṣuddu ɛan sabili Allahi fasayunfiqunaha ṯumma takunu ɛalayhim ḥasratan ṯumma yuɣlabuna wa al-laḏina kafaru ʼila jahannama yuḥcarun.
Liyamiza Allahu al-xabiṯa mina aṭ-ṭayyibi wa yajɛala al-xabiṯa baɛḍahu ɛala baɛḍin fayarkumahu jamiɛan fayajɛalahu fi jahannama ʼulaʼika hum al-xasirun.
Qul lillaḏina kafaru ʼin yantahu yuɣfar lahum ma qad salafa wa ʼin yaɛudu faqad maḍat sunnatu al-ʼawwalin.
Wa qatiluhum ḥatta la takuna fitnatun wa yakuna ad-dinu kulluhu Lillahi faʼin antahaw faʼinna Allaha bima yaɛmaluna baṣirun.
Wa ʼin tawallaw faɛlamu ʼanna Allaha mawlakum niɛma al-mawla wa niɛma an-naṣir.

Wa aɛlamu ʼannama ɣanimtum min cayʼin faʼanna Lillahi xumusahu wa lilrrasuli wa liḏi al-qurba wa al-yatama wa al-masakini wa abni as-sabili ʼin kuntum ʼamantum Billahi wa ma ʼanzalna ɛala ɛabdina yawma al-furqani yawma at-taqa al-jamɛani wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.

ʼiḏ ʼantum bil-ɛudwati ad-dunya wa hum bil-ɛudwati al-quṣwa wa ar-rakbu ʼasfala minkum wa law tawaɛadttum laxtalaftum fi al-miɛadi wa lakin liyaqḍiya Allahu ʼamran kana mafɛulan liyahlika man halaka ɛan bayyinatin wa yaḥya man ḥayya ɛan bayyinatin wa ʼinna Allaha lasamiɛun ɛalimun.
ʼiḏ yurikahumu Allahu fi manamika qalilan wa law ʼarakahum kaṯiran lafaciltum wa latanazaɛtum fi al-ʼamri wa lakinna Allaha sallama ʼinnahu ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
Wa ʼiḏ yurikumuhum ʼiḏ at-taqaytum fi ʼaɛyunikum qalilan wa yuqallilukum fi ʼaɛyunihim liyaqḍiya Allahu ʼamran kana mafɛulan wa ʼila Allahi turjaɛu al-ʼumur.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa laqitum fiʼatan faṯbutu wa aḏkuru Allaha kaṯiran laɛallakum tufliḥun.
Wa ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa rasulahu wa la tanazaɛu fatafcalu wa taḏ/haba riḥukum wa aṣbiru ʼinna Allaha maɛa aṣ-ṣabirin.
Wa la takunu kallaḏina xaraju min diyarihim baṭaran wa riʼaʼa an-nasi wa yaṣudduna ɛan sabili Allahi wa Allahu bima yaɛmaluna muḥiṭun.

Wa ʼiḏ zayyana lahum ac-cayṭanu ʼaɛmalahum wa qala la ɣaliba lakum al-yawma mina an-nasi wa ʼinni jarun lakum falamma taraʼati al-fiʼatani nakaṣa ɛala ɛaqibayhi wa qala ʼinni bariʼun minkum ʼinni ʼara ma la tarawna ʼinni ʼaxafu Allaha wa Allahu cadidu al-ɛiqab.
ʼiḏ yaqulu al-munafiquna wa al-laḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun ɣarra haʼuulaʼ dinuhum wa man yatawakkal ɛala Allahi faʼinna Allaha ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Wa law tara ʼiḏ yatawaffa al-laḏina kafaru al-malaʼikatu yaḍribuna wujuhahum wa ʼadbarahum wa ḏuqu ɛaḏaba al-ḥariq.
Ḏalika bima qaddamat ʼaydikum wa ʼanna Allaha laysa biḏ̣allamin lilɛabid.
Kadaʼbi ʼali firɛawna wa al-laḏina min qablihim kafaru biʼayati Allahi faʼaxaḏahumu Allahu biḏunubihim ʼinna Allaha qawiyun cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Ḏalika biʼanna Allaha lam yaku muɣayyiran niɛmatan ʼanɛamaha ɛala qawmin ḥatta yuɣayyiru ma biʼanfusihim wa ʼanna Allaha samiɛun ɛalimun.
Kadaʼbi ʼali firɛawna wa al-laḏina min qablihim kaḏḏabu biʼayati rabbihim faʼahlaknahum biḏunubihim wa ʼaɣraqna ʼala firɛawna wa kullun kanu ḏ̣alimin.
ʼinna carra ad-dawabbi ɛinda Allahi al-laḏina kafaru fahum la yuʼminun.
Al-laḏina ɛahadta minhum ṯumma yanquḍuna ɛahdahum fi kulli marratin wa hum la yattaqun.
Faʼimma taṯqafannahum fi al-ḥarbi facarrid bihim man xalfahum laɛallahum yaḏḏakkarun.
Wa ʼimma taxafanna min qawmin xiyanatan fanbiḏ ʼilayhim ɛala sawaʼin ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu al-xaʼinin.
Wa la yaḥsabanna al-laḏina kafaru sabaqu ʼinnahum la yuɛjizun.

Wa ʼaɛiddu lahum ma astaṭaɛtum min quwatin wa min ribaṭi al-xayli turhibuna bihi ɛaduwa Allahi wa ɛaduwakum wa ʼaxarina min dunihim la taɛlamunahumu Allahu yaɛlamuhum wa ma tunfiqu min cayʼin fi sabili Allahi yuwaffa ʼilaykum wa ʼantum la tuḏ̣lamun.
Wa ʼin janaḥu lilssalmi fajnaḥ laha wa tawakkal ɛala Allahi ʼinnahu huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Wa ʼin yuridu ʼan yaxdaɛuka faʼinna ḥasbaka Allahu huwa al-laḏi ʼayyadaka binaṣrihi wa bil-muʼminin.
Wa ʼallafa bayna qulubihim law ʼanfaqta ma fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan ma ʼallafta bayna qulubihim wa lakinna Allaha ʼallafa baynahum ʼinnahu ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu ḥasbuka Allahu wa man attabaɛaka mina al-muʼminin.

Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu ḥarriḍi al-muʼminina ɛala al-qitali ʼin yakun minkum ɛicruna ṣabiruna yaɣlibu miaʼatayni wa ʼin yakun minkum miaʼatun yaɣlibu ʼalfan mina al-laḏina kafaru biʼannahum qawmun la yafqahun.

Al-ʼana xaffafa Allahu ɛankum wa ɛalima ʼanna fikum ḍaɛfan faʼin yakun minkum miaʼatun ṣabiratun yaɣlibu miaʼatayni wa ʼin yakun minkum ʼalfun yaɣlibu ʼalfayni biʼiḏni Allahi wa Allahu maɛa aṣ-ṣabirin.
Ma kana linabiyin ʼan yakuna lahu ʼasra ḥatta yuṯxina fi al-ʼarḍi turiduna ɛaraḍa ad-dunya wa Allahu yuridu al-ʼaxirata wa Allahu ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Lawla kitabun mina Allahi sabaqa lamassakum fima ʼaxaḏtum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Fakulu mimma ɣanimtum ḥalalan ṭayyiban wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu qul liman fi ʼaydikum mina al-ʼasra ʼin yaɛlami Allahu fi qulubikum xayran yuʼtikum xayran mimma ʼuxiḏa minkum wa yaɣfir lakum wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa ʼin yuridu xiyanataka faqad xanu Allaha min qablu faʼamkana minhum wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.

ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa hajaru wa jahadu biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim fi sabili Allahi wa al-laḏina ʼawaw wa naṣaru ʼulaʼika baɛḍuhum ʼawliyaʼu baɛḍin wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa lam yuhajaru ma lakum min walayatihim min cayʼin ḥatta yuhajiru wa ʼin astanṣarukum fi ad-dini faɛalaykum an-naṣru ʼilla ɛala qawmin baynakum wa baynahum miṯaqun wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru baɛḍuhum ʼawliyaʼu baɛḍin ʼilla tafɛaluhu takun fitnatun fi al-ʼarḍi wa fasadun kabirun.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa hajaru wa jahadu fi sabili Allahi wa al-laḏina ʼawaw wa naṣaru ʼulaʼika hum al-muʼminuna ḥaqqan lahum maɣfiratun wa rizqun karimun.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu min baɛdu wa hajaru wa jahadu maɛakum faʼulaʼika minkum wa ʼulu al-ʼarḥami baɛḍuhum ʼawla bibaɛḍin fi kitabi Allahi ʼinna Allaha bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Baraʼatun mina Allahi wa rasulihi ʼila al-laḏina ɛahadttum mina al-mucrikin.
Fasiḥu fi al-ʼarḍi ʼarbaɛata ʼac/hurin wa aɛlamu ʼannakum ɣayru muɛjizi Allahi wa ʼanna Allaha muxzi al-kafirin.

Wa ʼaḏanun mina Allahi wa rasulihi ʼila an-nasi yawma al-ḥajji al-ʼakbari ʼanna Allaha bariʼun mina al-mucrikina wa rasuluhu faʼin tubtum fahuwa xayrun lakum wa ʼin tawallaytum faɛlamu ʼannakum ɣayru muɛjizi Allahi wa bacciri al-laḏina kafaru biɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
ʼilla al-laḏina ɛahadttum mina al-mucrikina ṯumma lam yanquṣukum cayʼan wa lam yuḏ̣ahiru ɛalaykum ʼaḥadan faʼatimmu ʼilayhim ɛahdahum ʼila muddatihim ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muttaqin.

Faʼiḏa ansalaxa al-ʼac/huru al-ḥurumu faqtulu al-mucrikina ḥayṯu wajadtumuhum wa xuḏuhum wa aḥṣuruhum waqɛudu lahum kulla marṣadin faʼin tabu wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼataw az-zakata faxallu sabilahum ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa ʼin ʼaḥadun mina al-mucrikina astajaraka faʼajirhu ḥatta yasmaɛa kalama Allahi ṯumma ʼabliɣ/hu maʼmanahu ḏalika biʼannahum qawmun la yaɛlamun.
Kayfa yakunu lilmucrikina ɛahdun ɛinda Allahi wa ɛinda rasulihi ʼilla al-laḏina ɛahadtum ɛinda al-masjidi al-ḥarami fama astaqamu lakum fastaqimu lahum ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muttaqin.
Kayfa wa ʼin yaḏ̣haru ɛalaykum la yarqubu fikum ʼillan wa la ḏimmatan yurḍunakum biʼafwahihim wa taʼba qulubuhum wa ʼakṯaruhum fasiqun.
Actaraw biʼayati Allahi ṯamanan qalilan faṣaddu ɛan sabilihi ʼinnahum saʼa ma kanu yaɛmalun.
La yarqubuna fi muʼminin ʼillan wa la ḏimmatan wa ʼulaʼika hum al-muɛtadun.
Faʼin tabu wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼataw az-zakata faʼixwanukum fi ad-dini wa nufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati liqawmin yaɛlamun.
Wa ʼin nakaṯu ʼaymanahum min baɛdi ɛahdihim wa ṭaɛanu fi dinikum faqatilu ʼaʼimmata al-kufri ʼinnahum la ʼaymana lahum laɛallahum yantahun.
ʼala tuqatiluna qawman nakaṯu ʼaymanahum wa hammu biʼixraji ar-rasuli wa hum badaʼukum ʼawwala marratin ʼataxcawnahum fa-Allahu ʼaḥaqqu ʼan taxcawhu ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Qatiluhum yuɛaḏḏibhumu Allahu biʼaydikum wa yuxzihim wa yanṣurkum ɛalayhim wa yacfi ṣudura qawmin muʼminin.
Wa yuḏ/hib ɣayḏ̣a qulubihim wa yatubu Allahu ɛala man yacaʼu wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
ʼam ḥasibtum ʼan tutraku wa lamma yaɛlami Allahu al-laḏina jahadu minkum wa lam yattaxiḏu min duni Allahi wa la rasulihi wa la al-muʼminina walijatan wa Allahu xabirun bima taɛmalun.
Ma kana lilmucrikina ʼan yaɛmuru masajida Allahi cahidina ɛala ʼanfusihim bil-kufri ʼulaʼika ḥabiṭat ʼaɛmaluhum wa fi an-nari hum xalidun.
ʼinnama yaɛmuru masajida Allahi man ʼamana Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa ʼaqama aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼata az-zakata wa lam yaxca ʼilla Allaha faɛasa ʼulaʼika ʼan yakunu mina al-muhtadin.
ʼajaɛaltum siqayata al-ḥajji wa ɛimarata al-masjidi al-ḥarami kaman ʼamana Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa jahada fi sabili Allahi la yastawuna ɛinda Allahi wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Al-laḏina ʼamanu wa hajaru wa jahadu fi sabili Allahi biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim ʼaɛḏ̣amu darajatan ɛinda Allahi wa ʼulaʼika hum al-faʼizun.
Yubacciruhum rabbuhum biraḥmatin minhu wa riḍwanin wa jannatin lahum fiha naɛimun muqimun.
Xalidina fiha ʼabadan ʼinna Allaha ɛindahu ʼajrun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tattaxiḏu ʼabaʼakum wa ʼixwanakum ʼawliyaʼa ʼin astaḥabbu al-kufra ɛala al-ʼimani wa man yatawallahum minkum faʼulaʼika hum aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.

Qul ʼin kana ʼabaʼuukum wa ʼabnaʼuukum wa ʼixwanukum wa ʼazwajukum wa ɛaciratukum wa ʼamwalun aqtaraftumuha wa tijaratun taxcawna kasadaha wa masakinu tarḍawnaha ʼaḥabba ʼilaykum mina Allahi wa rasulihi wa jihadin fi sabilihi fatarabbaṣu ḥatta yaʼtiya Allahu biʼamrihi wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma al-fasiqin.
Laqad naṣarakumu Allahu fi mawaṭina kaṯiratin wa yawma ḥunaynin ʼiḏ ʼaɛjabatkum kaṯratukum falam tuɣni ɛankum cayʼan wa ḍaqat ɛalaykum al-ʼarḍu bima raḥubat ṯumma wallaytum mudbirin.
Ṯumma ʼanzala Allahu sakinatahu ɛala rasulihi wa ɛala al-muʼminina wa ʼanzala junudan lam tarawha wa ɛaḏḏaba al-laḏina kafaru wa ḏalika jazaʼu al-kafirin.
Ṯumma yatubu Allahu min baɛdi ḏalika ɛala man yacaʼu wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼinnama al-mucrikuna najasun fala yaqrabu al-masjida al-ḥarama baɛda ɛamihim haḏa wa ʼin xiftum ɛaylatan fasawfa yuɣnikum Allahu min faḍlihi ʼin caʼa ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun ḥakimun.

Qatilu al-laḏina la yuʼminuna Billahi wa la bil-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa la yuḥarrimuna ma ḥarrama Allahu wa rasuluhu wa la yadinuna dina al-ḥaqqi mina al-laḏina ʼutu al-kitaba ḥatta yuɛṭu al-jizyata ɛan yadin wa hum ṣaɣirun.

Wa qalat al-yahudu ɛuzayrun abnu Allahi wa qalat an-naṣara al-masiḥu abnu Allahi ḏalika qawluhum biʼafwahihim yuḍahiʼuna qawla al-laḏina kafaru min qablu qatalahum Allahu ʼanna yuʼfakuna.mpʼ>(at-tbwah: .
Attaxaḏu ʼaḥbarahum wa ruhbanahum ʼarbaban min duni Allahi wa al-masiḥa abna maryama wa ma ʼumiru ʼilla liyaɛbudu ʼilahan waḥidan la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa subḥanahu ɛamma yucrikun.
Yuriduna ʼan yuṭfiʼu nura Allahi biʼafwahihim wa yaʼba Allahu ʼilla ʼan yutimma nurahu wa law kariha al-kafirun.
Huwa al-laḏi ʼarsala rasulahu bil-huda wa dini al-ḥaqqi liyuḏ̣hirahu ɛala ad-dini kullihi wa law kariha al-mucrikun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼinna kaṯiran mina al-ʼaḥbari wa ar-ruhbani layaʼkuluna ʼamwala an-nasi bil-baṭili wa yaṣudduna ɛan sabili Allahi wa al-laḏina yaknizuna aḏ-ḏahaba wa al-fiḍḍata wa la yunfiqunaha fi sabili Allahi fabaccirhum biɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
Yawma yuḥma ɛalayha fi nari jahannama fatukwa biha jibahuhum wa junubuhum wa ḏ̣uhuruhum haḏa ma kanaztum liʼnfusikum faḏuqu ma kuntum taknizun.

ʼinna ɛiddata ac-cuhuri ɛinda Allahi aṯna ɛacara cahran fi kitabi Allahi yawma xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa minha ʼarbaɛatun ḥurumun ḏalika ad-dinu al-qayyimu fala taḏ̣limu fihinna ʼanfusakum wa qatilu al-mucrikina kaffatan kama yuqatilunakum kaffatan wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha maɛa al-muttaqin.

ʼinnama an-nasiʼu ziyadatun fi al-kufri yuḍallu bihi al-laḏina kafaru yuḥillunahu ɛaman wa yuḥarrimunahu ɛaman liyuwaṭiʼu ɛiddata ma ḥarrama Allahu fayuḥillu ma ḥarrama Allahu zuyyina lahum suʼ ʼaɛmalihim wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma al-kafirin.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ma lakum ʼiḏa qila lakum anfiru fi sabili Allahi aṯṯaqaltum ʼila al-ʼarḍi ʼaraḍitum bil-ḥayati ad-dunya mina al-ʼaxirati fama mataɛu al-ḥayati ad-dunya fi al-ʼaxirati ʼilla qalilun.
ʼilla tanfiru yuɛaḏḏibkum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman wa yastabdil qawman ɣayrakum wa la taḍurruhu cayʼan wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.

ʼilla tanṣuruhu faqad naṣarahu Allahu ʼiḏ ʼaxrajahu al-laḏina kafaru ṯaniya aṯnayni ʼiḏ huma fi al-ɣari ʼiḏ yaqulu liṣaḥibihi la taḥzan ʼinna Allaha maɛana faʼanzala Allahu sakinatahu ɛalayhi wa ʼayyadahu bijunudin lam tarawha wa jaɛala kalimata al-laḏina kafaru as-sufla wa kalimatu Allahi hiya al-ɛulya wa Allahu ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Anfiru xifafan wa ṯiqalan wa jahidu biʼamwalikum wa ʼanfusikum fi sabili Allahi ḏalikum xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.

Law kana ɛaraḍan qariban wa safaran qaṣidan lattabaɛuka wa lakin baɛudat ɛalayhimu ac-cuqqatu wa sayaḥlifuna Billahi law astaṭaɛna laxarajna maɛakum yuhlikuna ʼanfusahum wa Allahu yaɛlamu ʼinnahum lakaḏibun.
Ɛafa Allahu ɛanka lima ʼaḏinta lahum ḥatta yatabayyana laka al-laḏina ṣadaqu wa taɛlama al-kaḏibin.
La yastaʼḏinuka al-laḏina yuʼminuna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri ʼan yujahidu biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim wa Allahu ɛalimun bil-muttaqin.
ʼinnama yastaʼḏinuka al-laḏina la yuʼminuna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa artabat qulubuhum fahum fi raybihim yataraddadun.
Wa law ʼaradu al-xuruja laʼaɛaddu lahu ɛuddatan wa lakin kariha Allahu anbiɛaṯahum faṯabbaṭahum wa qila aqɛudu maɛa al-qaɛidin.
Law xaraju fikum ma zadukum ʼilla xabalan wa laʼawḍaɛu xilalakum yabɣunakum al-fitnata wa fikum sammaɛuna lahum wa Allahu ɛalimun biḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Laqad abtaɣaw al-fitnata min qablu wa qallabu laka al-ʼumura ḥatta jaʼa al-ḥaqqu wa ḏ̣ahara ʼamru Allahi wa hum karihun.
Wa minhum man yaqulu aʼḏan li wa la taftinni ʼala fi al-fitnati saqaṭu wa ʼinna jahannama lamuḥiṭatun bil-kafirin.
ʼin tuṣibka ḥasanatun tasuʼhum wa ʼin tuṣibka muṣibatun yaqulu qad ʼaxaḏna ʼamrana min qablu wa yatawallaw wa hum fariḥun.
Qul lan yuṣibana ʼilla ma kataba Allahu lana huwa mawlana wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkali al-muʼminun.
Qul hal tarbbaṣuna bina ʼilla ʼiḥda al-ḥusnayayni wa naḥnu natarabbaṣu bikum ʼan yuṣibakumu Allahu biɛaḏabin min ɛindihi ʼaw biʼaydina fatarabbaṣu ʼinna maɛakum mutarabbiṣun.
Qul ʼanfiqu ṭawɛan ʼaw karhan lan yutaqabbala minkum ʼinnakum kuntum qawman fasiqin.
Wa ma manaɛahum ʼan tuqbala minhum nafaqatuhum ʼilla ʼannahum kafaru Billahi wa birasulihi wa la yaʼtuna aṣ-ṣalata ʼilla wa hum kusala wa la yunfiquna ʼilla wa hum karihun.
Fala tuɛjibka ʼamwaluhum wa la ʼawladuhum ʼinnama yuridu Allahu liyuɛaḏḏibahum biha fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa tazhaqa ʼanfusuhum wa hum kafirun.
Wa yaḥlifuna Billahi ʼinnahum laminkum wa ma hum minkum wa lakinnahum qawmun yafraqun.
Law yajiduna maljaʼan ʼaw maɣaratin ʼaw muddaxalan lawallaw ʼilayhi wa hum yajmaḥun.
Wa minhum man yalmizuka fi aṣ-ṣadaqati faʼin ʼuɛṭu minha raḍu wa ʼin lam yuɛṭaw minha ʼiḏa hum yasxaṭun.
Wa law ʼannahum raḍu ma ʼatahum Allahu wa rasuluhu wa qalu ḥasbuna Allahu sayuʼtina Allahu min faḍlihi wa rasuluhu ʼinna ʼila Allahi raɣibun.

ʼinnama aṣ-ṣadaqatu lilfuqaraʼi wa al-masakini wa al-ɛamilina ɛalayha wa al-muʼallafati qulubuhum wa fi ar-riqabi wa al-ɣarimina wa fi sabili Allahi wa aibni as-sabili fariḍatan mina Allahi wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.

Wa minhumu al-laḏina yuʼḏuna an-nabiya wa yaquluna huwa ʼuḏunun qul ʼuḏunu xayrin lakum yuʼminu Billahi wa yuʼminu lilmuʼminina wa raḥmatun lillaḏina ʼamanu minkum wa al-laḏina yuʼḏuna rasula Allahi lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Yaḥlifuna Billahi lakum liyurḍukum wa Allahu wa rasuluhu ʼaḥaqqu ʼan yurḍuhu ʼin kanu muʼminin.
ʼalam yaɛlamu ʼannahu man yuḥadid Allaha wa rasulahu faʼanna lahu nara jahannama xalidan fiha ḏalika al-xizyu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Yaḥḏaru al-munafiquna ʼan tunazzala ɛalayhim suratun tunabbiʼuhum bima fi qulubihim qul astahziʼu ʼinna Allaha muxrijun ma taḥḏarun.
Wa laʼin saʼaltahum layaqulunna ʼinnama kunna naxuḍu wa nalɛabu qul ʼabialllahi wa ʼayatihi wa rasulihi kuntum tastahziʼun.
La taɛtaḏiru qad kafartum baɛda ʼimanikum ʼin naɛfu ɛan ṭaʼifatin minkum nuɛaḏḏib ṭaʼifatan biʼannahum kanu mujrimin.
Al-munafiquna wa al-munafiqatu baɛḍuhum min baɛḍin yaʼmuruna bil-munkari wa yanhawna ɛan al-maɛrufi wa yaqbiḍuna ʼaydiyahum nasu Allaha fanasiyahum ʼinna al-munafiqina humu al-fasiqun.
Waɛada Allahu al-munafiqina wa al-munafiqati wa al-kuffara nara jahannama xalidina fiha hiya ḥasbuhum wa laɛanahumu Allahu wa lahum ɛaḏabun muqimun.

Kallaḏina min qablikum kanu ʼacadda minkum quwatan wa ʼakṯara ʼamwalan wa ʼawladan fastamtaɛu bixalaqihim fastamtaɛtum bixalaqikum kama astamtaɛa al-laḏina min qablikum bixalaqihim wa xuḍtum kallaḏi xaḍu ʼulaʼika ḥabiṭat ʼaɛmaluhum fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa ʼulaʼika hum al-xasirun.

ʼalam yaʼtihim nabaʼu al-laḏina min qablihim qawmi nuḥin wa ɛadin wa ṯamuda wa qawmi ʼibrahima wa ʼaṣḥabi madyana wa al-muʼtafikati ʼatat/hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati fama kana Allahu liyaḏ̣limahum wa lakin kanu ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.

Wa al-muʼminuna wa al-muʼminatu baɛḍuhum ʼawliyaʼu baɛḍin yaʼmuruna bil-maɛrufi wa yanhawna ɛan al-munkari wa yuqimuna aṣ-ṣalata wa yuʼtuna az-zakata wa yuṭiɛuna Allaha wa rasulahu ʼulaʼika sayarḥamuhumu Allahu ʼinna Allaha ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Waɛada Allahu al-muʼminina wa al-muʼminati jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha wa masakina ṭayyibatan fi jannati ɛadnin wa riḍwanun mina Allahi ʼakbaru ḏalika huwa al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu jahidi al-kuffara wa al-munafiqina wa aɣluḏ̣ ɛalayhim wa maʼwahum jahannamu wa biʼsa al-maṣir.

Yaḥlifuna Billahi ma qalu wa laqad qalu kalimata al-kufri wa kafaru baɛda ʼislamihim wa hammu bima lam yanalu wa ma naqamu ʼilla ʼan ʼaɣnahumu Allahu wa rasuluhu min faḍlihi faʼin yatubu yaku xayran lahum wa ʼin yatawallaw yuɛaḏḏibhumu Allahu ɛaḏaban ʼaliman fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa ma lahum fi al-ʼarḍi min wa liyin wa la naṣirin.
Wa minhum man ɛahada Allaha laʼin ʼatana min faḍlihi lanaṣṣaddaqanna wa lanakunanna mina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Falamma ʼatahum min faḍlihi baxilu bihi wa tawallaw wa hum muɛriḍun.
Faʼaɛqabahum nifaqan fi qulubihim ʼila yawmi yalqawnahu bima ʼaxlafu Allaha ma waɛaduhu wa bima kanu yakḏibun.
ʼalam yaɛlamu ʼanna Allaha yaɛlamu sirrahum wa najwahum wa ʼanna Allaha ɛallamu al-ɣuyub.
Al-laḏina yalmizuna al-muṭṭawwiɛina mina al-muʼminina fi aṣ-ṣadaqati wa al-laḏina la yajiduna ʼilla juhdahum fayasxaruna minhum saxira Allahu minhum wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Astaɣfir lahum ʼaw la tastaɣfir lahum ʼin tastaɣfir lahum sabɛina marratan falan yaɣfira Allahu lahum ḏalika biʼannahum kafaru Billahi wa rasulihi wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma al-fasiqin.

Fariḥa al-muxallafuna bimaqɛadihim xilafa rasuli Allahi wa karihu ʼan yujahidu biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim fi sabili Allahi wa qalu la tanfiru fi al-ḥarri qul naru jahannama ʼacaddu ḥarran law kanu yafqahun.
Falyaḍḥaku qalilan wa liabku kaṯiran jazaʼan bima kanu yaksibun.

Faʼin rajaɛaka Allahu ʼila ṭaʼifatin minhum fastaʼḏanuka lilxuruji faqul lan taxruju maɛiya ʼabadan wa lan tuqatilu maɛiya ɛaduwan ʼinnakum raḍitum bil-quɛudi ʼawwala marratin faqɛudu maɛa al-xalifin.
Wa la tuṣalli ɛala ʼaḥadin minhum mata ʼabadan wa la taqum ɛala qabrihi ʼinnahum kafaru Billahi wa rasulihi wa matu wa hum fasiqun.
Wa la tuɛjibka ʼamwaluhum wa ʼawladuhum ʼinnama yuridu Allahu ʼan yuɛaḏḏibahum biha fi ad-dunya wa tazhaqa ʼanfusuhum wa hum kafirun.
Wa ʼiḏa ʼunzilat suratun ʼan ʼaminu Billahi wa jahidu maɛa rasulihi astaʼḏanaka ʼulu aṭ-ṭawli minhum wa qalu ḏarna nakun maɛa al-qaɛidin.
Raḍu biʼan yakunu maɛa al-xawalifi wa ṭubiɛa ɛala qulubihim fahum la yafqahun.
Lakin ar-rasulu wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu jahadu biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim wa ʼulaʼika lahum al-xayratu wa ʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
ʼaɛadda Allahu lahum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ḏalika al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa jaʼa al-muɛaḏḏiruna mina al-ʼaɛrabi liyuʼḏana lahum wa qaɛada al-laḏina kaḏabu Allaha wa rasulahu sayuṣibu al-laḏina kafaru minhum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Laysa ɛala aḍ-ḍuɛafaʼi wa la ɛala al-marḍa wa la ɛala al-laḏina la yajiduna ma yunfiquna ḥarajun ʼiḏa naṣaḥu Lillahi wa rasulihi ma ɛala al-muḥsinina min sabilin wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa la ɛala al-laḏina ʼiḏa ma ʼatawka litaḥmilahum qulta la ʼajidu ma ʼaḥmilukum ɛalayhi tawallaw wa ʼaɛyunuhum tafiḍu mina ad-damɛi ḥazanan ʼalla yajidu ma yunfiqun.
ʼinnama as-sabilu ɛala al-laḏina yastaʼḏinunaka wa hum ʼaɣniyaʼu raḍu biʼan yakunu maɛa al-xawalifi wa ṭabaɛa Allahu ɛala qulubihim fahum la yaɛlamun.

Yaɛtaḏiruna ʼilaykum ʼiḏa rajaɛtum ʼilayhim qul la taɛtaḏiru lan nuʼmina lakum qad nabbaʼana Allahu min ʼaxbarikum wa sayara Allahu ɛamalakum wa rasuluhu ṯumma turadduna ʼila ɛalimi al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati fayunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Sayaḥlifuna Billahi lakum ʼiḏa anqalabtum ʼilayhim lituɛriḍu ɛanhum faʼaɛriḍu ɛanhum ʼinnahum rijsun wa maʼwahum jahannamu jazaʼan bima kanu yaksibun.
Yaḥlifuna lakum litarḍaw ɛanhum faʼin tarḍaw ɛanhum faʼinna Allaha la yarḍa ɛan al-qawmi al-fasiqin.
Al-ʼaɛrabu ʼacaddu kufran wa nifaqan wa ʼajdaru ʼalla yaɛlamu ḥududa ma ʼanzala Allahu ɛala rasulihi wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
Wa mina al-ʼaɛrabi man yattaxiḏu ma yunfiqu maɣraman wa yatarabbaṣu bikumu ad-dawaʼira ɛalayhim daʼiratu as-sawʼi wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.

Wa mina al-ʼaɛrabi man yuʼminu Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa yattaxiḏu ma yunfiqu qurubatin ɛinda Allahi wa ṣalawati ar-rasuli ʼala ʼinnaha qurbatun lahum sayudxiluhum Allahu fi raḥmatihi ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.

Wa as-sabiquna al-ʼawwaluna mina al-muhajirina wa al-ʼanṣari wa al-laḏina attabaɛuhum biʼiḥsanin raḍiya Allahu ɛanhum wa raḍu ɛanhu wa ʼaɛadda lahum jannatin tajri taḥtaha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ʼabadan ḏalika al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa mimman ḥawlakum mina al-ʼaɛrabi munafiquna wa min ʼahli al-madinati maradu ɛala an-nifaqi la taɛlamuhum naḥnu naɛlamuhum sanuɛaḏḏibuhum marratayni ṯumma yuradduna ʼila ɛaḏabin ɛaḏ̣imin.
Wa ʼaxaruna aɛtarafu biḏunubihim xalaṭu ɛamalan ṣaliḥan wa ʼaxara sayyiʼan ɛasa Allahu ʼan yatuba ɛalayhim ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Xuḏ min ʼamwalihim ṣadaqatan tuṭahhiruhum wa tuzakkihim biha wa ṣalli ɛalayhim ʼinna ṣalataka sakanun lahum wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.
ʼalam yaɛlamu ʼanna Allaha huwa yaqbalu at-tawbat ɛan ɛibadihi wa yaʼxuḏu aṣ-ṣadaqati wa ʼanna Allaha huwa at-tawwabu ar-raḥim.
Wa qul aɛmalu fasayara Allahu ɛamalakum wa rasuluhu wa al-muʼminuna wa saturadduna ʼila ɛalimi al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati fayunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Wa ʼaxaruna murjawna liʼmri Allahi ʼimma yuɛaḏḏibuhum wa ʼimma yatubu ɛalayhim wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.

Wa al-laḏina attaxaḏu masjidan ḍiraran wa kufran wa tafriqan bayna al-muʼminina wa ʼirṣadan liman ḥaraba Allaha wa rasulahu min qablu wa layaḥlifunna ʼin ʼaradna ʼilla al-ḥusna wa Allahu yac/hadu ʼinnahum lakaḏibun.
La taqum fihi ʼabadan lamasjidun ʼussisa ɛala at-taqwa min ʼawwali yawmin ʼaḥaqqu ʼan taquma fihi fihi rijalun yuḥibbuna ʼan yataṭahharu wa Allahu yuḥibbu al-muṭṭahhirin.
ʼafaman ʼassasa bunyanahu ɛala taqwa mina Allahi wa riḍwanin xayrun ʼam man ʼassasa bunyanahu ɛala cafa jurufin harin fanhara bihi fi nari jahannama wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
La yazalu bunyanuhumu al-laḏi banaw ribatan fi qulubihim ʼilla ʼan taqaṭṭaɛa qulubuhum wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.

ʼinna Allaha actara mina al-muʼminina ʼanfusahum wa ʼamwalahum biʼanna lahum al-jannata yuqatiluna fi sabili Allahi fayaqtuluna wa yuqtaluna waɛdan ɛalayhi ḥaqqan fi at-tawrati wa al-ʼinjili wa al-qurʼani wa man ʼawfa biɛahdihi mina Allahi fastabciru bibayɛikum al-laḏi bayaɛtum bihi wa ḏalika huwa al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
At-taʼibuna al-ɛabiduna al-ḥamiduna as-saʼiḥuna ar-rakiɛuna as-sajiduna al-ʼamiruna bil-maɛrufi wa an-nahuna ɛan al-munkari wa al-ḥafiḏ̣una liḥududi Allahi wa baccir al-muʼminin.
Ma kana lilnnabiyi wa al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼan yastaɣfiru lilmucrikina wa law kanu ʼuli qurba min baɛdi ma tabayyana lahum ʼannahum ʼaṣḥabu al-jaḥim.
Wa ma kana astiɣfaru ʼibrahima liʼabihi ʼilla ɛan mawɛidatin waɛadaha ʼiyahu falamma tabayyana lahu ʼannahu ɛaduwun Lillahi tabarraʼa minhu ʼinna ʼibrahima laʼawwahun ḥalimun.
Wa ma kana Allahu liyuḍilla qawman baɛda ʼiḏ hadahum ḥatta yubayyina lahum ma yattaquna ʼinna Allaha bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
ʼinna Allaha lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yuḥyi wa yumitu wa ma lakum min duni Allahi min wa liyin wa la naṣirin.

Laqad taba Allahu ɛala an-nabiyi wa al-muhajirina wa al-ʼanṣari al-laḏina attabaɛuhu fi saɛati al-ɛusrati min baɛdi ma kada yaziɣu qulubu fariqin minhum ṯumma taba ɛalayhim ʼinnahu bihim raʼufun raḥimun.

Wa ɛala aṯ-ṯalaṯati al-laḏina xullifu ḥatta ʼiḏa ḍaqat ɛalayhim al-ʼarḍu bima raḥubat wa ḍaqat ɛalayhim ʼanfusuhum wa ḏ̣annu ʼan la maljaʼa mina Allahi ʼilla ʼilayhi ṯumma taba ɛalayhim liyatubu ʼinna Allaha huwa at-tawwabu ar-raḥim.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu Allaha wa kunu maɛa aṣ-ṣadiqin.

Ma kana liʼhli al-madinati wa man ḥawlahum mina al-ʼaɛrabi ʼan yataxallafu ɛan rasuli Allahi wa la yarɣabu biʼanfusihim ɛan nafsihi ḏalika biʼannahum la yuṣibuhum ḏ̣amaʼun wa la naṣabun wa la maxmaṣatun fi sabili Allahi wa la yaṭaʼuna mawṭiʼan yaɣiḏ̣u al-kuffara wa la yanaluna min ɛaduwin naylan ʼilla kutiba lahum bihi ɛamalun ṣaliḥun ʼinna Allaha la yuḍiɛu ʼajra al-muḥsinin.
Wa la yunfiquna nafaqatan ṣaɣiratan wa la kabiratan wa la yaqṭaɛuna wa adian ʼilla kutiba lahum liyajziyahum Allahu ʼaḥsana ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa ma kana al-muʼminuna liyanfiru kaffatan falawla nafara min kulli firqatin minhum ṭaʼifatun liyatafaqqahu fi ad-dini wa liyunḏiru qawmahum ʼiḏa rajaɛu ʼilayhim laɛallahum yaḥḏarun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu qatilu al-laḏina yalunakum mina al-kuffari wa liajidu fikum ɣilḏ̣atan wa aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha maɛa al-muttaqin.
Wa ʼiḏa ma ʼunzilat suratun faminhum man yaqulu ʼayyukum zadat/hu haḏihi ʼimanan faʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu fazadat/hum ʼimanan wa hum yastabcirun.
Wa ʼamma al-laḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun fazadat/hum rijsan ʼila rijsihim wa matu wa hum kafirun.
ʼawala yarawna ʼannahum yuftanuna fi kulli ɛamin marratan ʼaw marratayni ṯumma la yatubuna wa la hum yaḏḏakkarun.
Wa ʼiḏa ma ʼunzilat suratun naḏ̣ara baɛḍuhum ʼila baɛḍin hal yarakum min ʼaḥadin ṯumma anṣarafu ṣarafa Allahu qulubahum biʼannahum qawmun la yafqahun.
Laqad jaʼakum rasulun min ʼanfusikum ɛazizun ɛalayhi ma ɛanittum ḥariṣun ɛalaykum bil-muʼminina raʼufun raḥimun.
Faʼin tawallaw faqul ḥasbi Allahu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa ɛalayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbu al-ɛarci al-ɛaḏ̣im.
ʼalif-lam-ra tilka ʼayatu al-kitabi al-ḥakim.
ʼakana lilnnasi ɛajaban ʼan ʼawḥayna ʼila rajulin minhum ʼan ʼanḏiri an-nasa wa baccir al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼanna lahum qadama ṣidqin ɛinda rabbihim qala al-kafiruna ʼinna haḏa lasaḥirun mubinun.

ʼinna rabbakumu Allahu al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa fi sittati ʼayyamin ṯumma astawa ɛala al-ɛarci yudabbiru al-ʼamra ma min cafiɛin ʼilla min baɛdi ʼiḏnihi ḏalikumu Allahu rabbukum faɛbuduhu ʼafala taḏakkarun.

ʼilayhi marjiɛukum jamiɛan waɛda Allahi ḥaqqan ʼinnahu yabdaʼu al-xalqa ṯumma yuɛiduhu liyajziya al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati bil-qisṭi wa al-laḏina kafaru lahum carabun min ḥamimin wa ɛaḏabun ʼalimun bima kanu yakfurun.
Huwa al-laḏi jaɛala ac-camsa ḍiyaʼan wa al-qamara nuran wa qaddarahu manazila litaɛlamu ɛadada as-sinina wa al-ḥisaba ma xalaqa Allahu ḏalika ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi yufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati liqawmin yaɛlamun.
ʼinna fi axtilafi al-layli wa an-nahari wa ma xalaqa Allahu fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi lʼayatin liqawmin yattaqun.
ʼinna al-laḏina la yarjuna liqaʼana wa raḍu bil-ḥayati ad-dunya wa aṭmaʼannu biha wa al-laḏina hum ɛan ʼayatina ɣafilun.
ʼulaʼika maʼwahumu an-naru bima kanu yaksibun.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati yahdihim rabbuhum biʼimanihim tajri min taḥtihimu al-ʼanharu fi jannati an-naɛim.
Daɛwahum fiha subḥanaka al-lahumma wa taḥiyatuhum fiha salamun wa ʼaxiru daɛwahum ʼan al-ḥamdu Lillahi rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Wa law yuɛajjilu Allahu lilnnasi ac-carra astiɛjalahum bil-xayri laquḍiya ʼilayhim ʼajaluhum fanaḏaru al-laḏina la yarjuna liqaʼana fi ṭuɣyanihim yaɛmahun.
Wa ʼiḏa massa al-ʼinsana aḍ-ḍurru daɛana lijanbihi ʼaw qaɛidan ʼaw qaʼiman falamma kacafna ɛanhu ḍurrahu marra kaʼan lam yadɛuna ʼila ḍurrin massahu kaḏalika zuyyina lilmusrifina ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa laqad ʼahlakna al-quruna min qablikum lamma ḏ̣alamu wa jaʼat/hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati wa ma kanu liyuʼminu kaḏalika najzi al-qawma al-mujrimin.
Ṯumma jaɛalnakum xalaʼifa fi al-ʼarḍi min baɛdihim linanḏ̣ura kayfa taɛmalun.

Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatuna bayyinatin qala al-laḏina la yarjuna liqaʼana aʼti biqurʼanin ɣayri haḏa ʼaw baddilhu qul ma yakunu li ʼan ʼubaddilahu min tilqaʼi nafsi ʼin ʼattabiɛu ʼilla ma yuḥa ʼilayya ʼinni ʼaxafu ʼin ɛaṣaytu rabbi ɛaḏaba yawmin ɛaḏ̣imin.
Qul law caʼa Allahu ma talawtuhu ɛalaykum wa la ʼadrakum bihi faqad labiṯtu fikum ɛumuran min qablihi ʼafala taɛqilun.
Faman ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼaw kaḏḏaba biʼayatihi ʼinnahu la yufliḥu al-mujrimun.

Wa yaɛbuduna min duni Allahi ma la yaḍurruhum wa la yanfaɛuhum wa yaquluna haʼuulaʼ cufaɛaʼuuna ɛinda Allahi qul ʼatunabbiʼuna Allaha bima la yaɛlamu fi as-samawati wa la fi al-ʼarḍi subḥanahu wa taɛala ɛamma yucrikun.
Wa ma kana an-nasu ʼilla ʼummatan waḥidatan faxtalafu wa lawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum fima fihi yaxtalifun.
Wa yaquluna lawla ʼunzila ɛalayhi ʼayatun min rabbihi faqul ʼinnama al-ɣaybu Lillahi fantaḏ̣iru ʼinni maɛakum mina al-muntaḏ̣irin.
Wa ʼiḏa ʼaḏaqna an-nasa raḥmatan min baɛdi ḍarraʼa massat/hum ʼiḏa lahum makrun fi ʼayatina qul Allahu ʼasraɛu makran ʼinna rusulana yaktubuna ma tamkurun.

Huwa al-laḏi yusayyirukum fi al-barri wa al-baḥri ḥatta ʼiḏa kuntum fi al-fulki wa jarayna bihim biriḥin ṭayyibatin wa fariḥu biha jaʼat/ha riḥun ɛaṣifun wa jaʼahumu al-mawju min kulli makanin wa ḏ̣annu ʼannahum ʼuḥiṭa bihim daɛaw Allaha muxliṣina lahu ad-dina laʼin ʼanjaytana min haḏihi lanakunanna mina ac-cakirin.

Falamma ʼanjahum ʼiḏa hum yabɣuna fi al-ʼarḍi biɣayri al-ḥaqqi ya ʼayyuha an-nasu ʼinnama baɣyukum ɛala ʼanfusikum mataɛa al-ḥayati ad-dunya ṯumma ʼilayna marjiɛukum fanunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.

ʼinnama maṯalu al-ḥayati ad-dunya kamaʼin ʼanzalnahu mina as-samaʼi faxtalaṭa bihi nabatu al-ʼarḍi mimma yaʼkulu an-nasu wa al-ʼanɛam ḥatta ʼiḏa ʼaxaḏati al-ʼarḍu zuxrufaha wa azzayyanat wa ḏ̣anna ʼahluha ʼannahum qadiruna ɛalayha ʼataha ʼamruna laylan ʼaw naharan fajaɛalnaha ḥaṣidan kaʼan lam taɣna bil-ʼamsi kaḏalika nufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati liqawmin yatafakkarun.
Wa Allahu yadɛu ʼila dari as-salami wa yahdi man yacaʼu ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Lillaḏina ʼaḥsanu al-ḥusna wa ziyadatun wa la yarhaqu wujuhahum qatarun wa la ḏillatun ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati hum fiha xalidun.

Wa al-laḏina kasabu as-sayyiʼati jazaʼu sayyiʼatin bimiṯliha wa tarhaquhum ḏillatun ma lahum mina Allahi min ɛaṣimin kaʼannama ʼuɣciyat wujuhuhum qiṭaɛan mina al-layli muḏ̣liman ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
Wa yawma naḥcuruhum jamiɛan ṯumma naqulu lillaḏina ʼacraku makanakum ʼantum wa curakaʼuukum fazayyalna baynahum wa qala curakaʼuuhum ma kuntum ʼiyana taɛbudun.
Fakafa Billahi cahidan baynana wa baynakum ʼin kunna ɛan ɛibadatikum laɣafilin.
Hunalika tablu kullu nafsin ma ʼaslafat wa ruddu ʼila Allahi mawlahum al-ḥaqqi wa ḍalla ɛanhum ma kanu yaftarun.

Qul man yarzuqukum mina as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi ʼamman yamliku as-samɛa wa al-ʼabṣara wa man yuxriju al-ḥayya mina al-mayyiti wa yuxriju al-mayyita mina al-ḥayyi wa man yudabbiru al-ʼamra fasayaquluna Allahu faqul ʼafala tattaqun.
Faḏalikum Allahu rabbukum al-ḥaqqu famaḏa baɛda al-ḥaqqi ʼilla aḍ-ḍalalu faʼanna tuṣrafun.
Kaḏalika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ɛala al-laḏina fasaqu ʼannahum la yuʼminun.
Qul hal min curakaʼikum man yabdaʼu al-xalqa ṯumma yuɛiduhu qul Allahu yabdaʼu al-xalqa ṯumma yuɛiduhu faʼanna tuʼfakun.
Qul hal min curakaʼikum man yahdi ʼila al-ḥaqqi qul Allahu yahdi lilḥaqqi ʼafaman yahdi ʼila al-ḥaqqi ʼaḥaqqu ʼan yuttabaɛa ʼamman la yahiddi ʼilla ʼan yuhda fama lakum kayfa taḥkumun.
Wa ma yattabiɛu ʼakṯaruhum ʼilla ḏ̣annan ʼinna aḏ̣-ḏ̣anna la yuɣni mina al-ḥaqqi cayʼan ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun bima yafɛalun.
Wa ma kana haḏa al-qurʼanu ʼan yuftara min duni Allahi wa lakin taṣdiqa al-laḏi bayna yadayhi wa tafṣila al-kitabi la rayba fihi min rabbi al-ɛalamin.
ʼam yaquluna aftarahu qul faʼtu bisuratin miṯlihi wa adɛu man astaṭaɛtum min duni Allahi ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Bal kaḏḏabu bima lam yuḥiṭu biɛilmihi wa lamma yaʼtihim taʼwiluhu kaḏalika kaḏḏaba al-laḏina min qablihim fanḏ̣ur kayfa kana ɛaqibatu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa minhum man yuʼminu bihi wa minhum man la yuʼminu bihi wa rabbuka ʼaɛlamu bil-mufsidin.
Wa ʼin kaḏḏabuka faqul li ɛamali wa lakum ɛamalukum ʼantum bariʼuna mimma ʼaɛmalu wa ʼana bariʼun mimma taɛmalun.
Wa minhum man yastamiɛuna ʼilayka ʼafaʼanta tusmiɛu aṣ-ṣumma wa law kanu la yaɛqilun.
Wa minhum man yanḏ̣uru ʼilayka ʼafaʼanta tahdi al-ɛumya wa law kanu la yubṣirun.
ʼinna Allaha la yaḏ̣limu an-nasa cayʼan wa lakinna an-nasa ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.
Wa yawma yaḥcuruhum kaʼan lam yalbaṯu ʼilla saɛatan mina an-nahari yataɛarafuna baynahum qad xasira al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biliqaʼi Allahi wa ma kanu muhtadin.
Wa ʼimma nuriyannaka baɛḍa al-laḏi naɛiduhum ʼaw natawaffayannaka faʼilayna marjiɛuhum ṯumma Allahu cahidun ɛala ma yafɛalun.
Wa likulli ʼummatin rasulun faʼiḏa jaʼa rasuluhum quḍiya baynahum bil-qisṭi wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
Wa yaquluna mata haḏa al-waɛdu ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Qul la ʼamliku linafsi ḍarran wa la nafɛan ʼilla ma caʼa Allahu likulli ʼummatin ʼajalun ʼiḏa jaʼa ʼajaluhum fala yastaʼxiruna saɛatan wa la yastaqdimun.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ʼin ʼatakum ɛaḏabuhu bayatan ʼaw naharan maḏa yastaɛjilu minhu al-mujrimun.
ʼaṯumma ʼiḏa ma waqaɛa ʼamantum bihi ʼalʼana wa qad kuntum bihi tastaɛjilun.
Ṯumma qila lillaḏina ḏ̣alamu ḏuqu ɛaḏaba al-xuldi hal tujzawna ʼilla bima kuntum taksibun.
Wa yastanbiʼunaka ʼaḥaqqun huwa qul ʼi wa rabbi ʼinnahu laḥaqqun wa ma ʼantum bimuɛjizin.
Wa law ʼanna likulli nafsin ḏ̣alamat ma fi al-ʼarḍi laftadat bihi wa ʼasarru an-nadamata lamma raʼaw al-ɛaḏaba wa quḍiya baynahum bil-qisṭi wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
ʼala ʼinna Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼala ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
Huwa yuḥyi wa yumitu wa ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu qad jaʼatkum mawɛiḏ̣atun min rabbikum wa cifaʼun lima fi aṣ-ṣuduri wa hudan wa raḥmatun lilmuʼminin.
Qul bifaḍli Allahi wa biraḥmatihi fabiḏalika falyafraḥu huwa xayrun mimma yajmaɛun.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ma ʼanzala Allahu lakum min rizqin fajaɛaltum minhu ḥaraman wa ḥalalan qul ʼalllahu ʼaḏina lakum ʼam ɛala Allahi taftarun.
Wa ma ḏ̣annu al-laḏina yaftaruna ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba yawma al-qiyamati ʼinna Allaha laḏu faḍlin ɛala an-nasi wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yackurun.

Wa ma takunu fi caʼnin wa ma tatlu minhu min qurʼanin wa la taɛmaluna min ɛamalin ʼilla kunna ɛalaykum cuhudan ʼiḏ tufiḍuna fihi wa ma yaɛzubu ɛan rabbika min miṯqali ḏarratin fi al-ʼarḍi wa la fi as-samaʼi wa la ʼaṣɣara min ḏalika wa la ʼakbara ʼilla fi kitabin mubinin.
ʼala ʼinna ʼawliyaʼa Allahi la xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Al-laḏina ʼamanu wa kanu yattaqun.
Lahumu al-bucra fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa fi al-ʼaxirati la tabdila likalimati Allahi ḏalika huwa al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa la yaḥzunka qawluhum ʼinna al-ɛizzata Lillahi jamiɛan huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
ʼala ʼinna Lillahi man fi as-samawati wa man fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma yattabiɛu al-laḏina yadɛuna min duni Allahi curakaʼa ʼin yattabiɛuna ʼilla aḏ̣-ḏ̣anna wa ʼin hum ʼilla yaxruṣun.
Huwa al-laḏi jaɛala lakum al-layla litaskunu fihi wa an-nahara mubṣiran ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yasmaɛun.
Qalu attaxaḏa Allahu waladan subḥanahu huwa al-ɣaniyu lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi ʼin ɛindakum min sulṭanin bihaḏa ʼataquluna ɛala Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
Qul ʼinna al-laḏina yaftaruna ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba la yufliḥun.
Mataɛun fi ad-dunya ṯumma ʼilayna marjiɛuhum ṯumma nuḏiquhum al-ɛaḏaba ac-cadida bima kanu yakfurun.

Wa atlu ɛalayhim nabaʼa nuḥin ʼiḏ qala liqawmihi ya qawmi ʼin kana kabura ɛalaykum maqami wa taḏkiri biʼaya ti Allahi faɛala Allahi tawakkaltu faʼajmiɛu ʼamrakum wa curakaʼakum ṯumma la yakun ʼamrukum ɛalaykum ɣummatan ṯumma aqḍu ʼilayya wa la tunḏ̣irun.
Faʼin tawallaytum fama saʼaltukum min ʼajrin ʼin ʼajri ʼilla ɛala Allahi wa ʼumirtu ʼan ʼakuna mina al-muslimin.
Fakaḏḏabuhu fanajjaynahu wa man maɛahu fi al-fulki wa jaɛalnahum xalaʼifa wa ʼaɣraqna al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina fanḏ̣ur kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-munḏarin.
Ṯumma baɛaṯna min baɛdihi rusulan ʼila qawmihim fajaʼuhum bil-bayyinati fama kanu liyuʼminu bima kaḏḏabu bihi min qablu kaḏalika naṭbaɛu ɛala qulubi al-muɛtadin.
Ṯumma baɛaṯna min baɛdihim musa wa haruna ʼila firɛawna wa malaʼihi biʼayatina fastakbaru wa kanu qawman mujrimin.
Falamma jaʼahum al-ḥaqqu min ɛindina qalu ʼinna haḏa lasiḥrun mubinun.
Qala musa ʼataquluna lilḥaqqi lamma jaʼakum ʼasiḥrun haḏa wa la yufliḥu as-saḥirun.
Qalu ʼajiʼtana litalfitana ɛamma wajadna ɛalayhi ʼabaʼana wa takuna lakuma al-kibriyaʼu fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma naḥnu lakuma bimuʼminin.
Wa qala firɛawnu aʼtuni bikulli saḥirin ɛalimin.
Falamma jaʼa as-saḥaratu qala lahum musa ʼalqu ma ʼantum mulqun.
Falamma ʼalqaw qala musa ma jiʼtum bihi as-siḥru ʼinna Allaha sayubṭiluhu ʼinna Allaha la yuṣliḥu ɛamala al-mufsidin.
Wa yuḥiqqu Allahu al-ḥaqqa bikalimatihi wa law kariha al-mujrimun.
Fama ʼamana limusa ʼilla ḏurriyatun min qawmihi ɛala xawfin min firɛawna wa malaʼihim ʼan yaftinahum wa ʼinna firɛawna laɛalin fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼinnahu lamina al-musrifin.
Wa qala musa ya qawmi ʼin kuntum ʼamantum Billahi faɛalayhi tawakkalu ʼin kuntum muslimin.
Faqalu ɛala Allahi tawakkalna rabbana la tajɛalna fitnatan lilqawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa najjina biraḥmatika mina al-qawmi al-kafirin.
Wa ʼawḥayna ʼila musa wa ʼaxihi ʼan tabawwaʼa liqawmikuma bimiṣra buyutan wa ajɛalu buyutakum qiblatan wa ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa baccir al-muʼminin.

Wa qala musa rabbana ʼinnaka ʼatayta firɛawna wa malaʼahu zinatan wa ʼamwalan fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya rabbana liyuḍillu ɛan sabilika rabbana aṭmis ɛala ʼamwalihim wa acdud ɛala qulubihim fala yuʼminu ḥatta yaraw al-ɛaḏaba al-ʼalim.
Qala qad ʼujibat daɛwatukuma fastaqima wa la tattabiɛani sabila al-laḏina la yaɛlamun.

Wa jawazna bibani ʼisraʼila al-baḥra faʼatbaɛahum firɛawnu wa junuduhu baɣyan waɛadwan ḥatta ʼiḏa ʼadrakahu al-ɣaraqu qala ʼamantu ʼannahu la ʼilaha ʼilla al-laḏi ʼamanat bihi banu ʼisraʼila wa ʼana mina al-muslimin.
ʼalʼana wa qad ɛaṣayta qablu wa kunta mina al-mufsidin.
Falyawma nunajjika bibadanika litakuna liman xalfaka ʼayatan wa ʼinna kaṯiran mina an-nasi ɛan ʼayatina laɣafilun.
Wa laqad bawwaʼna bani ʼisraʼila mubawwaʼa ṣidqin wa razaqnahum mina aṭ-ṭayyibati fama axtalafu ḥatta jaʼahumu al-ɛilmu ʼinna rabbaka yaqḍi baynahum yawma al-qiyamati fima kanu fihi yaxtalifun.
Faʼin kunta fi cakkin mimma ʼanzalna ʼilayka fasʼali al-laḏina yaqraʼuna al-kitaba min qablika laqad jaʼaka al-ḥaqqu min rabbika fala takunanna mina al-mumtarin.
Wa la takunanna mina al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayati Allahi fatakuna mina al-xasirin.
ʼinna al-laḏina ḥaqqat ɛalayhim kalimatu rabbika la yuʼminun.
Wa law jaʼat/hum kullu ʼayatin ḥatta yaraw al-ɛaḏaba al-ʼalim.
Falawla kanat qaryatun ʼamanat fanafaɛaha ʼimanuha ʼilla qawma yunis lamma ʼamanu kacafna ɛanhum ɛaḏaba al-xizyi fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa mattaɛnahum ʼila ḥinin.
Wa law caʼa rabbuka laʼamana man fi al-ʼarḍi kulluhum jamiɛan ʼafaʼanta tukrihu an-nasa ḥatta yakunu muʼminin.
Wa ma kana linafsin ʼan tuʼmina ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi wa yajɛalu ar-rijsa ɛala al-laḏina la yaɛqilun.
Qul anḏ̣uru maḏa fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma tuɣni al-ʼayatu wa an-nuḏuru ɛan qawmin la yuʼminun.
Fahal yantaḏ̣iruna ʼilla miṯla ʼayyami al-laḏina xalaw min qablihim qul fantaḏ̣iru ʼinni maɛakum mina al-muntaḏ̣irin.
Ṯumma nunajji rusulana wa al-laḏina ʼamanu kaḏalika ḥaqqan ɛalayna nunji al-muʼminin.
Qul ya ʼayyuha an-nasu ʼin kuntum fi cakkin min dini fala ʼaɛbudu al-laḏina taɛbuduna min duni Allahi wa lakin ʼaɛbudu Allaha al-laḏi yatawaffakum wa ʼumirtu ʼan ʼakuna mina al-muʼminin.
Wa ʼan ʼaqim wajhaka lilddini ḥanifan wa la takunanna mina al-mucrikin.
Wa la tadɛu min duni Allahi ma la yanfaɛuka wa la yaḍurruka faʼin faɛalta faʼinnaka ʼiḏan mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa ʼin yamsaska Allahu biḍurrin fala kacifa lahu ʼilla huwa wa ʼin yuridka bixayrin fala radda lifaḍlihi yuṣibu bihi man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi wa huwa al-ɣafuru ar-raḥim.
Qul ya ʼayyuha an-nasu qad jaʼakumu al-ḥaqqu min rabbikum faman ahtada faʼinnama yahtadi linafsihi wa man ḍalla faʼinnama yaḍillu ɛalayha wa ma ʼana ɛalaykum biwakilin.
Wa attabiɛ ma yuḥa ʼilayka wa aṣbir ḥatta yaḥkuma Allahu wa huwa xayru al-ḥakimin.
ʼalif-lam-ra kitabun ʼuḥkimat ʼayatuhu ṯumma fuṣṣilat min ladun ḥakimin xabirin.
ʼalla taɛbudu ʼilla Allaha ʼinnani lakum minhu naḏirun wa bacirun.
Wa ʼan astaɣfiru rabbakum ṯumma tubu ʼilayhi yumattiɛkum mataɛan ḥasanan ʼila ʼajalin musamman wa yuʼti kulla ḏi faḍlin faḍlahu wa ʼin tawallaw faʼinni ʼaxafu ɛalaykum ɛaḏaba yawmin kabirin.
ʼila Allahi marjiɛukum wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
ʼala ʼinnahum yaṯnuna ṣudurahum liyastaxfu minhu ʼala ḥina yastaɣcuna ṯiyabahum yaɛlamu ma yusirruna wa ma yuɛlinuna ʼinnahu ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
Wa ma min dabbatin fi al-ʼarḍi ʼilla ɛala Allahi rizquha wa yaɛlamu mustaqarraha wa mustawdaɛaha kullun fi kitabin mubinin.

Wa huwa al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa fi sittati ʼayyamin wa kana ɛarcuhu ɛala al-maʼi liyabluwakum ʼayyukum ʼaḥsanu ɛamalan wa laʼin qulta ʼinnakum mabɛuṯuna min baɛdi al-mawti layaqulanna al-laḏina kafaru ʼin haḏa ʼilla siḥrun mubinun.
Wa laʼin ʼaxxarna ɛanhumu al-ɛaḏaba ʼila ʼummatin maɛdudatin layaqulunna ma yaḥbisuhu ʼala yawma yaʼtihim laysa maṣrufan ɛanhum wa ḥaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Wa laʼin ʼaḏaqna al-ʼinsana minna raḥmatan ṯumma nazaɛnaha minhu ʼinnahu layaʼusun kafurun.
Wa laʼin ʼaḏaqnahu naɛmaʼa baɛda ḍarraʼa massat/hu layaqulanna ḏahaba as-sayyiʼatu ɛanni ʼinnahu lafariḥun faxurun.
ʼilla al-laḏina ṣabaru wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati ʼulaʼika lahum maɣfiratun wa ʼajrun kabirun.
Falaɛallaka tarikun baɛḍa ma yuḥa ʼilayka wa ḍaʼiqun bihi ṣadruka ʼan yaqulu lawla ʼunzila ɛalayhi kanzun ʼaw jaʼa maɛahu malakun ʼinnama ʼanta naḏirun wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin wa kilun.
ʼam yaquluna aftarahu qul faʼtu biɛacri suwarin miṯlihi muftarayatin wa adɛu man astaṭaɛtum min duni Allahi ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Faʼillam yastajibu lakum faɛlamu ʼannama ʼunzila biɛilmi Allahi wa ʼan la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa fahal ʼantum muslimun.
Man kana yuridu al-ḥayata ad-dunya wa zinataha nuwaffi ʼilayhim ʼaɛmalahum fiha wa hum fiha la yubxasun.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina laysa lahum fi al-ʼaxirati ʼilla an-naru wa ḥabiṭa ma ṣanaɛu fiha wa baṭilun ma kanu yaɛmalun.

ʼafaman kana ɛala bayyinatin min rabbihi wa yatluhu cahidun minhu wa min qablihi kitabu musa ʼimaman wa raḥmatan ʼulaʼika yuʼminuna bihi wa man yakfur bihi mina al-ʼaḥzabi falnnaru mawɛiduhu fala takun fi miryatin minhu ʼinnahu al-ḥaqqu min rabbika wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yuʼminun.
Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼulaʼika yuɛraḍuna ɛala rabbihim wa yaqulu al-ʼac/hadu haʼuulaʼ al-laḏina kaḏabu ɛala rabbihim ʼala laɛnatu Allahi ɛala aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Al-laḏina yaṣudduna ɛan sabili Allahi wa yabɣunaha ɛiwajan wa hum bil-ʼaxirati hum kafirun.
ʼulaʼika lam yakunu muɛjizina fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma kana lahum min duni Allahi min ʼawliyaʼa yuḍaɛafu lahum al-ɛaḏabu ma kanu yastaṭiɛuna as-samɛa wa ma kanu yubṣirun.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina xasiru ʼanfusahum wa ḍalla ɛanhum ma kanu yaftarun.
La jarama ʼannahum fi al-ʼaxirati hum al-ʼaxsarun.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati yahdihim rabbuhum biʼimanihim tajri min taḥtihimu al-ʼanharu fi jannati an-naɛim.
Maṯalu al-fariqayni kalʼaɛma wa al-ʼaṣammi wa al-baṣiri wa as-samiɛi hal yastawiyani maṯalan ʼafala taḏakkarun.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna nuḥan ʼila qawmihi ʼinni lakum naḏirun mubinun.
ʼan la taɛbudu ʼilla Allaha ʼinni ʼaxafu ɛalaykum ɛaḏaba yawmin ʼalimin.

Faqala al-malaʼu al-laḏina kafaru min qawmihi ma naraka ʼilla bacaran miṯlana wa ma naraka attabaɛaka ʼilla al-laḏina hum ʼaraḏiluna badiya ar-raʼyi wa ma nara lakum ɛalayna min faḍlin bal naḏ̣unnukum kaḏibin.
Qala ya qawmi ʼaraʼaytum ʼin kuntu ɛala bayyinatin min rabbi wa ʼatani raḥmatan min ɛindihi faɛummiyat ɛalaykum ʼanulzimukumuha wa ʼantum laha karihun.
Wa yaqawmi la ʼasʼalukum ɛalayhi malan ʼin ʼajriya ʼilla ɛala Allahi wa ma ʼana biṭaridi al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼinnahum mulaqu rabbihim wa lakinni ʼarakum qawman tajhalun.
Wa yaqawmi man yanṣuruni mina Allahi ʼin ṭaradtuhum ʼafala taḏakkarun.

Wa la ʼaqulu lakum ɛindi xazaʼinu Allahi wa la ʼaɛlamu al-ɣayba wa la ʼaqulu ʼinni malakun wa la ʼaqulu lillaḏina tazdari ʼaɛyunukum lan yuʼtiyahum Allahu xayran Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima fi ʼanfusihim ʼinni ʼiḏan lamina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Qalu ya nuḥu qad jadaltana faʼakṯarta jidalana faʼtina bima taɛiduna ʼin kunta mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Qala ʼinnama yaʼtikum bihi Allahu ʼin caʼa wa ma ʼantum bimuɛjizin.
Wa la yanfaɛukum nuṣḥi ʼin ʼaradtu ʼan ʼanṣaḥa lakum ʼin kana Allahu yuridu ʼan yuɣwiyakum huwa rabbukum wa ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
ʼam yaquluna aftarahu qul ʼin aftaraytuhu faɛalayya ʼijrami wa ʼana bariʼun mimma tujrimun.
Wa ʼuḥiya ʼila nuḥin ʼannahu lan yuʼmina min qawmika ʼilla man qad ʼamana fala tabtaʼis bima kanu yafɛalun.
Wa aṣnaɛ al-fulka biʼaɛyunina wa waḥyina wa la tuxaṭibni fi al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu ʼinnahum muɣraqun.
Wa yaṣnaɛu al-fulka wa kullama marra ɛalayhi malaʼun min qawmihi saxiru minhu qala ʼin tasxaru minna faʼinna nasxaru minkum kama tasxarun.
Fasawfa taɛlamuna man yaʼtihi ɛaḏabun yuxzihi wa yaḥillu ɛalayhi ɛaḏabun muqimun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼa ʼamruna wa fara at-tannuru qulna aḥmil fiha min kullin zawjayni aṯnayni wa ʼahlaka ʼilla man sabaqa ɛalayhi al-qawlu wa man ʼamana wa ma ʼamana maɛahu ʼilla qalilun.
Wa qala arkabu fiha bismi Allahi majraha wa mursaha ʼinna rabbi laɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa hiya tajri bihim fi mawjin kaljibali wa nada nuḥun abnahu wa kana fi maɛzilin ya bunayya arkab maɛana wa la takun maɛa al-kafirin.
Qala saʼawi ʼila jabalin yaɛṣimuni mina al-maʼi qala la ɛaṣima al-yawma min ʼamri Allahi ʼilla man raḥima wa ḥala baynahuma al-mawju fakana mina al-muɣraqin.
Wa qila ya ʼarḍu ablaɛi maʼaki wa ya samaʼu ʼaqliɛi wa ɣiḍa al-maʼu wa quḍiya al-ʼamru wa astawat ɛala al-judiyi wa qila buɛdan lilqawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa nada nuḥun rabbahu faqala rabbi ʼinna abni min ʼahli wa ʼinna waɛdaka al-ḥaqqu wa ʼanta ʼaḥkamu al-ḥakimin.
Qala ya nuḥu ʼinnahu laysa min ʼahlika ʼinnahu ɛamalun ɣayru ṣaliḥin fala tasʼalni ma laysa laka bihi ɛilmun ʼinni ʼaɛiḏ̣uka ʼan takuna mina al-jahilin.
Qala rabbi ʼinni ʼaɛuḏu bika ʼan ʼasʼalaka ma laysa li bihi ɛilmun wa ʼilla taɣfir li wa tarḥamni ʼakun mina al-xasirin.
Qila ya nuḥu ahbiṭ bisalamin minna wa barakatin ɛalayka wa ɛala ʼumamin mimman maɛaka wa ʼumamun sanumattiɛuhum ṯumma yamassuhum minna ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Tilka min ʼanbaʼi al-ɣaybi nuḥiha ʼilayka ma kunta taɛlamuha ʼanta wa la qawmuka min qabli haḏa faṣbir ʼinna al-ɛaqibata lilmuttaqin.
Wa ʼila ɛadin ʼaxahum hudan qala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu ʼin ʼantum ʼilla muftarun.
Ya qawmi la ʼasʼalukum ɛalayhi ʼajran ʼin ʼajriya ʼilla ɛala al-laḏi faṭarani ʼafala taɛqilun.
Wa ya qawmi astaɣfiru rabbakum ṯumma tubu ʼilayhi yursil as-samaʼa ɛalaykum midraran wa yazidkum quwatan ʼila quwatikum wa la tatawallaw mujrimin.
Qalu ya hudu ma jiʼtana bibayyinatin wa ma naḥnu bitariki ʼalihatina ɛan qawlika wa ma naḥnu laka bimuʼminin.
ʼin naqulu ʼilla aɛtaraka baɛḍu ʼalihatina bisuʼin qala ʼinni ʼuc/hidu Allaha wa ac/hadu ʼanni bariʼun mimma tucrikun.
Min dunihi fakiduni jamiɛan ṯumma la tunḏ̣irun.
ʼinni tawakkaltu ɛala Allahi rabbi wa rabbikum ma min dabbatin ʼilla huwa ʼaxiḏun binaṣiyatiha ʼinna rabbi ɛala ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Faʼin tawallaw faqad ʼablaɣtukum ma ʼursiltu bihi ʼilaykum wa yastaxlifu rabbi qawman ɣayrakum wa la taḍurrunahu cayʼan ʼinna rabbi ɛala kulli cayʼin ḥafiḏ̣un.
Wa lamma jaʼa ʼamruna najjayna hudan wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu biraḥmatin minna wa najjaynahum min ɛaḏabin ɣaliḏ̣in.
Wa tilka ɛadun jaḥadu biʼayati rabbihim wa ɛaṣaw rusulahu wa attabaɛu ʼamra kulli jabbarin ɛanidin.
Wa ʼutbiɛu fi haḏihi ad-dunya laɛnatan wa yawma al-qiyamati ʼala ʼinna ɛadan kafaru rabbahum ʼala buɛdan liɛadin qawmi hudin.
Wa ʼila ṯamuda ʼaxahum ṣaliḥan qala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu huwa ʼancaʼakum mina al-ʼarḍi wa astaɛmarakum fiha fastaɣfiruhu ṯumma tubu ʼilayhi ʼinna rabbi qaribun mujibun.
Qalu ya ṣaliḥu qad kunta fina marjuwan qabla haḏa ʼatanhana ʼan naɛbuda ma yaɛbudu ʼabaʼuuna wa ʼinnana lafi cakkin mimma tadɛuna ʼilayhi muribin.
Qala ya qawmi ʼaraʼaytum ʼin kuntu ɛala bayyinatin min rabbi wa ʼatani minhu raḥmatan faman yanṣuruni mina Allahi ʼin ɛaṣaytuhu fama tazidunani ɣayra taxsirin.
Wa ya qawmi haḏihi naqatu Allahi lakum ʼayatan faḏaruha taʼkul fi ʼarḍi Allahi wa la tamassuha bisuʼin fayaʼxuḏakum ɛaḏabun qaribun.
Faɛaqaruha faqala tamattaɛu fi darikum ṯalaṯata ʼayyamin ḏalika waɛdun ɣayru makḏubin.
Falamma jaʼa ʼamruna najjayna ṣaliḥan wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu biraḥmatin minna wa min xizyi yawmiʼiḏin ʼinna rabbaka huwa al-qawiyu al-ɛaziz.
Wa ʼaxaḏa al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu aṣ-ṣayḥatu faʼaṣbaḥu fi diyarihim jaṯimin.
Kaʼan lam yaɣnaw fiha ʼala ʼinna ṯamuda kafaru rabbahum ʼala buɛdan liṯamud.
Wa laqad jaʼat rusuluna ʼibrahima bil-bucra qalu salaman qala salamun fama labiṯa ʼan jaʼa biɛijlin ḥaniḏin.
Falamma raʼa ʼaydiyahum la taṣilu ʼilayhi nakirahum wa ʼawjasa minhum xifatan qalu la taxaf ʼinna ʼursilna ʼila qawmi luṭin.
Wa amraʼatuhu qaʼimatun faḍaḥikat fabaccarnaha biʼisḥaqa wa min waraʼi ʼisḥaqa yaɛqub.
Qalat ya waylata ʼaʼalidu wa ʼana ɛajuzun wa haḏa baɛli cayxan ʼinna haḏa lacayʼun ɛajibun.
Qalu ʼataɛjabina min ʼamri Allahi raḥmatu Allahi wa barakatuhu ɛalaykum ʼahla al-bayti ʼinnahu ḥamidun majidun.
Falamma ḏahaba ɛan ʼibrahima ar-rawɛu wa jaʼat/hu al-bucra yujadiluna fi qawmi luṭin.
ʼinna ʼibrahima laḥalimun ʼawwahun munibun.
Ya ʼibrahimu ʼaɛriḍ ɛan haḏa ʼinnahu qad jaʼa ʼamru rabbika wa ʼinnahum ʼatihim ɛaḏabun ɣayru mardudin.
Wa lamma jaʼat rusuluna luṭan siʼa bihim wa ḍaqa bihim ḏarɛan wa qala haḏa yawmun ɛaṣibun.
Wa jaʼahu qawmuhu yuhraɛuna ʼilayhi wa min qablu kanu yaɛmaluna as-sayyiʼati qala ya qawmi haʼuulaʼ banati hunna ʼaṭharu lakum fa attaqu Allaha wa la tuxzuni fi ḍayfi ʼalaysa minkum rajulun racidun.
Qalu laqad ɛalimta ma lana fi banatika min ḥaqqin wa ʼinnaka lataɛlamu ma nurid.
Qala law ʼanna li bikum quwatan ʼaw ʼawi ʼila ruknin cadidin.

Qalu ya luṭu ʼinna rusulu rabbika lan yaṣilu ʼilayka faʼasri biʼahlika biqiṭɛin mina al-layli wa la yaltafit minkum ʼaḥadun ʼilla amraʼataka ʼinnahu muṣibuha ma ʼaṣabahum ʼinna mawɛidahumu aṣ-ṣubḥu ʼalaysa aṣ-ṣubḥu biqaribin.
Falamma jaʼa ʼamruna jaɛalna ɛaliyaha safilaha wa ʼamṭarna ɛalayha ḥijaratan min sijjilin manḍudin.
Musawwamatan ɛinda rabbika wa ma hiya mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina bibaɛidin.
Wa ʼila madyana ʼaxahum cuɛayban qala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu wa la tanquṣu al-mikya la wa al-mizana ʼinni ʼarakum bixayrin wa ʼinni ʼaxafu ɛalaykum ɛaḏaba yawmin muḥiṭin.
Wa ya qawmi ʼawfu al-mikyala wa al-mizana bil-qisṭi wa la tabxasu an-nasa ʼacyaʼahum wa la taɛṯaw fi al-ʼarḍi mufsidin.
Baqiyatu Allahi xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum muʼminina wa ma ʼana ɛalaykum biḥafiḏ̣in.
Qalu ya cuɛaybu ʼaṣalatuka taʼmuruka ʼan natruka ma yaɛbudu ʼabaʼuuna ʼaw ʼan nafɛala fi ʼamwalina ma nacaʼu ʼinnaka laʼanta al-ḥalimu ar-racid.

Qala ya qawmi ʼaraʼaytum ʼin kuntu ɛala bayyinatin min rabbi wa razaqani minhu rizqan ḥasanan wa ma ʼuridu ʼan ʼuxalifakum ʼila ma ʼanhakum ɛanhu ʼin ʼuridu ʼilla al-ʼiṣlaḥa ma astaṭaɛtu wa ma tawfiqi ʼilla Billahi ɛalayhi tawakkaltu wa ʼilayhi ʼunib.
Wa ya qawmi la yajrimannakum ciqaqi ʼan yuṣibakum miṯlu ma ʼaṣaba qawma nuḥin ʼaw qawma hudin ʼaw qawma ṣaliḥin wa ma qawmu luṭin minkum bibaɛidin.
Wa astaɣfiru rabbakum ṯumma tubu ʼilayhi ʼinna rabbi raḥimun wadudun.
Qalu ya cuɛaybu ma nafqahu kaṯiran mimma taqulu wa ʼinna lanaraka fina ḍaɛifan wa lawla rahṭuka larajamnaka wa ma ʼanta ɛalayna biɛazizin.
Qala ya qawmi ʼarahṭi ʼaɛazzu ɛalaykum mina Allahi wa attaxaḏtumuhu waraʼakum ḏ̣ihriyan ʼinna rabbi bima taɛmaluna muḥiṭun.
Wa ya qawmi aɛmalu ɛala makanatikum ʼinni ɛamilun sawfa taɛlamuna man yaʼtihi ɛaḏabun yuxzihi wa man huwa kaḏibun wa artaqibu ʼinni maɛakum raqibun.
Wa lamma jaʼa ʼamruna najjayna cuɛayban wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu biraḥmatin minna wa ʼaxaḏati al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu aṣ-ṣayḥatu faʼaṣbaḥu fi diyarihim jaṯimin.
Kaʼan lam yaɣnaw fiha ʼala buɛdan limadyana kama baɛidat ṯamud.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna musa biʼayatina wa sulṭanin mubinin.
ʼila firɛawna wa malaʼihi fa attabaɛu ʼamra firɛawna wa ma ʼamru firɛawna biracidin.
Yaqdumu qawmahu yawma al-qiyamati faʼawradahumu an-nara wa biʼsa al-wirdu al-mawrud.
Wa ʼutbiɛu fi haḏihi laɛnatan wa yawma al-qiyamati biʼsa ar-rifdu al-marfud.
Ḏalika min ʼanbaʼi al-qura naquṣṣuhu ɛalayka minha qaʼimun wa ḥaṣidun.
Wa ma ḏ̣alamnahum wa lakin ḏ̣alamu ʼanfusahum fama ʼaɣnat ɛanhum ʼalihatuhumu allati yadɛuna min duni Allahi min cayʼin lamma jaʼa ʼamru rabbika wa ma zaduhum ɣayra tatbibin.
Wa kaḏalika ʼaxḏu rabbika ʼiḏa ʼaxaḏa al-qura wa hiya ḏ̣alimatun ʼinna ʼaxḏahu ʼalimun cadidun.
ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan liman xafa ɛaḏaba al-ʼaxirati ḏalika yawmun majmuɛun lahu an-nasu wa ḏalika yawmun mac/hudun.
Wa ma nuʼaxxiruhu ʼilla liʼjalin maɛdudin.
Yawma yaʼti la takallamu nafsun ʼilla biʼiḏnihi faminhum caqiyun wa saɛidun.
Faʼamma al-laḏina caqu fafi an-nari lahum fiha zafirun wa cahiqun.
Xalidina fiha ma damti as-samawatu wa al-ʼarḍu ʼilla ma caʼa rabbuka ʼinna rabbaka faɛɛalun lima yurid.
Wa ʼamma al-laḏina suɛidu fafi al-jannati xalidina fiha ma damati as-samawatu wa al-ʼarḍu ʼilla ma caʼa rabbuka ɛaṭaʼan ɣayra majḏuḏin.
Fala taku fi miryatin mimma yaɛbudu haʼuulaʼ ma yaɛbuduna ʼilla kama yaɛbudu ʼabaʼuuhum min qablu wa ʼinna lamuwaffuhum naṣibahum ɣayra manquṣin.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-kitaba faxtulifa fihi wa lawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa ʼinnahum lafi cakkin minhu muribin.
Wa ʼinna kulla lamma layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka ʼaɛmalahum ʼinnahu bima yaɛmaluna xabirun.
Fastaqim kama ʼumirta wa man taba maɛaka wa la taṭɣaw ʼinnahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
Wa la tarkanu ʼila al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu fatamassakumu an-naru wa ma lakum min duni Allahi min ʼawliyaʼa ṯumma la tunṣarun.
Wa ʼaqimi aṣ-ṣalata ṭarafayi an-nahari wa zulafan mina al-layli ʼinna al-ḥasanati yuḏ/hibna as-sayyiʼati ḏalika ḏikra lilḏḏakirin.
Wa aṣbir faʼinna Allaha la yuḍiɛu ʼajra al-muḥsinin.
Falawla kana mina al-quruni min qablikum ʼulu baqiyatin yanhawna ɛani al-fasadi fi al-ʼarḍi ʼilla qalilan mimman ʼanjayna minhum wa attabaɛa al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu ma ʼutrifu fihi wa kanu mujrimin.
Wa ma kana rabbuka liyuhlika al-qura biḏ̣ulmin wa ʼahluha muṣliḥun.
Wa law caʼa rabbuka lajaɛala an-nasa ʼummatan waḥidatan wa la yazaluna muxtalifin.
ʼilla man raḥima rabbuka wa liḏalika xalaqahum wa tammat kalimatu rabbika laʼamlaʼanna jahannama mina al-jinnati wa an-nasi ʼajmaɛin.
Wa kullan naquṣṣu ɛalayka min ʼanbaʼi ar-rusuli ma nuṯabbitu bihi fuʼadaka wa jaʼaka fi haḏihi al-ḥaqqu wa mawɛiḏ̣atun wa ḏikra lilmuʼminin.
Wa qul lillaḏina la yuʼminuna aɛmalu ɛala makanatikum ʼinna ɛamilun.
Wa antaḏ̣iru ʼinna muntaḏ̣irun.
Wa Lillahi ɣaybu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ʼilayhi yurjaɛu al-ʼamru kulluhu faɛbud/hu wa tawakkal ɛalayhi wa ma rabbuka biɣafilin ɛamma taɛmalun.
ʼalif-lam-ra tilka ʼayatu al-kitabi al-mubin.
ʼinna ʼanzalnahu qurʼanan ɛarabiyan laɛallakum taɛqilun.
Naḥnu naquṣṣu ɛalayka ʼaḥsana al-qaṣaṣi bima ʼawḥayna ʼilayka haḏa al-qurʼana wa ʼin kunta min qablihi lamina al-ɣafilin.
ʼiḏ qala yusufu liʼabihi ya ʼabati ʼinni raʼaytu ʼaḥada ɛacara kawkaban wa ac-camsa wa al-qamara raʼaytuhum li sajidin.
Qala ya bunayya la taqṣuṣ ruʼya ka ɛala ʼixwatika fayakidu laka kaydan ʼinna ac-cayṭana lilʼinsani ɛaduwun mubinun.

Wa kaḏalika yajtabika rabbuka wa yuɛallimuka min taʼwili al-ʼaḥadiṯi wa yutimmu niɛmatahu ɛalayka wa ɛala ʼali yaɛquba kama ʼatammaha ɛala ʼabawayka min qablu ʼibrahima wa ʼisḥaqa ʼinna rabbaka ɛalimun ḥakimun.
Laqad kana fi yusufa wa ʼixwatihi ʼayatun lilssaʼilin.
ʼiḏ qalu layusufu wa ʼaxuhu ʼaḥabbu ʼila ʼabina minna wa naḥnu ɛuṣbatun ʼinna ʼabana lafi ḍalalin mubinin.
Aqtulu yusufa ʼawi aṭraḥuhu ʼarḍan yaxlu lakum wajhu ʼabikum wa takunu min baɛdihi qawman ṣaliḥin.
Qala qaʼilun minhum la taqtulu yusufa wa ʼalquhu fi ɣayabati al-jubbi yaltaqiṭhu baɛḍu as-sayyarati ʼin kuntum faɛilin.
Qalu ya ʼabana ma laka la taʼmanna ɛala yusufa wa ʼinna lahu lanaṣiḥun.
ʼarsilhu maɛana ɣadan yartaɛ wa yalɛab wa ʼinna lahu laḥafiḏ̣un.
Qala ʼinni layaḥzununi ʼan taḏ/habu bihi wa ʼaxafu ʼan yaʼkulahu aḏ-ḏiʼbu wa ʼantum ɛanhu ɣafilun.
Qalu laʼin ʼakalahu aḏ-ḏiʼbu wa naḥnu ɛuṣbatun ʼinna ʼiḏan laxasirun.
Falamma ḏahabu bihi wa ʼajmaɛu ʼan yajɛaluhu fi ɣayabati al-jubbi wa ʼawḥayna ʼilayhi latunabbiʼannahum biʼamrihim haḏa wa hum la yacɛurun.
Wa jaʼu ʼabahum ɛicaʼan yabkun.
Qalu ya ʼabana ʼinna ḏahabna nastabiqu wa tarakna yusufa ɛinda mataɛina faʼakalahu aḏ-ḏiʼbu wa ma ʼanta bimuʼminin lana wa law kunna ṣadiqin.
