Wa jaʼu ɛala qamiṣihi bidamin kaḏibin qala bal sawwalat lakum ʼanfusukum ʼamran faṣabrun jamilun wa Allahu al-mustaɛanu ɛala ma taṣifun.
Wa jaʼat sayyaratun faʼarsalu wa aridahum faʼadla dalwahu qala ya bucra haḏa ɣulamun wa ʼasarruhu biḍaɛatan wa Allahu ɛalimun bima yaɛmalun.
Wa carawhu biṯamanin baxsin darahima maɛdudatin wa kanu fihi mina az-zahidin.

Wa qala al-laḏi actarahu min miṣra liʼimraʼatihi ʼakrimi maṯwahu ɛasa ʼan yanfaɛana ʼaw nattaxiḏahu waladan wa kaḏalika makkanna liyusufa fi al-ʼarḍi wa linuɛallimahu min taʼwili al-ʼaḥadiṯi wa Allahu ɣalibun ɛala ʼamrihi wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Wa lamma balaɣa ʼacuddahu ʼataynahu ḥukman wa ɛilman wa kaḏalika najzi al-muḥsinin.
Wa rawadat/hu allati huwa fi baytiha ɛan nafsihi wa ɣallaqati al-ʼabwaba wa qalat hayta laka qala maɛaḏa Allahi ʼinnahu rabbi ʼaḥsana maṯwaya ʼinnahu la yufliḥu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.
Wa laqad hammat bihi wa hamma biha lawla ʼan raʼa burhana rabbihi kaḏalika linaṣrifa ɛanhu as-suʼa wa al-faḥcaʼa ʼinnahu min ɛibadina al-muxlaṣin.
Wa astabaqa al-baba wa qaddat qamiṣahu min duburin wa ʼalfaya sayyidaha lada al-babi qalat ma jazaʼu man ʼarada biʼahlika suʼan ʼilla ʼan yusjana ʼaw ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Qala hiya rawadatni ɛan nafsi wa cahida cahidun min ʼahliha ʼin kana qamiṣuhu qudda min qubulin faṣadaqat wa huwa mina al-kaḏibin.
Wa ʼin kana qamiṣuhu qudda min duburin fakaḏabat wa huwa mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Falamma raʼa qamiṣahu qudda min duburin qala ʼinnahu min kaydikunna ʼinna kaydakunna ɛaḏ̣imun.
Yusufu ʼaɛriḍ ɛan haḏa wa astaɣfiri liḏanbiki ʼinnaki kunti mina al-xaṭiʼin.
Wa qala niswatun fi al-madinati amraʼatu al-ɛazizi turawidu fataha ɛan nafsihi qad caɣafaha ḥubban ʼinna lanaraha fi ḍalalin mubinin.

Falamma samiɛat bimakrihinna ʼarsalat ʼilayhinna wa ʼaɛtadat lahunna muttakaʼan wa ʼatat kulla waḥidatin minhunna sikkinan wa qalati axruj ɛalayhinna falamma raʼaynahu ʼakbarnahu wa qaṭṭaɛna ʼaydiyahunna wa qulna ḥaca Lillahi ma haḏa bacaran ʼin haḏa ʼilla malakun karimun.
Qalat faḏalikunna al-laḏi lumtunnani fihi wa laqad rawadttuhu ɛan nafsihi fastaɛṣama wa laʼin lam yafɛal ma ʼamuruhu layusjananna wa layakunan mina aṣ-ṣaɣirin.
Qala rabbi as-sijnu ʼaḥabbu ʼilayya mimma yadɛunani ʼilayhi wa ʼilla taṣrif ɛanni kaydahunna ʼaṣbu ʼilayhinna wa ʼakun mina al-jahilin.
Fastajaba lahu rabbuhu faṣarafa ɛanhu kaydahunna ʼinnahu huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Ṯumma bada lahum min baɛdi ma raʼaw al-ʼayati layasjununnahu ḥatta ḥinin.

Wa daxala maɛahu as-sijna fatayani qala ʼaḥaduhuma ʼinni ʼarani ʼaɛṣiru xamran wa qala al-ʼaxaru ʼinni ʼarani ʼaḥmilu fawqa raʼsi xubzan taʼkulu aṭ-ṭayru minhu nabbiʼna bitaʼwilihi ʼinna naraka mina al-muḥsinin.

Qala la yaʼtikuma ṭaɛamun turzaqanihi ʼilla nabbaʼtukuma bitaʼwilihi qabla ʼan yaʼtiyakuma ḏalikuma mimma ɛallamani rabbi ʼinni taraktu millata qawmin la yuʼminuna Billahi wa hum bil-ʼaxirati hum kafirun.
Wa attabaɛtu millata ʼabaʼi ʼibrahima wa ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba ma kana lana ʼan nucrika Billahi min cayʼin ḏalika min faḍli Allahi ɛalayna wa ɛala an-nasi wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yackurun.
Ya ṣaḥibayi as-sijni ʼaʼarbabun mutafarriquna xayrun ʼami Allahu al-waḥidu al-qahhar.

Ma taɛbuduna min dunihi ʼilla ʼasmaʼan sammaytumuha ʼantum wa ʼabaʼuukum ma ʼanzala Allahu biha min sulṭanin ʼini al-ḥukmu ʼilla Lillahi ʼamara ʼalla taɛbudu ʼilla ʼiyahu ḏalika ad-dinu al-qayyimu wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Ya ṣaḥibayi as-sijni ʼamma ʼaḥadukuma fayasqi rabbahu xamran wa ʼamma al-ʼaxaru fayuṣlabu fataʼkulu aṭ-ṭayru min raʼsihi quḍiya al-ʼamru al-laḏi fihi tastaftiyan.
Wa qala lillaḏi ḏ̣anna ʼannahu najin minhuma aḏkurni ɛinda rabbika faʼansahu ac-cayṭanu ḏikra rabbihi falabiṯa fi as-sijni biḍɛa sinin.

Wa qala al-maliku ʼinni ʼara sabɛa baqaratin simanin yaʼkuluhunna sabɛun ɛijafun wa sabɛa sunbulatin xuḍrin wa ʼuxara ya bisatin ya ʼayyuha al-malaʼu ʼaftuni fi ruʼya ya ʼin kuntum lilrruʼya taɛburun.
Qalu ʼaḍɣaṯu ʼaḥlamin wa ma naḥnu bitaʼwili al-ʼaḥlami biɛalimin.
Wa qala al-laḏi naja minhuma wa aiddakara baɛda ʼummatin ʼana ʼunabbiʼukum bitaʼwilihi faʼarsilun.
Yusufu ʼayyuha aṣ-ṣiddiqu ʼaftina fi sabɛi baqaratin simanin yaʼkuluhunna sabɛun ɛijafun wa sabɛi sunbulatin xuḍrin wa ʼuxara ya bisatin laɛalli ʼarjiɛu ʼila an-nasi laɛallahum yaɛlamun.
Qala tazraɛuna sabɛa sinina daʼaban fama ḥaṣadtum faḏaruhu fi sunbulihi ʼilla qalilan mimma taʼkulun.
Ṯumma yaʼti min baɛdi ḏalika sabɛun cidadun yaʼkulna ma qaddamtum lahunna ʼilla qalilan mimma tuḥṣinun.
Ṯumma yaʼti min baɛdi ḏalika ɛamun fihi yuɣaṯu an-nasu wa fihi yaɛṣirun.
Wa qala al-maliku aʼtuni bihi falamma jaʼahu ar-rasulu qala arjiɛ ʼila rabbika fasʼalhu ma balu an-niswati al-lati qaṭṭaɛna ʼaydiyahunna ʼinna rabbi bikaydihinna ɛalimun.

Qala ma xaṭbukunna ʼiḏ rawadttunna yusufa ɛan nafsihi qulna ḥaca Lillahi ma ɛalimna ɛalayhi min suʼin qalati amraʼatu al-ɛazizi al-ʼana ḥaṣḥaṣa al-ḥaqqu ʼana rawadttuhu ɛan nafsihi wa ʼinnahu lamina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Ḏalika liyaɛlama ʼanni lam ʼaxunhu bil-ɣaybi wa ʼanna Allaha la yahdi kayda al-xaʼinin.
Wa ma ʼubarriʼu nafsi ʼinna an-nafsa laʼammaratun bis-suʼi ʼilla ma raḥima rabbi ʼinna rabbi ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa qala al-maliku aʼtuni bihi ʼastaxliṣhu linafsi falamma kallamahu qala ʼinnaka al-yawma ladayna makinun ʼaminun.
Qala ajɛalni ɛala xazaʼini al-ʼarḍi ʼinni ḥafiḏ̣un ɛalimun.
Wa kaḏalika makkanna liyusufa fi al-ʼarḍi yatabawwaʼu minha ḥayṯu yacaʼu nuṣibu biraḥmatina man nacaʼu wa la nuḍiɛu ʼajra al-muḥsinin.
Wa laʼajru al-ʼaxirati xayrun lillaḏina ʼamanu wa kanu yattaqun.
Wa jaʼa ʼixwatu yusufa fadaxalu ɛalayhi faɛarafahum wa hum lahu munkirun.
Wa lamma jahhazahum bijahazihim qala aʼtuni biʼaxin lakum min ʼabikum ʼala tarawna ʼanni ʼufi al-kayla wa ʼana xayru al-munzilin.
Faʼin lam taʼtuni bihi fala kayla lakum ɛindi wa la taqrabun.
Qalu sanurawidu ɛanhu ʼabahu wa ʼinna lafaɛilun.
Wa qala lifityanihi ajɛalu biḍaɛatahum fi riḥalihim laɛallahum yaɛrifunaha ʼiḏa anqalabu ʼila ʼahlihim laɛallahum yarjiɛun.
Falamma rajaɛu ʼila ʼabihim qalu ya ʼabana muniɛa minna al-kaylu faʼarsil maɛana ʼaxana naktal wa ʼinna lahu laḥafiḏ̣un.
Qala hal ʼamanukum ɛalayhi ʼilla kama ʼamintukum ɛala ʼaxihi min qablu fa-Allahu xayrun ḥafiḏ̣an wa huwa ʼarḥamu ar-raḥimin.

Wa lamma fataḥu mataɛahum wa jadu biḍaɛatahum ruddat ʼilayhim qalu ya ʼabana ma nabɣi haḏihi biḍaɛatuna ruddat ʼilayna wa namiru ʼahlana wa naḥfaḏ̣u ʼaxana wa nazdadu kayla baɛirin ḏalika kaylun yasirun.
Qala lan ʼursilahu maɛakum ḥatta tuʼtuni mawṯiqan mina Allahi lataʼtunani bihi ʼilla ʼan yuḥaṭa bikum falamma ʼatawhu mawṯiqahum qala Allahu ɛala ma naqulu wa kilun.

Wa qala ya baniya la tadxulu min babin waḥidin wa adxulu min ʼabwabin mutafarriqatin wa ma ʼuɣni ɛankum mina Allahi min cayʼin ʼin al-ḥukmu ʼilla Lillahi ɛalayhi tawakkaltu wa ɛalayhi falyatawakkal al-mutawakkilun.

Wa lamma daxalu min ḥayṯu ʼamarahum ʼabuhum mma kana yuɣni ɛanhum mmina Allahi min cayʼin ʼilla ḥajatan fi nafsi yaɛquba qaḍaha wa ʼinnahu laḏu ɛilmin lima ɛallamnahu wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Wa lamma daxalu ɛala yusufa ʼawa ʼilayhi ʼaxahu qala ʼinni ʼana ʼaxuka fala tabtaʼis bima kanu yaɛmalun.
Falamma jahhazahum bijahazihim jaɛala as-siqayata fi raḥli ʼaxihi ṯumma ʼaḏḏana muʼaḏḏinun ʼayyatuha al-ɛiru ʼinnakum lasariqun.
Qalu wa ʼaqbalu ɛalayhim maḏa tafqidun.
Qalu nafqidu ṣuwaɛa al-maliki wa liman jaʼa bihi ḥimlu baɛirin wa ʼana bihi zaɛimun.
Qalu ta-Allahi laqad ɛalimtum ma jiʼna linufsida fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma kunna sariqin.
Qalu fama jazaʼuuhu ʼin kuntum kaḏibin.
Qalu jazaʼuuhu man wujida fi raḥlihi fahuwa jazaʼuuhu kaḏalika najzi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.

Fabadaʼa biʼawɛiyatihim qabla wiɛaʼi ʼaxihi ṯumma astaxrajaha min wiɛaʼi ʼaxihi kaḏalika kidna liyusufa ma kana liyaʼxuḏa ʼaxahu fi dini al-maliki ʼilla ʼan yacaʼa Allahu narfaɛu darajatin man nacaʼu wa fawqa kulli ḏi ɛilmin ɛalimun.
Qalu ʼin yasriq faqad saraqa ʼaxun lahu min qablu faʼasarraha yusufu fi nafsihi wa lam yubdiha lahum qala ʼantum carrun makanan wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima taṣifun.
Qalu ya ʼayyuha al-ɛazizu ʼinna lahu ʼaban cayxan kabiran faxuḏ ʼaḥadana makanahu ʼinna naraka mina al-muḥsinin.
Qala maɛaḏa Allahi ʼan naʼxuḏa ʼilla man wajadna mataɛana ɛindahu ʼinna ʼiḏan laḏ̣alimun.

Falamma astayʼasu minhu xalaṣu najiyan qala kabiruhum ʼalam taɛlamu ʼanna ʼabakum qad ʼaxaḏa ɛalaykum mawṯiqan mina Allahi wa min qablu ma farraṭtum fi yusufa falan ʼabraḥa al-ʼarḍa ḥatta yaʼḏana li ʼabi ʼaw yaḥkuma Allahu li wa huwa xayru al-ḥakimin.
Arjiɛu ʼila ʼabikum faqulu ya ʼabana ʼinna abnaka saraqa wa ma cahidna ʼilla bima ɛalimna wa ma kunna lilɣaybi ḥafiḏ̣in.
Wa asʼal al-qaryata allati kunna fiha wa al-ɛira allati ʼaqbalna fiha wa ʼinna laṣadiqun.
Qala bal sawwalat lakum ʼanfusukum ʼamran faṣabrun jamilun ɛasa Allahu ʼan yaʼtiyani bihim jamiɛan ʼinnahu huwa al-ɛalimu al-ḥakim.
Wa tawalla ɛanhum wa qala ya ʼasafa ɛala yusufa wa abyaḍḍat ɛaynahu mina al-ḥuzni fahuwa kaḏ̣imun.
Qalu ta-Allahi taftaʼu taḏkuru yusufa ḥatta takuna ḥaraḍan ʼaw takuna mina al-halikin.
Qala ʼinnama ʼacku baṯṯi wa ḥuzni ʼila Allahi wa ʼaɛlamu mina Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
Ya baniya aḏ/habu fataḥassasu min yusufa wa ʼaxihi wa la tayʼasu min rawḥi Allahi ʼinnahu la yayʼasu min rawḥi Allahi ʼilla al-qawmu al-kafirun.
Falamma daxalu ɛalayhi qalu ya ʼayyuha al-ɛazizu massana wa ʼahlana aḍ-ḍurru wa jiʼna bibiḍaɛatin muzjatin faʼawfi lana al-kayla wa taṣaddaq ɛalayna ʼinna Allaha yajzi al-mutaṣaddiqin.
Qala hal ɛalimtum ma faɛaltum biyusufa wa ʼaxihi ʼiḏ ʼantum jahilun.
Qalu ʼaʼinnaka laʼanta yusufu qala ʼana yusufu wa hḏa ʼaxi qad manna Allahu ɛalayna ʼinnahu man yattaqi wa yaṣbir faʼinna Allaha la yuḍiɛu ʼajra al-muḥsinin.
Qalu ta-Allahi laqad ʼaṯaraka Allahu ɛalayna wa ʼin kunna laxaṭiʼin.
Qala la taṯriba ɛalaykum al-yawma yaɣfiru Allahu lakum wa huwa ʼarḥamu ar-raḥimin.
Aḏ/habu biqamiṣi haḏa faʼalquhu ɛala wajhi ʼabi yaʼti baṣiran wa ʼtuni biʼahlikum ʼajmaɛin.
Wa lamma faṣalat al-ɛiru qala ʼabuhum ʼinni laʼajidu riḥa yusufa lawla ʼan tufannidun.
Qalu ta-Allahi ʼinnaka lafi ḍalalika al-qadim.
Falamma ʼan jaʼa al-baciru ʼalqahu ɛala wajhihi fartadda baṣiran qala ʼalam ʼaqul lakum ʼinni ʼaɛlamu mina Allahi ma la taɛlamun.
Qalu ya ʼabana astaɣfir lana ḏunubana ʼinna kunna xaṭiʼin.
Qala sawfa ʼastaɣfiru lakum rabbi ʼinnahu huwa al-ɣafuru ar-raḥim.
Falamma daxalu ɛala yusufa ʼawa ʼilayhi ʼabawayhi wa qala adxulu miṣra ʼin caʼa Allahu ʼaminin.

Wa rafaɛa ʼabawayhi ɛala al-ɛarci wa xarru lahu sujjadan wa qala ya ʼabati haḏa taʼwilu ruʼya y min qablu qad jaɛalaha rabbi ḥaqqan wa qad ʼaḥsana bi ʼiḏ ʼaxrajani mina as-sijni wa jaʼa bikum mina al-badwi min baɛdi ʼan nazaɣa ac-cayṭanu bayni wa bayna ʼixwati ʼinna rabbi laṭifun lima yacaʼu ʼinnahu huwa al-ɛalimu al-ḥakim.
Rabbi qad ʼataytani mina al-mulki wa ɛallamtani min taʼwili al-ʼaḥadiṯi faṭira as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼanta wa liyi fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati tawaffani musliman wa ʼalḥiqni biṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Ḏalika min ʼanbaʼi al-ɣaybi nuḥihi ʼilayka wa ma kunta ladayhim ʼiḏ ʼajmaɛu ʼamrahum wa hum yamkurun.
Wa ma ʼakṯaru an-nasi wa law ḥaraṣta bimuʼminin.
Wa ma tasʼaluhum ɛalayhi min ʼajrin ʼin huwa ʼilla ḏikrun lilɛalamin.
Wa kaʼayyin min ʼayatin fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yamurruna ɛalayha wa hum ɛanha muɛriḍun.
Wa ma yuʼminu ʼakṯaruhum Billahi ʼilla wa hum mucrikun.
ʼafaʼaminu ʼan taʼtiyahum ɣaciyatun min ɛaḏabi Allahi ʼaw taʼtiyahum as-saɛatu baɣtatan wa hum la yacɛurun.
Qul haḏihi sabili ʼadɛu ʼila Allahi ɛala baṣiratin ʼana wa man attabaɛani wa subḥana Allahi wa ma ʼana mina al-mucrikin.

Wa ma ʼarsalna min qablika ʼilla rijalan nuḥi ʼilayhim min ʼahli al-qura ʼafalam yasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fayanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-laḏina min qablihim wa ladaru al-ʼaxirati xayrun lillaḏina attaqaw ʼafala taɛqilun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa astayʼasa ar-rusulu wa ḏ̣annu ʼannahum qad kuḏibu jaʼahum naṣruna fanujjiya man nacaʼu wa la yuraddu baʼsuna ɛan al-qawmi al-mujrimin.
Laqad kana fi qaṣaṣihim ɛibratun liʼwli al-ʼalbabi ma kana ḥadiṯan yuftara wa lakin taṣdiqa al-laḏi bayna yadayhi wa tafṣila kulli cayʼin wa hudan wa raḥmatan liqawmin yuʼminun.
ʼalif-lam-mim-ra tilka ʼayatu al-kitabi wa al-laḏi ʼunzila ʼilayka min rabbika al-ḥaqqu wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yuʼminun.

Allahu al-laḏi rafaɛa as-samawati biɣayri ɛamadin tarawnaha ṯumma astawa ɛala al-ɛarci wa saxxara ac-camsa wa al-qamara kullun yajri liʼjalin musamman yudabbiru al-ʼamra yufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati laɛallakum biliqaʼi rabbikum tuqinun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi madda al-ʼarḍa wa jaɛala fiha rawasiya wa ʼanharan wa min kulli aṯ-ṯamarati jaɛala fiha zawjayni aṯnayni yuɣci al-layla an-nahara ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yatafakkarun.

Wa fi al-ʼarḍi qiṭaɛun mutajawiratun wa jannatun min ʼaɛnabin wa zarɛun wa naxilun ṣinwanun wa ɣayru ṣinwanin yusqa bimaʼin waḥidin wa nufaḍḍilu baɛḍaha ɛala baɛḍin fi al-ʼukuli ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yaɛqilun.

Wa ʼin taɛjab faɛajabun qawluhum ʼaʼiḏa kunna turaban ʼaʼinna lafi xalqin jadidin ʼulaʼika al-laḏina kafaru birabbihim wa ʼulaʼika al-ʼaɣlalu fi ʼaɛnaqihim wa ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
Wa yastaɛjilunaka bis-sayyiʼati qabla al-ḥasanati wa qad xalat min qablihim al-maṯulatu wa ʼinna rabbaka laḏu maɣfiratin lilnnasi ɛala ḏ̣ulmihim wa ʼinna rabbaka lacadidu al-ɛiqab.
Wa yaqulu al-laḏina kafaru lawla ʼunzila ɛalayhi ʼayatun min rabbihi ʼinnama ʼanta munḏirun wa likulli qawmin hadin.
Allahu yaɛlamu ma taḥmilu kullu ʼunṯa wa ma taɣiḍu al-ʼarḥamu wa ma tazdadu wa kullu cayʼin ɛindahu bimiqdarin.
Ɛalimu al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati al-kabiru al-mutaɛal.
Sawaʼun minkum man ʼasarra al-qawla wa man jahara bihi wa man huwa mustaxfin bil-layli wa saribun bin-nahar.

Lahu muɛaqqibatun min bayni yadayhi wa min xalfihi yaḥfaḏ̣unahu min ʼamri Allahi ʼinna Allaha la yuɣayyiru ma biqawmin ḥatta yuɣayyiru ma biʼanfusihim wa ʼiḏa ʼarada Allahu biqawmin suʼan fala maradda lahu wa ma lahum min dunihi min wa a-.
Huwa al-laḏi yurikum al-barqa xawfan wa ṭamaɛan wa yunciʼu as-saḥaba aṯ-ṯiqal.
Wa yusabbiḥu ar-raɛdu biḥamdihi wa al-malaʼikatu min xifatihi wa yursilu aṣ-ṣawaɛiqa fayuṣibu biha man yacaʼu wa hum yujadiluna fi Allahi wa huwa cadidu al-miḥal.

Lahu daɛwatu al-ḥaqqi wa al-laḏina yadɛuna min dunihi la yastajibuna lahum bicayʼin ʼilla kabasiṭi kaffayhi ʼila al-maʼi liyabluɣa fahu wa ma huwa bibaliɣihi wa ma duɛaʼu al-kafirina ʼilla fi ḍalalin.
Wa Lillahi yasjudu man fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ṭawɛan wa karhan wa ḏ̣ilaluhum bil-ɣuduwi wa al-ʼaṣal.

Qul man rabbu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi qul Allahu qul ʼafattaxaḏtum min dunihi ʼawliyaʼa la yamlikuna liʼnfusihim nafɛan wa la ḍarran qul hal yastawi al-ʼaɛma wa al-baṣiru ʼam hal tastawi aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumatu wa an-nur ʼam jaɛalu Lillahi curakaʼa xalaqu kaxalqihi fatacabaha al-xalqu ɛalayhim qul Allahu xaliqu kulli cayʼin wa huwa al-waḥidu al-qahhar.

ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan fasalat ʼawdiyatun biqadariha faḥtamala as-saylu zabadan rabian wa mimma yuqiduna ɛalayhi fi an-nari abtiɣaʼa ḥilyatin ʼaw mataɛin zabadun miṯluhu kaḏalika yaḍribu Allahu al-ḥaqqa wa al-baṭila faʼamma az-zabadu fayaḏ/habu jufaʼan wa ʼamma ma yanfaɛu an-nasa fayamkuṯu fi al-ʼarḍi kaḏalika yaḍribu Allahu al-ʼamṯal.

Lillaḏina astajabu lirabbihim al-ḥusna wa al-laḏina lam yastajibu lahu law ʼanna lahum ma fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan wa miṯlahu maɛahu laftadaw bihi ʼulaʼika lahum suʼ al-ḥisabi wa maʼwahum jahannamu wa biʼsa al-mihad.
ʼafaman yaɛlamu ʼannama ʼunzila ʼilayka min rabbika al-ḥaqqu kaman huwa ʼaɛma ʼinnama yataḏakkaru ʼulu al-ʼalbab.
Al-laḏina yufuna biɛahdi Allahi wa la yanquḍuna al-miṯaq.
Wa al-laḏina yaṣiluna ma ʼamara Allahu bihi ʼan yuṣala wa yaxcawna rabbahum wa yaxafuna suʼa al-ḥisab.
Wa al-laḏina ṣabaru abtiɣaʼa wajhi rabbihim wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼanfaqu mimma razaqnahum sirran wa ɛalaniyatan wa yadraʼuna bil-ḥasanati as-sayyiʼata ʼulaʼika lahum ɛuqba ad-dar.
Jannatu ɛadnin yadxulunaha wa man ṣalaḥa min ʼabaʼihim wa ʼazwajihim wa ḏurriyatihim wa al-malaʼikatu yadxuluna ɛalayhim min kulli babin.
Salamun ɛalaykum bima ṣabartum faniɛma ɛuqba ad-dar.
Wa al-laḏina yanquḍuna ɛahda Allahi min baɛdi miṯaqihi wa yaqṭaɛuna ma ʼamara Allahu bihi ʼan yuṣala wa yufsiduna fi al-ʼarḍi ʼulaʼika lahumu al-laɛnatu wa lahum suʼ ad-dar.
Allahu yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu wa yaqdiru wa fariḥu bil-ḥayati ad-dunya wa ma al-ḥayatu ad-dunya fi al-ʼaxirati ʼilla mataɛun.
Wa yaqulu al-laḏina kafaru lawla ʼunzila ɛalayhi ʼayatun min rabbihi qul ʼinna Allaha yuḍillu man yacaʼu wa yahdi ʼilayhi man ʼanab.
Al-laḏina ʼamanu wa taṭmaʼinnu qulubuhum biḏikri Allahi ʼala biḏikri Allahi taṭmaʼinnu al-qulub.
Al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati ṭuba lahum wa ḥusnu maʼabin.

Kaḏalika ʼarsalnaka fi ʼummatin qad xalat min qabliha ʼumamun litatluwa ɛalayhim al-laḏi ʼawḥayna ʼilayka wa hum yakfuruna bir-raḥmani qul huwa rabbi la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa ɛalayhi tawakkaltu wa ʼilayhi matab.

Wa law ʼanna qurʼanan suyyirat bihi al-jibalu ʼaw quṭṭiɛat bihi al-ʼarḍu ʼaw kullima bihi al-mawta bal Lillahi al-ʼamru jamiɛan ʼafalam yayʼas al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼan law yacaʼu Allahu lahada an-nasa jamiɛan wa la yazalu al-laḏina kafaru tuṣibuhum bima ṣanaɛu qariɛatun ʼaw taḥullu qariban min darihim ḥatta yaʼtiya waɛdu Allahi ʼinna Allaha la yuxlifu al-miɛad.
Wa laqad astuhziʼa birusulin min qablika faʼamlaytu lillaḏina kafaru ṯumma ʼaxaḏtuhum fakayfa kana ɛiqab.

ʼafaman huwa qaʼimun ɛala kulli nafsin bima kasabat wa jaɛalu Lillahi curakaʼa qul sammuhum ʼam tunabbiʼunahu bima la yaɛlamu fi al-ʼarḍi ʼam biḏ̣ahirin mina al-qawli bal zuyyina lillaḏina kafaru makruhum wa ṣuddu ɛan as-sabili wa man yuḍlil Allahu fama lahu min hadin.
Lahum ɛaḏabun fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa laɛaḏabu al-ʼaxirati ʼacaqqu wa ma lahum mina Allahi min waqin.
Maṯalu al-jannati allati wuɛida al-muttaquna tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu ʼukuluha daʼimun wa ḏ̣illuha tilka ɛuqba al-laḏina attaqaw wa ɛuqba al-kafirina an-nar.
Wa al-laḏina ʼataynahum al-kitaba yafraḥuna bima ʼunzila ʼilayka wa mina al-ʼaḥzabi man yunkiru baɛḍahu qul ʼinnama ʼumirtu ʼan ʼaɛbuda Allaha wa la ʼucrika bihi ʼilayhi ʼadɛu wa ʼilayhi maʼab.
Wa kaḏalika ʼanzalnahu ḥukman ɛarabiyan wa laʼin attabaɛta ʼahwaʼahum baɛdama jaʼaka mina al-ɛilmi ma laka mina Allahi min wa liyin wa la waqin.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna rusulan min qablika wa jaɛalna lahum ʼazwajan wa ḏurriyatan wa ma kana lirasulin ʼan yaʼtiya biʼayatin ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi likulli ʼajalin kitabun.
Yamḥu Allahu ma yacaʼu wa yuṯbitu wa ɛindahu ʼummu al-kitab.
Wa ʼin ma nuriyannaka baɛḍa al-laḏi naɛiduhum ʼaw natawaffayannaka faʼinnama ɛalayka al-balaɣu wa ɛalayna al-ḥisab.
ʼawalam yaraw ʼanna naʼti al-ʼarḍa nanquṣuha min ʼaṭrafiha wa Allahu yaḥkumu la muɛaqqiba liḥukmihi wa huwa sariɛu al-ḥisab.
Wa qad makara al-laḏina min qablihim falillahi al-makru jamiɛan yaɛlamu ma taksibu kullu nafsin wa sayaɛlamu al-kuffaru liman ɛuqba ad-dar.
Wa yaqulu al-laḏina kafaru lasta mursalan qul kafa Billahi cahidan bayni wa baynakum wa man ɛindahu ɛilmu al-kitab.
ʼalif-lam-ra kitabun ʼanzalnahu ʼilayka lituxrija an-nasa mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼila an-nur biʼiḏni rabbihim ʼila ṣiraṭi al-ɛazizi al-ḥamid.
Allahi al-laḏi lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa waylun lilkafirina min ɛaḏabin cadidin.
Al-laḏina yastaḥibbuna al-ḥayata ad-dunya ɛala al-ʼaxirati wa yaṣudduna ɛan sabili Allahi wa yabɣunaha ɛiwajan ʼulaʼika fi ḍalalin baɛidin.
Wa ma ʼarsalna min rasulin ʼilla bilisani qawmihi liyubayyina lahum fayuḍillu Allahu man yacaʼu wa yahdi man yacaʼu wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna musa biʼayatina ʼan ʼaxrij qawmaka mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼila an-nur wa ḏakkirhum biʼayyami Allahi ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin likulli ṣabbarin cakurin.

Wa ʼiḏ qala musa liqawmihi aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum ʼiḏ ʼanjakum min ʼali firɛawna yasumunakum suʼa al-ɛaḏabi wa yuḏabbiḥuna ʼabnaʼakum wa yastaḥyuna nisaʼakum wa fi ḏalikum balaʼun min rabbikum ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa ʼiḏ taʼaḏḏana rabbukum laʼin cakartum laʼazidannakum wa laʼin kafartum ʼinna ɛaḏabi lacadidun.
Wa qala musa ʼin takfuru ʼantum wa man fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan faʼinna Allaha laɣaniyun ḥamidun.

ʼalam yaʼtikum nabaʼu al-laḏina min qablikum qawmi nuḥin wa ɛadin wa ṯamuda wa al-laḏina min baɛdihim la yaɛlamuhum ʼilla Allahu jaʼat/hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati faraddu ʼaydiyahum fi ʼafwahihim wa qalu ʼinna kafarna bima ʼursiltum bihi wa ʼinna lafi cakkin mimma tadɛunana ʼilayhi muribin.

Qalat rusuluhum ʼafi Allahi cakkun faṭiri as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yadɛukum liyaɣfira lakum min ḏunubikum wa yuʼaxxirakum ʼila ʼajalin musamman qalu ʼin ʼantum ʼilla bacarun miṯluna turiduna ʼan taṣudduna ɛamma kana yaɛbudu ʼabaʼuuna faʼtuna bisulṭanin mubinin.

Qalat lahum rusuluhum ʼin naḥnu ʼilla bacarun miṯlukum wa lakinna Allaha yamunnu ɛala man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi wa ma kana lana ʼan naʼtiyakum bisulṭanin ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkal al-muʼminun.
Wa ma lana ʼalla natawakkala ɛala Allahi wa qad hadana subulana wa lanaṣbiranna ɛala ma ʼaḏaytumuna wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkal al-mutawakkilun.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru lirusulihim lanuxrijannakum min ʼarḍina ʼaw lataɛudunna fi millatina faʼawḥa ʼilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa lanuskinannakum al-ʼarḍa min baɛdihim ḏalika liman xafa maqami wa xafa waɛid.
Wa astaftaḥu wa xaba kullu jabbarin ɛanidin.
Min waraʼihi jahannamu wa yusqa min maʼin ṣadidin.
Yatajarraɛuhu wa la yakadu yusiɣuhu wa yaʼtihi al-mawtu min kulli makanin wa ma huwa bimayyitin wa min waraʼihi ɛaḏabun ɣaliḏ̣un.
Maṯalu al-laḏina kafaru birabbihim ʼaɛmaluhum karamadin actaddat bihi ar-riḥu fi yawmin ɛaṣifin la yaqdiruna mimma kasabu ɛala cayʼin ḏalika huwa aḍ-ḍalalu al-baɛid.
ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa bil-ḥaqqi ʼin yacaʼ yuḏ/hibkum wa yaʼti bixalqin jadidin.
Wa ma ḏalika ɛala Allahi biɛazizin.

Wa barazu Lillahi jamiɛan faqala aḍ-ḍuɛafaʼu lillaḏina astakbaru ʼinna kunna lakum tabaɛan fahal ʼantum muɣnuna ɛanna min ɛaḏabi Allahi min cayʼin qalu law hadana Allahu lahadaynakum sawaʼun ɛalayna ʼajaziɛna ʼam ṣabarna ma lana min maḥiṣin.

Wa qala ac-cayṭanu lamma quḍiya al-ʼamru ʼinna Allaha waɛadakum waɛda al-ḥaqqi wa waɛadtukum faʼaxlaftukum wa ma kana li ɛalaykum min sulṭanin ʼilla ʼan daɛawtukum fastajabtum li fala talumuni wa lumu ʼanfusakum ma ʼana bimuṣrixikum wa ma ʼantum bimuṣrixiya ʼinni kafartu bima ʼacraktumuni min qablu ʼinna aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa ʼudxila al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha biʼiḏni rabbihim taḥiyatuhum fiha salamun.
ʼalam tara kayfa ḍaraba Allahu maṯalan kalimatan ṭayyibatan kacajaratin ṭayyibatin ʼaṣluha ṯabitun wa farɛuha fi as-samaʼ.
Tuʼti ʼukulaha kulla ḥinin biʼiḏni rabbiha wa yaḍribu Allahu al-ʼamṯala lilnnasi laɛallahum yataḏakkarun.
Wa maṯalu kalimatin xabiṯatin kacajaratin xabiṯatin ajtuṯṯat min fawqi al-ʼarḍi ma laha min qararin.
Yuṯabbitu Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu bil-qawli aṯ-ṯabiti fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa fi al-ʼaxirati wa yuḍillu Allahu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina wa yafɛalu Allahu ma yacaʼ.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina baddalu niɛmata Allahi kufran wa ʼaḥallu qawmahum dara al-bawar.
Jahannama yaṣlawnaha wa biʼsa al-qarar.
Wa jaɛalu Lillahi ʼandadan liyuḍillu ɛan sabilihi qul tamattaɛu faʼinna maṣirakum ʼila an-nar.
Qul liɛibadi al-laḏina ʼamanu yuqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa yunfiqu mimma razaqnahum sirran wa ɛalaniyatan min qabli ʼan yaʼtiya yawmun la bayɛun fihi wa la xilalun.

Allahu al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼaxraja bihi mina aṯ-ṯamarati rizqan lakum wa saxxara lakum al-fulka litajriya fi al-baḥri biʼamrihi wa saxxara lakum al-ʼanhar.
Wa saxxara lakum ac-camsa wa al-qamara daʼibayni wa saxxara lakum al-layla wa an-nahar.
Wa ʼatakum min kulli ma saʼaltumuhu wa ʼin taɛuddu niɛmata Allahi la tuḥṣuha ʼinna al-ʼinsana laḏ̣alumun kaffarun.
Wa ʼiḏ qala ʼibrahimu rabbi ajɛal haḏa al-balada ʼaminan wa ajnubni wa baniya ʼan naɛbuda al-ʼaṣnam.
Rabbi ʼinnahunna ʼaḍlalna kaṯiran mina an-nasi faman tabiɛani faʼinnahu minni wa man ɛaṣani faʼinnaka ɣafurun raḥimun.

Rabbana ʼinni ʼaskantu min ḏurriyati biwadin ɣayri ḏi zarɛin ɛinda baytika al-muḥarrami rabbana liyuqimu aṣ-ṣalata fajɛal ʼafʼidatan mina an-nasi tahwi ʼilayhim wa arzuqhum mina aṯ-ṯamarati laɛallahum yackurun.
Rabbana ʼinnaka taɛlamu ma nuxfi wa ma nuɛlinu wa ma yaxfa ɛala Allahi min cayʼin fi al-ʼarḍi wa la fi as-samaʼ.
Al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi wahaba li ɛala al-kibari ʼismaɛila wa ʼisḥaqa ʼinna rabbi lasamiɛu ad-duɛaʼ.
Rabbi ajɛalni muqima aṣ-ṣalati wa min ḏurriyati rabbana wa taqabbal duɛaʼ.
Rabbana aɣfir li wa liwalidayya wa lilmuʼminina yawma yaqumu al-ḥisab.
Wa la taḥsabanna Allaha ɣafilan ɛamma yaɛmalu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna ʼinnama yuʼaxxiruhum liyawmin tacxaṣu fihi al-ʼabṣar.
Muhṭiɛina muqniɛi ruʼsihim la yartaddu ʼilayhim ṭarfuhum wa ʼafʼidatuhum hawaʼun.

Wa ʼanḏir an-nasa yawma yaʼtihim al-ɛaḏabu fayaqulu al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu rabbana ʼaxxirna ʼila ʼajalin qaribin nujib daɛwataka wa nattabiɛ ar-rusula ʼawalam takunu ʼaqsamtum min qablu ma lakum min zawalin.
Wa sakantum fi masakini al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu ʼanfusahum wa tabayyana lakum kayfa faɛalna bihim wa ḍarabna lakum al-ʼamṯal.
Wa qad makaru makrahum wa ɛinda Allahi makruhum wa ʼin kana makruhum litazula minhu al-jibal.
Fala taḥsabanna Allaha muxlifa waɛdihi rusulahu ʼinna Allaha ɛazizun ḏu antiqamin.
Yawma tubaddalu al-ʼarḍu ɣayra al-ʼarḍi wa as-samawatu wa barazu Lillahi al-waḥidi al-qahhar.
Wa tara al-mujrimina yawmaʼiḏin muqarranina fi al-ʼaṣfad.
Sarabiluhum min qaṭiranin wa taɣca wujuhahum an-nar.
Liyajziya Allahu kulla nafsin ma kasabat ʼinna Allaha sariɛu al-ḥisab.
Haḏa balaɣun lilnnasi wa liyunḏaru bihi wa liyaɛlamu ʼannama huwa ʼilahun waḥidun wa liyaḏḏakkara ʼulu al-ʼalbab.
ʼalif-lam-ra tilka ʼayatu al-kitabi wa qurʼanin mubinin.
Rubama yawaddu al-laḏina kafaru law kanu muslimin.
Ḏarhum yaʼkulu wa yatamattaɛu wa yulhihim al-ʼamalu fasawfa yaɛlamun.
Wa ma ʼahlakna min qaryatin ʼilla wa laha kitabun maɛlumun.
Ma tasbiqu min ʼummatin ʼajalaha wa ma yastaʼxirun.
Wa qalu ya ʼayyuha al-laḏi nuzzila ɛalayhi aḏ-ḏikru ʼinnaka lamajnunun.
Law ma taʼtina bil-malaʼikati ʼin kunta mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Ma nunazzilu al-malaʼikata ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi wa ma kanu ʼiḏan munḏ̣arin.
ʼinna naḥnu nazzalna aḏ-ḏikra wa ʼinna lahu laḥafiḏ̣un.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna min qablika fi ciyaɛi al-ʼawwalin.
Wa ma yaʼtihim min rasulin ʼilla kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Kaḏalika naslukuhu fi qulubi al-mujrimin.
La yuʼminuna bihi wa qad xalat sunnatu al-ʼawwalin.
Wa law fataḥna ɛalayhim baban mina as-samaʼi faḏ̣allu fihi yaɛrujun.
Laqalu ʼinnama sukkirat ʼabṣaruna bal naḥnu qawmun masḥurun.
Wa laqad jaɛalna fi as-samaʼi burujan wa zayyannaha lilnnaḏ̣irin.
Wa ḥafiḏ̣naha min kulli cayṭanin rajimin.
ʼilla man astaraqa as-samɛa faʼatbaɛahu cihabun mubinun.
Wa al-ʼarḍa madadnaha wa ʼalqayna fiha rawasiya wa ʼanbatna fiha min kulli cayʼin mawzunin.
Wa jaɛalna lakum fiha maɛayica wa man lastum lahu biraziqin.
Wa ʼin min cayʼin ʼilla ɛindana xazaʼinuhu wa ma nunazziluhu ʼilla biqadarin maɛlumin.
Wa ʼarsalna ar-riyaḥa lawaqiḥa faʼanzalna mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼasqaynakumuhu wa ma ʼantum lahu bixazinin.
Wa ʼinna lanaḥnu nuḥyi wa numitu wa naḥnu al-wariṯun.
Wa laqad ɛalimna al-mustaqdimina minkum wa laqad ɛalimna al-mustaʼxirin.
Wa ʼinna rabbaka huwa yaḥcuruhum ʼinnahu ḥakimun ɛalimun.
Wa laqad xalaqna al-ʼinsana min ṣalṣalin min ḥamaʼiin masnunin.
Wa al-janna xalaqnahu min qablu min nari as-samum.
Wa ʼiḏ qala rabbuka lilmalaʼikati ʼinni xaliqun bacaran min ṣalṣalin min ḥamaʼiin masnunin.
Faʼiḏa sawwaytuhu wa nafaxtu fihi min ruḥi faqaɛu lahu sajidin.
Fasajada al-malaʼikatu kulluhum ʼajmaɛun.
ʼilla ʼiblisa ʼaba ʼan yakuna maɛa as-sajidin.
Qala ya ʼiblisu ma laka ʼalla takuna maɛa as-sajidin.
Qala lam ʼakun liʼsjuda libacarin xalaqtahu min ṣalṣalin min ḥamaʼiin masnunin.
Qala faxruj minha faʼinnaka rajimun.
Wa ʼinna ɛalayka al-laɛnata ʼila yawmi ad-din.
Qala rabbi faʼanḏ̣irni ʼila yawmi yubɛaṯun.
Qala faʼinnaka mina al-munḏ̣arin.
ʼila yawmi al-waqti al-maɛlum.
Qala rabbi bima ʼaɣwaytani laʼuzayyinanna lahum fi al-ʼarḍi wa laʼuɣwiyannahum ʼajmaɛin.
ʼilla ɛibadaka minhumu al-muxlaṣin.
Qala haḏa ṣiraṭun ɛalayya mustaqimun.
ʼinna ɛibadi laysa laka ɛalayhim sulṭanun ʼilla mani attabaɛaka mina al-ɣawin.
Wa ʼinna jahannama lamawɛiduhum ʼajmaɛin.
Laha sabɛatu ʼabwabin likulli babin minhum juzʼun maqsumun.
ʼinna al-muttaqina fi jannatin wa ɛuyunin.
Adxuluha bisalamin ʼaminin.
Wa nazaɛna ma fi ṣudurihim min ɣillin ʼixwanan ɛala sururin mutaqabilin.
La yamassuhum fiha naṣabun wa ma hum minha bimuxrajin.
Nabbiʼ ɛibadi ʼanni ʼana al-ɣafuru ar-raḥim.
Wa ʼanna ɛaḏabi huwa al-ɛaḏabu al-ʼalim.
Wa nabbiʼhum ɛan ḍayfi ʼibrahim.
ʼiḏ daxalu ɛalayhi faqalu salaman qala ʼinna minkum wajilun.
Qalu la tawjal ʼinna nubacciruka biɣulamin ɛalimin.
Qala ʼabaccartumuni ɛala ʼan massani al-kibaru fabima tubaccirun.
Qalu baccarnaka bil-ḥaqqi fala takun mina al-qaniṭin.
Qala wa man yaqnaṭu min raḥmati rabbihi ʼilla aḍ-ḍallun.
Qala fama xaṭbukum ʼayyuha al-mursalun.
Qalu ʼinna ʼursilna ʼila qawmin mujrimin.
ʼilla ʼala luṭin ʼinna lamunajjuhum ʼajmaɛin.
ʼilla amraʼatahu qaddarna ʼinnaha lamina al-ɣabirin.
Falamma jaʼa ʼala luṭin al-mursalun.
Qala ʼinnakum qawmun munkarun.
Qalu bal jiʼnaka bima kanu fihi yamtarun.
Wa ʼataynaka bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼinna laṣadiqun.
Faʼasri biʼahlika biqiṭɛin mina al-layli wa attabiɛ ʼadbarahum wa la yaltafit minkum ʼaḥadun wa amḍu ḥayṯu tuʼmarun.
Wa qaḍayna ʼilayhi ḏalika al-ʼamra ʼanna dabira haʼuulaʼ maqṭuɛun muṣbiḥin.
Wa jaʼa ʼahlu al-madinati yastabcirun.
Qala ʼinna haʼuulaʼ ḍayfi fala tafḍaḥun.
Wa attaqu Allaha wa la tuxzun.
Qalu ʼawalam nanhaka ɛani al-ɛalamin.
Qala haʼuulaʼ banati ʼin kuntum faɛilin.
Laɛamruka ʼinnahum lafi sakratihim yaɛmahun.
Faʼaxaḏat/humu aṣ-ṣayḥatu mucriqin.
Fajaɛalna ɛaliyaha safilaha wa ʼamṭarna ɛalayhim ḥijaratan min sijjilin.
ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin lilmutawassimin.
Wa ʼinnaha labisabilin muqimin.
ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan lilmuʼminin.
Wa ʼin kana ʼaṣḥabu al-ʼaykati laḏ̣alimin.
Fantaqamna minhum wa ʼinnahuma labiʼimamin mubinin.
Wa laqad kaḏḏaba ʼaṣḥabu al-ḥijri al-mursalin.
Wa ʼatakum min kulli ma saʼaltumuhu wa ʼin taɛuddu niɛmata Allahi la tuḥṣuha ʼinna al-ʼinsana laḏ̣alumun kaffarun.
Wa kanu yanḥituna mina al-jibali buyutan ʼaminin.
Faʼaxaḏat/humu aṣ-ṣayḥatu muṣbiḥin.
Fama ʼaɣna ɛanhum ma kanu yaksibun.
Wa ma xalaqna as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ma baynahuma ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼinna as-saɛata laʼatiyatun faṣfaḥ aṣ-ṣafḥa al-jamil.
ʼinna rabbaka huwa al-xallaqu al-ɛalim.
Wa laqad ʼataynaka sabɛan mina al-maṯani wa al-qurʼana al-ɛaḏ̣im.
La tamuddanna ɛaynayka ʼila ma mattaɛna bihi ʼazwajan minhum wa la taḥzan ɛalayhim wa axfiḍ janaḥaka lilmuʼminin.
Wa qul ʼinni ʼana an-naḏiru al-mubin.
Kama ʼanzalna ɛala al-muqtasimin.
Al-laḏina jaɛalu al-qurʼana ɛiḍin.
Fawarabbika lanasʼalannahum ʼajmaɛin.
Ɛamma kanu yaɛmalun.
Faṣdaɛ bima tuʼmaru wa ʼaɛriḍ ɛani al-mucrikin.
ʼinna kafaynaka al-mustahziʼin.
Al-laḏina yajɛaluna maɛa Allahi ʼilahan ʼaxara fasawfa yaɛlamun.
Wa laqad naɛlamu ʼannaka yaḍiqu ṣadruka bima yaqulun.
Fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa kun mina as-sajidin.
Wa aɛbud rabbaka ḥatta yaʼtiyaka al-yaqin.
ʼata ʼamru Allahi fala tastaɛjiluhu subḥanahu wa taɛala ɛamma yucrikun.
Yunazzilu al-malaʼikata bir-ruḥi min ʼamrihi ɛala man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi ʼan ʼanḏiru ʼannahu la ʼilaha ʼilla ʼana fa attaqun.
Xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa bil-ḥaqqi taɛala ɛamma yucrikun.
Xalaqa al-ʼinsana min nuṭfatin faʼiḏa huwa xaṣimun mubinun.
Wa al-ʼanɛam xalaqaha lakum fiha difʼun wa manafiɛu wa minha taʼkulun.
Wa lakum fiha jamalun ḥina turiḥuna wa ḥina tasraḥun.
Wa taḥmilu ʼaṯqalakum ʼila baladin lam takunu baliɣihi ʼilla biciqqi al-ʼanfusi ʼinna rabbakum laraʼufun raḥimun.
Wa al-xayla wa al-biɣala wa al-ḥamira litarkabuha wa zinatan wa yaxluqu ma la taɛlamun.
Wa ɛala Allahi qaṣdu as-sabili wa minha jaʼirun wa law caʼa lahadakum ʼajmaɛin.
Huwa al-laḏi ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan lakum minhu carabun wa minhu cajarun fihi tusimun.
Yunbitu lakum bihi az-zarɛa wa az-zaytuna wa an-naxila wa al-ʼaɛnaba wa min kulli aṯ-ṯamarati ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan liqawmin yatafakkarun.
Wa saxxara lakum al-layla wa an-nahara wa ac-camsa wa al-qamara wa an-nujumu musaxxaratun biʼamrihi ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yaɛqilun.
Wa ma ḏaraʼa lakum fi al-ʼarḍi muxtalifan ʼalwanuhu ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan liqawmin yaḏḏakkarun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi saxxara al-baḥra litaʼkulu minhu laḥman ṭariyan wa tastaxriju minhu ḥilyatan talbasunaha wa tara al-fulka mawaxira fihi wa litabtaɣu min faḍlihi wa laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa ʼalqa fi al-ʼarḍi rawasiya ʼan tamida bikum wa ʼanharan wa subulan llaɛallakum tahtadun.
Wa ɛalamatin wa bin-najmi hum yahtadun.
ʼafaman yaxluqu kaman la yaxluqu ʼafala taḏakkarun.
Wa ʼin taɛuddu niɛmata Allahi la tuḥṣuha ʼinna Allaha laɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa Allahu yaɛlamu ma tusirruna wa ma tuɛlinun.
Wa al-laḏina yadɛuna min duni Allahi la yaxluquna cayʼan wa hum yuxlaqun.
ʼamwatun ɣayru ʼaḥyaʼin wa ma yacɛuruna ʼayyana yubɛaṯun.
ʼilahukum ʼilahun waḥidun fa-al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati qulubuhum munkiratun wa hum mustakbirun.
La jarama ʼanna Allaha yaɛlamu ma yusirruna wa ma yuɛlinuna ʼinnahu la yuḥibbu al-mustakbirin.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum maḏa ʼanzala rabbukum qalu ʼasaṭiru al-ʼawwalin.
Liyaḥmilu ʼawzarahum kamilatan yawma al-qiyamati wa min ʼawzari al-laḏina yuḍillunahum biɣayri ɛilmin ʼala saʼa ma yazirun.
Qad makara al-laḏina min qablihim faʼata Allahu bunyanahum mina al-qawaɛidi faxarra ɛalayhimu as-saqfu min fawqihim wa ʼatahumu al-ɛaḏabu min ḥayṯu la yacɛurun.
Ṯumma yawma al-qiyamati yuxzihim wa yaqulu ʼayna curakaʼiya al-laḏina kuntum tucaqquna fihim qala al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma ʼinna al-xizya al-yawma wa as-suʼa ɛala al-kafirin.
Al-laḏina tatawaffahumu al-malaʼikatu ḏ̣alimi ʼanfusihim faʼalqaw as-salama ma kunna naɛmalu min suʼin bala ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Fadxulu ʼabwaba jahannama xalidina fiha falabiʼsa maṯwa al-mutakabbirin.
Wa qila lillaḏina attaqaw maḏa ʼanzala rabbukum qalu xayran lillaḏina ʼaḥsanu fi haḏihi ad-dunya ḥasanatun wa ladaru al-ʼaxirati xayrun wa laniɛma daru al-muttaqin.
Jannatu ɛadnin yadxulunaha tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu lahum fiha ma yacaʼuna kaḏalika yajzi Allahu al-muttaqin.
Al-laḏina tatawaffahumu al-malaʼikatu ṭayyibina yaquluna salamun ɛalaykum adxulu al-jannata bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Hal yanḏ̣uruna ʼilla ʼan taʼtiyahumu al-malaʼikatu ʼaw yaʼtiya ʼamru rabbika kaḏalika faɛala al-laḏina min qablihim wa ma ḏ̣alamahumu Allahu wa lakin kanu ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.
Faʼaṣabahum sayyiʼatu ma ɛamilu wa ḥaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.

Wa qala al-laḏina ʼacraku law caʼa Allahu ma ɛabadna min dunihi min cayʼin naḥnu wa la ʼabaʼuuna wa la ḥarramna min dunihi min cayʼin kaḏalika faɛala al-laḏina min qablihim fahal ɛala ar-rusuli ʼilla al-balaɣu al-mubin.

Wa laqad baɛaṯna fi kulli ʼummatin rasulan ʼan auɛbudu Allaha wa ajtanibu aṭ-ṭaɣuta faminhum man hada Allahu wa minhum man ḥaqqat ɛalayhi aḍ-ḍalalatu fasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mukaḏḏibin.
ʼin taḥriṣ ɛala hudahum faʼinna Allaha la yahdi man yuḍillu wa ma lahum min naṣirin.
Wa ʼaqsamu Billahi jahda ʼaymanihim la yabɛaṯu Allahu man yamutu bala waɛdan ɛalayhi ḥaqqan wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Liyubayyina lahum al-laḏi yaxtalifuna fihi wa liyaɛlama al-laḏina kafaru ʼannahum kanu kaḏibin.
ʼinnama qawluna licayʼin ʼiḏa ʼaradnahu ʼan naqula lahu kun fayakun.
Wa al-laḏina hajaru fi Allahi min baɛdi ma ḏ̣ulimu lanubawwiʼannahum fi ad-dunya ḥasanatan wa laʼajru al-ʼaxirati ʼakbaru law kanu yaɛlamun.
Al-laḏina ṣabaru wa ɛala rabbihim yatawakkalun.
Wa ma ʼarsalna min qablika ʼilla rijalan nuḥi ʼilayhim fasʼalu ʼahla aḏ-ḏikri ʼin kuntum la taɛlamun.
Bil-bayyinati wa az-zuburi wa ʼanzalna ʼilayka aḏ-ḏikra litubayyina lilnnasi ma nuzzila ʼilayhim wa laɛallahum yatafakkarun.
ʼafaʼamina al-laḏina makaru as-sayyiʼati ʼan yaxsifa Allahu bihimu al-ʼarḍa ʼaw yaʼtiyahumu al-ɛaḏabu min ḥayṯu la yacɛurun.
ʼaw yaʼxuḏahum fi taqallubihim fama hum bimuɛjizin.
ʼaw yaʼxuḏahum ɛala taxawwufin faʼinna rabbakum laraʼufun raḥimun.
ʼawalam yaraw ʼila ma xalaqa Allahu min cayʼin yatafayyaʼu ḏ̣ilaluhu ɛani al-yamini wa ac-camaʼili sujjadan Lillahi wa hum daxirun.
Wa Lillahi yasjudu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi min dabbatin wa al-malaʼikatu wa hum la yastakbirun.
Yaxafuna rabbahum min fawqihim wa yafɛaluna ma yuʼmarun.
Wa qala Allahu la tattaxiḏu ʼilahayni aṯnayni ʼinnama huwa ʼilahun waḥidun faʼiyaya farhabun.
Wa lahu ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa lahu ad-dinu wa aṣiban ʼafaɣayra Allahi tattaqun.
Wa ma bikum min niɛmatin famina Allahi ṯumma ʼiḏa massakumu aḍ-ḍurru faʼilayhi tajʼarun.
Ṯumma ʼiḏa kacafa aḍ-ḍurra ɛankum ʼiḏa fariqun minkum birabbihim yucrikun.
Liyakfuru bima ʼataynahum fatamattaɛu fasawfa taɛlamun.
Wa yajɛaluna lima la yaɛlamuna naṣiban mimma razaqnahum ta-Allahi latusʼalunna ɛamma kuntum taftarun.
Wa yajɛaluna Lillahi al-banati subḥanahu wa lahum ma yactahun.
Wa ʼiḏa buccira ʼaḥaduhum bil-ʼunṯa ḏ̣alla wajhuhu muswaddan wa huwa kaḏ̣imun.
Yatawara mina al-qawmi min suʼi ma buccira bihi ʼayumsikuhu ɛala hunin ʼam yadussuhu fi at-turabi ʼala saʼa ma yaḥkumun.
Lillaḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati maṯalu as-sawʼi wa Lillahi al-maṯalu al-ʼaɛla wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Wa law yuʼaxiḏu Allahu an-nasa biḏ̣ulmihim ma taraka ɛalayha min dabbatin wa lakin yuʼaxxiruhum ʼila ʼajalin musamman faʼiḏa jaʼa ʼajaluhum la yastaʼxiruna saɛatan wa la yastaqdimun.
Wa yajɛaluna Lillahi ma yakrahuna wa taṣifu ʼalsinatuhumu al-kaḏiba ʼanna lahum al-ḥusna la jarama ʼanna lahum an-nara wa ʼannahum mufraṭun.
Ta-Allahi laqad ʼarsalna ʼila ʼumamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu ac-cayṭanu ʼaɛmalahum fahuwa waliyuhumu al-yawma wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa ma ʼanzalna ɛalayka al-kitaba ʼilla litubayyina lahumu al-laḏi axtalafu fihi wa hudan wa raḥmatan liqawmin yuʼminun.
Wa Allahu ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼaḥya bihi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan liqawmin yasmaɛun.
Wa ʼinna lakum fi al-ʼanɛam laɛibratan nusqikum mimma fi buṭunihi min bayni farṯin wa damin labanan xaliṣan saʼiɣan lilccaribin.
Wa min ṯamarati an-naxili wa al-ʼaɛnabi tattaxiḏuna minhu sakaran wa rizqan ḥasanan ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan liqawmin yaɛqilun.
Wa ʼawḥa rabbuka ʼila an-naḥli ʼani attaxiḏi mina al-jibali buyutan wa mina ac-cajari wa mimma yaɛricun.
Ṯumma kuli min kulli aṯ-ṯamarati fasluki subula rabbiki ḏululan yaxruju min buṭuniha carabun muxtalifun ʼalwanuhu fihi cifaʼun lilnnasi ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan liqawmin yatafakkarun.
Wa Allahu xalaqakum ṯumma yatawaffakum wa minkum man yuraddu ʼila ʼarḏali al-ɛumuri likay la yaɛlama baɛda ɛilmin cayʼan ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun qadirun.
Wa Allahu faḍḍala baɛḍakum ɛala baɛḍin fi ar-rizqi fama al-laḏina fuḍḍilu biraddi rizqihim ɛala ma malakat ʼaymanuhum fahum fihi sawaʼun ʼafabiniɛmati Allahi yajḥadun.
Wa Allahu jaɛala lakum min ʼanfusikum ʼazwajan wa jaɛala lakum min ʼazwajikum banina wa ḥafadatan wa razaqakum mina aṭ-ṭayyibati ʼafabialbaṭili yuʼminuna wa biniɛmati Allahi hum yakfurun.
Wa yaɛbuduna min duni Allahi ma la yamliku lahum rizqan mina as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi cayʼan wa la yastaṭiɛun.
Fala taḍribu Lillahi al-ʼamṯala ʼinna Allaha yaɛlamu wa ʼantum la taɛlamun.
Ḍaraba Allahu maṯalan ɛabdan mamlukan la yaqdiru ɛala cayʼin wa man razaqnahu minna rizqan ḥasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wa jahran hal yastawuna al-ḥamdu Lillahi bal ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛlamun.

Wa ḍaraba Allahu maṯalan rajulayni ʼaḥaduhuma ʼabkamu la yaqdiru ɛala cayʼin wa huwa kallun ɛala mawlahu ʼaynama yuwajjhihhu la yaʼti bixayrin hal yastawi huwa wa man yaʼmuru bil-ɛadli wa huwa ɛala ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Wa Lillahi ɣaybu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma ʼamru as-saɛati ʼilla kalamḥi al-baṣari ʼaw huwa ʼaqrabu ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa Allahu ʼaxrajakum min buṭuni ʼummahatikum la taɛlamuna cayʼan wa jaɛala lakumu as-samɛa wa al-ʼabṣara wa al-ʼafʼidata laɛallakum tackurun.
ʼalam yaraw ʼila aṭ-ṭayri musaxxaratin fi jawwi as-samaʼi ma yumsikuhunna ʼilla Allahu ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yuʼminun.

Wa Allahu jaɛala lakum min buyutikum sakanan wa jaɛala lakum min juludi al-ʼanɛam buyutan tastaxiffunaha yawma ḏ̣aɛnikum wa yawma ʼiqamatikum wa min ʼaṣwafiha wa ʼawbariha wa ʼacɛariha ʼaṯaṯan wa mataɛan ʼila ḥinin.

Wa Allahu jaɛala lakum mimma xalaqa ḏ̣ilalan wa jaɛala lakum mina al-jibali ʼaknanan wa jaɛala lakum sarabila taqikumu al-ḥarra wa sarabila taqikum baʼsakum kaḏalika yutimmu niɛmatahu ɛalaykum laɛallakum tuslimun.
Faʼin tawallaw faʼinnama ɛalayka al-balaɣu al-mubin.
Yaɛrifuna niɛmata Allahi ṯumma yunkirunaha wa ʼakṯaruhumu al-kafirun.
Wa yawma nabɛaṯu min kulli ʼummatin cahidan ṯumma la yuʼḏanu lillaḏina kafaru wa la hum yustaɛtabun.
Wa ʼiḏa raʼa al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu al-ɛaḏaba fala yuxaffafu ɛanhum wa la hum yunḏ̣arun.
Wa ʼiḏa raʼa al-laḏina ʼacraku curakaʼahum qalu rabbana haʼuulaʼ curakaʼuuna al-laḏina kunna nadɛu min dunika faʼalqaw ʼilayhimu al-qawla ʼinnakum lakaḏibun.
Wa ʼalqaw ʼila Allahi yawmaʼiḏin as-salama wa ḍalla ɛanhum ma kanu yaftarun.
Al-laḏina kafaru wa ṣaddu ɛan sabili Allahi zidnahum ɛaḏaban fawqa al-ɛaḏabi bima kanu yufsidun.
Wa yawma nabɛaṯu fi kulli ʼummatin cahidan ɛalayhim min ʼanfusihim wa jiʼna bika cahidan ɛala haʼuulaʼ wa nazzalna ɛalayka al-kitaba tibyanan likulli cayʼin wa hudan wa raḥmatan wa bucra lilmuslimin.
ʼinna Allaha yaʼmuru bil-ɛadli wa al-ʼiḥsani wa ʼitaʼi ḏi al-qurba wa yanha ɛani al-faḥcaʼi wa al-munkari wa al-baɣyi yaɛiḏ̣ukum laɛallakum taḏakkarun.
Wa ʼawfu biɛahdi Allahi ʼiḏa ɛahadtum wa la tanquḍu al-ʼaymana baɛda tawkidiha wa qad jaɛaltumu Allaha ɛalaykum kafilan ʼinna Allaha yaɛlamu ma tafɛalun.

Wa la takunu kallati naqaḍat ɣazlaha min baɛdi quwatin ʼankaṯan tattaxiḏuna ʼaymanakum daxalan baynakum ʼan takuna ʼummatun hiya ʼarba min ʼummatin ʼinnama yablukumu Allahu bihi wa layubayyinanna lakum yawma al-qiyamati ma kuntum fihi taxtalifun.
Wa law caʼa Allahu lajaɛalakum ʼummatan waḥidatan wa lakin yuḍillu man yacaʼu wa yahdi man yacaʼu wa latusʼalunna ɛamma kuntum taɛmalun.
Wa la tattaxiḏu ʼaymanakum daxalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baɛda ṯubutiha wa taḏuqu as-suʼa bima ṣadadtum ɛan sabili Allahi wa lakum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa la tactaru biɛahdi Allahi ṯamanan qalilan ʼinnama ɛinda Allahi huwa xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.
Ma ɛindakum yanfadu wa ma ɛinda Allahi baqin wa lanajziyanna al-laḏina ṣabaru ʼajrahum biʼaḥsani ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Man ɛamila ṣaliḥan min ḏakarin ʼaw ʼunṯa wa huwa muʼminun falanuḥyiyannahu ḥayatan ṭayyibatan wa lanajziyannahum ʼajrahum biʼaḥsani ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Faʼiḏa qaraʼta al-qurʼana fastaɛiḏ Billahi mina ac-cayṭani ar-rajim.
ʼinnahu laysa lahu sulṭanun ɛala al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛala rabbihim yatawakkalun.
ʼinnama sulṭanuhu ɛala al-laḏina yatawallawnahu wa al-laḏina hum bihi mucrikun.
Wa ʼiḏa baddalna ʼayatan makana ʼayatin wa Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima yunazzilu qalu ʼinnama ʼanta muftarin bal ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛlamun.
Qul nazzalahu ruḥu al-qudusi min rabbika bil-ḥaqqi liyuṯabbita al-laḏina ʼamanu wa hudan wa bucra lilmuslimin.
Wa laqad naɛlamu ʼannahum yaquluna ʼinnama yuɛallimuhu bacarun lisanu al-laḏi yulḥiduna ʼilayhi ʼaɛjamiyun wa haḏa lisanun ɛarabiyun mubinun.
ʼinna al-laḏina la yuʼminuna biʼayati Allahi la yahdihimu Allahu wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
ʼinnama yaftari al-kaḏiba al-laḏina la yuʼminuna biʼayati Allahi wa ʼulaʼika humu al-kaḏibun.
Man kafara Billahi min baɛdi ʼimanihi ʼilla man ʼukriha wa qalbuhu muṭmaʼinnun bil-ʼimani wa lakin man caraḥa bil-kufri ṣadran faɛalayhim ɣaḍabun mina Allahi wa lahum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Ḏalika biʼannahumu astaḥabbu al-ḥayata ad-dunya ɛala al-ʼaxirati wa ʼanna Allaha la yahdi al-qawma al-kafirin.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ṭabaɛa Allahu ɛala qulubihim wa samɛihim wa ʼabṣarihim wa ʼulaʼika humu al-ɣafilun.
La jarama ʼannahum fi al-ʼaxirati humu al-xasirun.
Ṯumma ʼinna rabbaka lillaḏina hajaru min baɛdi ma futinu ṯumma jahadu wa ṣabaru ʼinna rabbaka min baɛdiha laɣafurun raḥimun.
Yawma taʼti kullu nafsin tujadilu ɛan nafsiha wa tuwaffa kullu nafsin ma ɛamilat wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
Wa ḍaraba Allahu maṯalan qaryatan kanat ʼaminatan muṭmaʼinnatan yaʼtiha rizquha raɣadan min kulli makanin fakafarat biʼanɛumi Allahi faʼaḏaqaha Allahu libasa al-juɛi wa al-xawfi bima kanu yaṣnaɛun.
Wa laqad jaʼahum rasulun minhum fakaḏḏabuhu faʼaxaḏahumu al-ɛaḏabu wa hum ḏ̣alimun.
Fakulu mimma razaqakumu Allahu ḥalalan ṭayyiban wa ackuru niɛmata Allahi ʼin kuntum ʼiyahu taɛbudun.
ʼinnama ḥarrama ɛalaykumu al-maytata wa ad-dama wa laḥma al-xinziri wa ma ʼuhilla liɣayri Allahi bihi faman aḍṭurra ɣayra baɣin wa la ɛadin faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa la taqulu lima taṣifu ʼalsinatukumu al-kaḏiba haḏa ḥalalun wa haḏa ḥaramun litaftaru ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba ʼinna al-laḏina yaftaruna ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba la yufliḥun.
Mataɛun qalilun wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa ɛala al-laḏina hadu ḥarramna ma qaṣaṣna ɛalayka min qablu wa ma ḏ̣alamnahum wa lakin kanu ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.
Ṯumma ʼinna rabbaka lillaḏina ɛamilu as-suʼa bijahalatin ṯumma tabu min baɛdi ḏalika wa ʼaṣlaḥu ʼinna rabbaka min baɛdiha laɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼinna ʼibrahima kana ʼummatan qanitan Lillahi ḥanifan wa lam yaku mina al-mucrikin.
Cakiran liʼnɛumihi ajtabahu wa hadahu ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqim.
Wa ʼatakum min kulli ma saʼaltumuhu wa ʼin taɛuddu niɛmata Allahi la tuḥṣuha ʼinna al-ʼinsana laḏ̣alumun kaffarun.
Ṯumma ʼawḥayna ʼilayka ʼani attabiɛ millata ʼibrahima ḥanifan wa ma kana mina al-mucrikin.
ʼinnama juɛila as-sabtu ɛala al-laḏina axtalafu fihi wa ʼinna rabbaka layaḥkumu baynahum yawma al-qiyamati fima kanu fihi yaxtalifun.
Adɛu ʼila sabili rabbika bil-ḥikmati wa al-mawɛiḏ̣ati al-ḥasanati wa jadilhum bi-ati hiya ʼaḥsanu ʼinna rabbaka huwa ʼaɛlamu biman ḍalla ɛan sabilihi wa huwa ʼaɛlamu bil-muhtadin.
Wa ʼin ɛaqabtum faɛaqibu bimiṯli ma ɛuqibtum bihi wa laʼin ṣabartum lahuwa xayrun lilṣṣabirin.
Wa aṣbir wa ma ṣabruka ʼilla Billahi wa la taḥzan ɛalayhim wa la taku fi ḍayqin mimma yamkurun.
ʼinna Allaha maɛa al-laḏina attaqaw wa al-laḏina hum muḥsinun.
Subḥana al-laḏi ʼasra biɛabdihi laylan mina al-masjidi al-ḥarami ʼila al-masjidi al-ʼaqṣa al-laḏi barakna ḥawlahu linuriyahu min ʼayatina ʼinnahu huwa as-samiɛu al-baṣir.
Wa ʼatayna musa al-kitaba wa jaɛalnahu hudan libani ʼisraʼila ʼalla tattaxiḏu min duni wa kilan.
Ḏurriyata man ḥamalna maɛa nuḥin ʼinnahu kana ɛabdan cakuran.
Wa qaḍayna ʼila bani ʼisraʼila fi al-kitabi latufsidunna fi al-ʼarḍi marratayni wa lataɛlunna ɛuluwan kabiran.
Faʼiḏa jaʼa waɛdu ʼulahuma baɛaṯna ɛalaykum ɛibadan lana ʼuli baʼsin cadidin fajasu xilala ad-diyari wa kana waɛdan mafɛulan.
Ṯumma radadna lakumu al-karrata ɛalayhim wa ʼamdadnakum biʼamwalin wa banina wa jaɛalnakum ʼakṯara nafiran.
ʼin ʼaḥsantum ʼaḥsantum liʼnfusikum wa ʼin ʼasaʼtum falaha faʼiḏa jaʼa waɛdu al-ʼaxirati liyasuʼ wujuhakum wa liyadxulu al-masjida kama daxaluhu ʼawwala marratin wa liyutabbiru ma ɛalaw tatbiran.
Ɛasa rabbukum ʼan yarḥamakum wa ʼin ɛudtum ɛudna wa jaɛalna jahannama lilkafirina ḥaṣiran.
ʼinna haḏa al-qurʼana yahdi lillati hiya ʼaqwamu wa yubacciru al-muʼminina al-laḏina yaɛmaluna aṣ-ṣaliḥati ʼanna lahum ʼajran kabiran.
Wa ʼanna al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati ʼaɛtadna lahum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.
Wa yadɛu al-ʼinsanu bic-carri duɛaʼahu bil-xayri wa kana al-ʼinsanu ɛajulan.

Wa jaɛalna al-layla wa an-nahara ʼayatayni famaḥawna ʼayata al-layli wa jaɛalna ʼayata an-nahari mubṣiratan litabtaɣu faḍlan min rabbikum wa litaɛlamu ɛadada as-sinina wa al-ḥisaba wa kulla cayʼin faṣṣalnahu tafṣilan.
Wa kulla ʼinsanin ʼalzamnahu ṭaʼirahu fi ɛunuqihi wa nuxriju lahu yawma al-qiyamati kitaban yalqahu mancuran.
Aqraʼ kitabaka kafa binafsika al-yawma ɛalayka ḥasiban.
Mani ahtada faʼinnama yahtadi linafsihi wa man ḍalla faʼinnama yaḍillu ɛalayha wa la taziru waziratun wizra ʼuxra wa ma kunna muɛaḏḏibina ḥatta nabɛaṯa rasulan.
Wa ʼiḏa ʼaradna ʼan nuhlika qaryatan ʼamarna mutrafiha fafasaqu fiha faḥaqqa ɛalayha al-qawlu fadammarnaha tadmiran.
Wa kam ʼahlakna mina al-quruni min baɛdi nuḥin wa kafa birabbika biḏunubi ɛibadihi xabiran baṣiran.
Man kana yuridu al-ɛajilata ɛajjalna lahu fiha ma nacaʼu liman nuridu ṯumma jaɛalna lahu jahannama yaṣlaha maḏmuman madḥuran.
Wa man ʼarada al-ʼaxirata wa saɛa laha saɛyaha wa huwa muʼminun faʼulaʼika kana saɛyuhum mackuran.
Kullan numiddu haʼuulaʼ wa haʼuulaʼ min ɛaṭaʼi rabbika wa ma kana ɛaṭaʼu rabbika maḥḏ̣uran.
Anḏ̣ur kayfa faḍḍalna baɛḍahum ɛala baɛḍin wa lalʼaxiratu ʼakbaru darajatin wa ʼakbaru tafḍilan.
La tajɛal maɛa Allahi ʼilahan ʼaxara fataqɛuda maḏmuman maxḏulan.
Wa qaḍa rabbuka ʼalla taɛbudu ʼilla ʼiyahu wa bil-walidayni ʼiḥsanan ʼimma yabluɣanna ɛindaka al-kibara ʼaḥaduhuma ʼaw kilahuma fala taqul lahuma ʼuffin wa la tanharhuma wa qul lahuma qawlan kariman.
Wa axfiḍ lahuma janaḥa aḏ-ḏulli mina ar-raḥmati wa qul rrabbi arḥamhuma kama rabbayani ṣaɣiran.
Rabbukum ʼaɛlamu bima fi nufusikum ʼin takunu ṣaliḥina faʼinnahu kana lilʼawwabina ɣafuran.
Wa ʼati ḏa al-qurba ḥaqqahu wa al-miskina wa abna as-sabili wa la tubaḏḏir tabḏiran.
ʼinna al-mubaḏḏirina kanu ʼixwana ac-cayaṭini wa kana ac-cayṭanu lirabbihi kafuran.
Wa ʼimma tuɛriḍanna ɛanhumu abtiɣaʼa raḥmatin min rabbika tarjuha faqul lahum qawlan maysuran.
Wa la tajɛal yadaka maɣlulatan ʼila ɛunuqika wa la tabsuṭha kulla al-basṭi fataqɛuda maluman maḥsuran.
ʼinna rabbaka yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu wa yaqdiru ʼinnahu kana biɛibadihi xabiran baṣiran.
Wa la taqtulu ʼawladakum xacyata ʼimlaqin naḥnu narzuquhum wa ʼiyakum ʼinna qatlahum kana xiṭʼan kabiran.
Wa la taqrabu az-zina ʼinnahu kana faḥicatan wa saʼa sabilan.
Wa la taqtulu an-nafsa allati ḥarrama Allahu ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi wa man qutila maḏ̣luman faqad jaɛalna liwaliyihi sulṭanan fala yusrif fi al-qatli ʼinnahu kana manṣuran.
Wa la taqrabu mala al-yatimi ʼilla bi-ati hiya ʼaḥsanu ḥatta yabluɣa ʼacuddahu wa ʼawfu bil-ɛahdi ʼinna al-ɛahda kana masʼulan.
Wa ʼawfu al-kayla ʼiḏa kiltum wa zinu bil-qisṭasi al-mustaqimi ḏalika xayrun wa ʼaḥsanu taʼwilan.
Wa la taqfu ma laysa laka bihi ɛilmun ʼinna as-samɛa wa al-baṣara wa al-fuʼada kullu ʼulaʼika kana ɛanhu masʼulan.
Wa la tamci fi al-ʼarḍi maraḥan ʼinnaka lan taxriqa al-ʼarḍa wa lan tabluɣa al-jibala ṭulan.
Kullu ḏalika kana sayyiʼuhu ɛinda rabbika makruhan.
Ḏalika mimma ʼawḥa ʼilayka rabbuka mina al-ḥikmati wa la tajɛal maɛa Allahi ʼilahan ʼaxara fatulqa fi jahannama maluman madḥuran.
ʼafaʼaṣfakum rabbukum bil-banina wa attaxaḏa mina al-malaʼikati ʼinaṯan ʼinnakum lataquluna qawlan ɛaḏ̣iman.
Wa laqad ṣarrafna fi haḏa al-qurʼani liyaḏḏakkaru wa ma yaziduhum ʼilla nufuran.
Qul law kana maɛahu ʼalihatun kama yaquluna ʼiḏan labtaɣaw ʼila ḏi al-ɛarci sabilan.
Subḥanahu wa taɛala ɛamma yaquluna ɛuluwan kabiran.
Tusabbiḥu lahu as-samawatu as-sabɛu wa al-ʼarḍu wa man fihinna wa ʼin min cayʼin ʼilla yusabbiḥu biḥamdihi wa lakin la tafqahuna tasbiḥahum ʼinnahu kana ḥaliman ɣafuran.
Wa ʼiḏa qaraʼta al-qurʼana jaɛalna baynaka wa bayna al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati ḥijaban masturan.
Wa jaɛalna ɛala qulubihim ʼakinnatan ʼan yafqahuhu wa fi ʼaḏanihim waqran wa ʼiḏa ḏakarta rabbaka fi al-qurʼani waḥdahu wa llaw ɛala ʼadbarihim nufuran.
Naḥnu ʼaɛlamu bima yastamiɛuna bihi ʼiḏ yastamiɛuna ʼilayka wa ʼiḏ hum najwa ʼiḏ yaqulu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna ʼin tattabiɛuna ʼilla rajulan masḥuran.
Anḏ̣ur kayfa ḍarabu laka al-ʼamṯala faḍallu fala yastaṭiɛuna sabilan.
Wa qalu ʼaʼiḏa kunna ɛiḏ̣aman wa rufatan ʼaʼinna lamabɛuṯuna xalqan jadidan.
Qul kunu ḥijaratan ʼaw ḥadidan.
ʼaw xalqan mimma yakburu fi ṣudurikum fasayaquluna man yuɛiduna quli al-laḏi faṭarakum ʼawwala marratin fasayunɣiḍuna ʼilayka ruʼsahum wa yaquluna mata huwa qul ɛasa ʼan yakuna qariban.
Yawma yadɛukum fatastajibuna biḥamdihi wa taḏ̣unnuna ʼin labiṯtum ʼilla qalilan.
Wa qul liɛibadi yaqulu allati hiya ʼaḥsanu ʼinna ac-cayṭana yanzaɣu baynahum ʼinna ac-cayṭana kana lilʼinsani ɛaduwan mubinan.
Rabbukum ʼaɛlamu bikum ʼin yacaʼ yarḥamkum ʼaw ʼin yacaʼ yuɛaḏḏibkum wa ma ʼarsalnaka ɛalayhim wa kilan.
Wa rabbuka ʼaɛlamu biman fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa laqad faḍḍalna baɛḍa an-nabiyina ɛala baɛḍin wa ʼatayna dawuda zaburan.
Quli adɛu al-laḏina zaɛamtum min dunihi fala yamlikuna kacfa aḍ-ḍurri ɛankum wa la taḥwilan.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina yadɛuna yabtaɣuna ʼila rabbihimu al-wasilata ʼayyuhum ʼaqrabu wa yarjuna raḥmatahu wa yaxafuna ɛaḏabahu ʼinna ɛaḏaba rabbika kana maḥḏuran.
Wa ʼin min qaryatin ʼilla naḥnu muhlikuha qabla yawmi al-qiyamati ʼaw muɛaḏḏibuha ɛaḏaban cadidan kana ḏalika fi al-kitabi masṭuran.
Wa ma manaɛana ʼan nursila bil-ʼayati ʼilla ʼan kaḏḏaba biha al-ʼawwaluna wa ʼatayna ṯamuda an-naqata mubṣiratan faḏ̣alamu biha wa ma nursilu bil-ʼayati ʼilla taxwifan.

Wa ʼiḏ qulna laka ʼinna rabbaka ʼaḥaṭa bin-nasi wa ma jaɛalna ar-ruʼya allati ʼaraynaka ʼilla fitnatan lilnnasi wa ac-cajarata al-malɛunata fi al-qurʼani wa nuxawwifuhum fama yaziduhum ʼilla ṭuɣyanan kabiran.
Wa ʼiḏ qulna lilmalaʼikati asjudu liʼdama fasajadu ʼilla ʼiblisa qala ʼaʼasjudu liman xalaqta ṭinan.
Qala ʼaraʼaytaka haḏa al-laḏi karramta ɛalayya laʼin ʼaxxartani ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati laʼaḥtanikanna ḏurriyatahu ʼilla qalilan.
Qala aḏ/hab faman tabiɛaka minhum faʼinna jahannama jazaʼuukum jazaʼan mawfuran.
Wa astafziz mani astaṭaɛta minhum biṣawtika wa ʼajlib ɛalayhim bixaylika wa rajilika wa carik/hum fi al-ʼamwli wa al-ʼawladi wa ɛid/hum wa ma yaɛiduhum ac-cayṭanu ʼilla ɣururan.
ʼinna ɛibadi laysa laka ɛalayhim sulṭanun wa kafa birabbika wa kilan.
Rabbukumu al-laḏi yuzji lakumu al-fulka fi al-baḥri litabtaɣu min faḍlihi ʼinnahu kana bikum raḥiman.
Wa ʼiḏa massakumu aḍ-ḍurru fi al-baḥri ḍalla man tadɛuna ʼilla ʼiyahu falamma najjakum ʼila al-barri ʼaɛraḍtum wa kana al-ʼinsanu kafuran.
ʼafaʼamintum ʼan yaxsifa bikum janiba al-barri ʼaw yursila ɛalaykum ḥaṣiban ṯumma la tajidu lakum wa kilan.
ʼam ʼamintum ʼan yuɛidakum fihi taratan ʼuxra fayursila ɛalaykum qaṣifan mina ar-riḥi fayuɣriqakum bima kafartum ṯumma la tajidu lakum ɛalayna bihi tabiɛan.
Wa laqad karramna bani ʼadama wa ḥamalnahum fi al-barri wa al-baḥri wa razaqnahum mina aṭ-ṭayyibati wa faḍḍalnahum ɛala kaṯirin mimman xalaqna tafḍilan.
Yawma nadɛu kulla ʼunasin biʼimamihim faman ʼutiya kitabahu biyaminihi faʼulaʼika yaqraʼuna kitabahum wa la yuḏ̣lamuna fatilan.
Wa man kana fi haḏihi ʼaɛma fahuwa fi al-ʼaxirati ʼaɛma wa ʼaḍallu sabilan.
Wa ʼin kadu layaftinunaka ɛani al-laḏi ʼawḥayna ʼilayka litaftariya ɛalayna ɣayrahu wa ʼiḏan lattaxaḏuka xalilan.
Wa lawla ʼan ṯabbatnaka laqad kidtta tarkanu ʼilayhim cayʼan qalilan.
ʼiḏan laʼaḏaqnaka ḍiɛfa al-ḥayati wa ḍiɛfa al-mamati ṯumma la tajidu laka ɛalayna naṣiran.
Wa ʼin kadu layastafizzunaka mina al-ʼarḍi liyuxrijuka minha wa ʼiḏan la yalbaṯuna xilafaka ʼilla qalilan.
Sunnata man qad ʼarsalna qablaka min rusulina wa la tajidu lisunnatina taḥwilan.
ʼaqimi aṣ-ṣalata liduluki ac-camsi ʼila ɣasaqi al-layli wa qurʼana al-fajri ʼinna qurʼana al-fajri kana mac/hudan.
Wa mina al-layli fatahajjad bihi nafilatan laka ɛasa ʼan yabɛaṯaka rabbuka maqaman maḥmudan.
Wa qul rabbi ʼadxilni mudxala ṣidqin wa ʼaxrijni muxraja ṣidqin wa ajɛal li min ladunka sulṭanan naṣiran.
Wa qul jaʼa al-ḥaqqu wa zahaqa al-baṭilu ʼinna al-baṭila kana zahuqan.
Wa nunazzilu mina al-qurʼani ma huwa cifaʼun wa raḥmatun lilmuʼminina wa la yazidu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina ʼilla xasaran.
Wa ʼiḏa ʼanɛamna ɛala al-ʼinsani ʼaɛraḍa wa naʼa bijanibihi wa ʼiḏa massahu ac-carru kana yaʼusan.
Qul kullun yaɛmalu ɛala cakilatihi farabbukum ʼaɛlamu biman huwa ʼahda sabilan.
Wa yasʼalunaka ɛani ar-ruḥi quli ar-ruḥu min ʼamri rabbi wa ma ʼutitum mina al-ɛilmi ʼilla qalilan.
Wa laʼin ciʼna lanaḏ/habanna bial-laḏi ʼawḥayna ʼilayka ṯumma la tajidu laka bihi ɛalayna wa kilan.
ʼilla raḥmatan min rabbika ʼinna faḍlahu kana ɛalayka kabiran.
Qul laʼini ajtamaɛati al-ʼinsu wa al-jinnu ɛala ʼan yaʼtu bimiṯli haḏa al-qurʼani la yaʼtuna bimiṯlihi wa law kana baɛḍuhum libaɛḍin ḏ̣ahiran.
Wa laqad ṣarrafna lilnnasi fi haḏa al-qurʼani min kulli maṯalin faʼaba ʼakṯaru an-nasi ʼilla kufuran.
Wa qalu lan nuʼmina laka ḥatta tafjura lana mina al-ʼarḍi yanbuɛan.
ʼaw takuna laka jannatun min naxilin wa ɛinabin fatufajjira al-ʼanhara xilalaha tafjiran.
ʼaw tusqiṭa as-samaʼa kama zaɛamta ɛalayna kisafan ʼaw taʼtiya Billahi wa al-malaʼikati qabilan.
ʼaw yakuna laka baytun min zuxrufin ʼaw tarqa fi as-samaʼi wa lan nuʼmina liruqiyika ḥatta tunazzila ɛalayna kitaban naqraʼuuhu qul subḥana rabbi hal kuntu ʼilla bacaran rasulan.
Wa ma manaɛa an-nasa ʼan yuʼminu ʼiḏ jaʼahumu al-huda ʼilla ʼan qalu ʼabaɛaṯa Allahu bacaran rasulan.
Qul law kana fi al-ʼarḍi malaʼikatun yamcuna muṭmaʼinnina lanazzalna ɛalayhim mina as-samaʼi malakan rasulan.
Qul kafa Billahi cahidan bayni wa baynakum ʼinnahu kana biɛibadihi xabiran baṣiran.

Wa man yahdi Allahu fahuwa al-muhtadi wa man yuḍlil falan tajida lahum ʼawliyaʼa min dunihi wa naḥcuruhum yawma al-qiyamati ɛala wajuhihim ɛumyan wa bukman wa ṣumman maʼwahum jahannamu kullama xabat zidnahum saɛiran.
Ḏalika jazaʼuuhum biʼannahum kafaru biʼayatina wa qalu ʼaʼiḏa kunna ɛiḏ̣aman wa rufatan ʼaʼinna lamabɛuṯuna xalqan jadidan.
ʼawalam yaraw ʼanna Allaha al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa qadirun ɛala ʼan yaxluqa miṯlahum wa jaɛala lahum ʼajalan la rayba fihi faʼaba aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna ʼilla kufuran.
Qul law ʼantum tamlikuna xazaʼina raḥmati rabbi ʼiḏan laʼamsaktum xacyata al-ʼinfaqi wa kana al-ʼinsanu qaturan.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa tisɛa ʼayatin bayyinatin fasʼl bani ʼisraʼila ʼiḏ jaʼahum faqala lahu firɛawnu ʼinni laʼaḏ̣unnuka yamusa masḥuran.
Qala laqad ɛalimta ma ʼanzala haʼuulaʼ ʼilla rabbu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi baṣaʼira wa ʼinni laʼaḏ̣unnuka ya firɛawnu maṯburan.
Faʼarada ʼan yastafizzahum mina al-ʼarḍi faʼaɣraqnahu wa man maɛahu jamiɛan.
Wa qulna min baɛdihi libani ʼisraʼila askunu al-ʼarḍa faʼiḏa jaʼa waɛdu al-ʼaxirati jiʼna bikum lafifan.
Wa bil-ḥaqqi ʼanzalnahu wa bil-ḥaqqi nazala wa ma ʼarsalnaka ʼilla mubacciran wa naḏiran.
Wa qurʼanan faraqnahu litaqraʼahu ɛala an-nasi ɛala mukṯin wa nazzalnahu tanzilan.
Qul ʼaminu bihi ʼaw la tuʼminu ʼinna al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma min qablihi ʼiḏa yutla ɛalayhim yaxirruna lilʼaḏqani sujjadan.
Wa yaquluna subḥana rabbina ʼin kana waɛdu rabbina lamafɛulan.
Wa yaxirruna lilʼaḏqani yabkuna wa yaziduhum xucuɛan.
Qul adɛu Allaha ʼaw adɛu ar-raḥmana ʼayyanmma tadɛu falahu al-ʼasmaʼu al-ḥusna wa la tajhar biṣalatika wa la tuxafit biha wa abtaɣi bayna ḏalika sabilan.
Wa quli al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi lam yattaxiḏ waladan wa lam yakun lahu carikun fi al-mulki wa lam yakun lahu wa liyun mina aḏ-ḏulli wa kabbirhu takbiran.
Al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi ʼanzala ɛala ɛabdihi al-kitaba wa lam yajɛal llahu ɛiwaj.
Qayyiman liyunḏira baʼsan cadidan min ladunhu wa yubaccira al-muʼminina al-laḏina yaɛmaluna aṣ-ṣaliḥati ʼanna lahum ʼajran ḥasanan.
Makiṯina fihi ʼabadan.
Wa yunḏira al-laḏina qalu attaxaḏa Allahu waladan.
Mma lahum bihi min ɛilmin wa la liʼabaʼihim kaburat kalimatan taxruju min ʼafwahihim ʼin yaquluna ʼilla kaḏiban.
Falaɛallaka baxiɛun nafsaka ɛala ʼaṯarihim ʼin lam yuʼminu bihaḏa al-ḥadiṯi ʼasafan.
ʼinna jaɛalna ma ɛala al-ʼarḍi zinatan laha linabluwahum ʼayyuhum ʼaḥsanu ɛamalan.
Wa ʼinna lajaɛiluna ma ɛalayha ṣaɛidan juruzan.
ʼam ḥasibta ʼanna ʼaṣḥaba al-kahfi wa ar-raqimi kanu min ʼayatina ɛajaban.
ʼiḏ ʼawa al-fityatu ʼila al-kahfi faqalu rabbana ʼatina min ladunka raḥmatan wa hayyiʼ lana min ʼamrina racadan.
Faḍarabna ɛala ʼaḏanihim fi al-kahfi sinina ɛadadan.
Ṯumma baɛaṯnahum linaɛlama ʼayyu al-ḥizbayni ʼaḥṣa lima labiṯu ʼamadan.
Naḥnu naquṣṣu ɛalayka nabaʼahum bil-ḥaqqi ʼinnahum fityatun ʼamanu birabbihim wa zidnahum hudan.
Wa rabaṭna ɛala qulubihim ʼiḏ qamu faqalu rabbuna rabbu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi lan nadɛuwa min dunihi ʼilahan laqad qulna ʼiḏan caṭaṭan.
Haʼuulaʼ qawmuna attaxaḏu min dunihi ʼalihatan lawla yaʼtuna ɛalayhim bisulṭanin bayyinin faman ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban.
Wa ʼiḏ aɛtazaltumuhum wa ma yaɛbuduna ʼilla Allaha faʼwu ʼila al-kahfi yancur lakum rabbukum min raḥmatihi wa yuhayyiʼ lakum min ʼamrikum mirfaqan.

Wa tara ac-camsa ʼiḏa ṭalaɛat tazawaru ɛan kahfihim ḏata al-yamini wa ʼiḏa ɣarabat taqriḍuhum ḏata ac-cimali wa hum fi fajwatin minhu ḏalika min ʼayati Allahi man yahdi Allahu fahuwa al-muhtadi wa man yuḍlil falan tajida lahu waliyan murcidan.

Wa taḥsabuhum ʼayqaḏ̣an wa hum ruqudun wa nuqallibuhum ḏata al-yamini wa ḏata ac-cimali wa kalbuhum basiṭun ḏiraɛayhi bil-waṣidi lawi aṭṭalaɛta ɛalayhim lawallayta minhum firaran wa lamuliʼta minhum ruɛban.

Wa kaḏalika baɛaṯnahum liyatasaʼalu baynahum qala qaʼilun minhum kam labiṯtum qalu labiṯna yawman ʼaw baɛḍa yawmin qalu rabbukum ʼaɛlamu bima labiṯtum fabɛaṯu ʼaḥadakum biwariqikum haḏihi ʼila al-madinati falyanḏ̣ur ʼayyuha ʼazka ṭaɛaman falyaʼtikum birizqin minhu wa liatalaṭṭaf wa la yucɛiranna bikum ʼaḥadan.
ʼinnahum ʼin yaḏ̣haru ɛalaykum yarjumukum ʼaw yuɛidukum fi millatihim wa lan tufliḥu ʼiḏan ʼabadan.

Wa kaḏalika ʼaɛṯarna ɛalayhim liyaɛlamu ʼanna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun wa ʼanna as-saɛata la rayba fiha ʼiḏ yatanazaɛuna baynahum ʼamrahum faqalu abnu ɛalayhim bunyanan rabbuhum ʼaɛlamu bihim qala al-laḏina ɣalabu ɛala ʼamrihim lanattaxiḏanna ɛalayhim masjidan.

Sayaquluna ṯalaṯatun rabiɛuhum kalbuhum wa yaquluna xamsatun sadisuhum kalbuhum rajman bil-ɣaybi wa yaquluna sabɛatun wa ṯaminuhum kalbuhum qul rabbi ʼaɛlamu biɛiddatihim ma yaɛlamuhum ʼilla qalilun fala tumari fihim ʼilla miraʼan ḏ̣ahiran wa la tastafti fihim minhum ʼaḥadan.
Wa la taqulanna licayʼin ʼinni faɛilun ḏalika ɣadan.
ʼilla ʼan yacaʼa Allahu wa aḏkur rabbaka ʼiḏa nasita wa qul ɛasa ʼan yahdiyani rabbi liʼqraba min haḏa racadan.
Wa labiṯu fi kahfihim ṯalaṯa miaʼatin sinina wa azdadu tisɛan.
Quli Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima labiṯu lahu ɣaybu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼabṣir bihi wa ʼasmiɛ ma lahum min dunihi min wa liyin wa la yucriku fi ḥukmihi ʼaḥadan.
Wa atlu ma ʼuḥiya ʼilayka min kitabi rabbika la mubaddila likalimatihi wa lan tajida min dunihi multaḥadan.

Wa aṣbir nafsaka maɛa al-laḏina yadɛuna rabbahum bil-ɣadati wa al-ɛaciyi yuriduna wajhahu wa la taɛdu ɛaynaka ɛanhum turidu zinata al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa la tuṭiɛ man ʼaɣfalna qalbahu ɛan ḏikrina wa attabaɛa hawahu wa kana ʼamruhu furuṭan.

Wa quli al-ḥaqqu min rabbikum faman caʼa falyuʼmin wa man caʼa falyakfur ʼinna ʼaɛtadna lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina naran ʼaḥaṭa bihim suradiquha wa ʼin yastaɣiṯu yuɣaṯu bimaʼin kalmuhli yacwi al-wujuha biʼsa ac-carabu wa saʼat murtafaqan.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati ʼinna la nuḍiɛu ʼajra man ʼaḥsana ɛamalan.

ʼulaʼika lahum jannatu ɛadnin tajri min taḥtihimu al-ʼanharu yuḥallawna fiha min ʼasawira min ḏahabin wa yalbasuna ṯiyaban xuḍran min sundusin wa ʼistabraqin muttakiʼina fiha ɛala al-ʼaraʼiki niɛma aṯ-ṯawabu wa ḥasunat murtafaqan.
Wa aḍrib lahum maṯalan rajulayni jaɛalna liʼḥadihima jannatayni min ʼaɛnabin wa ḥafafnahuma binaxlin wa jaɛalna baynahuma zarɛan.
Kilta al-jannatayni ʼatat ʼukulaha wa lam taḏ̣lim minhu cayʼan wa fajjarna xilalahuma naharan.
Wa kana lahu ṯamarun faqala liṣaḥibihi wa huwa yuḥawiruhu ʼana ʼakṯaru minka malan wa ʼaɛazzu nafaran.
Wa daxala jannatahu wa huwa ḏ̣alimun linafsihi qala ma ʼaḏ̣unnu ʼan tabida haḏihi ʼabadan.
Wa ma ʼaḏ̣unnu as-saɛata qaʼimatan wa laʼin rudidtu ʼila rabbi laʼajidanna xayran minha munqalaban.
Qala lahu ṣaḥibuhu wa huwa yuḥawiruhu ʼakafarta bial-laḏi xalaqaka min turabin ṯumma min nuṭfatin ṯumma sawwaka rajulan.
Lakinna huwa Allahu rabbi wa la ʼucriku birabbi ʼaḥadan.
Wa lawla ʼiḏ daxalta jannataka qulta ma caʼa Allahu la quwata ʼilla Billahi ʼin tarani ʼana ʼaqalla minka malan wa waladan.
Faɛasa rabbi ʼan yuʼtiyani xayran min jannatika wa yursila ɛalayha ḥusbanan mina as-samaʼi fatuṣbiḥa ṣaɛidan zalaqan.
ʼaw yuṣbiḥa maʼuuha ɣawran falan tastaṭiɛa lahu ṭalaban.
Wa ʼuḥiṭa biṯamarihi faʼaṣbaḥa yuqallibu kaffayhi ɛala ma ʼanfaqa fiha wa hiya xawiyatun ɛala ɛuruciha wa yaqulu ya laytani lam ʼucrik birabbi ʼaḥadan.
Wa lam takun lahu fiʼatun yanṣurunahu min duni Allahi wa ma kana muntaṣiran.
Hunalika al-walayatu Lillahi al-ḥaqqi huwa xayrun ṯawaban wa xayrun ɛuqban.
Wa aḍrib lahum maṯala al-ḥayati ad-dunya kamaʼin ʼanzalnahu mina as-samaʼi faxtalaṭa bihi nabatu al-ʼarḍi faʼaṣbaḥa haciman taḏruhu ar-riyaḥu wa kana Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin muqtadiran.
Al-malu wa al-banuna zinatu al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa al-baqiyatu aṣ-ṣaliḥatu xayrun ɛinda rabbika ṯawaban wa xayrun ʼamalan.
Wa yawma nusayyiru al-jibala wa tara al-ʼarḍa barizatan wa ḥacarnahum falam nuɣadir minhum ʼaḥadan.
Wa ɛuriḍu ɛala rabbika ṣaffan laqad jiʼtumuna kama xalaqnakum ʼawwala marratin bal zaɛamtum ʼallan najɛala lakum mawɛidan.

Wa wuḍiɛa al-kitabu fatara al-mujrimina mucfiqina mimma fihi wa yaquluna ya waylatana mali haḏa al-kitabi la yuɣadiru ṣaɣiratan wa la kabiratan ʼilla ʼaḥṣaha wa wajadu ma ɛamilu ḥaḍiran wa la yaḏ̣limu rabbuka ʼaḥadan.

Wa ʼiḏ qulna lilmalaʼikati asjudu liʼdama fasajadu ʼilla ʼiblisa kana mina al-jinni fafasaqa ɛan ʼamri rabbihi ʼafatattaxiḏunahu wa ḏurriyatahu ʼawliyaʼa min duni wa hum lakum ɛaduwun biʼsa lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina badalan.
Ma ʼac/hadtuhum xalqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa la xalqa ʼanfusihim wa ma kuntu muttaxiḏa al-muḍillina ɛaḍudan.
Wa yawma yaqulu nadu curakaʼiya al-laḏina zaɛamtum fadaɛawhum falam yastajibu lahum wa jaɛalna baynahum mawbiqan.
Wa raʼa al-mujrimuna an-nara faḏ̣annu ʼannahum muwaqiɛuha wa lam yajidu ɛanha maṣrifan.
Wa laqad ṣarrafna fi haḏa al-qurʼani lilnnasi min kulli maṯalin wa kana al-ʼinsanu ʼakṯara cayʼin jadalan.
Wa ma manaɛa an-nasa ʼan yuʼminu ʼiḏ jaʼahumu al-huda wa yastaɣfiru rabbahum ʼilla ʼan taʼtiyahum sunnatu al-ʼawwalina ʼaw yaʼtiyahumu al-ɛaḏabu qubulan.
Wa ma nursilu al-mursalina ʼilla mubaccirina wa munḏirina wa yujadilu al-laḏina kafaru bil-baṭili liyudḥiḍu bihi al-ḥaqqa wa attaxaḏu ʼayati wa ma ʼunḏiru huzuan.

Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman ḏukkira biʼayati rabbihi faʼaɛraḍa ɛanha wa nasiya ma qaddamat yadahu ʼinna jaɛalna ɛala qulubihim ʼakinnatan ʼan yafqahuhu wa fi ʼaḏanihim waqran wa ʼin tadɛuhum ʼila al-huda falan yahtadu ʼiḏan ʼabadan.
Wa rabbuka al-ɣafuru ḏu ar-raḥmati law yuʼaxiḏuhum bima kasabu laɛajjala lahumu al-ɛaḏaba bal lahum mawɛidun lan yajidu min dunihi mawʼilan.
Wa tilka al-qura ʼahlaknahum lamma ḏ̣alamu wa jaɛalna limahlikihim mawɛidan.
Wa ʼiḏ qala musa lifatahu la ʼabraḥu ḥatta ʼabluɣa majmaɛa al-baḥrayni ʼaw ʼamḍiya ḥuquban.
Falamma balaɣa majmaɛa baynihima nasiya ḥutahuma fa attaxaḏa sabilahu fi al-baḥri saraban.
Falamma jawaza qala lifatahu ʼatina ɣadaʼana laqad laqina min safarina haḏa naṣaban.
Qala ʼaraʼayta ʼiḏ ʼawayna ʼila aṣ-ṣaxrati faʼinni nasitu al-ḥuta wa ma ʼansanihu ʼilla ac-cayṭanu ʼan ʼaḏkurahu wa attaxaḏa sabilahu fi al-baḥri ɛajaban.
Qala ḏalika ma kunna nabɣi fartadda ɛala ʼaṯarihima qaṣaṣan.
Fawajada ɛabdan min ɛibadina ʼataynahu raḥmatan min ɛindina wa ɛallamnahu min ladunna ɛilman.
Qala lahu musa hal ʼattabiɛuka ɛala ʼan tuɛallimani mimma ɛullimta rucdan.
Qala ʼinnaka lan tastaṭiɛa maɛi ṣabran.
Wa kayfa taṣbiru ɛala ma lam tuḥiṭ bihi xubran.
Qala satajiduni ʼin caʼa Allahu ṣabiran wa la ʼaɛṣi laka ʼamran.
Qala faʼin attabaɛtani fala tasʼalni ɛan cayʼin ḥatta ʼuḥdiṯa laka minhu ḏikran.
Fanṭalaqa ḥatta ʼiḏa rakiba fi as-safinati xaraqaha qala ʼaxaraqtaha lituɣriqa ʼahlaha laqad jiʼta cayʼan ʼimran.
Qala ʼalam ʼaqul ʼinnaka lan tastaṭiɛa maɛiya ṣabran.
Qala la tuʼaxiḏni bima nasitu wa la turhiqni min ʼamri ɛusran.
Fanṭalaqa ḥatta ʼiḏa laqiya ɣulaman faqatalahu qala ʼaqatalta nafsan zakiyatan biɣayri nafsin laqad jiʼta cayʼan nukran.
Qala ʼalam ʼaqul laka ʼinnaka lan tastaṭiɛa maɛiya ṣabran.
Qala ʼin saʼaltuka ɛan cayʼin baɛdaha fala tuṣaḥibni qad balaɣta min ladunni ɛuḏran.
Fanṭalaqa ḥatta ʼiḏa ʼataya ʼahla qaryatin astaṭɛama ʼahlaha faʼabaw ʼan yuḍayyifuhuma fawajada fiha jidaran yuridu ʼan yanqaḍḍa faʼaqamahu qala law ciʼta lattaxaḏta ɛalayhi ʼajran.
Qala haḏa firaqu bayni wa baynika saʼunabbiʼuka bitaʼwili ma lam tastaṭiɛ ɛalayhi ṣabran.
ʼamma as-safinatu fakanat limasakina yaɛmaluna fi al-baḥri faʼaradtu ʼan ʼaɛibaha wa kana waraʼahum malikun yaʼxuḏu kulla safinatin ɣaṣban.
Wa ʼamma al-ɣulamu fakana ʼabawahu muʼminayni faxacina ʼan yurhiqahuma ṭuɣyanan wa kufran.
Faʼaradna ʼan yubdilahuma rabbuhuma xayran minhu zakatan wa ʼaqraba ruḥman.

Wa ʼamma al-jidaru fakana liɣulamayni yatimayni fi al-madinati wa kana taḥtahu kanzun lahuma wa kana ʼabuhuma ṣaliḥan faʼarada rabbuka ʼan yabluɣa ʼacuddahuma wa yastaxrija kanzahuma raḥmatan min rabbika wa ma faɛaltuhu ɛan ʼamri ḏalika taʼwilu ma lam tasṭiɛ ɛalayhi ṣabran.
Wa yasʼalunaka ɛan ḏi al-qarnayni qul saʼatlu ɛalaykum minhu ḏikran.
ʼinna makkanna lahu fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼataynahu min kulli cayʼin sababan.
Faʼatbaɛa sababan.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa balaɣa maɣriba ac-camsi wajadaha taɣrubu fi ɛaynin ḥamiʼatin wa wajada ɛindaha qawman qulna ya ḏa al-qarnayni ʼimma ʼan tuɛaḏḏiba wa ʼimma ʼan tattaxiḏa fihim ḥusnan.
Qala ʼamma man ḏ̣alama fasawfa nuɛaḏḏibuhu ṯumma yuraddu ʼila rabbihi fayuɛaḏḏibuhu ɛaḏaban nukran.
Wa ʼamma man ʼamana wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan falahu jazaʼan al-ḥusna wa sanaqulu lahu min ʼamrina yusran.
Ṯumma ʼatbaɛa sababan.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa balaɣa maṭliɛa ac-camsi wajadaha taṭluɛu ɛala qawmin lam najɛal lahum min duniha sitran.
Kaḏalika wa qad ʼaḥaṭna bima ladayhi xubran.
Ṯumma ʼatbaɛa sababan.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa balaɣa bayna as-saddayni wajada min dunihima qawman la yakaduna yafqahuna qawlan.
Qalu ya ḏa al-qarnayni ʼinna yaʼjuja wa maʼjuja mufsiduna fi al-ʼarḍi fahal najɛalu laka xarjan ɛala ʼan tajɛala baynana wa baynahum saddan.
Qala ma makkanani fihi rabbi xayrun faʼaɛinuni biquwatin ʼajɛal baynakum wa baynahum radman.
ʼatuni zubara al-ḥadidi ḥatta ʼiḏa sawa bayna aṣ-ṣadafayni qala anfuxu ḥatta ʼiḏa jaɛalahu naran qala ʼatuni ʼufriɣ ɛalayhi qiṭran.
Fama asṭaɛu ʼan yaḏ̣haruhu wa ma astaṭaɛu lahu naqban.
Qala haḏa raḥmatun min rabbi faʼiḏa jaʼa waɛdu rabbi jaɛalahu dakkaʼa wa kana waɛdu rabbi ḥaqqan.
Wa tarakna baɛḍahum yawmaʼiḏin yamuju fi baɛḍin wa nufixa fi aṣ-ṣuri fajamaɛnahum jamɛan.
Wa ɛaraḍna jahannama yawmaʼiḏin lilkafirina ɛarḍan.
Al-laḏina kanat ʼaɛyunuhum fi ɣiṭaʼin ɛan ḏikri wa kanu la yastaṭiɛuna samɛan.
ʼafaḥasiba al-laḏina kafaru ʼan yattaxiḏu ɛibadi min duni ʼawliyaʼa ʼinna ʼaɛtadna jahannama lilkafirina nuzulan.
Qul hal nunabbiʼukum bil-ʼaxsarina ʼaɛmalan.
Al-laḏina ḍalla saɛyuhum fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa hum yaḥsabuna ʼannahum yuḥsinuna ṣunɛan.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina kafaru biʼayati rabbihim wa liqaʼihi faḥabiṭat ʼaɛmaluhum fala nuqimu lahum yawma al-qiyamati waznan.
Ḏalika jazaʼuuhum jahannamu bima kafaru wa attaxaḏu ʼayati wa rusuli huzuan.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati kanat lahum jannatu al-firdawsi nuzulan.
Xalidina fiha la yabɣuna ɛanha ḥiwalan.
Qul law kana al-baḥru midadan likalimati rabbi lanafida al-baḥru qabla ʼan tanfada kalimatu rabbi wa law jiʼna bimiṯlihi madadan.
Qul ʼinnama ʼana bacarun miṯlukum yuḥa ʼilayya ʼannama ʼilahukum ʼilahun waḥidun faman kana yarju liqaʼa rabbihi falyaɛmal ɛamalan ṣaliḥan wa la yucrik biɛibadati rabbihi ʼaḥadan.
Kaf-ha-ya-ɛayn-ṣad.
Ḏikru raḥmati rabbika ɛabdahu zakariy.
ʼiḏ nada rabbahu nidaʼan xafiyan.
Qala rabbi ʼinni wahana al-ɛaḏ̣mu minni wa actaɛala ar-raʼsu cayban wa lam ʼakun biduɛaʼika rabbi caqiyan.
Wa ʼinni xiftu al-mawaliya min waraʼi wa kanat amraʼati ɛaqiran fahab li min ladunka waliyan.
Yariṯuni wa yariṯu min ʼali yaɛquba wa ajɛalhu rabbi raḍiyan.
Ya zakariya ʼinna nubacciruka biɣulamin asmuhu yaḥya lam najɛal lahu min qablu samiyan.
Qala rabbi ʼanna yakunu li ɣulamun wa kanat amraʼati ɛaqiran wa qad balaɣtu mina al-kibari ɛitiyan.
Qala kaḏalika qala rabbuka huwa ɛalayya hayyinun wa qad xalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku cayʼan.
Qala rabbi ajɛal li ʼayatan qala ʼayatuka ʼalla tukallima an-nasa ṯalaṯa layalin sawiyan.
Faxaraja ɛala qawmihi mina al-miḥrabi faʼawḥa ʼilayhim ʼan sabbiḥu bukratan wa ɛaciyan.
Ya yaḥya xuḏ al-kitaba biquwatin wa ʼataynahu al-ḥukma ṣabiyan.
Wa ḥananan min ladunna wa zakatan wa kana taqiyan.
Wa barran biwalidayhi wa lam yakun jabbaran ɛaṣiyan.
Wa salamun ɛalayhi yawma wulida wa yawma yamutu wa yawma yubɛaṯu ḥayyan.
Wa aḏkur fi al-kitabi maryama ʼiḏ antabaḏat min ʼahliha makanan carqiyan.
Fattaxaḏat min dunihim ḥijaban faʼarsalna ʼilayha ruḥana fatamaṯṯala laha bacaran sawiyan.
Qalat ʼinni ʼaɛuḏu bir-raḥmani minka ʼin kunta taqiyan.
Qala ʼinnama ʼana rasulu rabbiki liʼhaba laki ɣulaman zakiyan.
Qalat ʼanna yakunu li ɣulamun wa lam yamsasni bacarun wa lam ʼaku baɣiyan.
Qala kaḏaliki qala rabbuki huwa ɛalayya hayyinun wa linajɛalahu ʼayatan lilnnasi wa raḥmatan minna wa kana ʼamran maqḍiyan.
Faḥamalat/hu fantabaḏat bihi makanan qaṣiyan.
Faʼajaʼaha al-maxaḍu ʼila jiḏɛi an-naxlati qalat ya laytani mittu qabla haḏa wa kuntu nasyan mansiyan.
Fanadaha min taḥtiha ʼalla taḥzani qad jaɛala rabbuki taḥtaki sariyan.
Wa huzzi ʼilayki bijiḏɛi an-naxlati tusaqiṭ ɛalayki ruṭaban janiyan.
Fakuli wa acrabi wa qarri ɛaynan faʼimma taraynna mina al-bacari ʼaḥadan faquli ʼinni naḏartu lilrraḥmani ṣawman falan ʼukallima al-yawma ʼinsiyan.
Faʼatat bihi qawmaha taḥmiluhu qalu ya maryamu laqad jiʼti cayʼan fariyan.
Ya ʼuxta haruna ma kana ʼabuki amraʼa sawʼin wa ma kanat ʼummuki baɣiyan.
Faʼacarat ʼilayhi qalu kayfa nukallimu man kana fi al-mahdi ṣabiyan.
Qala ʼinni ɛabdu Allahi ʼataniya al-kitaba wa jaɛalani nabiyan.
Wa jaɛalani mubarakan ʼayna ma kuntu wa ʼawṣani biṣ-ṣalati wa az-zakati ma dumtu ḥayyan.
Wa barran biwalidati wa lam yajɛalni jabbaran caqiyan.
Wa as-salamu ɛalayya yawma wulidtu wa yawma ʼamutu wa yawma ʼubɛaṯu ḥayyan.
Ḏalika ɛisa abnu maryama qawla al-ḥaqqi al-laḏi fihi yamtarun.
Ma kana Lillahi ʼan yattaxiḏa min waladin subḥanahu ʼiḏa qaḍa ʼamran faʼinnama yaqulu lahu kun fayakun.
Wa ʼinna Allaha rabbi wa rabbukum faɛbuduhu haḏa ṣiraṭun mustaqimun.
Faxtalafa al-ʼaḥzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillaḏina kafaru min mac/hadi yawmin ɛaḏ̣imin.
ʼasmiɛ bihim wa ʼabṣir yawma yaʼtunana lakin aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna al-yawma fi ḍalalin mubinin.
Wa ʼanḏirhum yawma al-ḥasrati ʼiḏ quḍiya al-ʼamru wa hum fi ɣaflatin wa hum la yuʼminun.
ʼinna naḥnu nariṯu al-ʼarḍa wa man ɛalayha wa ʼilayna yurjaɛun.
Wa aḏkur fi al-kitabi ʼibrahima ʼinnahu kana ṣiddiqan nabiyan.
ʼiḏ qala liʼabihi ya ʼabati lima taɛbudu ma la yasmaɛu wa la yubṣiru wa la yuɣni ɛanka cayʼan.
Ya ʼabati ʼinni qad jaʼani mina al-ɛilmi ma lam yaʼtika fa attabiɛni ʼahdika ṣiraṭan sawiyan.
Ya ʼabati la taɛbud ac-cayṭana ʼinna ac-cayṭana kana lilrraḥmani ɛaṣiyan.
Ya ʼabati ʼinni ʼaxafu ʼan yamassaka ɛaḏabun mina ar-raḥmani fatakuna lilccayṭani waliyan.
Qala ʼaraɣibun ʼanta ɛan ʼalihati ya ʼibrahimu laʼin lam tantahi laʼarjumannaka wa ahjurni maliyan.
Qala salamun ɛalayka saʼastaɣfiru laka rabbi ʼinnahu kana bi ḥafiyan.
Wa ʼaɛtazilukum wa ma tadɛuna min duni Allahi wa ʼadɛu rabbi ɛasa ʼalla ʼakuna biduɛaʼi rabbi caqiyan.
Falamma aɛtazalahum wa ma yaɛbuduna min duni Allahi wahabna lahu ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba wa kulla jaɛalna nabiyan.
Wa wahabna lahum min raḥmatina wa jaɛalna lahum lisana ṣidqin ɛaliyan.
Wa aḏkur fi al-kitabi musa ʼinnahu kana muxlaṣan wa kana rasulan nabiyan.
Wa nadaynahu min janibi aṭ-ṭuri al-ʼaymani wa qarrabnahu najiyan.
Wa wahabna lahu min raḥmatina ʼaxahu haruna nabiyan.
Wa aḏkur fi al-kitabi ʼismaɛila ʼinnahu kana ṣadiqa al-waɛdi wa kana rasulan nabiyan.
Wa kana yaʼmuru ʼahlahu biṣ-ṣalati wa az-zakati wa kana ɛinda rabbihi marḍiyan.
Wa aḏkur fi al-kitabi ʼidrisa ʼinnahu kana ṣiddiqan nabiyan.
Wa rafaɛnahu makanan ɛaliyan.

ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ʼanɛama Allahu ɛalayhim mina an-nabiyina min ḏurriyati ʼadama wa mimman ḥamalna maɛa nuḥin wa min ḏurriyati ʼibrahima wa ʼisraʼila wa mimman hadayna wa ajtabayna ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatu ar-raḥmani xarru sujjadan wa bukiyan.
Faxalafa min baɛdihim xalfun ʼaḍaɛu aṣ-ṣalata wa attabaɛu ac-cahawati fasawfa yalqawna ɣayyan.
ʼilla man taba wa ʼamana wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan faʼulaʼika yadxuluna al-jannata wa la yuḏ̣lamuna cayʼan.
Jannati ɛadnin allati waɛada ar-raḥmanu ɛibadahu bil-ɣaybi ʼinnahu kana waɛduhu maʼtiyan.
La yasmaɛuna fiha laɣwan ʼilla salaman wa lahum rizquhum fiha bukratan wa ɛaciyan.
Tilka al-jannatu allati nuriṯu min ɛibadina man kana taqiyan.
Wa ma natanazzalu ʼilla biʼamri rabbika lahu ma bayna ʼaydina wa ma xalfana wa ma bayna ḏalika wa ma kana rabbuka nasiyan.
Rabbu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma baynahuma faɛbud/hu wa aṣṭabir liɛibadatihi hal taɛlamu lahu samiyan.
Wa yaqulu al-ʼinsanu ʼaʼiḏa ma mittu lasawfa ʼuxraju ḥayyan.
ʼawala yaḏkuru al-ʼinsanu ʼanna xalaqnahu min qablu wa lam yaku cayʼan.
Fawarabbika lanaḥcurannahum wa ac-cayaṭina ṯumma lanuḥḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jiṯiyan.
Ṯumma lananziɛanna min kulli ciɛatin ʼayyuhum ʼacaddu ɛala ar-raḥmani ɛitiyan.
Ṯumma lanaḥnu ʼaɛlamu bial-laḏina hum ʼawla biha ṣiliyan.
Wa ʼin minkum ʼilla wa ariduha kana ɛala rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyan.
Ṯumma nunajji al-laḏina attaqaw wa naḏaru aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina fiha jiṯiyan.
Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatuna bayyinatin qala al-laḏina kafaru lillaḏina ʼamanu ʼayyu al-fariqayni xayrun maqaman wa ʼaḥsanu nadiyan.
Wa kam ʼahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ʼaḥsanu ʼaṯaṯan wa riʼyan.
Qul man kana fi aḍ-ḍalalati falyamdud lahu ar-raḥmanu maddan ḥatta ʼiḏa raʼaw ma yuɛaduna ʼimma al-ɛaḏaba wa ʼimma as-saɛata fasayaɛlamuna man huwa carrun makanan wa ʼaḍɛafu jundan.
Wa yazidu Allahu al-laḏina ahtadaw hudan wa al-baqiyatu aṣ-ṣaliḥatu xayrun ɛinda rabbika ṯawaban wa xayrun maraddan.
