Fa-al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lahum maɣfiratun wa rizqun karimun.
Wa al-laḏina saɛaw fi ʼayatina muɛajizina ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jaḥim.
Wa ma ʼarsalna min qablika min rasulin wa la nabiyin ʼilla ʼiḏa tamanna ʼalqa ac-cayṭanu fi ʼumniyatihi fayansaxu Allahu ma yulqi ac-cayṭanu ṯumma yuḥkimu Allahu ʼayatihi wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
Liyajɛala ma yulqi ac-cayṭanu fitnatan lillaḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun wa al-qasiyati qulubuhum wa ʼinna aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina lafi ciqaqin baɛidin.
Wa liyaɛlama al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma ʼannahu al-ḥaqqu min rabbika fayuʼminu bihi fatuxbita lahu qulubuhum wa ʼinna Allaha lahadi al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Wa la yazalu al-laḏina kafaru fi miryatin minhu ḥatta taʼtiyahumu as-saɛatu baɣtatan ʼaw yaʼtiyahum ɛaḏabu yawmin ɛaqimin.
Al-mulku yawmaʼiḏin Lillahi yaḥkumu baynahum fa-al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati fi jannati an-naɛim.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biʼayatina faʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun muhinun.
Wa al-laḏina hajaru fi sabili Allahi ṯumma qutilu ʼaw matu layarzuqannahum Allahu rizqan ḥasanan wa ʼinna Allaha lahuwa xayru ar-raziqin.
Layudxilannahum mudxalan yarḍawnahu wa ʼinna Allaha laɛalimun ḥalimun.
Ḏalika wa man ɛaqaba bimiṯli ma ɛuqiba bihi ṯumma buɣiya ɛalayhi layanṣurannahu Allahu ʼinna Allaha laɛafuwun ɣafurun.
Ḏalika biʼanna Allaha yuliju al-layla fi an-nahari wa yuliju an-nahara fi al-layli wa ʼanna Allaha samiɛun baṣirun.
Ḏalika biʼanna Allaha huwa al-ḥaqqu wa ʼanna ma yadɛuna min dunihi huwa al-baṭilu wa ʼanna Allaha huwa al-ɛaliyu al-kabir.
ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan fatuṣbiḥu al-ʼarḍu muxḍarratan ʼinna Allaha laṭifun xabirun.
Lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼinna Allaha lahuwa al-ɣaniyu al-ḥamid.
ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha saxxara lakum ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa al-fulka tajri fi al-baḥri biʼamrihi wa yumsiku as-samaʼa ʼan taqaɛa ɛala al-ʼarḍi ʼilla biʼiḏnihi ʼinna Allaha bin-nasi laraʼufun raḥimun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi ʼaḥyakum ṯumma yumitukum ṯumma yuḥyikum ʼinna al-ʼinsana lakafurun.
Likulli ʼummatin jaɛalna mansakan hum nasikuhu fala yunaziɛunnaka fi al-ʼamri wa adɛu ʼila rabbika ʼinnaka laɛala hudan mustaqimin.
Wa ʼin jadaluka faqul Allahu ʼaɛlamu bima taɛmalun.
Allahu yaḥkumu baynakum yawma al-qiyamati fima kuntum fihi taxtalifun.
ʼalam taɛlam ʼanna Allaha yaɛlamu ma fi as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi ʼinna ḏalika fi kitabin ʼinna ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasirun.
Wa yaɛbuduna min duni Allahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sulṭanan wa ma laysa lahum bihi ɛilmun wa ma lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina min naṣirin.

Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatuna bayyinatin taɛrifu fi wujuhi al-laḏina kafaru al-munkara yakaduna yasṭuna bial-laḏina yatluna ɛalayhim ʼayatina qul ʼafaʼunabbiʼukum bicarrin min ḏalikum an-naru waɛadaha Allahu al-laḏina kafaru wa biʼsa al-maṣir.

Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu ḍuriba maṯalun fastamiɛu lahu ʼinna al-laḏina tadɛuna min duni Allahi lan yaxluqu ḏubaban wa law ajtamaɛu lahu wa ʼin yaslubhumu aḏ-ḏubabu cayʼan la yastanqiḏuhu minhu ḍaɛufa aṭ-ṭalibu wa al-maṭlub.
Ma qadaru Allaha ḥaqqa qadrihi ʼinna Allaha laqawiyun ɛazizun.
Allahu yaṣṭafi mina al-malaʼikati rusulan wa mina an-nasi ʼinna Allaha samiɛun baṣirun.
Yaɛlamu ma bayna ʼaydihim wa ma xalfahum wa ʼila Allahi turjaɛu al-ʼumur.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu arkaɛu wa asjudu wa aɛbudu rabbakum wa afɛalu al-xayra laɛallakum tufliḥun.

Wa jahidu fi Allahi ḥaqqa jihadihi huwa ajtabakum wa ma jaɛala ɛalaykum fi ad-dini min ḥarajin millata ʼabikum ʼibrahima huwa sammakum al-muslimyna min qablu wa fi haḏa liyakuna ar-rasulu cahidan ɛalaykum wa takunu cuhadaʼa ɛala an-nasi faʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatu az-zakata wa aɛtaṣimu Billahi huwa mawlakum faniɛma al-mawla wa niɛma an-naṣir.
Qad ʼaflaḥa al-muʼminun.
Al-laḏina hum fi ṣalatihim xaciɛun.
Wa al-laḏina hum ɛan al-laɣwi muɛriḍun.
Wa al-laḏina hum lilzzakati faɛilun.
Wa al-laḏina hum lifurujihim ḥafiḏ̣un.
ʼilla ɛala ʼazwajihim ʼw ma malakat ʼaymanuhum faʼinnahum ɣayru malumin.
Faman abtaɣa waraʼa ḏalika faʼulaʼika hum al-ɛadun.
Wa al-laḏina hum liʼmanatihim wa ɛahdihim raɛun.
Wa al-laḏina hum ɛala ṣalawatihim yuḥafiḏ̣un.
ʼulaʼika hum al-wariṯun.
Al-laḏina yariṯuna al-firdawsa hum fiha xalidun.
Wa laqad xalaqna al-ʼinsana min sulalatin min ṭinin.
Ṯumma jaɛalnahu nuṭfatan fi qararin makinin.
Ṯumma xalaqna an-nuṭfata ɛalaqatan faxalaqna al-ɛalaqata muḍɣatan faxalaqna al-muḍɣata ɛiḏ̣aman fakasawna al-ɛiḏ̣ama laḥman ṯumma ʼancaʼnahu xalqan ʼaxara fatabaraka Allahu ʼaḥsanu al-xaliqin.
Ṯumma ʼinnakum baɛda ḏalika lamayyitun.
Ṯumma ʼinnakum yawma al-qiyamati tubɛaṯun.
Wa laqad xalaqna fawqakum sabɛa ṭaraʼiqa wa ma kunna ɛan al-xalqi ɣafilin.
Wa ʼanzalna mina as-samaʼi maʼan biqadarin faʼaskannahu fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼinna ɛala ḏahabin bihi laqadirun.
Faʼancaʼna lakum bihi jannatin min naxilin wa ʼaɛnabin lakum fiha fawakihu kaṯiratun wa minha taʼkulun.
Wa cajaratan taxruju min ṭuri saynaʼa tanbutu bid-duhni wa ṣibɣin lilʼakilin.
Wa ʼinna lakum fi al-ʼanɛam laɛibratan nusqikum mimma fi buṭuniha wa lakum fiha manafiɛu kaṯiratun wa minha taʼkulun.
Wa ɛalayha wa ɛala al-fulki tuḥmalun.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna nuḥan ʼila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu ʼafala tattaqun.
Faqala al-malaʼu al-laḏina kafaru min qawmihi ma haḏa ʼilla bacarun miṯlukum yuridu ʼan yatafaḍḍala ɛalaykum wa law caʼa Allahu laʼanzala malaʼikatan ma samiɛna bihaḏa fi ʼabaʼina al-ʼawwalin.
ʼin huwa ʼilla rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣu bihi ḥatta ḥinin.
Qala rabbi anṣurni bima kaḏḏabun.

Faʼawḥayna ʼilayhi ʼan aṣnaɛ al-fulka biʼaɛyunina wa waḥyina faʼiḏa jaʼa ʼamruna wa fara at-tannuru fasluk fiha min kullin zawjayni aṯnayni wa ʼahlaka ʼilla man sabaqa ɛalayhi al-qawlu minhum wa la tuxaṭibni fi al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu ʼinnahum muɣraqun.
Faʼiḏa astawayta ʼanta wa man maɛaka ɛala al-fulki faqul al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi najjana mina al-qawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa qul rabbi ʼanzilni munzalan mubarakan wa ʼanta xayru al-munzilin.
ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin wa ʼin kunna lamubtalin.
Ṯumma ʼancaʼna min baɛdihim qarnan ʼaxarin.
Faʼarsalna fihim rasulan minhum ʼan aɛbudu Allaha ma lakum min ʼilahin ɣayruhu ʼafala tattaqun.

Wa qala al-malaʼu min qawmihi al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biliqaʼi al-ʼaxirati wa ʼatrafnahum fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya ma haḏa ʼilla bacarun miṯlukum yaʼkulu mimma taʼkuluna minhu wa yacrabu mimma tacrabun.
Wa laʼin ʼaṭaɛtum bacaran miṯlakum ʼinnakum ʼiḏan laxasirun.
ʼayaɛidukum ʼannakum ʼiḏa mittum wa kuntum turaban wa ɛiḏ̣aman ʼannakum muxrajun.
Hayhata hayhata lima tuɛadun.
ʼin hiya ʼilla ḥayatuna ad-dunya namutu wa naḥya wa ma naḥnu bimabɛuṯin.
ʼin huwa ʼilla rajulun aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban wa ma naḥnu lahu bimuʼminin.
Qala rabbi anṣurni bima kaḏḏabun.
Qala ɛamma qalilin layuṣbiḥunna nadimin.
Faʼaxaḏat/hum aṣ-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqqi fajaɛalnahum ɣuṯaʼan fabuɛdan lilqawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Ṯumma ʼancaʼna min baɛdihim qurunan ʼaxarin.
Ma tasbiqu min ʼummatin ʼajalaha wa ma yastaʼxirun.
Ṯumma ʼarsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaʼa ʼummatan rasuluha kaḏḏabuhu faʼatbaɛna baɛḍahum baɛḍan wa jaɛalnahum ʼaḥadiṯa fabuɛdan liqawmin la yuʼminun.
Ṯumma ʼarsalna musa wa ʼaxahu haruna biʼayatina wa sulṭanin mubinin.
ʼila firɛawna wa malaʼihi fastakbaru wa kanu qawman ɛalin.
Faqalu ʼanuʼminu libacarayni miṯlina wa qawmuhuma lana ɛabidun.
Fakaḏḏabuhuma fakanu mina al-muhlakin.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-kitaba laɛallahum yahtadun.
Wa jaɛalna abna maryama wa ʼummahu ʼayatan wa ʼawaynahuma ʼila rabwatin ḏati qararin wa maɛinin.
Ya ʼayyuha ar-rusulu kulu mina aṭ-ṭayyibati wa aɛmalu ṣaliḥan ʼinni bima taɛmaluna ɛalimun.
Wa ʼinna haḏihi ʼummatukum ʼummatan waḥidatan wa ʼana rabbukum fa attaqun.
Fataqaṭṭaɛu ʼamrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥizbin bima ladayhim fariḥun.
Faḏarhum fi ɣamratihim ḥatta ḥinin.
ʼayaḥsabuna ʼannama numidduhum bihi min malin wa banin.
Nusariɛu lahum fi al-xayrati bal la yacɛurun.
ʼinna al-laḏina hum min xacyati rabbihim mucfiqun.
Wa al-laḏina hum biʼayati rabbihim yuʼminun.
Wa al-laḏina hum birabbihim la yucrikun.
Wa al-laḏina yuʼtuna ma ʼataw wa qulubuhum wa jilatun ʼannahum ʼila rabbihim rajiɛun.
ʼulaʼika yusariɛuna fi al-xayrati wa hum laha sabiqun.
Wa la nukallifu nafsan ʼilla wusɛaha wa ladayna kitabun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqqi wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
Bal qulubuhum fi ɣamratin min haḏa wa lahum ʼaɛmalun min duni ḏalika hum laha ɛamilun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa ʼaxaḏna mutrafihim bil-ɛaḏabi ʼiḏa hum yajʼarun.
La tajʼaru al-yawma ʼinnakum minna la tunṣarun.
Qad kanat ʼayati tutla ɛalaykum fakuntum ɛala ʼaɛqabikum tankiṣun.
Mustakbirina bihi samiran tahjurun.
ʼafalam yaddabbaru al-qawla ʼam jaʼahum ma lam yaʼti ʼabaʼahumu al-ʼawwalin.
ʼam lam yaɛrifu rasulahum fahum lahu munkirun.
ʼam yaquluna bihi jinnatun bal jaʼahum bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼakṯaruhum lilḥaqqi karihun.
Wa law attabaɛa al-ḥaqqu ʼahwaʼahum lafasadat as-samawatu wa al-ʼarḍu wa man fihinna bal ʼataynahum biḏikrihim fahum ɛan ḏikrihim muɛriḍun.
ʼam tasʼaluhum xarjan faxaraju rabbika xayrun wa huwa xayru ar-raziqin.
Wa ʼinnaka latadɛuhum ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Wa ʼinna al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati ɛan aṣ-ṣiraṭi lanakibun.
Wa law raḥimnahum wa kacafna ma bihim min ḍurrin lalajju fi ṭuɣyanihim yaɛmahun.
Wa laqad ʼaxaḏnahum bil-ɛaḏabi fama astakanu lirabbihim wa ma yataḍarraɛun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa fataḥna ɛalayhim baban ḏa ɛaḏabin cadidin ʼiḏa hum fihi mublisun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi ʼancaʼa lakum as-samɛa wa al-ʼabṣara wa al-ʼafʼidata qalilan ma tackurun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi ḏaraʼakum fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼilayhi tuḥcarun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi yuḥyi wa yumitu wa lahu axtilafu al-layli wa an-nahari ʼafala taɛqilun.
Bal qalu miṯla ma qala al-ʼawwalun.
Qalu ʼaʼiḏa mitna wa kunna turaban wa ɛiḏ̣aman ʼaʼinna lamabɛuṯun.
Laqad wuɛidna naḥnu wa ʼabaʼuuna haḏa min qablu ʼin haḏa ʼilla ʼasaṭiru al-ʼawwalin.
Qul liman al-ʼarḍu wa man fiha ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.
Sayaquluna Lillahi qul ʼafala taḏakkarun.
Qul man rabbu as-samawati as-sabɛi wa rabbu al-ɛarci al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Sayaquluna Lillahi qul ʼafala tattaqun.
Qul man biyadihi malakutu kulli cayʼin wa huwa yujiru wa la yujaru ɛalayhi ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.
Sayaquluna Lillahi qul faʼanna tusḥarun.
Bal ʼataynahum bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼinnahum lakaḏibun.
Ma attaxaḏa Allahu min waladin wa ma kana maɛahu min ʼilahin ʼiḏan laḏahaba kullu ʼilahin bima xalaqa wa laɛala baɛḍuhum ɛala baɛḍin subḥana Allahi ɛamma yaṣifun.
Ɛalimi al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati fataɛala ɛamma yucrikun.
Qul rabbi ʼimma turiyanni ma yuɛadun.
Rabbi fala tajɛalni fi al-qawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa ʼinna ɛala ʼan nuriyaka ma naɛiduhum laqadirun.
Adfaɛ bi-ati hiya ʼaḥsanu as-sayyiʼata naḥnu ʼaɛlamu bima yaṣifun.
Wa qul rabbi ʼaɛuḏu bika min hamazati ac-cayaṭin.
Wa ʼaɛuḏu bika rabbi ʼan yaḥḍurun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼa ʼaḥadahum al-mawtu qala rabbi arjiɛun.
Laɛalli ʼaɛmalu ṣaliḥan fima taraktu kalla ʼinnaha kalimatun huwa qaʼiluha wa min waraʼihim barzaxun ʼila yawmi yubɛaṯun.
Faʼiḏa nufixa fi aṣ-ṣuri fala ʼansaba baynahum yawmaʼiḏin wa la yatasaʼalun.
Faman ṯaqulat mawazinuhu faʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
Wa man xaffat mawazinuhu faʼulaʼika al-laḏina xasiru ʼanfusahum fi jahannama xalidun.
Talfaḥu wujuhahum an-naru wa hum fiha kaliḥun.
ʼalam takun ʼayati tutla ɛalaykum fakuntum biha tukaḏḏibun.
Qalu rabbana ɣalabat ɛalayna ciqwatuna wa kunna qawman ḍallin.
Rabbana ʼaxrijna minha faʼin ɛudna faʼinna ḏ̣alimun.
Qala axsaʼu fiha wa la tukallimun.
ʼinnahu kana fariqun min ɛibadi yaquluna rabbana ʼamanna faɣfir lana wa arḥamna wa ʼanta xayru ar-raḥimin.
Fattaxaḏtumuhum sixriyan ḥatta ʼansawkum ḏikri wa kuntum minhum taḍḥakun.
ʼinni jazaytuhumu al-yawma bima ṣabaru ʼannahum hum al-faʼizun.
Qala kam labiṯtum fi al-ʼarḍi ɛadada sinin.
Qalu labiṯna yawman ʼaw baɛḍa yawmin fasʼali al-ɛaddin.
Qala ʼin labiṯtum ʼilla qalilan law ʼannakum kuntum taɛlamun.
ʼafaḥasibtum ʼannama xalaqnakum ɛabaṯan wa ʼannakum ʼilayna la turjaɛun.
Fataɛala Allahu al-maliku al-ḥaqqu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa rabbu al-ɛarci al-karim.
Wa man yadɛu maɛa Allahi ʼilahan ʼaxara la burhana lahu bihi faʼinnama ḥisabuhu ɛinda rabbihi ʼinnahu la yufliḥu al-kafirun.
Wa qul rabbi aɣfir wa arḥam wa ʼanta xayru ar-raḥimin.
Suratun ʼanzalnaha wa faraḍnaha wa ʼanzalna fiha ʼayatin bayyinatin laɛallakum taḏakkarun.

Az-zaniyatu wa az-zani fajlidu kulla waḥidin minhuma miaʼata jaldatin wa la taʼxuḏkum bihima raʼfatun fi dini Allahi ʼin kuntum tuʼminuna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa liac/had ɛaḏabahuma ṭaʼifatun mina al-muʼminin.
Az-zani la yankiḥu ʼilla zaniyatan ʼaw mucrikatan wa az-zaniyatu la yankiḥuha ʼilla zanin ʼaw mucrikun wa ḥurrima ḏalika ɛala al-muʼminin.
Wa al-laḏina yarmuna al-muḥṣanati ṯumma lam yaʼtu biʼarbaɛati cuhadaʼa fajliduhum ṯamanina jaldatan wa la taqbalu lahum cahadatan ʼabadan wa ʼulaʼika hum al-fasiqun.
ʼilla al-laḏina tabu min baɛdi ḏalika wa ʼaṣlaḥu faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa al-laḏina yarmuna ʼazwajahum wa lam yakun lahum cuhadaʼu ʼilla ʼanfusuhum facahadatu ʼaḥadihim ʼarbaɛu cahadatin Billahi ʼinnahu lamina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Wa al-xamisatu ʼanna laɛnata Allahi ɛalayhi ʼin kana mina al-kaḏibin.
Wa yadraʼu ɛanha al-ɛaḏaba ʼan tac/hada ʼarbaɛa cahadatin Billahi ʼinnahu lamina al-kaḏibin.
Wa al-xamisata ʼanna ɣaḍaba Allahi ɛalayha ʼin kana mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Wa lawla faḍlu Allahi ɛalaykum wa raḥmatuhu wa ʼanna Allaha tawwabun ḥakimun.

ʼinna al-laḏina jaʼu bil-ʼifki ɛuṣbatun minkum la taḥsabuhu carran lakum bal huwa xayrun lakum likulli amriʼin minhum ma aktasaba mina al-ʼiṯmi wa al-laḏi tawalla kibrahu minhum lahu ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Lawla ʼiḏ samiɛtumuhu ḏ̣anna al-muʼminuna wa al-muʼminatu biʼanfusihim xayran wa qalu haḏa ʼifkun mubinun.
Lawla jaʼu ɛalayhi biʼarbaɛati cuhadaʼa faʼiḏ lam yaʼtu bic-cuhadaʼi faʼulaʼika ɛinda Allahi hum al-kaḏibun.
Wa lawla faḍlu Allahi ɛalaykum wa raḥmatuhu fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati lamassakum fi ma ʼafaḍtum fihi ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
ʼiḏ talaqqawnahu biʼalsinatikum wa taquluna biʼafwahikum ma laysa lakum bihi ɛilmun wa taḥsabunahu hayyinan wa huwa ɛinda Allahi ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa lawla ʼiḏ samiɛtumuhu qultum ma yakunu lana ʼan natakallama bihaḏa subḥanaka haḏa buhtanun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Yaɛiḏ̣ukum Allahu ʼan taɛudu limiṯlihi ʼabadan ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Wa yubayyinu Allahu lakum al-ʼayati wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yuḥibbuna ʼan taciɛa al-faḥicatu fi al-laḏina ʼamanu lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa Allahu yaɛlamu wa ʼantum la taɛlamun.
Wa lawla faḍlu Allahi ɛalaykum wa raḥmatuhu wa ʼanna Allaha raʼufun raḥim.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tattabiɛu xuṭuwati ac-cayṭani wa man yattabiɛ xuṭuwati ac-cayṭani faʼinnahu yaʼmuru bil-faḥcaʼi wa al-munkari wa lawla faḍlu Allahi ɛalaykum wa raḥmatuhu ma zaka minkum min ʼaḥadin ʼabadan wa lakinna Allaha yuzakki man yacaʼu wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.

Wa la yaʼtali ʼulu al-faḍli minkum wa as-saɛati ʼan yuʼtu ʼuli al-qurba wa al-masakina wa al-muhajirina fi sabili Allahi wa liaɛfu wa liaṣfaḥu ʼala tuḥibbuna ʼan yaɣfira Allahu lakum wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yarmuna al-muḥṣanati al-ɣafilati al-muʼminati luɛinu fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa lahum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Yawma tac/hadu ɛalayhim ʼalsinatuhum wa ʼaydihim wa ʼarjuluhum bima kanu yaɛmalun.
Yawmaʼiḏin yuwaffihimu Allahu dinahum al-ḥaqqa wa yaɛlamuna ʼanna Allaha huwa al-ḥaqqu al-mubin.
Al-xabiṯatu lilxabiṯina wa al-xabiṯuna lilxabiṯati wa aṭ-ṭayyibatu lilṭṭayyibina wa aṭ-ṭayyibuna lilṭṭayyibati ʼulaʼika mubarraʼuna mimma yaquluna lahum maɣfiratun wa rizqun karimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tadxulu buyutan ɣayra buyutikum ḥatta tastaʼnisu wa tusallimu ɛala ʼahliha ḏalikum xayrun lakum laɛallakum taḏakkarun.
Faʼin lam tajidu fiha ʼaḥadan fala tadxuluha ḥatta yuʼḏana lakum wa ʼin qila lakum arjiɛu farjiɛu huwa ʼazka lakum wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna ɛalimun.
Laysa ɛalaykum junaḥun ʼan tadxulu buyutan ɣayra maskunatin fiha mataɛun lakum wa Allahu yaɛlamu ma tubduna wa ma taktumun.
Qul lilmuʼminina yaɣuḍḍu min ʼabṣarihim wa yaḥfaḏ̣u furujahum ḏalika ʼazka lahum ʼinna Allaha xabirun bima yaṣnaɛun.

Wa qul lilmuʼminati yaɣḍuḍna min ʼabṣarihinna wa yaḥfaḏ̣na furujahunna wa la yubdina zinatahunna ʼilla ma ḏ̣ahara minha wa liaḍribna bixumurihinna ɛala juyubihinna wa la yubdina zinatahunna ʼilla libuɛulatihinna ʼaw ʼabaʼihinna ʼaw ʼabaʼi buɛulatihinna ʼaw ʼabnaʼihinna ʼaw ʼabnaʼi buɛulatihinna ʼaw ʼixwanihinna ʼaw bani ʼixwanihinna ʼaw bani ʼaxawatihinna ʼaw nisaʼihinna ʼaw ma malakat ʼaymanuhunna ʼaw at-tabiɛina ɣayri ʼuli al-ʼirbati mina ar-rijali ʼaw aṭ-ṭifli al-laḏina lam yaḏ̣haru ɛala ɛawrati an-nisaʼ wa la yaḍribna biʼarjulihinna liyuɛlama ma yuxfina min zinatihinna wa tubu ʼila Allahi jamiɛan ʼayyuha al-muʼminuna laɛallakum tufliḥun.
Wa ʼankiḥu al-ʼayama minkum wa aṣ-ṣaliḥina min ɛibadikum wa ʼimaʼikum ʼin yakunu fuqaraʼa yuɣnihim Allahu min faḍlihi wa Allahu wasiɛun ɛalimun.

Wa liastaɛfif al-laḏina la yajiduna nikaḥan ḥatta yuɣniyahum Allahu min faḍlihi wa al-laḏina yabtaɣuna al-kitaba mimma malakat ʼaymanukum fakatibuhum ʼin ɛalimtum fihim xayran wa ʼatuhum min mali Allahi al-laḏi ʼatakum wa la tukrihu fatayatikum ɛala al-biɣaʼi ʼin ʼaradna taḥaṣṣunan litabtaɣu ɛaraḍa al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa man yukrihhunna faʼinna Allaha min baɛdi ʼikrahihinna ɣafurun raḥimun.
Wa laqad ʼanzalna ʼilaykum ʼayatin mubayyinatin wa maṯalan mina al-laḏina xalaw min qablikum wa mawɛiḏ̣atan lilmuttaqin.

Allahu nuru as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi maṯalu nurihi kamickatin fiha miṣbaḥun al-miṣbaḥu fi zujajatin az-zujajatu kaʼannaha kawkabun durriyun yuqadu min cajaratin mubarakatin zaytuniatin la carqiyatin wa la ɣarbiyatin yakadu zaytuha yuḍiʼu wa law lam tamsas/hu narun nurun ɛala nurin yahdi Allahu linurihi man yacaʼu wa yaḍribu Allahu al-ʼamṯala lilnnasi wa Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Fi buyutin ʼaḏina Allahu ʼan turfaɛa wa yuḏkara fiha asmuhu yusabbiḥu lahu fiha bil-ɣuduwi wa al-ʼaṣal.
Rijalun la tulhihim tijaratun wa la bayɛun ɛan ḏikri Allahi wa ʼiqami aṣ-ṣalati wa ʼitaʼi az-zakati yaxafuna yawman tataqallabu fihi al-qulubu wa al-ʼabṣar.
Liyajziyahum Allahu ʼaḥsana ma ɛamilu wa yazidahum min faḍlihi wa Allahu yarzuqu man yacaʼu biɣayri ḥisabin.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru ʼaɛmaluhum kasarabin biqiɛatin yaḥsabuhu aḏ̣-ḏ̣amʼanu maʼan ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼahu lam yajid/hu cayʼan wa wajada Allaha ɛindahu fawaffahu ḥisabahu wa Allahu sariɛu al-ḥisab.

ʼaw kaḏ̣ulumatin fi baḥrin lujjiyin yaɣcahu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi saḥabun ḏ̣ulumatun baɛḍuha fawqa baɛḍin ʼiḏa ʼaxraja yadahu lam yakad yaraha wa man lam yajɛali Allahu lahu nuran fama lahu min nurin.
ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha yusabbiḥu lahu man fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa aṭ-ṭayru ṣaffatin kullun qad ɛalima ṣalatahu wa tasbiḥahu wa Allahu ɛalimun bima yafɛalun.
Wa Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ʼila Allahi al-maṣir.

ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha yuzji saḥaban ṯumma yuʼallifu baynahu ṯumma yajɛaluhu rukaman fatara al-wadqa yaxruju min xilalihi wa yunazzilu mina as-samaʼi min jibalin fiha min baradin fayuṣibu bihi man yacaʼu wa yaṣrifuhu ɛan man yacaʼu yakadu sana barqihi yaḏ/habu bil-ʼabṣar.
Yuqallibu Allahu al-layla wa an-nahara ʼinna fi ḏalika laɛibratan liʼwli al-ʼabṣar.

Wa Allahu xalaqa kulla dabbatin min maʼin faminhum man yamci ɛala baṭnihi wa minhum man yamci ɛala rijlayni wa minhum man yamci ɛala ʼarbaɛin yaxluqu Allahu ma yacaʼu ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Laqad ʼanzalna ʼayatin mubayyinatin wa Allahu yahdi man yacaʼu ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Wa yaquluna ʼamanna Billahi wa bir-rasuli wa ʼaṭaɛna ṯumma yatawalla fariqun minhum min baɛdi ḏalika wa ma ʼulaʼika bil-muʼminin.
Wa ʼiḏa duɛu ʼila Allahi wa rasulihi liyaḥkuma baynahum ʼiḏa fariqun minhum muɛriḍun.
Wa ʼin yakun lahum al-ḥaqqu yaʼtu ʼilayhi muḏɛinin.
ʼafi qulubihim maraḍun ʼam artabu ʼam yaxafuna ʼan yaḥifa Allahu ɛalayhim wa rasuluhu bal ʼulaʼika hum aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.
ʼinnama kana qawla al-muʼminina ʼiḏa duɛu ʼila Allahi wa rasulihi liyaḥkuma baynahum ʼan yaqulu samiɛna wa ʼaṭaɛna wa ʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
Wa man yuṭiɛ Allaha wa rasulahu wa yaxca Allaha wa yattaqhi faʼulaʼika humu al-faʼizun.
Wa ʼaqsamu Billahi jahda ʼaymanihim laʼin ʼamartahum layaxrujunna qul la tuqsimu ṭaɛatun maɛrufatun ʼinna Allaha xabirun bima taɛmalun.
Qul ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa ʼaṭiɛu ar-rasula faʼin tawallaw faʼinnama ɛalayhi ma ḥummila wa ɛalaykum ma ḥummiltum wa ʼin tuṭiɛuhu tahtadu wa ma ɛala ar-rasuli ʼilla al-balaɣu al-mubin.

Waɛada Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu minkum wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati layastaxlifannahum fi al-ʼarḍi kama astaxlafa al-laḏina min qablihim wa layumakkinanna lahum dinahumu al-laḏi artaḍa lahum wa layubaddilannahum min baɛdi xawfihim ʼamnan yaɛbudunani la yucrikuna bi cayʼan wa man kafara baɛda ḏalika faʼulaʼika hum al-fasiqun.
Wa ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatu az-zakata wa ʼaṭiɛu ar-rasula laɛallakum turḥamun.
La taḥsabanna al-laḏina kafaru muɛjizina fi al-ʼarḍi wa maʼwahum an-naru wa labiʼsa al-maṣir.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu liyastaʼḏinkum al-laḏina malakat ʼaymanukum wa al-laḏina lam yabluɣu al-ḥuluma minkum ṯalaṯa marratin min qabli ṣalati al-fajri wa ḥina taḍaɛuna ṯiya bakum mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ahirati wa min baɛdi ṣalati al-ɛicaʼi ṯalaṯu ɛawratin lakum laysa ɛalaykum wa la ɛalayhim junaḥun baɛdahunna ṭawwafuna ɛalaykum baɛḍukum ɛala baɛḍin kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum al-ʼayati wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
Wa ʼiḏa balaɣa al-ʼaṭfalu minkum al-ḥuluma falyastaʼḏinu kama astaʼḏana al-laḏina min qablihim kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ʼayatihi wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
Wa al-qawaɛidu mina an-nisaʼ al-lati la yarjuna nikaḥan falaysa ɛalayhinna junaḥun ʼan yaḍaɛna ṯiyabahunna ɣayra mutabarrijatin bizinatin wa ʼan yastaɛfifna xayrun lahunna wa Allahu samiɛun ɛalimun.

Laysa ɛala al-ʼaɛma ḥarajun wa la ɛala al-ʼaɛraji ḥarajun wa la ɛala al-mariḍi ḥarajun wa la ɛala ʼanfusikum ʼan taʼkulu min buyutikum ʼaw buyuti ʼabaʼikum ʼaw buyuti ʼummahatikum ʼaw buyuti ʼixwanikum ʼaw buyuti ʼaxawatikum ʼaw buyuti ʼaɛmamikum ʼaw buyuti ɛammatikum ʼaw buyuti ʼaxwalikum ʼaw buyuti xalatikum ʼaw ma malaktum mafatiḥahu ʼaw ṣadiqikum laysa ɛalaykum junaḥun ʼan taʼkulu jamiɛan ʼaw ʼactatan faʼiḏa daxaltum buyutan fasallimu ɛala ʼanfusikum taḥiyatan min ɛindi Allahi mubarakatan ṭayyibatan kaḏalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum al-ʼayati laɛallakum taɛqilun.

ʼinnama al-muʼminuna al-laḏina ʼamanu Billahi wa rasulihi wa ʼiḏa kanu maɛahu ɛala ʼamrin jamiɛin lam yaḏ/habu ḥatta yastaʼḏinuhu ʼinna al-laḏina yastaʼḏinunaka ʼulaʼika al-laḏina yuʼminuna Billahi wa rasulihi faʼiḏa astaʼḏanuka libaɛḍi caʼnihim faʼḏan liman ciʼta minhum wa astaɣfir lahum Allaha ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.

La tajɛalu duɛaʼa ar-rasuli baynakum kaduɛaʼi baɛḍikum baɛḍan qad yaɛlamu Allahu al-laḏina yatasallaluna minkum liwaḏan falyaḥḏari al-laḏina yuxalifuna ɛan ʼamrihi ʼan tuṣibahum fitnatun ʼaw yuṣibahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
ʼala ʼinna Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi qad yaɛlamu ma ʼantum ɛalayhi wa yawma yurjaɛuna ʼilayhi fayunabbiʼuhum bima ɛamilu wa Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Tabaraka al-laḏi nazzala al-furqana ɛala ɛabdihi liyakuna lilɛalamina naḏiran.
Al-laḏi lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa lam yattaxiḏ waladan wa lam yakun lahu carikun fi al-mulki wa xalaqa kulla cayʼin faqaddarahu taqdiran.
Wa attaxaḏu min dunihi ʼalihatan la yaxluquna cayʼan wa hum yuxlaquna wa la yamlikuna liʼnfusihim ḍarran wa la nafɛan wa la yamlikuna mawtan wa la ḥayatan wa la nucuran.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru ʼin haḏa ʼilla ʼifkun aftarahu wa ʼaɛanahu ɛalayhi qawmun ʼaxaruna faqad jaʼu ḏ̣ulman wa zuran.
Wa qalu ʼasaṭiru al-ʼawwalina aktatabaha fahiya tumla ɛalayhi bukratan wa ʼaṣilan.
Qul ʼanzalahu al-laḏi yaɛlamu as-sirra fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼinnahu kana ɣafuran raḥiman.
Wa qalu mali haḏa ar-rasuli yaʼkulu aṭ-ṭaɛama wa yamci fi al-ʼaswaqi lawla ʼunzila ʼilayhi malakun fayakuna maɛahu naḏiran.
ʼaw yulqa ʼilayhi kanzun ʼaw takunu lahu jannatun yaʼkulu minha wa qala aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna ʼin tattabiɛuna ʼilla rajulan masḥuran.
Anḏ̣ur kayfa ḍarabu laka al-ʼamṯala faḍallu fala yastaṭiɛuna sabilan.
Tabaraka al-laḏi ʼin caʼa jaɛala laka xayran min ḏalika jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu wa yajɛal laka quṣuran.
Bal kaḏḏabu bis-saɛati wa ʼaɛtadna liman kaḏḏaba bis-saɛati saɛiran.
ʼiḏa raʼat/hum min makanin baɛidin samiɛu laha taɣayyuḏ̣an wa zafiran.
Wa ʼiḏa ʼulqu minha makanan ḍayyiqan muqarranina daɛaw hunalika ṯuburan.
La tadɛu al-yawma ṯuburan waḥidan wa adɛu ṯuburan kaṯiran.
Qul ʼaḏalika xayrun ʼam jannatu al-xuldi allati wuɛida al-muttaquna kanat lahum jazaʼan wa maṣiran.
Lahum fiha ma yacaʼuna xalidina kana ɛala rabbika waɛdan masʼulan.
Wa yawma yaḥcuruhum wa ma yaɛbuduna min duni Allahi fayaqulu ʼaʼantum ʼaḍlaltum ɛibadi haʼuulaʼ ʼam hum ḍallu as-sabil.
Qalu subḥanaka ma kana yanbaɣi lana ʼan nattaxiḏa min dunika min ʼawliyaʼa wa lakin mattaɛtahum wa ʼabaʼahum ḥatta nasu aḏ-ḏikra wa kanu qawman buran.
Faqad kaḏḏabukum bima taquluna fama tastaṭiɛuna ṣarfan wa la naṣran wa man yaḏ̣lim minkum nuḏiqhu ɛaḏaban kabiran.
Wa ma ʼarsalna qablaka mina al-mursalina ʼilla ʼinnahum layaʼkuluna aṭ-ṭaɛama wa yamcuna fi al-ʼaswaqi wa jaɛalna baɛḍakum libaɛḍin fitnatan ʼataṣbiruna wa kana rabbuka baṣiran.
Wa qala al-laḏina la yarjuna liqaʼana lawla ʼunzila ɛalayna al-malaʼikatu ʼaw nara rabbana laqad astakbaru fi ʼanfusihim wa ɛataw ɛutuwan kabiran.
Yawma yarawna al-malaʼikata la bucra yawmaʼiḏin lilmujrimina wa yaquluna ḥijran maḥjuran.
Wa qadimna ʼila ma ɛamilu min ɛamalin fajaɛalnahu habaʼan manṯuran.
ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati yawmaʼiḏin xayrun mustaqarran wa ʼaḥsanu maqilan.
Wa yawma tacaqqaqu as-samaʼu bil-ɣamami wa nuzzila al-malaʼikatu tanzilan.
Al-mulku yawmaʼiḏin al-ḥaqqu lilrraḥmani wa kana yawman ɛala al-kafirina ɛasiran.
Wa yawma yaɛaḍḍu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimu ɛala yadayhi yaqulu ya laytani attaxaḏtu maɛa ar-rasuli sabilan.
Ya waylati laytani lam ʼattaxiḏ fulanan xalilan.
Laqad ʼaḍallani ɛan aḏ-ḏikri baɛda ʼiḏ jaʼani wa kana ac-cayṭanu lilʼinsani xaḏulan.
Wa qala ar-rasulu ya rabbi ʼinna qawmi attaxaḏu haḏa al-qurʼana mahjuran.
Wa kaḏalika jaɛalna likulli nabiyin ɛaduwan mina al-mujrimina wa kafa birabbika hadian wa naṣiran.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru lawla nuzzila ɛalayhi al-qurʼanu jumlatan waḥidatan kaḏalika linuṯabbita bihi fuʼadaka wa rattalnahu tartilan.
Wa la yaʼtunaka bimaṯalin ʼilla jiʼnaka bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼaḥsana tafsiran.
Al-laḏina yuḥcaruna ɛala wujuhihim ʼila jahannama ʼulaʼika carrun makanan wa ʼaḍallu sabilan.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-kitaba wa jaɛalna maɛahu ʼaxahu haruna waziran.
Faqulna aḏ/haba ʼila al-qawmi al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayatina fadammarnahum tadmiran.
Wa qawma nuḥin lamma kaḏḏabu ar-rusula ʼaɣraqnahum wa jaɛalnahum lilnnasi ʼayatan wa ʼaɛtadna lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.
Wa ɛadan wa ṯamuda wa ʼaṣḥaba ar-rassi wa qurunan bayna ḏalika kaṯiran.
Wa kullan ḍarabna lahu al-ʼamṯala wa kullan tabbarna tatbiran.
Wa laqad ʼataw ɛala al-qaryati allati ʼumṭirat maṭara as-sawʼi ʼafalam yakunu yarawnaha bal kanu la yarjuna nucuran.
Wa ʼiḏa rʼawka ʼin yattaxiḏunaka ʼilla huzuan ʼahaḏa al-laḏi baɛaṯa Allahu rasulan.
ʼin kada layuḍilluna ɛan ʼalihatina lawla ʼan ṣabarna ɛalayha wa sawfa yaɛlamuna ḥina yarawna al-ɛaḏaba man ʼaḍallu sabilan.
ʼaraʼayta man attaxaḏa ʼilahahu hawahu ʼafaʼanta takunu ɛalayhi wa kilan.
ʼam taḥsabu ʼanna ʼakṯarahum yasmaɛuna ʼaw yaɛqiluna ʼin hum ʼilla kalʼanɛam bal hum ʼaḍallu sabilan.
ʼalam tara ʼila rabbika kayfa madda aḏ̣-ḏ̣illa wa law caʼa lajaɛalahu sakinan ṯumma jaɛalna ac-camsa ɛalayhi dalilan.
Ṯumma qabaḍnahu ʼilayna qabḍan yasiran.
Wa huwa al-laḏi jaɛala lakumu al-layla libasan wa an-nawma subatan wa jaɛala an-nahara nucuran.
Wa huwa al-laḏi ʼarsala ar-riyaḥa bucran bayna yaday raḥmatihi wa ʼanzalna mina as-samaʼi maʼan ṭahuran.
Linuḥyiya bihi baldatan maytan wa nusqiyahu mimma xalaqna ʼanɛaman wa ʼanasiya kaṯiran.
Wa laqad ṣarrafnahu baynahum liyaḏḏakkaru faʼaba ʼakṯaru an-nasi ʼilla kufuran.

Wa ʼalqi ɛaṣaka falamma raʼaha tahtazzu kaʼannaha jannun walla mudbiran wa lam yuɛaqqib ya musa la taxaf ʼinni la yaxafu ladayya al-mursaluna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
ʼilla man ḏ̣alama ṯumma baddala ḥusnan baɛda suʼin faʼinni ɣafurun raḥimun.mpʼ>(an-naml: .

Wa laqad ʼatayna dawuda wa sulaymana ɛilman wa qala al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi faḍḍalana ɛala kaṯirin min ɛibadihi al-muʼminina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .

ʼinni wa jadttu amraʼatan tamlikuhum wa ʼutiyat min kulli cayʼin wa laha ɛarcun ɛaḏ̣imun.mpʼ>(an-naml: .

Qala sananḏ̣uru ʼaṣadaqta ʼam kunta mina al-kaḏibina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Aḏ/hab bikitabi haḏa faʼalqihi ʼilayhim ṯumma tawalla ɛanhum fanḏ̣ur maḏa yarjiɛuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Qalat ya ʼayyuha al-malaʼu ʼinni ʼulqiya ʼilayya kitabun karimun.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
ʼinnahu min sulaymana wa ʼinnahu bismi Allahi ar-raḥmani ar-raḥimi.mpʼ>(an-naml: .

Arjiɛ ʼilayhim falanaʼtiyannahum bijunudin la qibala lahum biha wa lanuxrijannahum minha ʼaḏillatan wa hum ṣaɣiruna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
