Qala al-laḏi ɛindahu ɛilmun mina al-kitabi ʼana ʼatika bihi qabla ʼan yartadda ʼilayka ṭarfuka falamma raʼahu mustaqirran ɛindahu qala haḏa min faḍli rabbi liyabluwani ʼaʼackuru ʼam ʼakfuru wa man cakara faʼinnama yackuru linafsihi wa man kafara faʼinna rabbi ɣaniyun karimun.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Qala nakkiru laha ɛarcaha nanḏ̣ur ʼatahtadi ʼam takunu mina al-laḏina la yahtaduna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Falamma jaʼat qila ʼahakaḏa ɛarcuki qalat kaʼannahu huwa wa ʼutina al-ɛilma min qabliha wa kunna muslimina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa ṣaddaha ma kanat taɛbudu min duni Allahi ʼinnaha kanat min qawmin kafirina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .

Qila laha adxuli aṣ-ṣarḥa falamma raʼat/hu ḥasibat/hu lujjatan wa kacafat ɛan saqayha qala ʼinnahu ṣarḥun mumarradun min qawarira qalat rabbi ʼinni ḏ̣alamtu nafsi wa ʼaslamtu maɛa sulaymana Lillahi rabbi al-ɛalamina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa laqad ʼarsalna ʼila ṯamuda ʼaxahum ṣaliḥan ʼan aɛbudu Allaha faʼiḏa hum fariqani yaxtaṣimuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Qala ya qawmi lima tastaɛjiluna bis-sayyiʼati qabla al-ḥasanati lawla tastaɣfiruna Allaha laɛallakum turḥamuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Qalu aṭṭayyarna bika wa biman maɛaka qala ṭaʼirukum ɛinda Allahi bal ʼantum qawmun tuftanuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa kana fi al-madinati tisɛatu rahṭin yufsiduna fi al-ʼarḍi wa la yuṣliḥuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Qalu taqasamu Billahi lanubayyitannahu wa ʼahlahu ṯumma lanaqulanna liwaliyihi ma cahidna mahlika ʼahlihi wa ʼinna laṣadiquna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa makaru makran wa makarna makran wa hum la yacɛuruna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Fanḏ̣ur kayfa kana ɛaqibatu makrihim ʼanna dammarnahum wa qawmahum ʼajmaɛina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Fatilka buyutuhum xawiyatan bima ḏ̣alamu ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan liqawmin yaɛlamuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa ʼanjayna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa kanu yattaquna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa luṭan ʼiḏ qala liqawmihi ʼataʼtuna al-faḥicata wa ʼantum tubṣiruna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
ʼaʼinnakum lataʼtuna ar-rijala cahwatan min duni an-nisaʼ bal ʼantum qawmun tajhaluna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Fama kana jawaba qawmihi ʼilla ʼan qalu ʼaxriju ʼala luṭin min qaryatikum ʼinnahum ʼunasun yataṭahharuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Faʼanjaynahu wa ʼahlahu ʼilla amraʼatahu qaddarnaha mina al-ɣabirina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa ʼamṭarna ɛalayhim maṭaran fasaʼa maṭaru al-munḏarina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Qul al-ḥamdu Lillahi wa salamun ɛala ɛibadihi al-laḏina aṣṭafa ʼalllahu xayrun ʼamma yucrikuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .

ʼamman xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ʼanzala lakum mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼanbatna bihi ḥadaʼiqa ḏata bahjatin ma kana lakum ʼan tunbitu cajaraha ʼaʼilahun maɛa Allahi bal hum qawmun yaɛdiluna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
ʼamman jaɛala al-ʼarḍa qararan wa jaɛala xilalaha ʼanharan wa jaɛala laha rawasiya wa jaɛala bayna al-baḥrayni ḥajizan ʼaʼilahun maɛa Allahi bal ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛlamuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
ʼamman yujibu al-muḍṭarra ʼiḏa daɛahu wa yakcifu as-suʼa wa yajɛalukum xulafaʼa al-ʼarḍi ʼaʼilahun maɛa Allahi qalilan ma taḏakkaruna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
ʼamman yahdikum fi ḏ̣ulumati al-barri wa al-baḥri wa man yursilu ar-riyaḥa bucran bayna yaday raḥmatihi ʼaʼilahun maɛa Allahi taɛala Allahu ɛamma yucrikuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
ʼamman yabdaʼu al-xalqa ṯumma yuɛiduhu wa man yarzuqukum mina as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi ʼaʼilahun maɛa Allahi qul hatu burhanakum ʼin kuntum ṣadiqina.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Qul la yaɛlamu man fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi al-ɣayba ʼilla Allahu wa ma yacɛuruna ʼayyana yubɛaṯuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Bal addaraka ɛilmuhum fi al-ʼaxirati bal hum fi cakkin minha bal hum minha ɛamuna.mpʼ>(an-naml: .
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru ʼaʼiḏa kunna turaban wa ʼabaʼuuna ʼaʼinna lamuxrajun.
Laqad wuɛidna haḏa naḥnu wa ʼabaʼuuna min qablu ʼin haḏa ʼilla ʼasaṭiru al-ʼawwalin.
Qul siru fi al-ʼarḍi fanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mujrimin.
Wa la taḥzan ɛalayhim wa la takun fi ḍayqin mimma yamkurun.
Wa yaquluna mata haḏa al-waɛdu ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Qul ɛasa ʼan yakuna radifa lakum baɛḍu al-laḏi tastaɛjilun.
Wa ʼinna rabbaka laḏu faḍlin ɛala an-nasi wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yackurun.
Wa ʼinna rabbaka layaɛlamu ma tukinnu ṣuduruhum wa ma yuɛlinun.
Wa ma min ɣaʼibatin fi as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi ʼilla fi kitabin mubinin.
ʼinna haḏa al-qurʼana yaquṣṣu ɛala bani ʼisraʼila ʼakṯara al-laḏi hum fihi yaxtalifun.
Wa ʼinnahu lahudan wa raḥmatun lilmuʼminin.
ʼinna rabbaka yaqḍi baynahum biḥukmihi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ɛalim.
Fatawakkal ɛala Allahi ʼinnaka ɛala al-ḥaqqi al-mubin.
ʼinnaka la tusmiɛu al-mawta wa la tusmiɛu aṣ-ṣumma ad-duɛaʼa ʼiḏa wa llaw mudbirin.
Wa ma ʼanta bihadi al-ɛumyi ɛan ḍalalatihim ʼin tusmiɛu ʼilla man yuʼminu biʼayatina fahum muslimun.
Wa ʼiḏa waqaɛa al-qawlu ɛalayhim ʼaxrajna lahum dabbatan mina al-ʼarḍi tukallimuhum ʼanna an-nasa kanu biʼayatina la yuqinun.
Wa yawma naḥcuru min kulli ʼummatin fawjan mimman yukaḏḏibu biʼayatina fahum yuzaɛun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼu qala ʼakaḏḏabtum biʼayati wa lam tuḥiṭu biha ɛilman ʼammaḏa kuntum taɛmalun.
Wa waqaɛa al-qawlu ɛalayhim bima ḏ̣alamu fahum la yanṭiqun.
ʼalam yaraw ʼanna jaɛalna al-layla liyaskunu fihi wa an-nahara mubṣiran ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yuʼminun.
Wa yawma yunfaxu fi aṣ-ṣuri fafaziɛa man fi as-samawati wa man fi al-ʼarḍi ʼilla man caʼa Allahu wa kullun ʼatawhu daxirin.
Wa tara al-jibala taḥsabuha jamidatan wa hiya tamurru marra as-saḥabi ṣunɛa Allahi al-laḏi ʼatqana kulla cayʼin ʼinnahu xabirun bima tafɛalun.
Man jaʼa bil-ḥasanati falahu xayrun minha wa hum min fazaɛin yawmaʼiḏin ʼaminun.
Wa man jaʼa bis-sayyiʼati fakubbat wujuhuhum fi an-nari hal tujzawna ʼilla ma kuntum taɛmalun.
ʼinnama ʼumirtu ʼan ʼaɛbuda rabba haḏihi al-baldati al-laḏi ḥarramaha wa lahu kullu cayʼin wa ʼumirtu ʼan ʼakuna mina al-muslimin.
Wa ʼan ʼatluwa al-qurʼana famani ahtada faʼinnama yahtadi linafsihi wa man ḍalla faqul ʼinnama ʼana mina al-munḏirin.
Wa qul al-ḥamdu Lillahi sayurikum ʼayatihi fataɛrifunaha wa ma rabbuka biɣafilin ɛamma taɛmalun.
Ṭa-sin-mim.
Tilka ʼayatu al-kitabi al-mubin.
Natlu ɛalayka min nabaʼi musa wa firɛawna bil-ḥaqqi liqawmin yuʼminun.
ʼinna firɛawna ɛala fi al-ʼarḍi wa jaɛala ʼahlaha ciyaɛan yastaḍɛifu ṭaʼifatan minhum yuḏabbiḥu ʼabnaʼahum wa yastaḥyi nisaʼahum ʼinnahu kana mina al-mufsidin.
Wa nuridu ʼan namunna ɛala al-laḏina astuḍɛifu fi al-ʼarḍi wa najɛalahum ʼaʼimmatan wa najɛalahumu al-wariṯin.
Wa numakkina lahum fi al-ʼarḍi wa nuriya firɛawna wa hamana wa junudahuma minhum ma kanu yaḥḏarun.
Wa ʼawḥayna ʼila ʼummi musa ʼan ʼarḍiɛihi faʼiḏa xifti ɛalayhi faʼalqihi fi al-yammi wa la taxafi wa la taḥzani ʼinna radduhu ʼilayki wa jaɛiluhu mina al-mursalin.
Faltaqaṭahu ʼalu firɛawna liyakuna lahum ɛaduwan wa ḥazanan ʼinna firɛawna wa hamana wa junudahuma kanu xaṭiʼin.
Wa qalat amraʼatu firɛawna qurratu ɛaynin li wa laka la taqtuluhu ɛasa ʼan yanfaɛana ʼaw nattaxiḏahu waladan wa hum la yacɛurun.
Wa ʼaṣbaḥa fuʼadu ʼummi musa fariɣan ʼin kadat latubdi bihi lawla ʼan rabaṭna ɛala qalbiha litakuna mina al-muʼminin.
Wa qalat liʼxtihi quṣṣihi fabaṣurat bihi ɛan junubin wa hum la yacɛurun.
Wa ḥarramna ɛalayhi al-maraḍiɛa min qablu faqalat hal ʼadullukum ɛala ʼahli baytin yakfulunahu lakum wa hum lahu naṣiḥun.
Faradadnahu ʼila ʼummihi kay taqarra ɛaynuha wa la taḥzana wa litaɛlama ʼanna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
Wa lamma balaɣa ʼacuddahu wa astawa ʼataynahu ḥukman wa ɛilman wa kaḏalika najzi al-muḥsinin.

Wa daxala al-madinata ɛala ḥini ɣaflatin min ʼahliha fawajada fiha rajulayni yaqtatilani haḏa min ciɛatihi wa haḏa min ɛaduwihi fastaɣaṯahu al-laḏi min ciɛatihi ɛala al-laḏi min ɛaduwihi fawakazahu musa faqaḍa ɛalayhi qala haḏa min ɛamali ac-cayṭani ʼinnahu ɛaduwun muḍillun mubinun.
Qala rabbi ʼinni ḏ̣alamtu nafsi faɣfir li faɣafara lahu ʼinnahu huwa al-ɣafuru ar-raḥim.
Qala rabbi bima ʼanɛamta ɛalayya falan ʼakuna ḏ̣ahiran lilmujrimin.
Faʼaṣbaḥa fi al-madinati xaʼifan yataraqqabu faʼiḏa al-laḏi astanṣarahu bil-ʼamsi yastaṣrixuhu qala lahu musa ʼinnaka laɣawiyun mubinun.

Falamma ʼan ʼarada ʼan yabṭica bial-laḏi huwa ɛaduwun lahuma qala ya musa ʼaturidu ʼan taqtulani kama qatalta nafsan bil-ʼamsi ʼin turidu ʼilla ʼan takuna jabbaran fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma turidu ʼan takuna mina al-muṣliḥin.
Wa jaʼa rajulun min ʼaqṣa al-madinati yasɛa qala ya musa ʼinna al-malaʼa yaʼtamiruna bika liyaqtuluka faxruj ʼinni laka mina an-naṣiḥin.
Faxaraja minha xaʼifan yataraqqabu qala rabbi najjini mina al-qawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa lamma tawajjaha tilqaʼa madyana qala ɛasa rabbi ʼan yahdiyani sawaʼa as-sabil.
Wa lamma warada maʼa madyana wajada ɛalayhi ʼummatan mina an-nasi yasquna wa wajada min dunihim amraʼtayni taḏudani qala ma xaṭbukuma qalata la nasqi ḥatta yuṣdira ar-riɛaʼu wa ʼabuna cayxun kabirun.
Fasaqa lahuma ṯumma tawalla ʼila aḏ̣-ḏ̣illi faqala rabbi ʼinni lima ʼanzalta ʼilayya min xayrin faqirun.
Fajaʼat/hu ʼiḥdahuma tamci ɛala astiḥyaʼin qalat ʼinna ʼabi yadɛuka liyajziyaka ʼajra ma saqayta lana falamma jaʼahu wa qaṣṣa ɛalayhi al-qaṣaṣa qala la taxaf najawta mina al-qawmi aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Qalat ʼiḥdahuma ya ʼabati astaʼjirhu ʼinna xayra mani astaʼjarta al-qawiyu al-ʼamin.

Qala ʼinni ʼuridu ʼan ʼunkiḥaka ʼiḥda abnatayya hatayni ɛala ʼan taʼjurani ṯamaniyata ḥijajin faʼin ʼatmamta ɛacran famin ɛindika wa ma ʼuridu ʼan ʼacuqqa ɛalayka satajiduni ʼin caʼa Allahu mina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Qala ḏalika bayni wa baynaka ʼayyama al-ʼajalayni qaḍaytu fala ɛudwana ɛalayya wa Allahu ɛala ma naqulu wa kilun.
Falamma qaḍa musa al-ʼajala wa sara biʼahlihi ʼanasa min janibi aṭ-ṭuri naran qala liʼhlihi amkuṯu ʼinni ʼanastu naran laɛalli ʼatikum minha bixabarin ʼaw jaḏwatin mina an-nari laɛallakum taṣṭalun.
Falamma ʼataha nudi min caṭiʼi al-wadi al-ʼaymani fi al-buqɛati al-mubarakati mina ac-cajarati ʼan ya musa ʼinni ʼana Allahu rabbu al-ɛalamin.
Wa ʼan ʼalqi ɛaṣaka falamma raʼaha tahtazzu kaʼannaha jannun walla mudbiran wa lam yuɛaqqib ya musa ʼaqbil wa la taxaf ʼinnaka mina al-ʼaminin.
Asluk yadaka fi jaybika taxruj bayḍaʼa min ɣayri suʼin wa aḍmum ʼilayka janaḥaka mina ar-rahbi faḏanika burhanani min rabbika ʼila firɛawna wa malaʼihi ʼinnahum kanu qawman fasiqin.
Qala rabbi ʼinni qataltu minhum nafsan faʼaxafu ʼan yaqtulun.
Wa ʼaxi harunu huwa ʼafṣaḥu minni lisanan faʼarsilhu maɛi ridʼan yuṣaddiquni ʼinni ʼaxafu ʼan yukaḏḏibun.
Qala sanacuddu ɛaḍudaka biʼaxika wa najɛalu lakuma sulṭanan fala yaṣiluna ʼilaykuma biʼayatina ʼantuma wa man attabaɛakuma al-ɣalibun.
Falamma jaʼahum musa biʼayatina bayyinatin qalu ma haḏa ʼilla siḥrun muftaran wa ma samiɛna bihaḏa fi ʼabaʼina al-ʼawwalin.
Wa qala musa rabbi ʼaɛlamu biman jaʼa bil-huda min ɛindihi wa man takunu lahu ɛaqibatu ad-dari ʼinnahu la yufliḥu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.
Wa qala firɛawnu ya ʼayyuha al-malaʼu ma ɛalimtu lakum min ʼilahin ɣayri faʼawqid li ya hamanu ɛala aṭ-ṭini fajɛal li ṣarḥan laɛalli ʼaṭṭaliɛu ʼila ʼilahi musa wa ʼinni laʼaḏ̣unnuhu mina al-kaḏibin.
Wa astakbara huwa wa junuduhu fi al-ʼarḍi biɣayri al-ḥaqqi wa ḏ̣annu ʼannahum ʼilayna la yurjaɛun.
Faʼaxaḏnahu wa junudahu fanabaḏnahum fi al-yammi fanḏ̣ur kayfa kana ɛaqibatu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa jaɛalnahum ʼaʼimmatan yadɛuna ʼila an-nari wa yawma al-qiyamati la yunṣarun.
Wa ʼatbaɛnahum fi haḏihi ad-dunya laɛnatan wa yawma al-qiyamati hum mina al-maqbuḥin.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-kitaba min baɛdi ma ʼahlakna al-quruna al-ʼula baṣaʼira lilnnasi wa hudan wa raḥmatan laɛallahum yataḏakkarun.
Wa ma kunta bijanibi al-ɣarbiyi ʼiḏ qaḍayna ʼila musa al-ʼamra wa ma kunta mina ac-cahidin.
Wa lakinna ʼancaʼna qurunan fataṭawala ɛalayhimu al-ɛumuru wa ma kunta ṯawian fi ʼahli madyana tatlu ɛalayhim ʼayatina wa lakinna kunna mursilin.
Wa ma kunta bijanibi aṭ-ṭuri ʼiḏ nadayna wa lakin raḥmatan min rabbika litunḏira qawman ma ʼatahum min naḏirin min qablika laɛallahum yataḏakkarun.
Wa lawla ʼan tuṣibahum muṣibatun bima qaddamat ʼaydihim fayaqulu rabbana lawla ʼarsalta ʼilayna rasulan fanattabiɛa ʼayatika wa nakuna mina al-muʼminin.
Falamma jaʼahumu al-ḥaqqu min ɛindina qalu lawla ʼutiya miṯla ma ʼutiya musa ʼawalam yakfuru bima ʼutiya musa min qablu qalu siḥrani taḏ̣ahara wa qalu ʼinna bikullin kafirun.
Qul faʼtu bikitabin min ɛindi Allahi huwa ʼahda minhuma ʼattabiɛhu ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Faʼin lam yastajibu laka faɛlam ʼannama yattabiɛuna ʼahwaʼahum wa man ʼaḍallu mimman attabaɛa hawahu biɣayri hudan mina Allahi ʼinna Allaha la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa laqad waṣṣalna lahumu al-qawla laɛallahum yataḏakkarun.
Al-laḏina ʼataynahumu al-kitaba min qablihi hum bihi yuʼminun.
Wa ʼiḏa yutla ɛalayhim qalu ʼamanna bihi ʼinnahu al-ḥaqqu min rabbina ʼinna kunna min qablihi muslimin.
ʼulaʼika yuʼtawna ʼajrahum marratayni bima ṣabaru wa yadraʼuna bil-ḥasanati as-sayyiʼata wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun.
Wa ʼiḏa samiɛu al-laɣwa ʼaɛraḍu ɛanhu wa qalu lana ʼaɛmaluna wa lakum ʼaɛmalukum salamun ɛalaykum la nabtaɣi al-jahilin.
ʼinnaka la tahdi man ʼaḥbabta wa lakinna Allaha yahdi man yacaʼu wa huwa ʼaɛlamu bil-muhtadin.
Wa qalu ʼin nattabiɛi al-huda maɛaka nutaxaṭṭaf min ʼarḍina ʼawalam numakkin lahum ḥaraman ʼaminan yujba ʼilayhi ṯamaratu kulli cayʼin rizqan min ladunna wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
Wa kam ʼahlakna min qaryatin baṭirat maɛicataha fatilka masakinuhum lam tuskan min baɛdihim ʼilla qalilan wa kunna naḥnu al-wariṯin.
Wa ma kana rabbuka muhlika al-qura ḥatta yabɛaṯa fi ʼummiha rasulan yatlu ɛalayhim ʼayatina wa ma kunna muhliki al-qura ʼilla wa ʼahluha ḏ̣alimun.
Wa ma ʼutitum min cayʼin famataɛu al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa zinatuha wa ma ɛinda Allahi xayrun wa ʼabqa ʼafala taɛqilun.
ʼafaman waɛadnahu waɛdan ḥasanan fahuwa laqihi kaman mattaɛnahu mataɛa al-ḥayati ad-dunya ṯumma huwa yawma al-qiyamati mina al-muḥḍarin.
Wa yawma yunadihim fayaqulu ʼayna curakaʼiya al-laḏina kuntum tazɛumun.
Qala al-laḏina ḥaqqa ɛalayhimu al-qawlu rabbana haʼuulaʼ al-laḏina ʼaɣwayna ʼaɣwaynahum kama ɣawayna tabarraʼna ʼilayka ma kanu ʼiyana yaɛbudun.
Wa qila adɛu curakaʼakum fadaɛawhum falam yastajibu lahum wa raʼaw al-ɛaḏaba law ʼannahum kanu yahtadun.
Wa yawma yunadihim fayaqulu maḏa ʼajabtumu al-mursalin.
Faɛamiyat ɛalayhimu al-ʼanbaʼu yawmaʼiḏin fahum la yatasaʼalun.
Faʼamma man taba wa ʼamana wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan faɛasa ʼan yakuna mina al-mufliḥin.
Wa rabbuka yaxluqu ma yacaʼu wa yaxtaru ma kana lahumu al-xiyaratu subḥana Allahi wa taɛala ɛamma yucrikun.
Wa rabbuka yaɛlamu ma tukinnu ṣuduruhum wa ma yuɛlinun.
Wa huwa Allahu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa lahu al-ḥamdu fi al-ʼula wa al-ʼaxirati wa lahu al-ḥukmu wa ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ʼin jaɛala Allahu ɛalaykumu al-layla sarmadan ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati man ʼilahun ɣayru Allahi yaʼtikum biḍiyaʼin ʼafala tasmaɛun.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ʼin jaɛala Allahu ɛalaykumu an-nahara sarmadan ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati man ʼilahun ɣayru Allahi yaʼtikum bilaylin taskununa fihi ʼafala tubṣirun.
Wa min raḥmatihi jaɛala lakumu al-layla wa an-nahara litaskunu fihi wa litabtaɣu min faḍlihi wa laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa yawma yunadihim fayaqulu ʼayna curakaʼiya al-laḏina kuntum tazɛumun.
Wa nazaɛna min kulli ʼummatin cahidan faqulna hatu burhanakum faɛalimu ʼanna al-ḥaqqa Lillahi wa ḍalla ɛanhum ma kanu yaftarun.
ʼinna qaruna kana min qawmi musa fabaɣa ɛalayhim wa ʼataynahu mina al-kunuzi ma ʼinna mafatiḥahu latanuʼ bil-ɛuṣbati ʼuli al-quwati ʼiḏ qala lahu qawmuhu la tafraḥ ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu al-fariḥin.
Wa abtaɣi fima ʼataka Allahu ad-dara al-ʼaxirata wa la tansa naṣibaka mina ad-dunya wa ʼaḥsin kama ʼaḥsana Allahu ʼilayka wa la tabɣi al-fasada fi al-ʼarḍi ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu al-mufsidin.
Qala ʼinnama ʼutituhu ɛala ɛilmin ɛindi ʼawalam yaɛlam ʼanna Allaha qad ʼahlaka min qablihi mina al-quruni man huwa ʼacaddu minhu quwatan wa ʼakṯaru jamɛan wa la yusʼalu ɛan ḏunubihimu al-mujrimun.
Faxaraja ɛala qawmihi fi zinatihi qala al-laḏina yuriduna al-ḥayata ad-dunya yalayta lana miṯla ma ʼutiya qarunu ʼinnahu laḏu ḥaḏ̣ḏ̣in ɛaḏ̣imin.
Wa qala al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma waylakum ṯawabu Allahi xayrun liman ʼamana wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan wa la yulaqqaha ʼilla aṣ-ṣabirun.
Faxasafna bihi wa bidarihi al-ʼarḍa fama kana lahu min fiʼatin yanṣurunahu min duni Allahi wa ma kana mina al-muntaṣirin.

Wa ʼaṣbaḥa al-laḏina tamannaw makanahu bil-ʼamsi yaquluna waykaʼanna Allaha yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu min ɛibadihi wa yaqdiru lawla ʼan manna Allahu ɛalayna laxasafa bina waykaʼannahu la yufliḥu al-kafirun.
Tilka ad-daru al-ʼaxiratu najɛaluha lillaḏina la yuriduna ɛuluwan fi al-ʼarḍi wa la fasadan wa al-ɛaqibatu lilmuttaqin.
Man jaʼa bil-ḥasanati falahu xayrun minha wa man jaʼa bis-sayyiʼati fala yujza al-laḏina ɛamilu as-sayyiʼati ʼilla ma kanu yaɛmalun.
ʼinna al-laḏi faraḍa ɛalayka al-qurʼana laradduka ʼila maɛadin qul rabbi ʼaɛlamu man jaʼa bil-huda wa man huwa fi ḍalalin mubinin.
Wa ma kunta tarju ʼan yulqa ʼilayka al-kitabu ʼilla raḥmatan min rabbika fala takunanna ḏ̣ahiran lilkafirin.
Wa la yaṣuddunnaka ɛan ʼayati Allahi baɛda ʼiḏ ʼunzilat ʼilayka wa adɛu ʼila rabbika wa la takunanna mina al-mucrikin.
Wa la tadɛu maɛa Allahi ʼilahan ʼaxara la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa kullu cayʼin halikun ʼilla wajhahu lahu al-ḥukmu wa ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
ʼalif-lam-mim.
ʼaḥasiba an-nasu ʼan yutraku ʼan yaqulu ʼamanna wa hum la yuftanun.
Wa laqad fatanna al-laḏina min qablihim falayaɛlamanna Allahu al-laḏina ṣadaqu wa layaɛlamanna al-kaḏibin.
ʼam ḥasiba al-laḏina yaɛmaluna as-sayyiʼati ʼan yasbiquna saʼa ma yaḥkumun.
Man kana yarju liqaʼa Allahi faʼinna ʼajala Allahi laʼatin wa huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Wa man jahada faʼinnama yujahidu linafsihi ʼinna Allaha laɣaniyun ɛani al-ɛalamin.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lanukaffiranna ɛanhum sayyiʼatihim wa lanajziyannahum ʼaḥsana al-laḏi kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa waṣṣayna al-ʼinsana biwalidayhi ḥusnan wa ʼin jahadaka litucrika bi ma laysa laka bihi ɛilmun fala tuṭiɛhuma ʼilayya marjiɛukum faʼunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lanudxilannahum fi aṣ-ṣaliḥin.

Wa mina an-nasi man yaqulu ʼamanna Billahi faʼiḏa ʼuḏiya fi Allahi jaɛala fitnata an-nasi kaɛaḏabi Allahi wa laʼin jaʼa naṣrun min rabbika layaqulunna ʼinna kunna maɛakum ʼawalaysa Allahu biʼaɛlama bima fi ṣuduri al-ɛalamin.
Wa layaɛlamanna Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa layaɛlamanna al-munafiqin.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru lillaḏina ʼamanu attabiɛu sabilana wa lnaḥmil xaṭayakum wa ma hum biḥamilina min xaṭayahum min cayʼin ʼinnahum lakaḏibun.
Wa layaḥmilunna ʼaṯqalahum wa ʼaṯqalan maɛa ʼaṯqalihim wa layusʼalunna yawma al-qiyamati ɛamma kanu yaftarun.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna nuḥan ʼila qawmihi falabiṯa fihim ʼalfa sanatin ʼilla xamsina ɛaman faʼaxaḏahum aṭ-ṭufanu wa hum ḏ̣alimun.
Faʼanjaynahu wa ʼaṣḥaba as-safinati wa jaɛalnaha ʼayatan lilɛalamin.
Wa ʼibrahima ʼiḏ qala liqawmihi aɛbudu Allaha wa attaquhu ḏalikum xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.

ʼinnama taɛbuduna min duni Allahi ʼawṯanan wa taxluquna ʼifkan ʼinna al-laḏina taɛbuduna min duni Allahi la yamlikuna lakum rizqan fabtaɣu ɛinda Allahi ar-rizqa wa aɛbuduhu wa ackuru lahu ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Wa ʼin tukaḏḏibu faqad kaḏḏaba ʼumamun min qablikum wa ma ɛala ar-rasuli ʼilla al-balaɣu al-mubin.
ʼawalam yaraw kayfa yubdiʼu Allahu al-xalqa ṯumma yuɛiduhu ʼinna ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasirun.
Qul siru fi al-ʼarḍi fanḏ̣uru kayfa badaʼa al-xalqa ṯumma Allahu yunciʼu an-nacʼata al-ʼaxirata ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Yuɛaḏḏibu man yacaʼu wa yarḥamu man yacaʼu wa ʼilayhi tuqlabun.
Wa ma ʼantum bimuɛjizina fi al-ʼarḍi wa la fi as-samaʼi wa ma lakum min duni Allahi min wa liyin wa la naṣirin.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru biʼayati Allahi wa liqaʼihi ʼulaʼika yaʼisu min raḥmati wa ʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Fama kana jawaba qawmihi ʼilla ʼan qalu aqtuluhu ʼaw ḥarriquhu faʼanjahu Allahu mina an-nari ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yuʼminun.

Wa qala ʼinnama attaxaḏtum min duni Allahi ʼawṯanan mawaddata baynikum fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya ṯumma yawma al-qiyamati yakfuru baɛḍukum bibaɛḍin wa yalɛanu baɛḍukum baɛḍan wa maʼwakumu an-naru wa ma lakum min naṣirin.
Faʼamana lahu luṭun wa qala ʼinni muhajirun ʼila rabbi ʼinnahu huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Wa wahabna lahu ʼisḥaqa wa yaɛquba wa jaɛalna fi ḏurriyatihi an-nubuwata wa al-kitaba wa ʼataynahu ʼajrahu fi ad-dunya wa ʼinnahu fi al-ʼaxirati lamina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Wa luṭan ʼiḏ qala liqawmihi ʼinnakum lataʼtuna al-faḥicata ma sabaqakum biha min ʼaḥadin mina al-ɛalamin.
ʼaʼinnakum lataʼtuna ar-rijala wa taqṭaɛuna as-sabila wa taʼtuna fi nadikum al-munkara fama kana jawaba qawmihi ʼilla ʼan qalu aʼtina biɛaḏabi Allahi ʼin kunta mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Qala rabbi anṣurni ɛala al-qawmi al-mufsidin.
Wa lamma jaʼat rusuluna ʼibrahima bil-bucra qalu ʼinna muhliku ʼahli haḏihi al-qaryati ʼinna ʼahlaha kanu ḏ̣alimin.
Qala ʼinna fiha luṭan qalu naḥnu ʼaɛlamu biman fiha lanunajjiyannahu wa ʼahlahu ʼilla amraʼatahu kanat mina al-ɣabirin.
Wa lamma ʼan jaʼat rusuluna luṭan siʼa bihim wa ḍaqa bihim ḏarɛan wa qalu la taxaf wa la taḥzan ʼinna munajjuka wa ʼahlaka ʼilla amraʼataka kanat mina al-ɣabirin.
ʼinna munziluna ɛala ʼahli haḏihi al-qaryati rijzan mina as-samaʼi bima kanu yafsuqun.
Wa laqad tarakna minha ʼayatan bayyinatan liqawmin yaɛqilun.
Wa ʼila madyana ʼaxahum cuɛayban faqala ya qawmi aɛbudu Allaha wa arju al-yawma al-ʼaxira wa la taɛṯaw fi al-ʼarḍi mufsidin.
Fakaḏḏabuhu faʼaxaḏat/humu ar-rajfatu faʼaṣbaḥu fi darihim jaṯimin.
Wa ɛadan wa ṯamuda wa qad tabayyana lakum min masakinihim wa zayyana lahumu ac-cayṭanu ʼaɛmalahum faṣaddahum ɛani as-sabili wa kanu mustabṣirin.
Wa qaruna wa firɛawna wa hamana wa laqad jaʼahum musa bil-bayyinati fastakbaru fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma kanu sabiqin.

Fakullan ʼaxaḏna biḏanbihi faminhum man ʼarsalna ɛalayhi ḥaṣiban wa minhum man ʼaxaḏat/hu aṣ-ṣayḥatu wa minhum man xasafna bihi al-ʼarḍa wa minhum man ʼaɣraqna wa ma kana Allahu liyaḏ̣limahum wa lakin kanu ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.
Maṯalu al-laḏina attaxaḏu min duni Allahi ʼawliyaʼa kamaṯali al-ɛankabuti attaxaḏat baytan wa ʼinna ʼawhana al-buyuti labaytu al-ɛankabuti law kanu yaɛlamun.
ʼinna Allaha yaɛlamu ma yadɛuna min dunihi min cayʼin wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Wa tilka al-ʼamṯalu naḍribuha lilnnasi wa ma yaɛqiluha ʼilla al-ɛalimun.
Xalaqa Allahu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa bil-ḥaqqi ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan lilmuʼminin.
Atlu ma ʼuḥiya ʼilayka mina al-kitabi wa ʼaqim aṣ-ṣalata ʼinna aṣ-ṣalata tanha ɛan al-faḥcaʼi wa al-munkari wa laḏikru Allahi ʼakbaru wa Allahu yaɛlamu ma taṣnaɛun.

Wa la tujadilu ʼahla al-kitabi ʼilla bi-ati hiya ʼaḥsanu ʼilla al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu minhum wa qulu ʼamanna bial-laḏi ʼunzila ʼilayna wa ʼunzila ʼilaykum wa ʼilahuna wa ʼilahukum waḥidun wa naḥnu lahu muslimun.
Wa kaḏalika ʼanzalna ʼilayka al-kitaba fa-al-laḏina ʼataynahum al-kitaba yuʼminuna bihi wa min haʼuulaʼ man yuʼminu bihi wa ma yajḥadu biʼayatina ʼilla al-kafirun.
Wa ma kunta tatlu min qablihi min kitabin wa la taxuṭṭuhu biyaminika ʼiḏan lartaba al-mubṭilun.
Bal huwa ʼayatun bayyinatun fi ṣuduri al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma wa ma yajḥadu biʼayatina ʼilla aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.
Wa qalu lawla ʼunzila ɛalayhi ʼayatun min rabbihi qul ʼinnama al-ʼayatu ɛinda Allahi wa ʼinnama ʼana naḏirun mubinun.
ʼawalam yakfihim ʼanna ʼanzalna ɛalayka al-kitaba yutla ɛalayhim ʼinna fi ḏalika laraḥmatan wa ḏikra liqawmin yuʼminun.
Qul kafa Billahi bayni wa baynakum cahidan yaɛlamu ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa al-laḏina ʼamanu bil-baṭili wa kafaru Billahi ʼulaʼika hum al-xasirun.
Wa yastaɛjilunaka bil-ɛaḏabi wa lawla ʼajalun musamman lajaʼahum al-ɛaḏabu wa layaʼtiyannahum baɣtatan wa hum la yacɛurun.
Yastaɛjilunaka bil-ɛaḏabi wa ʼinna jahannama lamuḥiṭatun bil-kafirin.
Yawma yaɣcahum al-ɛaḏabu min fawqihim wa min taḥti ʼarjulihim wa yaqulu ḏuqu ma kuntum taɛmalun.
Ya ɛibadi al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼinna ʼarḍi wasiɛatun faʼiyaya faɛbudun.
Kullu nafsin ḏaʼiqatu al-mawti ṯumma ʼilayna turjaɛun.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lanubawwiʼannahum mina al-jannati ɣurafan tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha niɛma ʼajru al-ɛamilin.
Al-laḏina ṣabaru wa ɛala rabbihim yatawakkalun.
Wa kaʼayyin min dabbatin la taḥmilu rizqaha Allahu yarzuquha wa ʼiyakum wa huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Wa laʼin saʼaltahum man xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa saxxara ac-camsa wa al-qamara layaqulunna Allahu faʼanna yuʼfakun.
Allahu yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu min ɛibadihi wa yaqdiru lahu ʼinna Allaha bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Wa laʼin saʼaltahum man nazzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼaḥya bihi al-ʼarḍa min baɛdi mawtiha layaqulunna Allahu qul al-ḥamdu Lillahi bal ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛqilun.
Wa ma haḏihi al-ḥayatu ad-dunya ʼilla lahwun wa laɛibun wa ʼinna ad-dara al-ʼaxirata lahiya al-ḥayawanu law kanu yaɛlamun.
Faʼiḏa rakibu fi al-fulki daɛaw Allaha muxliṣina lahu ad-dina falamma najjahum ʼila al-barri ʼiḏa hum yucrikun.
Liyakfuru bima ʼataynahum wa liyatamattaɛu fasawfa yaɛlamun.
ʼawalam yaraw ʼanna jaɛalna ḥaraman ʼaminan wa yutaxaṭṭafu an-nasu min ḥawlihim ʼafabialbaṭili yuʼminuna wa biniɛmati Allahi yakfurun.
Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼaw kaḏḏaba bil-ḥaqqi lamma jaʼahu ʼalaysa fi jahannama maṯwan lilkafirin.
Wa al-laḏina jahadu fina lanahdiyannahum subulana wa ʼinna Allaha lamaɛa al-muḥsinin.
ʼalif-lam-mim.
Ɣulibati ar-rum.
Fi ʼadna al-ʼarḍi wa hum min baɛdi ɣalabihim sayaɣlibun.
Fi biḍɛi sinina Lillahi al-ʼamru min qablu wa min baɛdu wa yawmaʼiḏin yafraḥu al-muʼminun.
Binaṣri Allahi yanṣuru man yacaʼu wa huwa al-ɛazizu ar-raḥim.
Waɛda Allahi la yuxlifu Allahu waɛdahu wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Yaɛlamuna ḏ̣ahiran mina al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa hum ɛan al-ʼaxirati hum ɣafilun.
ʼawalam yatafakkaru fi ʼanfusihim ma xalaqa Allahu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ma baynahuma ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼajalin musamman wa ʼinna kaṯiran mina an-nasi biliqaʼi rabbihim lakafirun.

ʼawalam yasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fayanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-laḏina min qablihim kanu ʼacadda minhum quwatan wa ʼaṯaru al-ʼarḍa wa ɛamaruha ʼakṯara mimma ɛamaruha wa jaʼat/hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati fama kana Allahu liyaḏ̣limahum wa lakin kanu ʼanfusahum yaḏ̣limun.
Ṯumma kana ɛaqibata al-laḏina ʼasaʼu as-suʼa ʼan kaḏḏabu biʼayati Allahi wa kanu biha yastahziʼun.
Allahu yabdaʼu al-xalqa ṯumma yuɛiduhu ṯumma ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Wa yawma taqumu as-saɛatu yublisu al-mujrimun.
Wa lam yakun lahum min curakaʼihim cufaɛaʼu wa kanu bicurakaʼihim kafirin.
Wa yawma taqumu as-saɛatu yawmaʼiḏin yatafarraqun.
Faʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati fahum fi rawḍatin yuḥbarun.
Wa ʼamma al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biʼayatina wa liqaʼi al-ʼaxirati faʼulaʼika fi al-ɛaḏabi muḥḍarun.
Fasubḥana Allahi ḥina tumsuna wa ḥina tuṣbiḥun.
Wa lahu al-ḥamdu fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ɛaciyan wa ḥina tuḏ̣hirun.
Yuxriju al-ḥayya mina al-mayyiti wa yuxriju al-mayyita mina al-ḥayyi wa yuḥyi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha wa kaḏalika tuxrajun.
Wa min ʼayatihi ʼan xalaqakum min turabin ṯumma ʼiḏa ʼantum bacarun tantacirun.
Wa min ʼayatihi ʼan xalaqa lakum min ʼanfusikum ʼazwajan litaskunu ʼilayha wa jaɛala baynakum mawaddatan wa raḥmatan ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yatafakkarun.
Wa min ʼayatihi xalqu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa axtilafu ʼalsinatikum wa ʼalwanikum ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin lilɛalimin.
Wa min ʼayatihi manamukum bil-layli wa an-nahari wa abtiɣaʼuukum min faḍlihi ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yasmaɛun.
Wa min ʼayatihi yurikum al-barqa xawfan wa ṭamaɛan wa yunazzilu mina as-samaʼi maʼan fayuḥyi bihi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yaɛqilun.
Wa min ʼayatihi ʼan taquma as-samaʼu wa al-ʼarḍu biʼamrihi ṯumma ʼiḏa daɛakum daɛwatan mina al-ʼarḍi ʼiḏa ʼantum taxrujun.
Wa lahu man fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi kullun lahu qanitun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi yabdaʼu al-xalqa ṯumma yuɛiduhu wa huwa ʼahwanu ɛalayhi wa lahu al-maṯalu al-ʼaɛla fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.

Ḍaraba lakum maṯalan min ʼanfusikum hal lakum min ma malakat ʼaymanukum min curakaʼa fi ma razaqnakum faʼantum fihi sawaʼun taxafunahum kaxifatikum ʼanfusakum kaḏalika nufaṣṣilu al-ʼayati liqawmin yaɛqilun.
Bal attabaɛa al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu ʼahwaʼahum biɣayri ɛilmin faman yahdi man ʼaḍalla Allahu wa ma lahum min naṣirin.
Faʼaqim wajhaka lilddini ḥanifan fiṭrata Allahi allati faṭara an-nasa ɛalayha la tabdila lixalqi Allahi ḏalika ad-dinu al-qayyimu wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Munibina ʼilayhi wa attaquhu wa ʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa la takunu mina al-mucrikin.
Mina al-laḏina farraqu dinahum wa kanu ciyaɛan kullu ḥizbin bima ladayhim fariḥun.
Wa ʼiḏa massa an-nasa ḍurrun daɛaw rabbahum munibina ʼilayhi ṯumma ʼiḏa ʼaḏaqahum minhu raḥmatan ʼiḏa fariqun minhum birabbihim yucrikun.
Liyakfuru bima ʼataynahum fatamattaɛu fasawfa taɛlamun.
ʼam ʼanzalna ɛalayhim sulṭanan fahuwa yatakallamu bima kanu bihi yucrikun.
Wa ʼiḏa ʼaḏaqna an-nasa raḥmatan fariḥu biha wa ʼin tuṣibhum sayyiʼatun bima qaddamat ʼaydihim ʼiḏa hum yaqnaṭun.
ʼawalam yaraw ʼanna Allaha yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu wa yaqdiru ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yuʼminun.
Faʼati ḏa al-qurba ḥaqqahu wa al-miskina wa abna as-sabili ḏalika xayrun lillaḏina yuriduna wajha Allahi wa ʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
Wa ma ʼataytum min riban liyarbuwa fi ʼamwali an-nasi fala yarbu ɛinda Allahi wa ma ʼataytum min zakatin turiduna wajha Allahi faʼulaʼika hum al-muḍɛifun.
Allahu al-laḏi xalaqakum ṯumma razaqakum ṯumma yumitukum ṯumma yuḥyikum hal min curakaʼikum man yafɛalu min ḏalikum min cayʼin subḥanahu wa taɛala ɛamma yucrikun.
Ḏ̣ahara al-fasadu fi al-barri wa al-baḥri bima kasabat ʼaydi an-nasi liyuḏiqahum baɛḍa al-laḏi ɛamilu laɛallahum yarjiɛun.
Qul siru fi al-ʼarḍi fanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-laḏina min qablu kana ʼakṯaruhum mucrikin.
Faʼaqim wajhaka lilddini al-qayyimi min qabli ʼan yaʼtiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi yawmaʼiḏin yaṣṣaddaɛun.
Man kafara faɛalayhi kufruhu wa man ɛamila ṣaliḥan faliʼanfusihim yamhadun.
Liyajziya al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati min faḍlihi ʼinnahu la yuḥibbu al-kafirin.
Wa min ʼayatihi ʼan yursila ar-riyaḥa mubacciratin wa liyuḏiqakum min raḥmatihi wa litajriya al-fulku biʼamrihi wa litabtaɣu min faḍlihi wa laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna min qablika rusulan ʼila qawmihim fajaʼuhum bil-bayyinati fantaqamna mina al-laḏina ʼajramu wa kana ḥaqqan ɛalayna naṣru al-muʼminin.

Allahu al-laḏi yursilu ar-riyaḥa fatuṯiru saḥaban fayabsuṭuhu fi as-samaʼi kayfa yacaʼu wa yajɛaluhu kisafan fatara al-wadqa yaxruju min xilalihi faʼiḏa ʼaṣaba bihi man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi ʼiḏa hum yastabcirun.
Wa ʼin kanu min qabli ʼan yunazzala ɛalayhim min qablihi lamublisin.
Fanḏ̣ur ʼila ʼaṯari raḥmati Allahi kayfa yuḥyi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha ʼinna ḏalika lamuḥyi al-mawta wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa laʼin ʼarsalna riḥan faraʼawhu muṣfarran laḏ̣allu min baɛdihi yakfurun.
Faʼinnaka la tusmiɛu al-mawta wa la tusmiɛu aṣ-ṣumma ad-duɛaʼa ʼiḏa wa llaw mudbirin.
Wa ma ʼanta bihadi al-ɛumyi ɛan ḍalalatihim ʼin tusmiɛu ʼilla man yuʼminu biʼayatina fahum muslimun.
Allahu al-laḏi xalaqakum min ḍaɛfin ṯumma jaɛala min baɛdi ḍaɛfin quwatan ṯumma jaɛala min baɛdi quwatin ḍaɛfan wa caybatan yaxluqu ma yacaʼu wa huwa al-ɛalimu al-qadir.
Wa yawma taqumu as-saɛatu yuqsimu al-mujrimuna ma labiṯu ɣayra saɛatin kaḏalika kanu yuʼfakun.
Wa qala al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma wa al-ʼimana laqad labiṯtum fi kitabi Allahi ʼila yawmi al-baɛṯi fahaḏa yawmu al-baɛṯi wa lakinnakum kuntum la taɛlamun.
Fayawmaʼiḏin la yanfaɛu al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu maɛḏiratuhum wa la hum yustaɛtabun.
Wa laqad ḍarabna lilnnasi fi haḏa al-qurʼani min kulli maṯalin wa laʼin jiʼtahum biʼayatin layaqulanna al-laḏina kafaru ʼin ʼantum ʼilla mubṭilun.
Kaḏalika yaṭbaɛu Allahu ɛala qulubi al-laḏina la yaɛlamun.
Faṣbir ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun wa la yastaxiffannaka al-laḏina la yuqinun.
ʼalif-lam-mim.
Tilka ʼayatu al-kitabi al-ḥakim.
Hudan wa raḥmatan lilmuḥsinin.
Al-laḏina yuqimuna aṣ-ṣalata wa yuʼtuna az-zakata wa hum bil-ʼaxirati hum yuqinun.
ʼulaʼika ɛala hudan min rabbihim wa ʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
Wa mina an-nasi man yactari lahwa al-ḥadiṯi liyuḍilla ɛan sabili Allahi biɣayri ɛilmin wa yattaxiḏaha huzuan ʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun muhinun.
Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhi ʼayatuna walla mustakbiran kaʼan lam yasmaɛha kaʼanna fi ʼuḏunayhi waqran fabaccirhu biɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lahum jannatu an-naɛim.
Xalidina fiha waɛda Allahi ḥaqqan wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Xalaqa as-samawati biɣayri ɛamadin tarawnaha wa ʼalqa fi al-ʼarḍi rawasiya ʼan tamida bikum wa baṯṯa fiha min kulli dabbatin wa ʼanzalna mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼanbatna fiha min kulli zawjin karimin.
Haḏa xalqu Allahi faʼaruni maḏa xalaqa al-laḏina min dunihi bal aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna fi ḍalalin mubinin.
Wa laqad ʼatayna luqmana al-ḥikmata ʼan ackur Lillahi wa man yackur faʼinnama yackuru linafsihi wa man kafara faʼinna Allaha ɣaniyun ḥamidun.
Wa ʼiḏ qala luqmanu liabnihi wa huwa yaɛiḏ̣uhu ya bunayya la tucrik Billahi ʼinna ac-cirka laḏ̣ulmun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Wa waṣṣayna al-ʼinsana biwalidayhi ḥamalat/hu ʼummuhu wahnan ɛala wahnin wa fiṣaluhu fi ɛamayni ʼan ackur li wa liwalidayka ʼilayya al-maṣir.

Wa ʼin jahadaka ɛala ʼan tucrika bi ma laysa laka bihi ɛilmun fala tuṭiɛhuma wa ṣaḥibhuma fi ad-dunya maɛrufan wa attabiɛ sabila man ʼanaba ʼilayya ṯumma ʼilayya marjiɛukum faʼunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Ya bunayya ʼinnaha ʼin takun miṯqala ḥabbatin min xardalin fatakun fi ṣaxratin ʼaw fi as-samawati ʼaw fi al-ʼarḍi yaʼti biha Allahu ʼinna Allaha laṭifun xabirun.
Ya bunayya ʼaqim aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼmur bil-maɛrufi wa anha ɛan al-munkari wa aṣbir ɛala ma ʼaṣabaka ʼinna ḏalika min ɛazmi al-ʼumur.
Wa la tuṣaɛɛir xaddaka lilnnasi wa la tamci fi al-ʼarḍi maraḥan ʼinna Allaha la yuḥibbu kulla muxtalin faxurin.
Waqṣid fi macyika wa aɣḍuḍ min ṣawtika ʼinna ʼankara al-ʼaṣwati laṣawtu al-ḥamir.

ʼalam taraw ʼanna Allaha saxxara lakum ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa ʼasbaɣa ɛalaykum niɛamahu ḏ̣ahiratan wa baṭinatan wa mina an-nasi man yujadilu fi Allahi biɣayri ɛilmin wa la hudan wa la kitabin munirin.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum attabiɛu ma ʼanzala Allahu qalu bal nattabiɛu ma wajadna ɛalayhi ʼabaʼana ʼawalaw kana ac-cayṭanu yadɛuhum ʼila ɛaḏabi as-saɛir.
Wa man yuslim wajhahu ʼila Allahi wa huwa muḥsinun faqadi astamsaka bil-ɛurwati al-wuṯqa wa ʼila Allahi ɛaqibatu al-ʼumur.
Wa man kafara fala yaḥzunka kufruhu ʼilayna marjiɛuhum fanunabbiʼuhum bima ɛamilu ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
Numattiɛuhum qalilan ṯumma naḍṭarruhum ʼila ɛaḏabin ɣaliḏ̣in.
Wa laʼin saʼaltahum man xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa layaqulunna Allahu qul al-ḥamdu Lillahi bal ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛlamun.
Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼinna Allaha huwa al-ɣaniyu al-ḥamid.
Wa law ʼannama fi al-ʼarḍi min cajaratin ʼaqlamun wa al-baḥru yamudduhu min baɛdihi sabɛatu ʼabḥurin ma nafidat kalimatu Allahi ʼinna Allaha ɛazizun ḥakimun.
Ma xalqukum wa la baɛṯukum ʼilla kanafsin waḥidatin ʼinna Allaha samiɛun baṣirun.
ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha yuliju al-layla fi an-nahari wa yuliju an-nahara fi al-layli wa saxxara ac-camsa wa al-qamara kullun yajri ʼila ʼajalin musamman wa ʼanna Allaha bima taɛmaluna xabirun.
Ḏalika biʼanna Allaha huwa al-ḥaqqu wa ʼanna ma yadɛuna min dunihi al-baṭilu wa ʼanna Allaha huwa al-ɛaliyu al-kabir.
ʼalam tara ʼanna al-fulka tajri fi al-baḥri biniɛmati Allahi liyuriyakum min ʼayatihi ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin likulli ṣabbarin cakurin.
Wa ʼiḏa ɣaciyahum mawjun kalḏ̣ḏ̣ulali daɛaw Allaha muxliṣina lahu ad-dina falamma najjahum ʼila al-barri faminhum muqtaṣidun wa ma yajḥadu biʼayatina ʼilla kullu xattarin kafurin.

Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu attaqu rabbakum wa axcaw yawman la yajzi wa a-dun ɛan waladihi wa la mawludun huwa jazin ɛan wa a-dihi cayʼan ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun fala taɣurrannakum al-ḥaya atu ad-dunya wa la yaɣurrannakum Billahi al-ɣarur.
ʼinna Allaha ɛindahu ɛilmu as-saɛati wa yunazzilu al-ɣayṯa wa yaɛlamu ma fi al-ʼarḥami wa ma tadri nafsun maḏa taksibu ɣadan wa ma tadri nafsun biʼayyi ʼarḍin tamutu ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun xabirun.
ʼalif-lam-mim.
Tanzilu al-kitabi la rayba fihi min rabbi al-ɛalamin.
ʼam yaquluna aftarahu bal huwa al-ḥaqqu min rabbika litunḏira qawman ma ʼatahum min naḏirin min qablika laɛallahum yahtadun.
Allahu al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ma baynahuma fi sittati ʼayyamin ṯumma astawa ɛala al-ɛarci ma lakum min dunihi min wa liyin wa la cafiɛin ʼafala tataḏakkarun.
Yudabbiru al-ʼamra mina as-samaʼi ʼila al-ʼarḍi ṯumma yaɛruju ʼilayhi fi yawmin kana miqdaruhu ʼalfa sanatin mimma taɛuddun.
Ḏalika ɛalimu al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati al-ɛazizu ar-raḥim.
Al-laḏi ʼaḥsana kulla cayʼin xalaqahu wa badaʼa xalqa al-ʼinsani min ṭinin.
Ṯumma jaɛala naslahu min sulalatin min maʼin mahinin.
Ṯumma sawwahu wa nafaxa fihi min ruḥihi wa jaɛala lakum as-samɛa wa al-ʼabṣara wa al-ʼafʼidata qalilan ma tackurun.
Wa qalu ʼaʼiḏa ḍalalna fi al-ʼarḍi ʼaʼinna lafi xalqin jadidin bal hum biliqaʼi rabbihim kafirun.
Qul yatawaffakum malaku al-mawti al-laḏi wukkila bikum ṯumma ʼila rabbikum turjaɛun.
Wa law tara ʼiḏ al-mujrimuna nakisu ruʼsihim ɛinda rabbihim rabbana ʼabṣarna wa samiɛna farjiɛna naɛmal ṣaliḥan ʼinna muqinun.
Wa law ciʼna laʼatayna kulla nafsin hudaha wa lakin ḥaqqa al-qawlu minni laʼamlaʼanna jahannama mina al-jinnati wa an-nasi ʼajmaɛin.
Faḏuqu bima nasitum liqaʼa yawmikum haḏa ʼinna nasinakum wa ḏuqu ɛaḏaba al-xuldi bima kuntum taɛmalun.
ʼinnama yuʼminu biʼayatina al-laḏina ʼiḏa ḏukkiru biha xarru sujjadan wa sabbaḥu biḥamdi rabbihim wa hum la yastakbirun.
Tatajafa junubuhum ɛan al-maḍajiɛi yadɛuna rabbahum xawfan wa ṭamaɛan wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun.
Fala taɛlamu nafsun ma ʼuxfiya lahum min qurrati ʼaɛyunin jazaʼan bima kanu yaɛmalun.
ʼafaman kana muʼminan kaman kana fasiqan la yastawun.
ʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati falahum jannatu al-maʼwa nuzulan bima kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa ʼamma al-laḏina fasaqu famaʼwahum an-naru kullama ʼaradu ʼan yaxruju minha ʼuɛidu fiha wa qila lahum ḏuqu ɛaḏaba an-nari al-laḏi kuntum bihi tukaḏḏibun.
Wa lanuḏiqannahum mina al-ɛaḏabi al-ʼadna duna al-ɛaḏabi al-ʼakbari laɛallahum yarjiɛun.
Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman ḏukkira biʼayati rabbihi ṯumma ʼaɛraḍa ɛanha ʼinna mina al-mujrimina muntaqimun.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-kitaba fala takun fi miryatin min liqaʼihi wa jaɛalnahu hudan libani ʼisraʼil.
Wa jaɛalna minhum ʼaʼimmatan yahduna biʼamrina lamma ṣabaru wa kanu biʼayatina yuqinun.
ʼinna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu baynahum yawma al-qiyamati fima kanu fihi yaxtalifun.
ʼawalam yahdi lahum kam ʼahlakna min qablihim mina al-quruni yamcuna fi masakinihim ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin ʼafala yasmaɛun.
ʼawalam yaraw ʼanna nasuqu al-maʼa ʼila al-ʼarḍi al-juruzi fanuxriju bihi zarɛan taʼkulu minhu ʼanɛamuhum wa ʼanfusuhum ʼafala yubṣirun.
Wa yaquluna mata haḏa al-fatḥu ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Qul yawma al-fatḥi la yanfaɛu al-laḏina kafaru ʼimanuhum wa la hum yunḏ̣arun.
Faʼaɛriḍ ɛanhum wa antaḏ̣ir ʼinnahum muntaḏ̣irun.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu attaqi Allaha wa la tuṭiɛ al-kafirina wa al-munafiqina ʼinna Allaha kana ɛaliman ḥakiman.
Wa attabiɛ ma yuḥa ʼilayka min rabbika ʼinna Allaha kana bima taɛmaluna xabiran.
Wa tawakkal ɛala Allahi wa kafa Billahi wa kilan.

Ma jaɛala Allahu lirajulin min qalbayni fi jawfihi wa ma jaɛala ʼazwajakum al-laʼi tuḏ̣ahiruna minhunna ʼummahatikum wa ma jaɛala ʼadɛiyaʼakum ʼabnaʼakum ḏalikum qawlukum biʼafwahikum wa Allahu yaqulu al-ḥaqqa wa huwa yahdi as-sabil.

Adɛuhum liʼabaʼihim huwa ʼaqsaṭu ɛinda Allahi faʼin lam taɛlamu ʼabaʼahum faʼixwanukum fi ad-dini wa mawalikum wa laysa ɛalaykum junaḥun fima ʼaxṭaʼtum bihi wa lakin ma taɛammadat qulubukum wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.

An-nabiyu ʼawla bil-muʼminina min ʼanfusihim wa ʼazwajuhu ʼummahatuhum wa ʼulu al-ʼarḥami baɛḍuhum ʼawla bibaɛḍin fi kitabi Allahi mina al-muʼminina wa al-muhajirina ʼilla ʼan tafɛalu ʼila ʼawliyaʼikum maɛrufan kana ḏalika fi al-kitabi masṭuran.
Wa ʼiḏ ʼaxaḏna mina an-nabiyina miṯaqahum wa minka wa min nuḥin wa ʼibrahima wa musa wa ɛisa abni maryama wa ʼaxaḏna minhum miṯaqan ɣaliḏ̣an.
Liyasʼala aṣ-ṣadiqina ɛan ṣidqihim wa ʼaɛadda lilkafirina ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum ʼiḏ jaʼatkum junudun faʼarsalna ɛalayhim riḥan wa junudan lam tarawha wa kana Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣiran.
ʼiḏ jaʼukum min fawqikum wa min ʼasfala minkum wa ʼiḏ zaɣat al-ʼabṣaru wa balaɣat al-qulubu al-ḥanajira wa taḏ̣unnuna Billahi aḏ̣-ḏ̣unun.
Hunalika abtuliya al-muʼminuna wa zulzilu zilzalan cadidan.
Wa ʼiḏ yaqulu al-munafiquna wa al-laḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun ma waɛadana Allahu wa rasuluhu ʼilla ɣururan.
Wa ʼiḏ qalat ṭaʼifatun minhum ya ʼahla yaṯriba la muqama lakum farjiɛu wa yastaʼḏinu fariqun minhum an-nabiya yaquluna ʼinna buyutana ɛawratun wa ma hiya biɛawratin ʼin yuriduna ʼilla firaran.
Wa law duxilat ɛalayhim min ʼaqṭariha ṯumma suʼilu al-fitnata laʼatawha wa ma talabbaṯu biha ʼilla yasiran.
Wa laqad kanu ɛahadu Allaha min qablu la yuwalluna al-ʼadbara wa kana ɛahdu Allahi masʼulan.
Qul lan yanfaɛakum al-firaru ʼin farartum mina al-mawti ʼaw al-qatli wa ʼiḏan la tumattaɛuna ʼilla qalilan.
Qul man ḏa al-laḏi yaɛṣimukum mina Allahi ʼin ʼarada bikum suʼan ʼaw ʼarada bikum raḥmatan wa la yajiduna lahum min duni Allahi waliyan wa la naṣiran.
Qad yaɛlamu Allahu al-muɛawwiqina minkum wa al-qaʼilina liʼixwanihim halumma ʼilayna wa la yaʼtuna al-baʼsa ʼilla qalilan.

ʼaciḥḥatan ɛalaykum faʼiḏa jaʼa al-xawfu raʼaytahum yanḏ̣uruna ʼilayka taduru ʼaɛyunuhum kallaḏi yuɣca ɛalayhi mina al-mawti faʼiḏa ḏahaba al-xawfu salaqukum biʼalsinatin ḥidadin ʼaciḥḥatan ɛala al-xayri ʼulaʼika lam yuʼminu faʼaḥbaṭa Allahu ʼaɛmalahum wa kana ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasiran.
Yaḥsabuna al-ʼaḥzaba lam yaḏ/habu wa ʼin yaʼti al-ʼaḥzabu yawaddu law ʼannahum baduna fi al-ʼaɛrabi yasʼaluna ɛan ʼanbaʼikum wa law kanu fikum ma qatalu ʼilla qalilan.
Laqad kana lakum fi rasuli Allahi ʼuswatun ḥasanatun liman kana yarju Allaha wa al-yawma al-ʼaxira wa ḏakara Allaha kaṯiran.
Wa lamma raʼa al-muʼminuna al-ʼaḥzaba qalu haḏa ma waɛadana Allahu wa rasuluhu wa ṣadaqa Allahu wa rasuluhu wa ma zadahum ʼilla ʼimanan wa tasliman.
Mina al-muʼminina rijalun ṣadaqu ma ɛahadu Allaha ɛalayhi faminhum man qaḍa naḥbahu wa minhum man yantaḏ̣iru wa ma baddalu tabdilan.
Liyajziya Allahu aṣ-ṣadiqina biṣidqihim wa yuɛaḏḏiba al-munafiqina ʼin caʼa ʼaw yatuba ɛalayhim ʼinna Allaha kana ɣafuran raḥiman.
Waradda Allahu al-laḏina kafaru biɣayḏ̣ihim lam yanalu xayran wa kafa Allahu al-muʼminina al-qitala wa kana Allahu qawiyan ɛazizan.
Wa ʼanzala al-laḏina ḏ̣aharuhum min ʼahli al-kitabi min ṣayaṣihim wa qaḏafa fi qulubihim ar-ruɛba fariqan taqtuluna wa taʼsiruna fariqan.
Wa ʼawraṯakum ʼarḍahum wa diyarahum wa ʼamwalahum wa ʼarḍan lam taṭaʼuha wa kana Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadiran.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu qul liʼzwajika ʼin kuntunna turidna al-ḥaya ata ad-dunya wa zinataha fataɛalayna ʼumattiɛkunna wa ʼusarriḥkunna saraḥan jamilan.
Wa ʼin kuntunna turidna Allaha wa rasulahu wa ad-dara al-ʼaxirata faʼinna Allaha ʼaɛadda lilmuḥsinati minkunna ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Ya nisaʼa an-nabiyi man yaʼti minkunna bifaḥicatin mubayyinatin yuḍaɛaf laha al-ɛaḏabu ḍiɛfayni wa kana ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasiran.
Wa man yaqnut minkunna Lillahi wa rasulihi wa taɛmal ṣaliḥan nuʼtiha ʼajraha marratayni wa ʼaɛtadna laha rizqan kariman.
Ya nisaʼa an-nabiyi lastunna kaʼaḥadin mina an-nisaʼ ʼin attaqaytunna fala taxḍaɛna bil-qawli fayaṭmaɛa al-laḏi fi qalbihi maraḍun wa qulna qawlan maɛrufan.

Wa qarna fi buyutikunna wa la tabarrajna tabarruja al-jahiliyati al-ʼula wa ʼaqimna aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatina az-zakata wa ʼaṭiɛna Allaha wa rasulahu ʼinnama yuridu Allahu liyuḏ/hiba ɛankum ar-rijsa ʼahla al-bayti wa yuṭahhirakum taṭhiran.
Wa aḏkurna ma yutla fi buyutikunna min ʼayati Allahi wa al-ḥikmati ʼinna Allaha kana laṭifan xabiran.

ʼinna al-muslimina wa al-muslimati wa al-muʼminina wa al-muʼminati wa al-qanitina wa al-qanitati wa aṣ-ṣadiqina wa aṣ-ṣadiqati wa aṣ-ṣabirina wa aṣ-ṣabirati wa al-xaciɛina wa al-xaciɛati wa al-mutaṣaddiqina wa al-mutaṣaddiqati wa aṣ-ṣaʼimina wa aṣ-ṣaʼimati wa al-ḥafiḏ̣ina furujahum wa al-ḥafiḏ̣ati wa aḏ-ḏakirina Allaha kaṯiran wa aḏ-ḏakirati ʼaɛadda Allahu lahum maɣfiratan wa ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Wa ma kana limuʼminin wa la muʼminatin ʼiḏa qaḍa Allahu wa rasuluhu ʼamran ʼan yakuna lahum al-xiyaratu min ʼamrihim wa man yaɛṣi Allaha wa rasulahu faqad ḍalla ḍalalan mubinan.

Wa ʼiḏ taqulu lillaḏi ʼanɛama Allahu ɛalayhi wa ʼanɛamta ɛalayhi ʼamsik ɛalayka zawjaka wa attaqi Allaha wa tuxfi fi nafsika ma Allahu mubdihi wa taxca an-nasa wa Allahu ʼaḥaqqu ʼan taxcahu falamma qaḍa zaydun minha waṭaran zawwajnakaha likay la yakuna ɛala al-muʼminina ḥarajun fi ʼazwaji ʼadɛiyaʼihim ʼiḏa qaḍaw minhunna waṭaran wa kana ʼamru Allahi mafɛulan.
Ma kana ɛala an-nabiyi min ḥarajin fima faraḍa Allahu lahu sunnata Allahi fi al-laḏina xalaw min qablu wa kana ʼamru Allahi qadaran maqduran.
Al-laḏina yuballiɣuna risalati Allahi wa yaxcawnahu wa la yaxcawna ʼaḥadan ʼilla Allaha wa kafa Billahi ḥasiban.
Ma kana muḥammadun ʼaba ʼaḥadin min rijalikum wa lakin rasula Allahi wa xatama an-nabiyina wa kana Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛaliman.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu aḏkuru Allaha ḏikran kaṯiran.
Wa sabbiḥuhu bukratan wa ʼaṣilan.
Huwa al-laḏi yuṣalli ɛalaykum wa malaʼikatuhu liyuxrijakum mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼila an-nur wa kana bil-muʼminina raḥiman.
Taḥiyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salamun wa ʼaɛadda lahum ʼajran kariman.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu ʼinna ʼarsalnaka cahidan wa mubacciran wa naḏiran.
Wa daɛian ʼila Allahi biʼiḏnihi wa sirajan muniran.
Wa baccir al-muʼminina biʼanna lahum mina Allahi faḍlan kabiran.
Wa la tuṭiɛ al-kafirina wa al-munafiqina wa daɛ ʼaḏahum wa tawakkal ɛala Allahi wa kafa Billahi wa kilan.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa nakaḥtum al-muʼminati ṯumma ṭallaqtumuhunna min qabli ʼan tamassuhunna fama lakum ɛalayhinna min ɛiddatin taɛtaddunaha famattiɛuhunna wa sarriḥuhunna saraḥan jamilan.

Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu ʼinna ʼaḥlalna laka ʼazwajaka al-lati ʼatayta ʼujurahunna wa ma malakat yaminuka mimma ʼafaʼa Allahu ɛalayka wa banati ɛammika wa banati ɛammatika wa banati xalika wa banati xalatika al-lati hajarna maɛaka wa amraʼatan muʼminatan ʼin wahabat nafsaha lilnnabiyi ʼin ʼarada an-nabiyu ʼan yastankiḥaha xaliṣatan laka min duni al-muʼminina qad ɛalimna ma faraḍna ɛalayhim fi ʼazwajihim wa ma malakat ʼaymanuhum likayla yakuna ɛalayka ḥarajun wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.

Turji man tacaʼu minhunna wa tuʼwi ʼilayka man tacaʼu wa man abtaɣayta mimman ɛazalta fala junaḥa ɛalayka ḏalika ʼadna ʼan taqarra ʼaɛyunuhunna wa la yaḥzanna wa yarḍayna bima ʼataytahunna kulluhunna wa Allahu yaɛlamu ma fi qulubikum wa kana Allahu ɛaliman ḥaliman.
La yaḥillu laka an-nisaʼ min baɛdu wa la ʼan tabaddala bihinna min ʼazwajin wa law ʼaɛjabaka ḥusnuhunna ʼilla ma malakat yaminuka wa kana Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin raqiban.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tadxulu buyuta an-nabiyi ʼilla ʼan yuʼḏana lakum ʼila ṭaɛamin ɣayra naḏ̣irina ʼinahu wa lakin ʼiḏa duɛitum fadxulu faʼiḏa ṭaɛimtum fantaciru wa la mustaʼnisina liḥadiṯin ʼinna ḏalikum kana yuʼḏi an-nabiya fayastaḥyi minkum wa Allahu la yastaḥyi mina al-ḥaqqi wa ʼiḏa saʼaltumuhunna mataɛan fasʼaluhunna min waraʼi ḥijabin ḏalikum ʼaṭharu liqulubikum wa qulubihinna wa ma kana lakum ʼan tuʼḏu rasula Allahi wa la ʼan tankiḥu ʼazwajahu min baɛdihi ʼabadan ʼinna ḏalikum kana ɛinda Allahi ɛaḏ̣iman.
ʼin tubdu cayʼan ʼaw tuxfuhu faʼinna Allaha kana bikulli cayʼin ɛaliman.

La junaḥa ɛalayhinna fi ʼabaʼihinna wa la ʼabnaʼihinna wa la ʼixwanihinna wa la ʼabnaʼi ʼixwanihinna wa la ʼabnaʼi ʼaxawatihinna wa la nisaʼihinna wa la ma malakat ʼaymanuhunna wa attaqina Allaha ʼinna Allaha kana ɛala kulli cayʼin cahidan.
ʼinna Allaha wa malaʼikatahu yuṣalluna ɛala an-nabiyi ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ṣallu ɛalayhi wa sallimu tasliman.
ʼinna al-laḏina yuʼḏuna Allaha wa rasulahu laɛanahum Allahu fi ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxirati wa ʼaɛadda lahum ɛaḏaban muhinan.
Wa al-laḏina yuʼḏuna al-muʼminina wa al-muʼminati biɣayri ma aktasabu faqadi aḥtamalu buhtanan wa ʼiṯman mubinan.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu qul liʼzwajika wa banatika wa nisaʼi al-muʼminina yudnina ɛalayhinna min jalabibihinna ḏalika ʼadna ʼan yuɛrafna fala yuʼḏayna wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.
Laʼin lam yantahi al-munafiquna wa al-laḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun wa al-murjifuna fi al-madinati lanuɣriyannaka bihim ṯumma la yujawirunaka fiha ʼilla qalilan.
Malɛunina ʼaynama ṯuqifu ʼuxiḏu wa quttilu taqtilan.
Sunnata Allahi fi al-laḏina xalaw min qablu wa lan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdilan.
Yasʼaluka an-nasu ɛan as-saɛati qul ʼinnama ɛilmuha ɛinda Allahi wa ma yudrika laɛalla as-saɛata takunu qariban.
ʼinna Allaha laɛana al-kafirina wa ʼaɛadda lahum saɛiran.
Xalidina fiha ʼabadan la yajiduna waliyan wa la naṣiran.
Yawma tuqallabu wujuhuhum fi an-nari yaquluna ya laytana ʼaṭaɛna Allaha wa ʼaṭaɛna ar-rasul.
Wa qalu rabbana ʼinna ʼaṭaɛna sadatana wa kubaraʼana faʼaḍalluna as-sabil.
Rabbana ʼatihim ḍiɛfayni mina al-ɛaḏabi wa al-ɛanhum laɛnan kabiran.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la takunu kallaḏina ʼaḏaw musa fabarraʼahu Allahu mimma qalu wa kana ɛinda Allahi wajihan.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu Allaha wa qulu qawlan sadidan.
Yuṣliḥ lakum ʼaɛmalakum wa yaɣfir lakum ḏunubakum wa man yuṭiɛ Allaha wa rasulahu faqad faza fawzan ɛaḏ̣iman.
ʼinna ɛaraḍna al-ʼamanata ɛala as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa al-jibali faʼabayna ʼan yaḥmilnaha wa ʼacfaqna minha wa ḥamalaha al-ʼinsanu ʼinnahu kana ḏ̣aluman jahulan.
Liyuɛaḏḏiba Allahu al-munafiqina wa al-munafiqati wa al-mucrikina wa al-mucrikati wa yatuba Allahu ɛala al-muʼminina wa al-muʼminati wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.
Al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa lahu al-ḥamdu fi al-ʼaxirati wa huwa al-ḥakimu al-xabir.
Yaɛlamu ma yaliju fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma yaxruju minha wa ma yanzilu mina as-samaʼi wa ma yaɛruju fiha wa huwa ar-raḥimu al-ɣafur.

Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru la taʼtina as-saɛatu qul bala wa rabbi lataʼtiyannakum ɛalimi al-ɣaybi la yaɛzubu ɛanhu miṯqalu ḏarratin fi as-samawati wa la fi al-ʼarḍi wa la ʼaṣɣaru min ḏalika wa la ʼakbaru ʼilla fi kitabin mubinin.
Liyajziya al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati ʼulaʼika lahum maɣfiratun wa rizqun karimun.
Wa al-laḏina saɛaw fi ʼayatina muɛajizina ʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun min rijzin ʼalimun.
Wa yara al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma al-laḏi ʼunzila ʼilayka min rabbika huwa al-ḥaqqa wa yahdi ʼila ṣiraṭi al-ɛazizi al-ḥamid.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru hal nadullukum ɛala rajulin yunabbiʼukum ʼiḏa muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin ʼinnakum lafi xalqin jadidin.
ʼaftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban ʼam bihi jinnatun bal al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati fi al-ɛaḏabi wa aḍ-ḍalali al-baɛid.

ʼafalam yaraw ʼila ma bayna ʼaydihim wa ma xalfahum mina as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi ʼin nacaʼ naxsif bihim al-ʼarḍa ʼaw nusqiṭ ɛalayhim kisafan mina as-samaʼi ʼinna fi ḏalika laʼayatan likulli ɛabdin munibin.
Wa laqad ʼatayna dawuda minna faḍlan ya jibalu ʼawwibi maɛahu wa aṭ-ṭayra wa ʼalanna lahu al-ḥadid.
ʼan aɛmal sabiɣatin wa qaddir fi as-sardi wa aɛmalu ṣaliḥan ʼinni bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.

Wa lisulaymana ar-riḥa ɣuduwuha cahrun wa rawaḥuha cahrun wa ʼasalna lahu ɛayna al-qiṭri wa mina al-jinni man yaɛmalu bayna yadayhi biʼiḏni rabbihi wa man yaziɣ minhum ɛan ʼamrina nuḏiqhu min ɛaḏabi as-saɛir.
Yaɛmaluna lahu ma yacaʼu min maḥariba wa tamaṯila wa jifanin kaljawabi wa qudurin rasiyatin aɛmalu ʼala dawuda cukran wa qalilun min ɛibadiya ac-cakur.
Falamma qaḍayna ɛalayhi al-mawta ma dallahum ɛala mawtihi ʼilla dabbatu al-ʼarḍi taʼkulu minsaʼatahu falamma xarra tabayyanat al-jinnu ʼan law kanu yaɛlamuna al-ɣayba ma labiṯu fi al-ɛaḏabi al-muhin.
Laqad kana lisabaʼiin fi maskanihim ʼayatun jannatani ɛan yaminin wa cimalin kulu min rizqi rabbikum wa ackuru lahu baldatun ṭayyibatun wa rabbun ɣafurun.
Faʼaɛraḍu faʼarsalna ɛalayhim sayla al-ɛarimi wa baddalnahum bijannatayhim jannatayni ḏawata ʼukulin xamṭin wa ʼaṯlin wa cayʼin min sidrin qalilin.
Ḏalika jazaynahum bima kafaru wa hal nujazi ʼilla al-kafur.
Wa jaɛalna baynahum wa bayna al-qura allati barakna fiha quran ḏ̣ahiratan wa qaddarna fiha as-sayra siru fiha layaliya wa ʼayyaman ʼaminin.
Faqalu rabbana baɛid bayna ʼasfarina wa ḏ̣alamu ʼanfusahum fajaɛalnahum ʼaḥadiṯa wa mazzaqnahum kulla mumazzaqin ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin likulli ṣabbarin cakurin.
Wa laqad ṣaddaqa ɛalayhim ʼiblisu ḏ̣annahu fa attabaɛuhu ʼilla fariqan mina al-muʼminin.
Wa ma kana lahu ɛalayhim min sulṭanin ʼilla linaɛlama man yuʼminu bil-ʼaxirati mimman huwa minha fi cakkin wa rabbuka ɛala kulli cayʼin ḥafiḏ̣un.
Qul adɛu al-laḏina zaɛamtum min duni Allahi la yamlikuna miṯqala ḏarratin fi as-samawati wa la fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma lahum fihima min cirkin wa ma lahu minhum min ḏ̣ahirin.
Wa la tanfaɛu ac-cafaɛatu ɛindahu ʼilla liman ʼaḏina lahu ḥatta ʼiḏa fuzziɛa ɛan qulubihim qalu maḏa qala rabbukum qalu al-ḥaqqa wa huwa al-ɛaliyu al-kabir.
Qul man yarzuqukum mina as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi qul Allahu wa ʼinna ʼaw ʼiyakum laɛala hudan ʼaw fi ḍalalin mubinin.
Qul la tusʼaluna ɛamma ʼajramna wa la nusʼalu ɛamma taɛmalun.
Qul yajmaɛu baynana rabbuna ṯumma yaftaḥu baynana bil-ḥaqqi wa huwa al-fattaḥu al-ɛalim.
Qul ʼaruniya al-laḏina ʼalḥaqtum bihi curakaʼa kalla bal huwa Allahu al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Wa ma ʼarsalnaka ʼilla kaffatan lilnnasi baciran wa naḏiran wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Wa yaquluna mata haḏa al-waɛdu ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Qul lakum miɛadu yawmin la tastaʼxiruna ɛanhu saɛatan wa la tastaqdimun.

Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru lan nuʼmina bihaḏa al-qurʼani wa la bial-laḏi bayna yadayhi wa law tara ʼiḏ aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna mawqufuna ɛinda rabbihim yarjiɛu baɛḍuhum ʼila baɛḍin al-qawla yaqulu al-laḏina astuḍɛifu lillaḏina astakbaru lawla ʼantum lakunna muʼminin.
Qala al-laḏina astakbaru lillaḏina astuḍɛifu ʼanaḥnu ṣadadnakum ɛan al-huda baɛda ʼiḏ jaʼakum bal kuntum mujrimin.

Wa qala al-laḏina astuḍɛifu lillaḏina astakbaru bal makru al-layli wa an-nahari ʼiḏ taʼmurunana ʼan nakfura Billahi wa najɛala lahu ʼandadan wa ʼasarru an-nadamata lamma raʼaw al-ɛaḏaba wa jaɛalna al-ʼaɣlala fi ʼaɛnaqi al-laḏina kafaru hal yujzawna ʼilla ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa ma ʼarsalna fi qaryatin min naḏirin ʼilla qala mutrafuha ʼinna bima ʼursiltum bihi kafirun.
Wa qalu naḥnu ʼakṯaru ʼamwalan wa ʼawladan wa ma naḥnu bimuɛaḏḏabin.
Qul ʼinna rabbi yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu wa yaqdiru wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Wa ma ʼamwalukum wa la ʼawladukum bi-ati tuqarribukum ɛindana zulfa ʼilla man ʼamana wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan faʼulaʼika lahum jazaʼu aḍ-ḍiɛfi bima ɛamilu wa hum fi al-ɣurufati ʼaminun.
Wa al-laḏina yasɛawna fi ʼayatina muɛajizina ʼulaʼika fi al-ɛaḏabi muḥḍarun.
Qul ʼinna rabbi yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu min ɛibadihi wa yaqdiru lahu wa ma ʼanfaqtum min cayʼin fahuwa yuxlifuhu wa huwa xayru ar-raziqin.
Wa yawma yaḥcuruhum jamiɛan ṯumma yaqulu lilmalaʼikati ʼahaʼuulaʼ ʼiyakum kanu yaɛbudun.
Qalu subḥanaka ʼanta waliyuna min dunihim bal kanu yaɛbuduna al-jinna ʼakṯaruhum bihim muʼminun.
Falyawma la yamliku baɛḍukum libaɛḍin nafɛan wa la ḍarran wa naqulu lillaḏina ḏ̣alamu ḏuqu ɛaḏaba an-nari allati kuntum biha tukaḏḏibun.

Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatuna bayyinatin qalu ma haḏa ʼilla rajulun yuridu ʼan yaṣuddakum ɛamma kana yaɛbudu ʼabaʼuukum wa qalu ma haḏa ʼilla ʼifkun muftaran wa qala al-laḏina kafaru lilḥaqqi lamma jaʼahum ʼin haḏa ʼilla siḥrun mubinun.
Wa ma ʼataynahum min kutubin yadrusunaha wa ma ʼarsalna ʼilayhim qablaka min naḏirin.
Wa kaḏḏaba al-laḏina min qablihim wa ma balaɣu miɛcara ma ʼataynahum fakaḏḏabu rusuli fakayfa kana nakir.
Qul ʼinnama ʼaɛiḏ̣ukum biwaḥidatin ʼan taqumu Lillahi maṯna wa furada ṯumma tatafakkaru ma biṣaḥibikum min jinnatin ʼin huwa ʼilla naḏirun lakum bayna yaday ɛaḏabin cadidin.
Qul ma saʼaltukum min ʼajrin fahuwa lakum ʼin ʼajriya ʼilla ɛala Allahi wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin cahidun.
Qul ʼinna rabbi yaqḏifu bil-ḥaqqi ɛallamu al-ɣuyub.
Qul jaʼa al-ḥaqqu wa ma yubdiʼu al-baṭilu wa ma yuɛid.
Qul ʼin ḍalaltu faʼinnama ʼaḍillu ɛala nafsi wa ʼin ahtadaytu fabima yuḥi ʼilayya rabbi ʼinnahu samiɛun qaribun.
Wa law tara ʼiḏ faziɛu fala fawta wa ʼuxiḏu min makanin qaribin.
Wa qalu ʼamanna bihi wa ʼanna lahumu at-tanawucu min makanin baɛidin.
Wa qad kafaru bihi min qablu wa yaqḏifuna bil-ɣaybi min makanin baɛidin.
Wa ḥila baynahum wa bayna ma yactahuna kama fuɛila biʼacyaɛihim min qablu ʼinnahum kanu fi cakkin muribin.
Al-ḥamdu Lillahi faṭiri as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi jaɛili al-malaʼikati rusulan ʼuli ʼajniḥatin maṯna wa ṯulaṯa wa rubaɛa yazidu fi al-xalqi ma yacaʼu ʼinna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Ma yaftaḥ Allahu lilnnasi min raḥmatin fala mumsika laha wa ma yumsik fala mursila lahu min baɛdihi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu aḏkuru niɛmata Allahi ɛalaykum hal min xaliqin ɣayru Allahi yarzuqukum mina as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa faʼanna tuʼfakun.
Wa ʼin yukaḏḏibuka faqad kuḏḏibat rusulun min qablika wa ʼila Allahi turjaɛu al-ʼumur.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun fala taɣurrannakumu al-ḥaya atu ad-dunya wa la yaɣurrannakum Billahi al-ɣarur.
ʼinna ac-cayṭana lakum ɛaduwun fa attaxiḏuhu ɛaduwan ʼinnama yadɛu ḥizbahu liyakunu min ʼaṣḥabi as-saɛir.
Al-laḏina kafaru lahum ɛaḏabun cadidun wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lahum maɣfiratun wa ʼajrun kabirun.
ʼafaman zuyyina lahu suʼ ɛamalihi faraʼahu ḥasanan faʼinna Allaha yuḍillu man yacaʼu wa yahdi man yacaʼu fala taḏ/hab nafsuka ɛalayhim ḥasaratin ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun bima yaṣnaɛun.
Wa Allahu al-laḏi ʼarsala ar-riyaḥa fatuṯiru saḥaban fasuqnahu ʼila baladin mayyitin faʼaḥyayna bihi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha kaḏalika an-nucur.

Man kana yuridu al-ɛizzata falillahi al-ɛizzatu jamiɛan ʼilayhi yaṣɛadu al-kalimu aṭ-ṭayyibu wa al-ɛamalu aṣ-ṣaliḥu yarfaɛuhu wa al-laḏina yamkuruna as-sayyiʼati lahum ɛaḏabun cadidun wa makru ʼulaʼika huwa yabur.

Wa Allahu xalaqakum min turabin ṯumma min nuṭfatin ṯumma jaɛalakum ʼazwajan wa ma taḥmilu min ʼunṯa wa la taḍaɛu ʼilla biɛilmihi wa ma yuɛammaru min muɛammarin wa la yunqaṣu min ɛumurihi ʼilla fi kitabin ʼinna ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasirun.

Wa ma yastawi al-baḥrani haḏa ɛaḏbun furatun saʼiɣun carabuhu wa haḏa milḥun ʼujajun wa min kullin taʼkuluna laḥman ṭariyan wa tastaxrijuna ḥilyatan talbasunaha wa tara al-fulka fihi mawaxira litabtaɣu min faḍlihi wa laɛallakum tackurun.

Yuliju al-layla fi an-nahari wa yuliju an-nahara fi al-layli wa saxxara ac-camsa wa al-qamara kullun yajri liʼjalin musamman ḏalikum Allahu rabbukum lahu al-mulku wa al-laḏina tadɛuna min dunihi ma yamlikuna min qiṭmirin.
ʼin tadɛuhum la yasmaɛu duɛaʼakum wa law samiɛu ma astajabu lakum wa yawma al-qiyamati yakfuruna bicirkikum wa la yunabbiʼuka miṯlu xabirin.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu ʼantum al-fuqaraʼu ʼila Allahi wa Allahu huwa al-ɣaniyu al-ḥamid.
ʼin yacaʼ yuḏ/hibkum wa yaʼti bixalqin jadidin.
Wa ma ḏalika ɛala Allahi biɛazizin.

Wa la taziru waziratun wizra ʼuxra wa ʼin tadɛu muṯqalatun ʼila ḥimliha la yuḥmal minhu cayʼun wa law kana ḏa qurba ʼinnama tunḏiru al-laḏina yaxcawna rabbahum bil-ɣaybi wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata wa man tazakka faʼinnama yatazakka linafsihi wa ʼila Allahi al-maṣir.
Wa ma yastawi al-ʼaɛma wa al-baṣir.
Wa la aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumatu wa la an-nur.
Wa la aḏ̣-ḏ̣illu wa la al-ḥarur.
Wa ma yastawi al-ʼaḥyaʼu wa la al-ʼamwatu ʼinna Allaha yusmiɛu man yacaʼu wa ma ʼanta bimusmiɛin man fi al-qubur.
ʼin ʼanta ʼilla naḏirun.
ʼinna ʼarsalnaka bil-ḥaqqi baciran wa naḏiran wa ʼin min ʼummatin ʼilla xala fiha naḏirun.
Wa ʼin yukaḏḏibuka faqad kaḏḏaba al-laḏina min qablihim jaʼat/hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati wa biz-zuburi wa bil-kitabi al-munir.
Ṯumma ʼaxaḏtu al-laḏina kafaru fakayfa kana nakir.
ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan faʼaxrajna bihi ṯamaratin muxtalifan ʼalwanuha wa mina al-jibali judadun biḍun wa ḥumrun muxtalifun ʼalwanuha wa ɣarabibu sudun.
Wa mina an-nasi wa ad-dawabbi wa al-ʼanɛam muxtalifun ʼalwanuhu kaḏalika ʼinnama yaxca Allaha min ɛibadihi al-ɛulamaʼu ʼinna Allaha ɛazizun ɣafurun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yatluna kitaba Allahi wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼanfaqu mimma razaqnahum sirran wa ɛalaniyatan yarjuna tijaratan lan tabur.
Liyuwaffiyahum ʼujurahum wa yazidahum min faḍlihi ʼinnahu ɣafurun cakurun.
Wa al-laḏi ʼawḥayna ʼilayka mina al-kitabi huwa al-ḥaqqu muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi ʼinna Allaha biɛibadihi laxabirun baṣirun.
Ṯumma ʼawraṯna al-kitaba al-laḏina aṣṭafayna min ɛibadina faminhum ḏ̣alimun linafsihi wa minhum muqtaṣidun wa minhum sabiqun bil-xayrati biʼiḏni Allahi ḏalika huwa al-faḍlu al-kabir.
Jannatu ɛadnin yadxulunaha yuḥallawna fiha min ʼasawira min ḏahabin wa luʼluʼan wa libasuhum fiha ḥarirun.
Wa qalu al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi ʼaḏ/haba ɛanna al-ḥazana ʼinna rabbana laɣafurun cakurun.
Al-laḏi ʼaḥallana dara al-muqamati min faḍlihi la yamassuna fiha naṣabun wa la yamassuna fiha luɣubun.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru lahum naru jahannama la yuqḍa ɛalayhim fayamutu wa la yuxaffafu ɛanhum min ɛaḏabiha kaḏalika najzi kulla kafurin.
Wa hum yaṣṭarixuna fiha rabbana ʼaxrijna naɛmal ṣaliḥan ɣayra al-laḏi kunna naɛmalu ʼawalam nuɛammirkum ma yataḏakkaru fihi man taḏakkara wa jaʼakumu an-naḏiru faḏuqu fama lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina min naṣir.
ʼinna Allaha ɛalimu ɣaybi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼinnahu ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
Huwa al-laḏi jaɛalakum xalaʼifa fi al-ʼarḍi faman kafara faɛalayhi kufruhu wa la yazidu al-kafirina kufruhum ɛinda rabbihim ʼilla maqtan wa la yazidu al-kafirina kufruhum ʼilla xasaran.

Qul ʼaraʼaytum curakaʼakum al-laḏina tadɛuna min duni Allahi ʼaruni maḏa xalaqu mina al-ʼarḍi ʼam lahum cirkun fi as-samawati ʼam ʼataynahum kitaban fahum ɛala bayyinatin minhu bal ʼin yaɛidu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna baɛḍuhum baɛḍan ʼilla ɣururan.
ʼinna Allaha yumsiku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa ʼan tazula wa laʼin zalata ʼin ʼamsakahuma min ʼaḥadin min baɛdihi ʼinnahu kana ḥaliman ɣafuran.
Wa ʼaqsamu Billahi jahda ʼaymanihim laʼin jaʼahum naḏirun layakununna ʼahda min ʼiḥda al-ʼumami falamma jaʼahum naḏirun ma zadahum ʼilla nufuran.

Astikbaran fi al-ʼarḍi wa makra as-sayyiʼi wa la yaḥiqu al-makru as-sayyiʼu ʼilla biʼahlihi fahal yanḏ̣uruna ʼilla sunnata al-ʼawwalina falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdilan wa lan tajida lisunnati Allahi taḥwilan.

ʼawalam yasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fayanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-laḏina min qablihim wa kanu ʼacadda minhum quwatan wa ma kana Allahu liyuɛjizahu min cayʼin fi as-samawati wa la fi al-ʼarḍi ʼinnahu kana ɛaliman qadiran.
