Wa aḏkur ʼismaɛila wa al-yasaɛa wa ḏa al-kifli wa kullun mina al-ʼaxyar.
Haḏa ḏikrun wa ʼinna lilmuttaqina laḥusna maʼabin.
Jannati ɛadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu al-ʼabwab.
Muttakiʼina fiha yadɛuna fiha bifakihatin kaṯiratin wa carabin.
Wa ɛindahum qaṣiratu aṭ-ṭarfi ʼatrabun.
Haḏa ma tuɛaduna liyawmi al-ḥisab.
ʼinna haḏa larizquna ma lahu min nafadin.
Haḏa wa ʼinna lilṭṭaɣina lacarra maʼabin.
Jahannama yaṣlawnaha fabiʼsa al-mihad.
Haḏa falyaḏuquhu ḥamimun wa ɣassaqun.
Wa ʼaxaru min caklihi ʼazwajun.
Haḏa fawjun muqtaḥimun maɛakum la marḥaban bihim ʼinnahum ṣalu an-nar.
Qalu bal ʼantum la marḥaban bikum ʼantum qaddamtumuhu lana fabiʼsa al-qarar.
Qalu rabbana man qaddama lana haḏa fazid/hu ɛaḏaban ḍiɛfan fi an-nar.
Wa qalu ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naɛudduhum mina al-ʼacrar.
ʼattaxaḏnahum sixriyan ʼam zaɣat ɛanhum al-ʼabṣar.
ʼinna ḏalika laḥaqqun taxaṣumu ʼahli an-nar.
Qul ʼinnama ʼana munḏirun wa ma min ʼilahin ʼilla Allahu al-waḥidu al-qahhar.
Rabbu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma baynahuma al-ɛazizu al-ɣaffar.
Qul huwa nabaʼun ɛaḏ̣imun.
ʼantum ɛanhu muɛriḍun.
Ma kana liya min ɛilmin bil-malaʼi al-ʼaɛla ʼiḏ yaxtaṣimun.
ʼin yuḥa ʼilayya ʼilla ʼannama ʼana naḏirun mubinun.
ʼiḏ qala rabbuka lilmalaʼikati ʼinni xaliqun bacaran min ṭinin.
Faʼiḏa sawwaytuhu wa nafaxtu fihi min ruḥi faqaɛu lahu sajidin.
Fasajada al-malaʼikatu kulluhum ʼajmaɛun.
ʼilla ʼiblisa astakbara wa kana mina al-kafirin.
Qala ya ʼiblisu ma manaɛaka ʼan tasjuda lima xalaqtu biyadayya ʼastakbarta ʼam kunta mina al-ɛalin.
Qala ʼana xayrun minhu xalaqtani min narin wa xalaqtahu min ṭinin.
Qala faxruj minha faʼinnaka rajimun.
Wa ʼinna ɛalayka laɛnati ʼila yawmi ad-din.
Qala rabbi faʼanḏ̣irni ʼila yawmi yubɛaṯun.
Qala faʼinnaka mina al-munḏ̣arin.
ʼila yawmi al-waqti al-maɛlum.
Qala fabiɛizzatika laʼuɣwiyannahum ʼajmaɛin.
ʼilla ɛibadaka minhum al-muxlaṣin.
Qala falḥaqqu wa al-ḥaqqa ʼaqul.
Laʼamlaʼanna jahannama minka wa mimman tabiɛaka minhum ʼajmaɛin.
Qul ma ʼasʼalukum ɛalayhi min ʼajrin wa ma ʼana mina al-mutakallifin.
ʼin huwa ʼilla ḏikrun lilɛalamin.
Wa lataɛlamunna nabaʼahu baɛda ḥinin.
Tanzilu al-kitabi mina Allahi al-ɛazizi al-ḥakim.
ʼinna ʼanzalna ʼilayka al-kitaba bil-ḥaqqi faɛbud Allaha muxliṣan lahu ad-din.

ʼala Lillahi ad-dinu al-xaliṣu wa al-laḏina attaxaḏu min dunihi ʼawliyaʼa ma naɛbuduhum ʼilla liyuqarribuna ʼila Allahi zulfa ʼinna Allaha yaḥkumu baynahum fi ma hum fihi yaxtalifuna ʼinna Allaha la yahdi man huwa kaḏibun kaffarun.
Law ʼarada Allahu ʼan yattaxiḏa waladan laṣṭafa mimma yaxluqu ma yacaʼu subḥanahu huwa Allahu al-waḥidu al-qahhar.

Xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa bil-ḥaqqi yukawwiru al-layla ɛala an-nahari wa yukawwiru an-nahara ɛala al-layli wa saxxara ac-camsa wa al-qamara kullun yajri liʼjalin musamman ʼala huwa al-ɛazizu al-ɣaffar.

Xalaqakum min nafsin waḥidatin ṯumma jaɛala minha zawjaha wa ʼanzala lakum mina al-ʼanɛam ṯamaniyata ʼazwajin yaxluqukum fi buṭuni ʼummahatikum xalqan min baɛdi xalqin fi ḏ̣ulumatin ṯalaṯin ḏalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu al-mulku la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa faʼanna tuṣrafun.

ʼin takfuru faʼinna Allaha ɣaniyun ɛankum wa la yarḍa liɛibadihi al-kufra wa ʼin tackuru yarḍahu lakum wa la taziru waziratun wizra ʼuxra ṯumma ʼila rabbikum marjiɛukum fayunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmaluna ʼinnahu ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.

Wa ʼiḏa massa al-ʼinsana ḍurrun daɛa rabbahu muniban ʼilayhi ṯumma ʼiḏa xawwalahu niɛmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadɛu ʼilayhi min qablu wa jaɛala Lillahi ʼandadan liyuḍilla ɛan sabilihi qul tamattaɛ bikufrika qalilan ʼinnaka min ʼaṣḥabi an-nar.
ʼamman huwa qanitun ʼanaʼa al-layli sajidan wa qaʼiman yaḥḏaru al-ʼaxirata wa yarju raḥmata rabbihi qul hal yastawi al-laḏina yaɛlamuna wa al-laḏina la yaɛlamuna ʼinnama yataḏakkaru ʼulu al-ʼalbab.
Qul ya ɛibadi al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu rabbakum lillaḏina ʼaḥsanu fi haḏihi ad-dunya ḥasanatun wa ʼarḍu Allahi wasiɛatun ʼinnama yuwaffa aṣ-ṣabiruna ʼajrahum biɣayri ḥisabin.
Qul ʼinni ʼumirtu ʼan ʼaɛbuda Allaha muxliṣan lahu ad-din.
Wa ʼumirtu liʼn ʼakuna ʼawwala al-muslimin.
Qul ʼinni ʼaxafu ʼin ɛaṣaytu rabbi ɛaḏaba yawmin ɛaḏ̣imin.
Quli Allaha ʼaɛbudu muxliṣan lahu din.
Faɛbudu ma ciʼtum min dunihi qul ʼinna al-xasirina al-laḏina xasiru ʼanfusahum wa ʼahlihim yawma al-qiyamati ʼala ḏalika huwa al-xusranu al-mubin.
Lahum min fawqihim ḏ̣ulalun mina an-nari wa min taḥtihim ḏ̣ulalun ḏalika yuxawwifu Allahu bihi ɛibadahu ya ɛibadi fa attaqun.
Wa al-laḏina ajtanabu aṭ-ṭaɣuta ʼan yaɛbuduha wa ʼanabu ʼila Allahi lahum al-bucra fabaccir ɛibad.
Al-laḏina yastamiɛuna al-qawla fayattabiɛuna ʼaḥsanahu ʼulaʼika al-laḏina hadahumu Allahu wa ʼulaʼika hum ʼulu al-ʼalbab.
ʼafaman ḥaqqa ɛalayhi kalimatu al-ɛaḏabi ʼafaʼanta tunqiḏu man fi an-nar.
Lakin al-laḏina attaqaw rabbahum lahum ɣurafun min fawqiha ɣurafun mabniyatun tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu waɛda Allahi la yuxlifu Allahu al-miɛad.

ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha ʼanzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan fasalakahu yanabiɛa fi al-ʼarḍi ṯumma yuxriju bihi zarɛan muxtalifan ʼalwanuhu ṯumma yahiju fatarahu muṣfarran ṯumma yajɛaluhu ḥuṭaman ʼinna fi ḏalika laḏikra liʼwli al-ʼalbab.
ʼafaman caraḥa Allahu ṣadrahu lilʼislami fahuwa ɛala nurin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati qulubuhum min ḏikri Allahi ʼulaʼika fi ḍalalin mubinin.

Allahu nazzala ʼaḥsana al-ḥadiṯi kitaban mutacabihan maṯaniya taqcaɛirru minhu juludu al-laḏina yaxcawna rabbahum ṯumma talinu juluduhum wa qulubuhum ʼila ḏikri Allahi ḏalika huda Allahi yahdi bihi man yacaʼu wa man yuḍlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin.
ʼafaman yattaqi biwajhihi suʼa al-ɛaḏabi yawma al-qiyamati wa qila lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina ḏuqu ma kuntum taksibun.
Kaḏḏaba al-laḏina min qablihim faʼatahum al-ɛaḏabu min ḥayṯu la yacɛurun.
Faʼaḏaqahum Allahu al-xizya fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa laɛaḏabu al-ʼaxirati ʼakbaru law kanu yaɛlamun.
Wa laqad ḍarabna lilnnasi fi haḏa al-qurʼani min kulli maṯalin laɛallahum yataḏakkarun.
Qurʼanan ɛarabiyan ɣayra ḏi ɛiwajin laɛallahum yattaqun.
Ḍaraba Allahu maṯalan rajulan fihi curakaʼu mutacakisuna wa rajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani maṯalan al-ḥamdu Lillahi bal ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛlamun.
ʼinnaka mayyitun wa ʼinnahum mayyitun.
Ṯumma ʼinnakum yawma al-qiyamati ɛinda rabbikum taxtaṣimun.
Faman ʼaḏ̣lamu mimman kaḏaba ɛala Allahi wa kaḏḏaba biṣ-ṣidqi ʼiḏ jaʼahu ʼalaysa fi jahannama maṯwan lilkafirin.
Wa al-laḏi jaʼa biṣ-ṣidqi wa ṣaddaqa bihi ʼulaʼika humu al-muttaqun.
Lahum ma yacaʼuna ɛinda rabbihim ḏalika jazaʼu al-muḥsinin.
Liyukaffira Allahu ɛanhum ʼaswaʼa al-laḏi ɛamilu wa yajziyahum ʼajrahum biʼaḥsani al-laḏi kanu yaɛmalun.
ʼalaysa Allahu bikafin ɛabdahu wa yuxawwifunaka bial-laḏina min dunihi wa man yuḍlil Allahu fama lahu min hadin.
Wa man yahdi Allahu fama lahu min muḍillin ʼalaysa Allahu biɛazizin ḏi antiqamin.

Wa laʼin saʼaltahum man xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa layaqulunna Allahu qul ʼafaraʼaytum ma tadɛuna min duni Allahi ʼin ʼaradaniya Allahu biḍurrin hal hunna kacifatu ḍurrihi ʼaw ʼaradani biraḥmatin hal hunna mumsikatu raḥmatihi qul ḥasbiya Allahu ɛalayhi yatawakkalu al-mutawakkilun.
Qul ya qawmi aɛmalu ɛala makanatikum ʼinni ɛamilun fasawfa taɛlamun.
Man yaʼtihi ɛaḏabun yuxzihi wa yaḥillu ɛalayhi ɛaḏabun muqimun.
ʼinna ʼanzalna ɛalayka al-kitaba lilnnasi bil-ḥaqqi famani ahtada falinafsihi wa man ḍalla faʼinnama yaḍillu ɛalayha wa ma ʼanta ɛalayhim biwakilin.

Allahu yatawaffa al-ʼanfusa ḥina mawtiha wa a-ati lam tamut fi manamiha fayumsiku allati qaḍa ɛalayha al-mawta wa yursilu al-ʼuxra ʼila ʼajalin musamman ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yatafakkarun.
ʼami attaxaḏu min duni Allahi cufaɛaʼa qul ʼawalaw kanu la yamlikuna cayʼan wa la yaɛqilun.
Qul Lillahi ac-cafaɛatu jamiɛan lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ṯumma ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Wa ʼiḏa ḏukira Allahu waḥdahu acmaʼazzat qulubu al-laḏina la yuʼminuna bil-ʼaxirati wa ʼiḏa ḏukira al-laḏina min dunihi ʼiḏa hum yastabcirun.
Qul al-lahumma faṭira as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ɛalima al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati ʼanta taḥkumu bayna ɛibadika fi ma kanu fihi yaxtalifun.
Wa law ʼanna lillaḏina ḏ̣alamu ma fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan wa miṯlahu maɛahu laftadaw bihi min suʼi al-ɛaḏabi yawma al-qiyamati wa bada lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakunu yaḥtasibun.
Wa bada lahum sayyiʼatu ma kasabu wa ḥaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Faʼiḏa massa al-ʼinsana ḍurrun daɛana ṯumma ʼiḏa xawwalnahu niɛmatan minna qala ʼinnama ʼutituhu ɛala ɛilmin bal hiya fitnatun wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
Qad qalaha al-laḏina min qablihim fama ʼaɣna ɛanhum ma kanu yaksibun.
Faʼaṣabahum sayyiʼatu ma kasabu wa al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu min haʼuulaʼ sayuṣibuhum sayyiʼatu ma kasabu wa ma hum bimuɛjizin.
ʼawalam yaɛlamu ʼanna Allaha yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu wa yaqdiru ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yuʼminun.
Qul ya ɛibadi al-laḏina ʼasrafu ɛala ʼanfusihim la taqnaṭu min raḥmati Allahi ʼinna Allaha yaɣfiru aḏ-ḏunuba jamiɛan ʼinnahu huwa al-ɣafuru ar-raḥim.
Wa ʼanibu ʼila rabbikum wa ʼaslimu lahu min qabli ʼan yaʼtiyakumu al-ɛaḏabu ṯumma la tunṣarun.
Wa attabiɛu ʼaḥsana ma ʼunzila ʼilaykum min rabbikum min qabli ʼan yaʼtiyakumu al-ɛaḏabu baɣtatan wa ʼantum la tacɛurun.
ʼan taqula nafsun ya ḥasrata ɛala ma farraṭtu fi janbi Allahi wa ʼin kuntu lamina as-saxirin.
ʼaw taqula law ʼanna Allaha hadani lakuntu mina al-muttaqin.
ʼaw taqula ḥina tara al-ɛaḏaba law ʼanna li karratan faʼakuna mina al-muḥsinin.
Bala qad jaʼatka ʼayati fakaḏḏabta biha wa astakbarta wa kunta mina al-kafirin.
Wa yawma al-qiyamati tara al-laḏina kaḏabu ɛala Allahi wujuhuhum muswaddatun ʼalaysa fi jahannama maṯwan lilmutakabbirin.
Wa yunajji Allahu al-laḏina attaqaw bimafazatihim la yamassuhumu as-suʼ wa la hum yaḥzanun.
Allahu xaliqu kulli cayʼin wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin wa kilun.
Lahu maqalidu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa al-laḏina kafaru biʼayati Allahi ʼulaʼika humu al-xasirun.
Qul ʼafaɣayra Allahi taʼmurunni ʼaɛbudu ʼayyuha al-jahilun.
Wa laqad ʼuḥiya ʼilayka wa ʼila al-laḏina min qablika laʼin ʼacrakta layaḥbaṭanna ɛamaluka wa latakunanna mina al-xasirin.
Bal Allaha faɛbud wa kun mina ac-cakirin.
Wa ma qadaru Allaha ḥaqqa qadrihi wa al-ʼarḍu jamiɛan qabḍatuhu yawma al-qiyamati wa as-samawatu maṭwiyatun biyaminihi subḥanahu wa taɛala ɛamma yucrikun.
Wa nufixa fi aṣ-ṣuri faṣaɛiqa man fi as-samawati wa man fi al-ʼarḍi ʼilla man caʼa Allahu ṯumma nufixa fihi ʼuxra faʼiḏa hum qiyamun yanḏ̣urun.
Wa ʼacraqati al-ʼarḍu binuri rabbiha wa wuḍiɛa al-kitabu wa jiʼa bin-nabiyina wa ac-cuhadaʼi wa quḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqqi wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
Wa wuffiyat kullu nafsin ma ɛamilat wa huwa ʼaɛlamu bima yafɛalun.

Wa siqa al-laḏina kafaru ʼila jahannama zumaran ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼuha futiḥat ʼabwabuha wa qala lahum xazanatuha ʼalam yaʼtikum rusulun minkum yatluna ɛalaykum ʼayati rabbikum wa yunḏirunakum liqaʼa yawmikum haḏa qalu bala wa lakin ḥaqqat kalimatu al-ɛaḏabi ɛala al-kafirin.
Qila adxulu ʼabwaba jahannama xalidina fiha fabiʼsa maṯwa al-mutakabbirin.
Wa siqa al-laḏina attaqaw rabbahum ʼila al-jannati zumaran ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼuha wa futiḥat ʼabwabuha wa qala lahum xazanatuha salamun ɛalaykum ṭibtum fadxuluha xalidin.
Wa qalu al-ḥamdu Lillahi al-laḏi ṣadaqana waɛdahu wa ʼawraṯana al-ʼarḍa natabawwaʼu mina al-jannati ḥayṯu nacaʼu faniɛma ʼajru al-ɛamilin.
Wa tara al-malaʼikata ḥaffina min ḥawli al-ɛarci yusabbiḥuna biḥamdi rabbihim wa quḍiya baynahum bil-ḥaqqi wa qila al-ḥamdu Lillahi rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Ḥa-mim.
Tanzilu al-kitabi mina Allahi al-ɛazizi al-ɛalim.
Ɣafiri aḏ-ḏanbi wa qabili at-tawbi cadidi al-ɛiqabi ḏi aṭ-ṭawli la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa ʼilayhi al-maṣir.
Ma yujadilu fi ʼayati Allahi ʼilla al-laḏina kafaru fala yaɣrurka taqallubuhum fi al-bilad.
Kaḏḏabat qablahum qawmu nuḥin wa al-ʼaḥzabu min baɛdihim wa hammat kullu ʼummatin birasulihim liyaʼxuḏuhu wa jadalu bil-baṭili liyudḥiḍu bihi al-ḥaqqa faʼaxaḏtuhum fakayfa kana ɛiqab.
Wa kaḏalika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ɛala al-laḏina kafaru ʼannahum ʼaṣḥabu an-nar.

Al-laḏina yaḥmiluna al-ɛarca wa man ḥawlahu yusabbiḥuna biḥamdi rabbihim wa yuʼminuna bihi wa yastaɣfiruna lillaḏina ʼamanu rabbana wasiɛta kulla cayʼin raḥmatan wa ɛilman faɣfir lillaḏina tabu wa attabaɛu sabilaka wa qihim ɛaḏaba al-jaḥim.
Rabbana wa ʼadxilhum jannati ɛadnin allati waɛadtahum wa man ṣalaḥa min ʼabaʼihim wa ʼazwajihim wa ḏurriyatihim ʼinnaka ʼanta al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Wa qihimu as-sayyiʼati wa man taqi as-sayyiʼati yawmaʼiḏin faqad raḥimtahu wa ḏalika huwa al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru yunadawna lamaqtu Allahi ʼakbaru min maqtikum ʼanfusakum ʼiḏ tudɛawna ʼila al-ʼimani fatakfurun.
Qalu rabbana ʼamattana aṯnatayni wa ʼaḥyaytana aṯnatayni faɛtarafna biḏunubina fahal ʼila xurujin min sabilin.
Ḏalikum biʼannahu ʼiḏa duɛiya Allahu waḥdahu kafartum wa ʼin yucrak bihi tuʼminu falḥukmu Lillahi al-ɛaliyi al-kabir.
Huwa al-laḏi yurikum ʼayatihi wa yunazzilu lakum mina as-samaʼi rizqan wa ma yataḏakkaru ʼilla man yunib.
Fadɛu Allaha muxliṣina lahu ad-dina wa law kariha al-kafirun.
Rafiɛu ad-darajati ḏu al-ɛarci yulqi ar-ruḥa min ʼamrihi ɛala man yacaʼu min ɛibadihi liyunḏira yawma at-talaq.
Yawma hum barizuna la yaxfa ɛala Allahi minhum cayʼun liman al-mulku al-yawma Lillahi al-waḥidi al-qahhar.
Al-yawma tujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat la ḏ̣ulma al-yawma ʼinna Allaha sariɛu al-ḥisab.
Wa ʼanḏirhum yawma al-ʼazifati ʼiḏi al-qulubu lada al-ḥanajiri kaḏ̣imina ma lilḏ̣ḏ̣alimina min ḥamimin wa la cafiɛin yuṭaɛ.
Yaɛlamu xaʼinata al-ʼaɛyuni wa ma tuxfi aṣ-ṣudur.
Wa Allahu yaqḍi bil-ḥaqqi wa al-laḏina yadɛuna min dunihi la yaqḍuna bicayʼin ʼinna Allaha huwa as-samiɛu al-baṣir.

ʼawa lam yasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fayanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-laḏina kanu min qablihim kanu hum ʼacadda minhum quwatan wa ʼaṯaran fi al-ʼarḍi faʼaxaḏahumu Allahu biḏunubihim wa ma kana lahum mini Allahi min waqin.
Ḏalika biʼannahum kanat taʼtihim rusuluhum bil-bayyinati fakafaru faʼaxaḏahumu Allahu ʼinnahu qawiyun cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna musa biʼayatina wa sulṭanin mubinin.
ʼila firɛawna wa hamana wa qaruna faqalu saḥirun kaḏḏabun.
Falamma jaʼahum bil-ḥaqqi min ɛindina qalu aqtulu ʼabnaʼa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu wa astaḥyu nisaʼahum wa ma kaydu al-kafirina ʼilla fi ḍalalin.
Wa qala firɛawnu ḏaruni ʼaqtul musa wa liadɛu rabbahu ʼinni ʼaxafu ʼan yubaddila dinakum ʼaw ʼan yuḏ̣hira fi al-ʼarḍi al-fasad.
Wa qala musa ʼinni ɛuḏtu birabbi wa rabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin la yuʼminu biyawmi al-ḥisab.

Wa qala rajulun muʼminun min ʼali firɛawna yaktumu ʼimanahu ʼataqtuluna rajulan ʼan yaqula rabbiya Allahu wa qad jaʼakum bil-bayyinati min rabbikum wa ʼin yaku kaḏiban faɛalayhi kaḏibuhu wa ʼin yaku ṣadiqan yuṣibkum baɛḍu al-laḏi yaɛidukum ʼinna Allaha la yahdi man huwa musrifun kaḏḏabun.
Ya qawmi lakumu al-mulku al-yawma ḏ̣ahirina fi al-ʼarḍi faman yanṣuruna min baʼsi Allahi ʼin jaʼana qala firɛawnu ma ʼurikum ʼilla ma ʼara wa ma ʼahdikum ʼilla sabila ar-racad.
Wa qala al-laḏi ʼamana ya qawmi ʼinni ʼaxafu ɛalaykum miṯla yawmi al-ʼaḥzab.
Miṯla daʼbi qawmi nuḥin wa ɛadin wa ṯamuda wa al-laḏina min baɛdihim wa ma Allahu yuridu ḏ̣ulman lilɛibad.
Wa yaqawmi ʼinni ʼaxafu ɛalaykum yawma at-tanad.
Yawma tuwalluna mudbirina ma lakum mina Allahi min ɛaṣimin wa man yuḍlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin.

Wa laqad jaʼakum yusufu min qablu bil-bayyinati fama ziltum fi cakkin mimma jaʼakum bihi ḥatta ʼiḏa halaka qultum lan yabɛaṯa Allahu min baɛdihi rasulan kaḏalika yuḍillu Allahu man huwa musrifun murtabun.
Al-laḏina yujadiluna fi ʼayati Allahi biɣayri sulṭanin ʼatahum kabura maqtan ɛinda Allahi wa ɛinda al-laḏina ʼamanu kaḏalika yaṭbaɛu Allahu ɛala kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbarin.
Wa qala firɛawnu ya hamanu abni li ṣarḥan laɛalli ʼabluɣu al-ʼasbab.
ʼasbaba as-samawati faʼaṭṭaliɛa ʼila ʼilahi musa wa ʼinni laʼaḏ̣unnuhu kaḏiban wa kaḏalika zuyyina lifirɛawna suʼ ɛamalihi wa ṣudda ɛani as-sabili wa ma kaydu firɛawna ʼilla fi tababin.
Wa qala al-laḏi ʼamana ya qawmi attabiɛuni ʼahdikum sabila ar-racad.
Ya qawmi ʼinnama haḏihi al-ḥaya atu ad-dunya mataɛun wa ʼinna al-ʼaxirata hiya daru al-qarar.
Man ɛamila sayyiʼatan fala yujza ʼilla miṯlaha wa man ɛamila ṣaliḥan min ḏakarin ʼaw ʼunṯa wa huwa muʼminun faʼulaʼika yadxuluna al-jannata yurzaquna fiha biɣayri ḥisabin.
Wa yaqawmi ma li ʼadɛukum ʼila an-najati wa tadɛunani ʼila an-nar.
Tadɛunani liʼkfura Billahi wa ʼucrika bihi ma laysa li bihi ɛilmun wa ʼana ʼadɛukum ʼila al-ɛazizi al-ɣaffar.
La jarama ʼannama tadɛunani ʼilayhi laysa lahu daɛwatun fi ad-dunya wa la fi al-ʼaxirati wa ʼanna maraddana ʼila Allahi wa ʼanna al-musrifina hum ʼaṣḥabu an-nar.
Fasataḏkuruna ma ʼaqulu lakum wa ʼufawwiḍu ʼamri ʼila Allahi ʼinna Allaha baṣirun bil-ɛibad.
Fawaqahu Allahu sayyiʼati ma makaru wa ḥaqa biʼali firɛawna suʼ al-ɛaḏab.
An-naru yuɛraḍuna ɛalayha ɣuduwan wa ɛaciyan wa yawma taqumu as-saɛatu ʼadxilu ʼala firɛawna ʼacadda al-ɛaḏab.
Wa ʼiḏ yataḥajjuna fi an-nari fayaqulu aḍ-ḍuɛafaʼu lillaḏina astakbaru ʼinna kunna lakum tabaɛan fahal ʼantum muɣnuna ɛanna naṣiban mina an-nar.
Qala al-laḏina astakbaru ʼinna kullun fiha ʼinna Allaha qad ḥakama bayna al-ɛibad.
Wa qala al-laḏina fi an-nari lixazanati jahannama adɛu rabbakum yuxaffif ɛanna yawman mina al-ɛaḏab.
Qalu ʼawa lam taku taʼtikum rusulukum bil-bayyinati qalu bala qalu fadɛu wa ma duɛaʼu al-kafirina ʼilla fi ḍalalin.
ʼinna lananṣuru rusulana wa al-laḏina ʼamanu fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa yawma yaqumu al-ʼac/had.
Yawma la yanfaɛu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina maɛḏiratuhum wa lahumu al-laɛnatu wa lahum suʼ ad-dar.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-huda wa ʼawraṯna bani ʼisraʼila al-kitab.
Hudan wa ḏikra liʼwli al-ʼalbab.
Faṣbir ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun wa astaɣfir liḏanbika wa sabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bil-ɛaciyi wa al-ʼibkar.
ʼinna al-laḏina yujadiluna fi ʼayati Allahi biɣayri sulṭanin ʼatahum ʼin fi ṣudurihim ʼilla kibrun ma hum bibaliɣihi fastaɛiḏ Billahi ʼinnahu huwa as-samiɛu al-baṣir.
Laxalqu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi ʼakbaru min xalqi an-nasi wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Wa ma yastawi al-ʼaɛma wa al-baṣiru wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati wa la al-musiʼu qalilan ma tataḏakkarun.
ʼinna as-saɛata laʼatiyatun la rayba fiha wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yuʼminun.
Wa qala rabbukum adɛuni ʼastajib lakum ʼinna al-laḏina yastakbiruna ɛan ɛibadati sayadxuluna jahannama daxirin.
Allahu al-laḏi jaɛala lakumu al-layla litaskunu fihi wa an-nahara mubṣiran ʼinna Allaha laḏu faḍlin ɛala an-nasi wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yackurun.
Ḏalikumu Allahu rabbukum xaliqu kulli cayʼin la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa faʼanna tuʼfakun.
Kaḏalika yuʼfaku al-laḏina kanu biʼayati Allahi yajḥadun.
Allahu al-laḏi jaɛala lakumu al-ʼarḍa qararan wa as-samaʼa binaʼan wa ṣawwarakum faʼaḥsana ṣuwarakum wa razaqakum mina aṭ-ṭayyibati ḏalikumu Allahu rabbukum fatabaraka Allahu rabbu al-ɛalamin.
Huwa al-ḥayyu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa fadɛuhu muxliṣina lahu ad-dina al-ḥamdu Lillahi rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Qul ʼinni nuhitu ʼan ʼaɛbuda al-laḏina tadɛuna min duni Allahi lamma jaʼaniya al-bayyinatu min rabbi wa ʼumirtu ʼan ʼuslima lirabbi al-ɛalamin.

Huwa al-laḏi xalaqakum min turabin ṯumma min nuṭfatin ṯumma min ɛalaqatin ṯumma yuxrijukum ṭiflan ṯumma litabluɣu ʼacuddakum ṯumma litakunu cuyuxan wa minkum man yutawaffa min qablu wa litabluɣu ʼajalan musamman wa laɛallakum taɛqilun.
Huwa al-laḏi yuḥyi wa yumitu faʼiḏa qaḍa ʼamran faʼinnama yaqulu lahu kun fayakun.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina yujadiluna fi ʼayati Allahi ʼanna yuṣrafun.
Al-laḏina kaḏḏabu bil-kitabi wa bima ʼarsalna bihi rusulana fasawfa yaɛlamun.
ʼiḏi al-ʼaɣlalu fi ʼaɛnaqihim wa as-salasilu yusḥabun.
Fi al-ḥamimi ṯumma fi an-nari yusjarun.
Ṯumma qila lahum ʼayna ma kuntum tucrikun.
Min duni Allahi qalu ḍallu ɛanna bal lam nakun nadɛu min qablu cayʼan kaḏalika yuḍillu Allahu al-kafirin.
Ḏalikum bima kuntum tafraḥuna fi al-ʼarḍi biɣayri al-ḥaqqi wa bima kuntum tamraḥun.
Adxulu ʼabwaba jahannama xalidina fiha fabiʼsa maṯwa al-mutakabbirin.
Faṣbir ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun faʼimma nuriyannaka baɛḍa al-laḏi naɛiduhum ʼaw natawaffayannaka faʼilayna yurjaɛun.

Wa laqad ʼarsalna rusulan min qablika minhum man qaṣaṣna ɛalayka wa minhum man lam naqṣuṣ ɛalayka wa ma kana lirasulin ʼan yaʼtiya biʼayatin ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi faʼiḏa jaʼa ʼamru Allahi quḍiya bil-ḥaqqi wa xasira hunalika al-mubṭilun.
Allahu al-laḏi jaɛala lakumu al-ʼanɛam litarkabu minha wa minha taʼkulun.
Wa lakum fiha manafiɛu wa litabluɣu ɛalayha ḥajatan fi ṣudurikum wa ɛalayha wa ɛala al-fulki tuḥmalun.
Wa yurikum ʼayatihi faʼayya ʼayati Allahi tunkirun.
ʼafalam yasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fayanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-laḏina min qablihim kanu ʼakṯara minhum wa ʼacadda quwatan wa ʼaṯaran fi al-ʼarḍi fama ʼaɣna ɛanhum ma kanu yaksibun.
Falamma jaʼat/hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinati fariḥu bima ɛindahum mina al-ɛilmi wa ḥaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Falamma raʼaw baʼsana qalu ʼamanna Billahi waḥdahu wa kafarna bima kunna bihi mucrikin.
Falam yaku yanfaɛuhum ʼimanuhum lamma raʼaw baʼsana sunnata Allahi allati qad xalat fi ɛibadihi wa xasira hunalika al-kafirun.
Ḥa-mim.
Tanzilun mina ar-raḥmani ar-raḥim.
Kitabun fuṣṣilat ʼayatuhu qurʼanan ɛarabiyan liqawmin yaɛlamun.
Baciran wa naḏiran faʼaɛraḍa ʼakṯaruhum fahum la yasmaɛun.
Wa qalu qulubuna fi ʼakinnatin mimma tadɛuna ʼilayhi wa fi ʼaḏanina waqrun wa min baynina wa baynika ḥijabun faɛmal ʼinnana ɛamilun.
Qul ʼinnama ʼana bacarun miṯlukum yuḥa ʼilayya ʼannama ʼilahukum ʼilahun waḥidun fastaqimu ʼilayhi wa astaɣfiruhu wa waylun lilmucrikin.
Al-laḏina la yuʼtuna az-zakata wa hum bil-ʼaxirati hum kafirun.
ʼinna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati lahum ʼajrun ɣayru mamnunin.
Qul ʼaʼinnakum latakfuruna bial-laḏi xalaqa al-ʼarḍa fi yawmayni wa tajɛaluna lahu ʼandadan ḏalika rabbu al-ɛalamin.
Wa jaɛala fiha rawasiya min fawqiha wa baraka fiha wa qaddara fiha ʼaqwataha fi ʼarbaɛati ʼayyamin sawaʼan lilssaʼilin.
Ṯumma astawa ʼila as-samaʼi wa hiya duxanun faqala laha wa lilʼarḍi aiʼtiya ṭawɛan ʼaw karhan qalata ʼatayna ṭaʼiɛin.
Faqaḍahunna sabɛa samawatin fi yawmayni wa ʼawḥa fi kulli samaʼin ʼamraha wa zayyanna as-samaʼa ad-dunya bimaṣabiḥa wa ḥifḏ̣an ḏalika taqdiru al-ɛazizi al-ɛalim.
Faʼin ʼaɛraḍu faqul ʼanḏartukum ṣaɛiqatan miṯla ṣaɛiqati ɛadin wa ṯamud.
ʼiḏ jaʼat/humu ar-rusulu min bayni ʼaydihim wa min xalfihim ʼalla taɛbudu ʼilla Allaha qalu law caʼa rabbuna laʼanzala malaʼikatan faʼinna bima ʼursiltum bihi kafirun.
Faʼamma ɛadun fastakbaru fi al-ʼarḍi biɣayri al-ḥaqqi wa qalu man ʼacaddu minna quwatan ʼawalam yaraw ʼanna Allaha al-laḏi xalaqahum huwa ʼacaddu minhum quwatan wa kanu biʼayatina yajḥadun.
Faʼarsalna ɛalayhim riḥan ṣarṣaran fi ʼayyamin naḥisatin linuḏiqahum ɛaḏaba al-xizyi fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa laɛaḏabu al-ʼaxirati ʼaxza wa hum la yunṣarun.
Wa ʼamma ṯamudu fahadaynahum fastaḥabbu al-ɛama ɛala al-huda faʼaxaḏat/hum ṣaɛiqatu al-ɛaḏabi al-huni bima kanu yaksibun.
Wa najjayna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa kanu yattaqun.
Wa yawma yuḥcaru ʼaɛdaʼu Allahi ʼila an-nari fahum yuzaɛun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa ma jaʼuha cahida ɛalayhim samɛuhum wa ʼabṣaruhum wa juluduhum bima kanu yaɛmalun.
Wa qalu lijuludihim lima cahidtum ɛalayna qalu ʼanṭaqana Allahu al-laḏi ʼanṭaqa kulla cayʼin wa huwa xalaqakum ʼawwala marratin wa ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Wa ma kuntum tastatiruna ʼan yac/hada ɛalaykum samɛukum wa la ʼabṣarukum wa la juludukum wa lakin ḏ̣anantum ʼanna Allaha la yaɛlamu kaṯiran mimma taɛmalun.
Wa ḏalikum ḏ̣annukumu al-laḏi ḏ̣anantum birabbikum ʼardakum faʼaṣbaḥtum mina al-xasirin.
Faʼin yaṣbiru falnnaru maṯwan lahum wa ʼin yastaɛtibu fama hum mina al-muɛtabin.
Wa qayyaḍna lahum quranaʼa fazayyanu lahum ma bayna ʼaydihim wa ma xalfahum wa ḥaqqa ɛalayhimu al-qawlu fi ʼumamin qad xalat min qablihim mina al-jinni wa al-ʼinsi ʼinnahum kanu xasirin.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru la tasmaɛu lihaḏa al-qurʼani wa al-ɣaw fihi laɛallakum taɣlibun.
Falanuḏiqanna al-laḏina kafaru ɛaḏaban cadidan wa lanajziyannahum ʼaswaʼa al-laḏi kanu yaɛmalun.
Ḏalika jazaʼu ʼaɛdaʼi Allahi an-naru lahum fiha daru al-xuldi jazaʼan bima kanu biʼayatina yajḥadun.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru rabbana ʼarina al-laḏayni ʼaḍallana mina al-jinni wa al-ʼinsi najɛalhuma taḥta ʼaqdamina liyakuna mina al-ʼasfalin.
ʼinna al-laḏina qalu rabbuna Allahu ṯumma astaqamu tatanazzalu ɛalayhimu al-malaʼikatu ʼalla taxafu wa la taḥzanu wa ʼabciru bil-jannati allati kuntum tuɛadun.
Naḥnu ʼawliyaʼuukum fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa fi al-ʼaxirati wa lakum fiha ma tactahi ʼanfusukum wa lakum fiha ma taddaɛun.
Nuzulan min ɣafurin raḥimin.
Wa man ʼaḥsanu qawlan mimman daɛa ʼila Allahi wa ɛamila ṣaliḥan wa qala ʼinnani mina al-muslimin.
Wa la tastawi al-ḥasanatu wa la as-sayyiʼatu adfaɛ bi-ati hiya ʼaḥsanu faʼiḏa al-laḏi baynaka wa baynahu ɛadawatun kaʼannahu wa liyun ḥamimun.
Wa ma yulaqqaha ʼilla al-laḏina ṣabaru wa ma yulaqqaha ʼilla ḏu ḥaḏ̣ḏ̣in ɛaḏ̣imin.
Wa ʼimma yanzaɣannaka mina ac-cayṭani nazɣun fastaɛiḏ Billahi ʼinnahu huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Wa min ʼayatihi al-laylu wa an-naharu wa ac-camsu wa al-qamaru la tasjudu lilccamsi wa la lilqamari wa asjudu Lillahi al-laḏi xalaqahunna ʼin kuntum ʼiyahu taɛbudun.
Faʼin astakbaru fa-al-laḏina ɛinda rabbika yusabbiḥuna lahu bil-layli wa an-nahari wa hum la yasʼamun.
Wa min ʼayatihi ʼannaka tara al-ʼarḍa xaciɛatan faʼiḏa ʼanzalna ɛalayha al-maʼa ahtazzat wa rabat ʼinna al-laḏi ʼaḥyaha lamuḥyi al-mawta ʼinnahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yulḥiduna fi ʼayatina la yaxfawna ɛalayna ʼafaman yulqa fi an-nari xayrun ʼam man yaʼti ʼaminan yawma al-qiyamati aɛmalu ma ciʼtum ʼinnahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru biḏ-ḏikri lamma jaʼahum wa ʼinnahu lakitabun ɛazizun.
La yaʼtihi al-baṭilu min bayni yadayhi wa la min xalfihi tanzilun min ḥakimin ḥamidin.
Ma yuqalu laka ʼilla ma qad qila lilrrusuli min qablika ʼinna rabbaka laḏu maɣfiratin wa ḏu ɛiqabin ʼalimin.

Wa law jaɛalnahu qurʼanan ʼaɛjamiyan laqalu lawla fuṣṣilat ʼayatuhu ʼaʼaɛjamiyun wa ɛarabiyun qul huwa lillaḏina ʼamanu hudan wa cifaʼun wa al-laḏina la yuʼminuna fi ʼaḏanihim waqrun wa huwa ɛalayhim ɛaman ʼulaʼika yunadawna min makanin baɛidin.
Wa laqad ʼatayna musa al-kitaba faxtulifa fihi wa lawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laquḍiya baynahum wa ʼinnahum lafi cakkin minhu muribin.
Man ɛamila ṣaliḥan falinafsihi wa man ʼasaʼa faɛalayha wa ma rabbuka biḏ̣allamin lilɛabid.
ʼilayhi yuraddu ɛilmu as-saɛati wa ma taxruju min ṯamaratin min ʼakmamiha wa ma taḥmilu min ʼunṯa wa la taḍaɛu ʼilla biɛilmihi wa yawma yunadihim ʼayna curakaʼi qalu ʼaḏannaka ma minna min cahidin.
Wa ḍalla ɛanhum ma kanu yadɛuna min qablu wa ḏ̣annu ma lahum min maḥiṣin.
La yasʼamu al-ʼinsanu min duɛaʼi al-xayri wa ʼin massahu ac-carru fayaʼusun qanuṭun.

Wa laʼin ʼaḏaqnahu raḥmatan minna min baɛdi ḍarraʼa massat/hu layaqulanna haḏa li wa ma ʼaḏ̣unnu as-saɛata qaʼimatan wa laʼin rujiɛtu ʼila rabbi ʼinna li ɛindahu lalḥusna falanunabbiʼanna al-laḏina kafaru bima ɛamilu wa lanuḏiqannahum min ɛaḏabin ɣaliḏ̣in.
Wa ʼiḏa ʼanɛamna ɛala al-ʼinsani ʼaɛraḍa wa naʼa bijanibihi wa ʼiḏa massahu ac-carru faḏu duɛaʼin ɛariḍin.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ʼin kana min ɛindi Allahi ṯumma kafartum bihi man ʼaḍallu mimman huwa fi ciqaqin baɛidin.
Sanurihim ʼayatina fi al-ʼafaqi wa fi ʼanfusihim ḥatta yatabayyana lahum ʼannahu al-ḥaqqu ʼawalam yakfi birabbika ʼannahu ɛala kulli cayʼin cahidun.
ʼala ʼinnahum fi miryatin min liqaʼi rabbihim ʼala ʼinnahu bikulli cayʼin muḥiṭun.
Ḥa-mim.
Ɛsq.
Kaḏalika yuḥi ʼilayka wa ʼila al-laḏina min qablika Allahu al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa huwa al-ɛaliyu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Takadu as-samawatu yatafaṭṭarna min fawqihinna wa al-malaʼikatu yusabbiḥuna biḥamdi rabbihim wa yastaɣfiruna liman fi al-ʼarḍi ʼala ʼinna Allaha huwa al-ɣafuru ar-raḥim.
Wa al-laḏina attaxaḏu min dunihi ʼawliyaʼa Allahu ḥafiḏ̣un ɛalayhim wa ma ʼanta ɛalayhim biwakilin.
Wa kaḏalika ʼawḥayna ʼilayka qurʼanan ɛarabiyan litunḏira ʼumma al-qura wa man ḥawlaha wa tunḏira yawma al-jamɛi la rayba fihi fariqun fi al-jannati wa fariqun fi as-saɛir.
Wa law caʼa Allahu lajaɛalahum ʼummatan waḥidatan wa lakin yudxilu man yacaʼu fi raḥmatihi wa aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimuna ma lahum min wa liyin wa la naṣirin.
ʼam attaxaḏu min dunihi ʼawliyaʼa fa-Allahu huwa al-waliyu wa huwa yuḥyi al-mawta wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa ma axtalaftum fihi min cayʼin faḥukmuhu ʼila Allahi ḏalikumu Allahu rabbi ɛalayhi tawakkaltu wa ʼilayhi ʼunib.
Faṭiru as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi jaɛala lakum min ʼanfusikum ʼazwajan wa mina al-ʼanɛam ʼazwajan yaḏraʼuukum fihi laysa kamiṯlihi cayʼun wa huwa as-samiɛu al-baṣir.
Lahu maqalidu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yabsuṭu ar-rizqa liman yacaʼu wa yaqdiru ʼinnahu bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.

Caraɛa lakum mina ad-dini ma waṣṣa bihi nuḥan wa al-laḏi ʼawḥayna ʼilayka wa ma waṣṣayna bihi ʼibrahima wa musa wa ɛisa ʼan ʼaqimu ad-dina wa la tatafarraqu fihi kabura ɛala al-mucrikina ma tadɛuhum ʼilayhi Allahu yajtabi ʼilayhi man yacaʼu wa yahdi ʼilayhi man yunib.

Wa ma tafarraqu ʼilla min baɛdi ma jaʼahum al-ɛilmu baɣyan baynahum wa lawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ʼila ʼajalin musamman laquḍiya baynahum wa ʼinna al-laḏina ʼuriṯu al-kitaba min baɛdihim lafi cakkin minhu muribin.

Faliḏalika fadɛu wa astaqim kama ʼumirta wa la tattabiɛ ʼahwaʼahum wa qul ʼamantu bima ʼanzala Allahu min kitabin wa ʼumirtu liʼɛdila baynakum Allahu rabbuna wa rabbukum lana ʼaɛmaluna wa lakum ʼaɛmalukum la ḥujjata baynana wa baynakum Allahu yajmaɛu baynana wa ʼilayhi al-maṣir.
Wa al-laḏina yuḥajjuna fi Allahi min baɛdi ma astujiba lahu ḥujjatuhum daḥiḍatun ɛinda rabbihim wa ɛalayhim ɣaḍabun wa lahum ɛaḏabun cadidun.
Allahu al-laḏi ʼanzala al-kitaba bil-ḥaqqi wa al-mizana wa ma yudrika laɛalla as-saɛata qaribun.
Yastaɛjilu biha al-laḏina la yuʼminuna biha wa al-laḏina ʼamanu mucfiquna minha wa yaɛlamuna ʼannaha al-ḥaqqu ʼala ʼinna al-laḏina yumaruna fi as-saɛati lafi ḍalalin baɛidin.
Allahu laṭifun biɛibadihi yarzuqu man yacaʼu wa huwa al-qawiyu al-ɛaziz.
Man kana yuridu ḥarṯa al-ʼaxirati nazid lahu fi ḥarṯihi wa man kana yuridu ḥarṯa ad-dunya nuʼtihi minha wa ma lahu fi al-ʼaxirati min naṣibin.
ʼam lahum curakaʼu caraɛu lahum mina ad-dini ma lam yaʼḏan bihi Allahu wa lawla kalimatu al-faṣli laquḍiya baynahum wa ʼinna aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Tara aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina mucfiqina mimma kasabu wa huwa waqiɛun bihim wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati fi rawḍati al-jannati lahum ma yacaʼuna ɛinda rabbihim ḏalika huwa al-faḍlu al-kabir.

Ḏalika al-laḏi yubacciru Allahu ɛibadahu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati qul la ʼasʼalukum ɛalayhi ʼajran ʼilla al-mawaddata fi al-qurba wa man yaqtarif ḥasanatan nazid lahu fiha ḥusnan ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun cakurun.
ʼam yaquluna aftara ɛala Allahi kaḏiban faʼin yacaʼi Allahu yaxtim ɛala qalbika wa yamḥu Allahu al-baṭila wa yuḥiqqu al-ḥaqqa bikalimatihi ʼinnahu ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
Wa huwa al-laḏi yaqbalu at-tawbat ɛan ɛibadihi wa yaɛfu ɛani as-sayyiʼati wa yaɛlamu ma tafɛalun.
Wa yastajibu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati wa yaziduhum min faḍlihi wa al-kafiruna lahum ɛaḏabun cadidun.
Wa law basaṭa Allahu ar-rizqa liɛibadihi labaɣaw fi al-ʼarḍi wa lakin yunazzilu biqadarin ma yacaʼu ʼinnahu biɛibadihi xabirun baṣirun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi yunazzilu al-ɣayṯa min baɛdi ma qanaṭu wa yancuru raḥmatahu wa huwa al-waliyu al-ḥamid.
Wa min ʼayatihi xalqu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma baṯṯa fihima min dabbatin wa huwa ɛala jamɛihim ʼiḏa yacaʼu qadirun.
Wa ma ʼaṣabakum min muṣibatin fabima kasabat ʼaydikum wa yaɛfu ɛan kaṯirin.
Wa ma ʼantum bimuɛjizina fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma lakum min duni Allahi min wa liyin wa la naṣirin.
Wa min ʼayatihi al-jawari fi al-baḥri kalʼaɛlam.
ʼin yacaʼ yuskin ar-riḥa fayaḏ̣lalna rawakida ɛala ḏ̣ahrihi ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin likulli ṣabbarin cakurin.
ʼaw yubiqhunna bima kasabu wa yaɛfu ɛan kaṯirin.
Wa yaɛlama al-laḏina yujadiluna fi ʼayatina ma lahum min maḥiṣin.
Fama ʼutitum min cayʼin famataɛu al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa ma ɛinda Allahi xayrun wa ʼabqa lillaḏina ʼamanu wa ɛala rabbihim yatawakkalun.
Wa al-laḏina yajtanibuna kabaʼira al-ʼiṯmi wa al-fawaḥica wa ʼiḏa ma ɣaḍibu hum yaɣfirun.
Wa al-laḏina astajabu lirabbihim wa ʼaqamu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼamruhum cura baynahum wa mimma razaqnahum yunfiqun.
Wa al-laḏina ʼiḏa ʼaṣabahumu al-baɣyu hum yantaṣirun.
Wa jazaʼu sayyiʼatin sayyiʼatun miṯluha faman ɛafa wa ʼaṣlaḥa faʼajruhu ɛala Allahi ʼinnahu la yuḥibbu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa lamani antaṣara baɛda ḏ̣ulmihi faʼulaʼika ma ɛalayhim min sabilin.
ʼinnama as-sabilu ɛala al-laḏina yaḏ̣limuna an-nasa wa yabɣuna fi al-ʼarḍi biɣayri al-ḥaqqi ʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Wa laman ṣabara wa ɣafara ʼinna ḏalika lamin ɛazmi al-ʼumur.
Wa man yuḍlili Allahu fama lahu min wa liyin min baɛdihi wa tara aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina lamma raʼaw al-ɛaḏaba yaquluna hal ʼila maraddin min sabilin.

Wa tarahum yuɛraḍuna ɛalayha xaciɛina mina aḏ-ḏulli yanḏ̣uruna min ṭarfin xafiyin wa qala al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼinna al-xasirina al-laḏina xasiru ʼanfusahum wa ʼahlihim yawma al-qiyamati ʼala ʼinna aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina fi ɛaḏabin muqimin.
Wa ma kana lahum min ʼawliyaʼa yanṣurunahum min duni Allahi wa man yuḍlili Allahu fama lahu min sabilin.
Astajibu lirabbikum min qabli ʼan yaʼtiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi ma lakum min maljaʼiin yawmaʼiḏin wa ma lakum min nakirin.

Faʼin ʼaɛraḍu fama ʼarsalnaka ɛalayhim ḥafiḏ̣an ʼin ɛalayka ʼilla al-balaɣu wa ʼinna ʼiḏa ʼaḏaqna al-ʼinsana minna raḥmatan fariḥa biha wa ʼin tuṣibhum sayyiʼatun bima qaddamat ʼaydihim faʼinna al-ʼinsana kafurun.
Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yaxluqu ma yacaʼu yahabu liman yacaʼu ʼinaṯan wa yahabu liman yacaʼu aḏ-ḏukur.
ʼaw yuzawwijuhum ḏukranan wa ʼinaṯan wa yajɛalu man yacaʼu ɛaqiman ʼinnahu ɛalimun qadirun.
Wa ma kana libacarin ʼan yukallimahu Allahu ʼilla waḥyan ʼaw min waraʼi ḥijabin ʼaw yursila rasulan fayuḥiya biʼiḏnihi ma yacaʼu ʼinnahu ɛaliyun ḥakimun.
Wa kaḏalika ʼawḥayna ʼilayka ruḥan min ʼamrina ma kunta tadri ma al-kitabu wa la al-ʼimanu wa lakin jaɛalnahu nuran nahdi bihi man nacaʼu min ɛibadina wa ʼinnaka latahdi ʼila ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Ṣiraṭi Allahi al-laḏi lahu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi ʼala ʼila Allahi taṣiru al-ʼumur.
Ḥa-mim.
Wa al-kitabi al-mubin.
ʼinna jaɛalnahu qurʼanan ɛarabiyan laɛallakum taɛqilun.
Wa ʼinnahu fi ʼummi al-kitabi ladayna laɛaliyun ḥakimun.
ʼafanaḍribu ɛankumu aḏ-ḏikra ṣafḥan ʼan kuntum qawman musrifin.
Wa kam ʼarsalna min nabiyin fi al-ʼawwalin.
Wa ma yaʼtihim min nabiyin ʼilla kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Faʼahlakna ʼacadda minhum baṭcan wa maḍa maṯalu al-ʼawwalin.
Wa laʼin saʼaltahum man xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa layaqulunna xalaqahunna al-ɛazizu al-ɛalim.
Al-laḏi jaɛala lakum al-ʼarḍa mahdan wa jaɛala lakum fiha subulan laɛallakum tahtadun.
Wa al-laḏi nazzala mina as-samaʼi maʼan biqadarin faʼancarna bihi baldatan maytan kaḏalika tuxrajun.
Wa al-laḏi xalaqa al-ʼazwaja kullaha wa jaɛala lakum mina al-fulki wa al-ʼanɛam ma tarkabun.
Litastawu ɛala ḏ̣uhurihi ṯumma taḏkuru niɛmata rabbikum ʼiḏa astawaytum ɛalayhi wa taqulu subḥana al-laḏi saxxara lana haḏa wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin.
Wa ʼinna ʼila rabbina lamunqalibun.
Wa jaɛalu lahu min ɛibadihi juzʼan ʼinna al-ʼinsana lakafurun mubinun.
ʼam attaxaḏa mimma yaxluqu banatin wa ʼaṣfakum bil-banin.
Wa ʼiḏa buccira ʼaḥaduhum bima ḍaraba lilrraḥmani maṯalan ḏ̣alla wajhuhu muswaddan wa huwa kaḏ̣imun.
ʼawaman yunaccaʼu fi al-ḥilyati wa huwa fi al-xiṣami ɣayru mubinin.
Wa jaɛalu al-malaʼikata al-laḏina hum ɛibadu ar-raḥmani ʼinaṯan ʼacahidu xalqahum satuktabu cahadatuhum wa yusʼalun.
Wa qalu law caʼa ar-raḥmanu ma ɛabadnahum ma lahum biḏalika min ɛilmin ʼin hum ʼilla yaxruṣun.
ʼam ʼataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikun.
Bal qalu ʼinna wajadna ʼabaʼana ɛala ʼummatin wa ʼinna ɛala ʼaṯarihim muhtadun.
Wa kaḏalika ma ʼarsalna min qablika fi qaryatin min naḏirin ʼilla qala mutrafuha ʼinna wajadna ʼabaʼana ɛala ʼummatin wa ʼinna ɛala ʼaṯarihim muqtadun.
Qala ʼawalaw jiʼtukum biʼahda mimma wajadtum ɛalayhi ʼabaʼakum qalu ʼinna bima ʼursiltum bihi kafirun.
Fantaqamna minhum fanḏ̣ur kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-mukaḏḏibin.
Wa ʼiḏ qala ʼibrahimu liʼabihi wa qawmihi ʼinnani baraʼun mimma taɛbudun.
ʼilla al-laḏi faṭarani faʼinnahu sayahdin.
Wa jaɛalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fi ɛaqibihi laɛallahum yarjiɛun.
Bal mattaɛtu haʼuulaʼ wa ʼabaʼahum ḥatta jaʼahum al-ḥaqqu wa rasulun mubinun.
Wa lamma jaʼahum al-ḥaqqu qalu haḏa siḥrun wa ʼinna bihi kafirun.
Wa qalu lawla nuzzila haḏa al-qurʼanu ɛala rajulin mina al-qaryatayni ɛaḏ̣imin.

ʼahum yaqsimuna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamna baynahum maɛicatahum fi al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa rafaɛna baɛḍahum fawqa baɛḍin darajatin liyattaxiḏa baɛḍuhum baɛḍan suxriyan wa raḥmatu rabbika xayrun mimma yajmaɛun.
Wa lawla ʼan yakuna an-nasu ʼummatan waḥidatan lajaɛalna liman yakfuru bir-raḥmani libuyutihim suqufan min faḍḍatin wa maɛarija ɛalayha yaḏ̣harun.
Wa libuyutihim ʼabwaban wa sururan ɛalayha yattakiʼun.
Wa zuxrufan wa ʼin kullu ḏalika lamma mataɛu al-ḥayati ad-dunya wa al-ʼaxiratu ɛinda rabbika lilmuttaqin.
Wa man yaɛcu ɛan ḏikri ar-raḥmani nuqayyiḍ lahu cayṭanan fahuwa lahu qarinun.
Wa ʼinnahum layaṣuddunahum ɛani as-sabili wa yaḥsabuna ʼannahum muhtadun.
Ḥatta ʼiḏa jaʼana qala ya layta bayni wa baynaka buɛda al-macriqayni fabiʼsa al-qarin.
Wa lan yanfaɛakumu al-yawma ʼiḏ ḏ̣alamtum ʼannakum fi al-ɛaḏabi muctarikun.
ʼafaʼanta tusmiɛu aṣ-ṣumma ʼaw tahdi al-ɛumya wa man kana fi ḍalalin mubinin.
Faʼimma naḏ/habanna bika faʼinna minhum muntaqimun.
ʼaw nuriyannaka al-laḏi waɛadnahum faʼinna ɛalayhim muqtadirun.
Fastamsik bial-laḏi ʼuḥiya ʼilayka ʼinnaka ɛala ṣiraṭin mustaqimin.
Wa ʼinnahu laḏikrun laka wa liqawmika wa sawfa tusʼalun.
Wa asʼal man ʼarsalna min qablika min rusulina ʼajaɛalna min duni ar-raḥmani ʼalihatan yuɛbadun.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna musa biʼayatina ʼila firɛawna wa malaʼihi faqala ʼinni rasulu rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Falamma jaʼahum biʼayatina ʼiḏa hum minha yaḍḥakun.
Wa ma nurihim min ʼayatin ʼilla hiya ʼakbaru min ʼuxtiha wa ʼaxaḏnahum bil-ɛaḏabi laɛallahum yarjiɛun.
Wa qalu ya ʼayyuha as-saḥiru adɛu lana rabbaka bima ɛahida ɛindaka ʼinnana lamuhtadun.
Falamma kacafna ɛanhumu al-ɛaḏaba ʼiḏa hum yankuṯun.
Wa nada firɛawnu fi qawmihi qala ya qawmi ʼalaysa li mulku miṣra wa haḏihi al-ʼanharu tajri min taḥti ʼafala tubṣirun.
ʼam ʼana xayrun min haḏa al-laḏi huwa mahinun wa la yakadu yubin.
Falawla ʼulqiya ɛalayhi ʼaswiratun min ḏahabin ʼaw jaʼa maɛahu al-malaʼikatu muqtarinin.
Fastaxaffa qawmahu faʼaṭaɛuhu ʼinnahum kanu qawman fasiqin.
Falamma ʼasafuna antaqamna minhum faʼaɣraqnahum ʼajmaɛin.
Fajaɛalnahum salafan wa maṯalan lilʼaxirin.
Wa lamma ḍuriba abnu maryama maṯalan ʼiḏa qawmuka minhu yaṣiddun.
Wa qalu ʼaʼalihatuna xayrun ʼam huwa ma ḍarabuhu laka ʼilla jadalan bal hum qawmun xaṣimun.
ʼin huwa ʼilla ɛabdun ʼanɛamna ɛalayhi wa jaɛalnahu maṯalan libani ʼisraʼil.
Wa law nacaʼu lajaɛalna minkum malaʼikatan fi al-ʼarḍi yaxlufun.
Wa ʼinnahu laɛilmun lilssaɛati fala tamtarunna biha wa attabiɛuni haḏa ṣiraṭun mustaqimun.
Wa la yaṣuddannakumu ac-cayṭanu ʼinnahu lakum ɛaduwun mubinun.
Wa lamma jaʼa ɛisa bil-bayyinati qala qad jiʼtukum bil-ḥikmati wa liʼabayyina lakum baɛḍa al-laḏi taxtalifuna fihi fa attaqu Allaha wa ʼaṭiɛun.
ʼinna Allaha huwa rabbi wa rabbukum faɛbuduhu haḏa ṣiraṭun mustaqimun.
Faxtalafa al-ʼaḥzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillaḏina ḏ̣alamu min ɛaḏabi yawmin ʼalimin.
Hal yanḏ̣uruna ʼilla as-saɛata ʼan taʼtiyahum baɣtatan wa hum la yacɛurun.
Al-ʼaxillaʼu yawmaʼiḏin baɛḍuhum libaɛḍin ɛaduwun ʼilla al-muttaqin.
Ya ɛibadi la xawfun ɛalaykum al-yawma wa la ʼantum taḥzanun.
Al-laḏina ʼamanu biʼayatina wa kanu muslimin.
Adxulu al-jannata ʼantum wa ʼazwajukum tuḥbarun.
Yuṭafu ɛalayhim biṣiḥafin min ḏahabin wa ʼakwabin wa fiha ma tactahihi al-ʼanfusu wa talaḏḏu al-ʼaɛyunu wa ʼantum fiha xalidun.
Wa tilka al-jannatu allati ʼuriṯtumuha bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Lakum fiha fakihatun kaṯiratun minha taʼkulun.
ʼinna al-mujrimina fi ɛaḏabi jahannama xalidun.
La yufattaru ɛanhum wa hum fihi mublisun.
Wa ma ḏ̣alamnahum wa lakin kanu humu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa nadaw ya maliku liyaqḍi ɛalayna rabbuka qala ʼinnakum makiṯun.
Laqad jiʼnakum bil-ḥaqqi wa lakinna ʼakṯarakum lilḥaqqi karihun.
ʼam ʼabramu ʼamran faʼinna mubrimun.
ʼam yaḥsabuna ʼanna la nasmaɛu sirrahum wa najwahum bala wa rusuluna ladayhim yaktubun.
Qul ʼin kana lilrraḥmani waladun faʼana ʼawwalu al-ɛabidin.
Subḥana rabbi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi rabbi al-ɛarci ɛamma yaṣifun.
Faḏarhum yaxuḍu wa yalɛabu ḥatta yulaqu yawmahum al-laḏi yuɛadun.
Wa huwa al-laḏi fi as-samaʼi ʼilahun wa fi al-ʼarḍi ʼilahun wa huwa al-ḥakimu al-ɛalim.
Wa tabaraka al-laḏi lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma baynahuma wa ɛindahu ɛilmu as-saɛati wa ʼilayhi turjaɛun.
Wa la yamliku al-laḏina yadɛuna min dunihi ac-cafaɛata ʼilla man cahida bil-ḥaqqi wa hum yaɛlamun.
Wa laʼin saʼaltahum man xalaqahum layaqulunna Allahu faʼanna yuʼfakun.
Wa qilihi ya rabbi ʼinna haʼuulaʼ qawmun la yuʼminun.
Faṣfaḥ ɛanhum wa qul salamun fasawfa yaɛlamun.
Ḥa-mim.
Wa al-kitabi al-mubin.
ʼinna ʼanzalnahu fi laylatin mubarakatin ʼinna kunna munḏirin.
Fiha yufraqu kullu ʼamrin ḥakimin.
ʼamran min ɛindina ʼinna kunna mursilin.
Raḥmatan min rabbika ʼinnahu huwa as-samiɛu al-ɛalim.
Rabbi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ma baynahuma ʼin kuntum muqinin.
La ʼilaha ʼilla huwa yuḥyi wa yumitu rabbukum wa rabbu ʼabaʼikumu al-ʼawwalin.
Bal hum fi cakkin yalɛabun.
Fartaqib yawma taʼti as-samaʼu biduxanin mubinin.
Yaɣca an-nasa haḏa ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Rabbana akcif ɛanna al-ɛaḏaba ʼinna muʼminun.
ʼanna lahumu aḏ-ḏikra wa qad jaʼahum rasulun mubinun.
Ṯumma tawallaw ɛanhu wa qalu muɛallamun majnunun.
ʼinna kacifu al-ɛaḏabi qalilan ʼinnakum ɛaʼidun.
Yawma nabṭicu al-baṭcata al-kubra ʼinna muntaqimun.
Wa laqad fatanna qablahum qawma firɛawna wa jaʼahum rasulun karimun.
ʼan ʼaddu ʼilayya ɛibada Allahi ʼinni lakum rasulun ʼaminun.
Wa ʼan la taɛlu ɛala Allahi ʼinni ʼatikum bisulṭanin mubinin.
Wa ʼinni ɛuḏtu birabbi wa rabbikum ʼan tarjumun.
Wa ʼin lam tuʼminu li faɛtazilun.
Fadaɛa rabbahu ʼanna haʼuulaʼ qawmun mujrimun.
Faʼasri biɛibadi laylan ʼinnakum muttabaɛun.
Wa atruki al-baḥra rahwan ʼinnahum jundun muɣraqun.
Kam taraku min jannatin wa ɛuyunin.
Wa zuruɛin wa maqamin karimin.
Wa naɛmatin kanu fiha fakihin.
Kaḏalika wa ʼawraṯnaha qawman ʼaxarin.
Fama bakat ɛalayhimu as-samaʼu wa al-ʼarḍu wa ma kanu munḏ̣arin.
Wa laqad najjayna bani ʼisraʼila mina al-ɛaḏabi al-muhin.
Min firɛawna ʼinnahu kana ɛalian mina al-musrifin.
Wa laqad axtarnahum ɛala ɛilmin ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Wa ʼataynahum mina al-ʼayati ma fihi balaʼun mubinun.
ʼinna haʼuulaʼ layaqulun.
ʼin hiya ʼilla mawtatuna al-ʼula wa ma naḥnu bimuncarin.
Faʼtu biʼabaʼina ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
ʼahum xayrun ʼam qawmu tubbaɛin wa al-laḏina min qablihim ʼahlaknahum ʼinnahum kanu mujrimin.
Wa ma xalaqna as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ma baynahuma laɛibin.
Ma xalaqnahuma ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi wa lakinna ʼakṯarahum la yaɛlamun.
ʼinna yawma al-faṣli miqatuhum ʼajmaɛin.
Yawma la yuɣni mawlan ɛan mawlan cayʼan wa la hum yunṣarun.
ʼilla man raḥima Allahu ʼinnahu huwa al-ɛazizu ar-raḥim.
ʼinna cajarata az-zaqqum.
Ṭaɛamu al-ʼaṯim.
Kalmuhli yaɣli fi al-buṭun.
Kaɣalyi al-ḥamim.
Xuḏuhu faɛtiluhu ʼila sawaʼi al-jaḥim.
Ṯumma ṣubbu fawqa raʼsihi min ɛaḏabi al-ḥamim.
Ḏuq ʼinnaka ʼanta al-ɛazizu al-karim.
ʼinna haḏa ma kuntum bihi tamtarun.
ʼinna al-muttaqina fi maqamin ʼaminin.
Fi jannatin wa ɛuyunin.
Yalbasuna min sundusin wa ʼistabraqin mutaqabilin.
Kaḏalika wa zawwajnahum biḥurin ɛinin.
Yadɛuna fiha bikulli fakihatin ʼaminin.
La yaḏuquna fiha al-mawta ʼilla al-mawtata al-ʼula wa waqahum ɛaḏaba al-jaḥim.
Faḍlan min rabbika ḏalika huwa al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Faʼinnama yassarnahu bilisanika laɛallahum yataḏakkarun.
Fartaqib ʼinnahum murtaqibun.
Ḥa-mim.
Tanzilu al-kitabi mina Allahi al-ɛazizi al-ḥakim.
ʼinna fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi lʼayatin lilmuʼminin.
Wa fi xalqikum wa ma yabuṯṯu min dabbatin ʼayatun liqawmin yuqinun.
Wa axtilafi al-layli wa an-nahari wa ma ʼanzala Allahu mina as-samaʼi min rizqin faʼaḥya bihi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha wa taṣrifi ar-riyaḥi ʼayatun liqawmin yaɛqilun.
Tilka ʼayatu Allahi natluha ɛalayka bil-ḥaqqi fabiʼayyi ḥadiṯin baɛda Allahi wa ʼayatihi yuʼminun.
Waylun likulli ʼaffakin ʼaṯimin.
Yasmaɛu ʼayati Allahi tutla ɛalayhi ṯumma yuṣirru mustakbiran kaʼan lam yasmaɛha fabaccirhu biɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
Wa ʼiḏa ɛalima min ʼayatina cayʼan attaxaḏaha huzuan ʼulaʼika lahum ɛaḏabun muhinun.
Min waraʼihim jahannamu wa la yuɣni ɛanhum ma kasabu cayʼan wa la ma attaxaḏu min duni Allahi ʼawliyaʼa wa lahum ɛaḏabun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Haḏa hudan wa al-laḏina kafaru biʼayati rabbihim lahum ɛaḏabun min rijzin ʼalimun.
Allahu al-laḏi saxxara lakum al-baḥra litajriya al-fulku fihi biʼamrihi wa litabtaɣu min faḍlihi wa laɛallakum tackurun.
Wa saxxara lakum ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi jamiɛan minhu ʼinna fi ḏalika lʼayatin liqawmin yatafakkarun.
Qul lillaḏina ʼamanu yaɣfiru lillaḏina la yarjuna ʼayyama Allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanu yaksibun.
Man ɛamila ṣaliḥan falinafsihi wa man ʼasaʼa faɛalayha ṯumma ʼila rabbikum turjaɛun.
Wa laqad ʼatayna bani ʼisraʼila al-kitaba wa al-ḥukma wa an-nubuwata wa razaqnahum mina aṭ-ṭayyibati wa faḍḍalnahum ɛala al-ɛalamin.
Wa ʼataynahum bayyinatin mina al-ʼamri fama axtalafu ʼilla min baɛdi ma jaʼahumu al-ɛilmu baɣyan baynahum ʼinna rabbaka yaqḍi baynahum yawma al-qiyamati fima kanu fihi yaxtalifun.
Ṯumma jaɛalnaka ɛala cariɛatin mina al-ʼamri fa attabiɛha wa la tattabiɛ ʼahwaʼa al-laḏina la yaɛlamun.
ʼinnahum lan yuɣnu ɛanka mina Allahi cayʼan wa ʼinna aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimina baɛḍuhum ʼawliyaʼu baɛḍin wa Allahu wa liyu al-muttaqin.
Haḏa baṣaʼiru lilnnasi wa hudan wa raḥmatun liqawmin yuqinun.
ʼam ḥasiba al-laḏina ajtaraḥu as-sayyiʼati ʼan najɛalahum kallaḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati sawaʼan maḥyahum wa mamatuhum saʼa ma yaḥkumun.
Wa xalaqa Allahu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa bil-ḥaqqi wa litujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.
ʼafaraʼayta man attaxaḏa ʼilahahu hawahu wa ʼaḍallahu Allahu ɛala ɛilmin wa xatama ɛala samɛihi wa qalbihi wa jaɛala ɛala baṣarihi ɣicawatan faman yahdihi min baɛdi Allahi ʼafala taḏakkarun.
Wa qalu ma hiya ʼilla ḥayatuna ad-dunya namutu wa naḥya wa ma yuhlikuna ʼilla ad-dahru wa ma lahum biḏalika min ɛilmin ʼin hum ʼilla yaḏ̣unnun.
Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatuna bayyinatin ma kana ḥujjatahum ʼilla ʼan qalu aʼtu biʼabaʼina ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Quli Allahu yuḥyikum ṯumma yumitukum ṯumma yajmaɛukum ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati la rayba fihi wa lakinna ʼakṯara an-nasi la yaɛlamun.
Wa Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa yawma taqumu as-saɛatu yawmaʼiḏin yaxsaru al-mubṭilun.
Wa tara kulla ʼummatin jaṯiyatan kullu ʼummatin tudɛa ʼila kitabiha al-yawma tujzawna ma kuntum taɛmalun.
Haḏa kitabuna yanṭiqu ɛalaykum bil-ḥaqqi ʼinna kunna nastansixu ma kuntum taɛmalun.
Faʼamma al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati fayudxiluhum rabbuhum fi raḥmatihi ḏalika huwa al-fawzu al-mubin.
Wa ʼamma al-laḏina kafaru ʼafalam takun ʼayati tutla ɛalaykum fastakbartum wa kuntum qawman mujrimin.
Wa ʼiḏa qila ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun wa as-saɛatu la rayba fiha qultum ma nadri ma as-saɛatu ʼin naḏ̣unnu ʼilla ḏ̣annan wa ma naḥnu bimustayqinin.
Wa bada lahum sayyiʼatu ma ɛamilu wa ḥaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Wa qila al-yawma nansakum kama nasitum liqaʼa yawmikum haḏa wa maʼwakum an-naru wa ma lakum min naṣirin.
Ḏalikum biʼannakum attaxaḏtum ʼayati Allahi huzuan wa ɣarratkum al-ḥayatu ad-dunya falyawma la yuxrajuna minha wa la hum yustaɛtabun.
Falillahi al-ḥamdu rabbi as-samawati wa rabbi al-ʼarḍi rabbi al-ɛalamin.
Wa lahu al-kibriyaʼu fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Ḥa-mim.
Tanzilu al-kitabi mina Allahi al-ɛazizi al-ḥakim.
Ma xalaqna as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ma baynahuma ʼilla bil-ḥaqqi wa ʼajalin musamman wa al-laḏina kafaru ɛamma ʼunḏiru muɛriḍun.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ma tadɛuna min duni Allahi ʼaruni maḏa xalaqu mina al-ʼarḍi ʼam lahum cirkun fi as-samawati aiʼtuni bikitabin min qabli haḏa ʼaw ʼaṯaratin min ɛilmin ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Wa man ʼaḍallu mimman yadɛu min duni Allahi man la yastajibu lahu ʼila yawmi al-qiyamati wa hum ɛan duɛaʼihim ɣafilun.
Wa ʼiḏa ḥucira an-nasu kanu lahum ʼaɛdaʼan wa kanu biɛibadatihim kafirin.
Wa ʼiḏa tutla ɛalayhim ʼayatuna bayyinatin qala al-laḏina kafaru lilḥaqqi lamma jaʼahum haḏa siḥrun mubinun.
ʼam yaquluna aftarahu qul ʼin aftaraytuhu fala tamlikuna li mina Allahi cayʼan huwa ʼaɛlamu bima tufiḍuna fihi kafa bihi cahidan bayni wa baynakum wa huwa al-ɣafuru ar-raḥim.
Qul ma kuntu bidɛan mina ar-rusuli wa ma ʼadri ma yufɛalu bi wa la bikum ʼin ʼattabiɛu ʼilla ma yuḥa ʼilayya wa ma ʼana ʼilla naḏirun mubinun.
Qul ʼaraʼaytum ʼin kana min ɛindi Allahi wa kafartum bihi wa cahida cahidun min bani ʼisraʼila ɛala miṯlihi faʼamana wa astakbartum ʼinna Allaha la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Wa qala al-laḏina kafaru lillaḏina ʼamanu law kana xayran ma sabaquna ʼilayhi wa ʼiḏ lam yahtadu bihi fasayaquluna haḏa ʼifkun qadimun.
Wa min qablihi kitabu musa ʼimaman wa raḥmatan wa haḏa kitabun muṣaddiqun lisanan ɛarabiyan liyunḏira al-laḏina ḏ̣alamu wa bucra lilmuḥsinin.
ʼinna al-laḏina qalu rabbuna Allahu ṯumma astaqamu fala xawfun ɛalayhim wa la hum yaḥzanun.
ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati xalidina fiha jazaʼan bima kanu yaɛmalun.

Wa waṣṣayna al-ʼinsana biwalidayhi ʼiḥsanan ḥamalat/hu ʼummuhu kurhan wa waḍaɛat/hu kurhan wa ḥamluhu wa fiṣaluhu ṯalaṯuna cahran ḥatta ʼiḏa balaɣa ʼacuddahu wa balaɣa ʼarbaɛina sanatan qala rabbi ʼawziɛni ʼan ʼackura niɛmataka allati ʼanɛamta ɛalayya wa ɛala wa a-dayya wa ʼan ʼaɛmala ṣaliḥan tarḍahu wa ʼaṣliḥ li fi ḏurriyati ʼinni tubtu ʼilayka wa ʼinni mina al-muslimin.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina nataqabbalu ɛanhum ʼaḥsana ma ɛamilu wa natajawazu ɛan sayyiʼatihim fi ʼaṣḥabi al-jannati waɛda aṣ-ṣidqi al-laḏi kanu yuɛadun.

Wa al-laḏi qala liwalidayhi ʼuffin lakuma ʼataɛidanini ʼan ʼuxraja wa qad xalat al-qurunu min qabli wa huma yastaɣiṯani Allaha waylaka ʼamin ʼinna waɛda Allahi ḥaqqun fayaqulu ma haḏa ʼilla ʼasaṭiru al-ʼawwalin.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ḥaqqa ɛalayhim al-qawlu fi ʼumamin qad xalat min qablihim mina al-jinni wa al-ʼinsi ʼinnahum kanu xasirin.
Wa likullin darajatun mimma ɛamilu wa liyuwaffiyahum ʼaɛmalahum wa hum la yuḏ̣lamun.

Wa yawma yuɛraḍu al-laḏina kafaru ɛala an-nari ʼaḏ/habtum ṭayyibatikum fi ḥayatikum ad-dunya wa astamtaɛtum biha falyawma tujzawna ɛaḏaba al-huni bima kuntum tastakbiruna fi al-ʼarḍi biɣayri al-ḥaqqi wa bima kuntum tafsuqun.
Wa aḏkur ʼaxa ɛadin ʼiḏ ʼanḏara qawmahu bil-ʼaḥqafi wa qad xalat an-nuḏuru min bayni yadayhi wa min xalfihi ʼalla taɛbudu ʼilla Allaha ʼinni ʼaxafu ɛalaykum ɛaḏaba yawmin ɛaḏ̣imin.
Qalu ʼajiʼtana litaʼfikana ɛan ʼalihatina faʼtina bima taɛiduna ʼin kunta mina aṣ-ṣadiqin.
Qala ʼinnama al-ɛilmu ɛinda Allahi wa ʼuballiɣukum ma ʼursiltu bihi wa lakinni ʼarakum qawman tajhalun.
Falamma raʼawhu ɛariḍan mustaqbila ʼawdiyatihim qalu haḏa ɛariḍun mumṭiruna bal huwa ma astaɛjaltum bihi riḥun fiha ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Tudammiru kulla cayʼin biʼamri rabbiha faʼaṣbaḥu la yura ʼilla masakinuhum kaḏalika najzi al-qawma al-mujrimin.

Wa laqad makkannahum fima ʼin makkannakum fihi wa jaɛalna lahum samɛan wa ʼabṣaran wa ʼafʼidatan fama ʼaɣna ɛanhum samɛuhum wa la ʼabṣaruhum wa la ʼafʼidatuhum min cayʼin ʼiḏ kanu yajḥaduna biʼayati Allahi wa ḥaqa bihim ma kanu bihi yastahziʼun.
Wa laqad ʼahlakna ma ḥawlakum mina al-qura wa ṣarrafna al-ʼayati laɛallahum yarjiɛun.
Falawla naṣarahumu al-laḏina attaxaḏu min duni Allahi qurbanan ʼalihatan bal ḍallu ɛanhum wa ḏalika ʼifkuhum wa ma kanu yaftarun.
Wa ʼiḏ ṣarafna ʼilayka nafaran mina al-jinni yastamiɛuna al-qurʼana falamma ḥaḍaruhu qalu ʼanṣitu falamma quḍiya wa llaw ʼila qawmihim munḏirin.
Qalu ya qawmana ʼinna samiɛna kitaban ʼunzila min baɛdi musa muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdi ʼila al-ḥaqqi wa ʼila ṭariqin mustaqimin.
Ya qawmana ʼajibu daɛiya Allahi wa ʼaminu bihi yaɣfir lakum min ḏunubikum wa yujirkum min ɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
Wa man la yujib daɛiya Allahi falaysa bimuɛjizin fi al-ʼarḍi wa laysa lahu min dunihi ʼawliyaʼu ʼulaʼika fi ḍalalin mubinin.
ʼawalam yaraw ʼanna Allaha al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa lam yaɛya bixalqihinna biqadirin ɛala ʼan yuḥyiya al-mawta bala ʼinnahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Wa yawma yuɛraḍu al-laḏina kafaru ɛala an-nari ʼalaysa haḏa bil-ḥaqqi qalu bala wa rabbina qala faḏuqu al-ɛaḏaba bima kuntum takfurun.
Faṣbir kama ṣabara ʼulu al-ɛazmi mina ar-rusuli wa la tastaɛjil lahum kaʼannahum yawma yarawna ma yuɛaduna lam yalbaṯu ʼilla saɛatan min naharin balaɣun fahal yuhlaku ʼilla al-qawmu al-fasiqun.
Al-laḏina kafaru wa ṣaddu ɛan sabili Allahi ʼaḍalla ʼaɛmalahum.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati wa ʼamanu bima nuzzila ɛala muḥammadin wa huwa al-ḥaqqu min rabbihim kaffara ɛanhum sayyiʼatihim wa ʼaṣlaḥa balahum.
Ḏalika biʼanna al-laḏina kafaru attabaɛu al-baṭila wa ʼanna al-laḏina ʼamanu attabaɛu al-ḥaqqa min rabbihim kaḏalika yaḍribu Allahu lilnnasi ʼamṯalahum.

Faʼiḏa laqitumu al-laḏina kafaru faḍarba ar-riqabi ḥatta ʼiḏa ʼaṯxantumuhum facuddu al-waṯaqa faʼimma mannan baɛdu wa ʼimma fidaʼan ḥatta taḍaɛa al-ḥarbu ʼawzaraha ḏalika wa law yacaʼu Allahu lantaṣara minhum wa lakin liyabluwa baɛḍakum bibaɛḍin wa al-laḏina qutilu fi sabili Allahi falan yuḍilla ʼaɛmalahum.
Sayahdihim wa yuṣliḥu balahum.
Wa yudxiluhumu al-jannata ɛarrafaha lahum.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼin tanṣuru Allaha yanṣurkum wa yuṯabbit ʼaqdamakum.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru fataɛsan lahum wa ʼaḍalla ʼaɛmalahum.
Ḏalika biʼannahum karihu ma ʼanzala Allahu faʼaḥbaṭa ʼaɛmalahum.
ʼafalam yasiru fi al-ʼarḍi fayanḏ̣uru kayfa kana ɛaqibatu al-laḏina min qablihim dammara Allahu ɛalayhim wa lilkafirina ʼamṯaluh.
Ḏalika biʼanna Allaha mawla al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ʼanna al-kafirina la mawla lahum.
ʼinna Allaha yudxilu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu wa al-laḏina kafaru yatamattaɛuna wa yaʼkuluna kama taʼkulu al-ʼanɛam wa an-naru maṯwan lahum.
Wa kaʼayyin min qaryatin hiya ʼacaddu quwatan min qaryatika allati ʼaxrajatka ʼahlaknahum fala naṣira lahum.
ʼafaman kana ɛala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu suʼ ɛamalihi wa attabaɛu ʼahwaʼahum.

Maṯalu al-jannati allati wuɛida al-muttaquna fiha ʼanharun min maʼin ɣayri ʼasinin wa ʼanharun min labanin lam yataɣayyar ṭaɛmuhu wa ʼanharun min xamrin laḏḏatin lilccaribina wa ʼanharun min ɛasalin muṣaffan wa lahum fiha min kulli aṯ-ṯamarati wa maɣfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa xalidun fi an-nari wa suqu maʼan ḥamiman faqaṭṭaɛa ʼamɛaʼahum.
Wa minhum man yastamiɛu ʼilayka ḥatta ʼiḏa xaraju min ɛindika qalu lillaḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma maḏa qala ʼanifan ʼulaʼika al-laḏina ṭabaɛa Allahu ɛala qulubihim wa attabaɛu ʼahwaʼahum.
Wa al-laḏina ahtadaw zadahum hudan wa ʼatahum taqwhum.
Fahal yanḏ̣uruna ʼilla as-saɛata ʼan taʼtiyahum baɣtatan faqad jaʼa ʼacraṭuha faʼanna lahum ʼiḏa jaʼat/hum ḏikrahum.
Faɛlam ʼannahu la ʼilaha ʼilla Allahu wa astaɣfir liḏanbika wa lilmuʼminina wa al-muʼminati wa Allahu yaɛlamu mutaqallabakum wa maṯwakum.

Wa yaqulu al-laḏina ʼamanu lawla nuzzilat suratun faʼiḏa ʼunzilat suratun muḥkamatun wa ḏukira fiha al-qitalu raʼayta al-laḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun yanḏ̣uruna ʼilayka naḏ̣ara al-maɣciyi ɛalayhi mina al-mawti faʼawla lahum.
Ṭaɛatun wa qawlun maɛrufun faʼiḏa ɛazama al-ʼamru falaw ṣadaqu Allaha lakana xayran lahum.
Fahal ɛasaytum ʼin tawallaytum ʼan tufsidu fi al-ʼarḍi wa tuqaṭṭiɛu ʼarḥamakum.
ʼulaʼika al-laḏina laɛanahumu Allahu faʼaṣammahum wa ʼaɛma ʼabṣarahum.
ʼafala yatadabbaruna al-qurʼana ʼam ɛala qulubin ʼaqfaluh.
ʼinna al-laḏina artaddu ɛala ʼadbarihim min baɛdi ma tabayyana lahumu al-huda ac-cayṭanu sawwala lahum wa ʼamla lahum.
Ḏalika biʼannahum qalu lillaḏina karihu ma nazzala Allahu sanuṭiɛukum fi baɛḍi al-ʼamri wa Allahu yaɛlamu ʼisrarahum.
Fakayfa ʼiḏa tawaffat/hum al-malaʼikatu yaḍribuna wujuhahum wa ʼadbarahum.
Ḏalika biʼannahumu attabaɛu ma ʼasxaṭa Allaha wa karihu riḍwanahu faʼaḥbaṭa ʼaɛmalahum.
ʼam ḥasiba al-laḏina fi qulubihim maraḍun ʼan lan yuxrija Allahu ʼaḍɣanahum.
Wa law nacaʼu laʼaraynakahum falaɛaraftahum bisimahum wa lataɛrifannahum fi laḥni al-qawli wa Allahu yaɛlamu ʼaɛmalakum.
Wa lanabluwannakum ḥatta naɛlama al-mujahidina minkum wa aṣ-ṣabirina wa nabluwa ʼaxbarakum.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru wa ṣaddu ɛan sabili Allahi wa caqqu ar-rasula min baɛdi ma tabayyana lahumu al-huda lan yaḍurru Allaha cayʼan wa sayuḥbiṭu ʼaɛmalahum.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa ʼaṭiɛu ar-rasula wa la tubṭilu ʼaɛmalakum.
ʼinna al-laḏina kafaru wa ṣaddu ɛan sabili Allahi ṯumma matu wa hum kuffarun falan yaɣfira Allahu lahum.
Fala tahinu wa tadɛu ʼila as-salmi wa ʼantum al-ʼaɛlawna wa Allahu maɛakum wa lan yatirakum ʼaɛmalakum.
ʼinnama al-ḥayatu ad-dunya laɛibun wa lahwun wa ʼin tuʼminu wa tattaqu yuʼtikum ʼujurakum wa la yasʼalkum ʼamwalakum.
ʼin yasʼalkumuha fayuḥfikum tabxalu wa yuxrij ʼaḍɣanakum.

Haʼantum haʼuulaʼ tudɛawna litunfiqu fi sabili Allahi faminkum man yabxalu wa man yabxal faʼinnama yabxalu ɛan nafsihi wa Allahu al-ɣaniyu wa ʼantumu al-fuqaraʼu wa ʼin tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ɣayrakum ṯumma la yakunu ʼamṯalakum.
ʼinna fataḥna laka fatḥan mubinan.
Liyaɣfira laka Allahu ma taqaddama min ḏanbika wa ma taʼaxxara wa yutimma niɛmatahu ɛalayka wa yahdiyaka ṣiraṭan mustaqiman.
Wa yanṣuraka Allahu naṣran ɛazizan.
Huwa al-laḏi ʼanzala as-sakinata fi qulubi al-muʼminina liyazdadu ʼimanan maɛa ʼimanihim wa Lillahi junudu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa kana Allahu ɛaliman ḥakiman.
Liyudxila al-muʼminina wa al-muʼminati jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha wa yukaffira ɛanhum sayyiʼatihim wa kana ḏalika ɛinda Allahi fawzan ɛaḏ̣iman.

Wa yuɛaḏḏiba al-munafiqina wa al-munafiqati wa al-mucrikina wa al-mucrikati aḏ̣-ḏ̣annina Billahi ḏ̣anna as-sawʼi ɛalayhim daʼiratu as-sawʼi wa ɣaḍiba Allahu ɛalayhim wa laɛanahum wa ʼaɛadda lahum jahannama wa saʼat maṣiran.
Wa Lillahi junudu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa kana Allahu ɛazizan ḥakiman.
ʼinna ʼarsalnaka cahidan wa mubacciran wa naḏiran.
Lituʼminu Billahi wa rasulihi wa tuɛazziruhu wa tuwaqqiruhu wa tusabbiḥuhu bukratan wa ʼaṣilan.
ʼinna al-laḏina yubayiɛunaka ʼinnama yubayiɛuna Allaha yadu Allahi fawqa ʼaydihim faman nakaṯa faʼinnama yankuṯu ɛala nafsihi wa man ʼawfa bima ɛahada ɛalayhu Allaha fasayuʼtihi ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.

Sayaqulu laka al-muxallafuna mina al-ʼaɛrabi caɣalatna ʼamwaluna wa ʼahluna fastaɣfir lana yaquluna biʼalsinatihim ma laysa fi qulubihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina Allahi cayʼan ʼin ʼarada bikum ḍarran ʼaw ʼarada bikum nafɛan bal kana Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabiran.
Bal ḏ̣anantum ʼan lan yanqaliba ar-rasulu wa al-muʼminuna ʼila ʼahlihim ʼabadan wa zuyyina ḏalika fi qulubikum wa ḏ̣anantum ḏ̣anna as-sawʼi wa kuntum qawman buran.
Wa man lam yuʼmin Billahi wa rasulihi faʼinna ʼaɛtadna lilkafirina saɛiran.
Wa Lillahi mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yaɣfiru liman yacaʼu wa yuɛaḏḏibu man yacaʼu wa kana Allahu ɣafuran raḥiman.

Sayaqulu al-muxallafuna ʼiḏa anṭalaqtum ʼila maɣanima litaʼxuḏuha ḏaruna nattabiɛkum yuriduna ʼan yubaddilu kalama Allahi qul lan tattabiɛuna kaḏalikum qala Allahu min qablu fasayaquluna bal taḥsudunana bal kanu la yafqahuna ʼilla qalilan.

Qul lilmuxallafina mina al-ʼaɛrabi satudɛawna ʼila qawmin ʼuli baʼsin cadidin tuqatilunahum ʼaw yuslimuna faʼin tuṭiɛu yuʼtikum Allahu ʼajran ḥasanan wa ʼin tatawallaw kama tawallaytum min qablu yuɛaḏḏibkum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.

Laysa ɛala al-ʼaɛma ḥarajun wa la ɛala al-ʼaɛraji ḥarajun wa la ɛala al-mariḍi ḥarajun wa man yuṭiɛ Allaha wa rasulahu yudxilhu jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu wa man yatawalla yuɛaḏḏibhu ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.
Laqad raḍiya Allahu ɛan al-muʼminina ʼiḏ yubayiɛunaka taḥta ac-cajarati faɛalima ma fi qulubihim faʼanzala as-sakinata ɛalayhim wa ʼaṯabahum fatḥan qariban.
Wa maɣanima kaṯiratan yaʼxuḏunaha wa kana Allahu ɛazizan ḥakiman.
Waɛadakumu Allahu maɣanima kaṯiratan taʼxuḏunaha faɛajjala lakum haḏihi wa kaffa ʼaydiya an-nasi ɛankum wa litakuna ʼayatan lilmuʼminina wa yahdiyakum ṣiraṭan mustaqiman.
Wa ʼuxra lam taqdiru ɛalayha qad ʼaḥaṭa Allahu biha wa kana Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadiran.
Wa law qatalakumu al-laḏina kafaru lawallaw al-ʼadbara ṯumma la yajiduna waliyan wa la naṣiran.
Sunnata Allahi allati qad xalat min qablu wa lan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdilan.
Wa huwa al-laḏi kaffa ʼaydiyahum ɛankum wa ʼaydiyakum ɛanhum bibaṭni makkata min baɛdi ʼan ʼaḏ̣farakum ɛalayhim wa kana Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣiran.

Hum al-laḏina kafaru wa ṣaddukum ɛan al-masjidi al-ḥarami wa al-hadya maɛkufan ʼan yabluɣa maḥillahu wa lawla rijalun muʼminuna wa nisaʼun muʼminatun lam taɛlamuhum ʼan taṭaʼuhum fatuṣibakum minhum maɛarratun biɣayri ɛilmin liyudxila Allahu fi raḥmatihi man yacaʼu law tazayyalu laɛaḏḏabna al-laḏina kafaru minhum ɛaḏaban ʼaliman.

ʼiḏ jaɛala al-laḏina kafaru fi qulubihimu al-ḥamiyata ḥamiyata al-jahiliyati faʼanzala Allahu sakinatahu ɛala rasulihi wa ɛala al-muʼminina wa ʼalzamahum kalimata at-taqwa wa kanu ʼaḥaqqa biha wa ʼahlaha wa kana Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛaliman.

Laqad ṣadaqa Allahu rasulahu ar-ruʼya bil-ḥaqqi latadxulunna al-masjida al-ḥarama ʼin caʼa Allahu ʼaminina muḥalliqina ruʼsakum wa muqaṣṣirina la taxafuna faɛalima ma lam taɛlamu fajaɛala min duni ḏalika fatḥan qariban.
Huwa al-laḏi ʼarsala rasulahu bil-huda wa dini al-ḥaqqi liyuḏ̣hirahu ɛala ad-dini kullihi wa kafa Billahi cahidan.

Muḥammadun rasulu Allahi wa al-laḏina maɛahu ʼaciddaʼu ɛala al-kuffari ruḥamaʼu baynahum tarahum rukkaɛan sujjadan yabtaɣuna faḍlan mina Allahi wa riḍwanan simahum fi wujuhihim min ʼaṯari as-sujudi ḏalika maṯaluhum fi at-tawrati wa maṯaluhum fi al-ʼinjili kazarɛin ʼaxraja caṭʼahu faʼazarahu fastaɣlaḏ̣a fastawa ɛala suqihi yuɛjibu az-zurraɛa liyaɣiḏ̣a bihim al-kuffara waɛada Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati minhum maɣfiratan wa ʼajran ɛaḏ̣iman.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tuqaddimu bayna yaday Allahi wa rasulihi wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha samiɛun ɛalimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tarfaɛu ʼaṣwatakum fawqa ṣawti an-nabiyi wa la tajharu lahu bil-qawli kajahri baɛḍikum libaɛḍin ʼan taḥbaṭa ʼaɛmalukum wa ʼantum la tacɛurun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yaɣuḍḍuna ʼaṣwatahum ɛinda rasuli Allahi ʼulaʼika al-laḏina amtaḥana Allahu qulubahum lilttaqwa lahum maɣfiratun wa ʼajrun ɛaḏ̣imun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yunadunaka min waraʼi al-ḥujurati ʼakṯaruhum la yaɛqilun.
Wa law ʼannahum ṣabaru ḥatta taxruja ʼilayhim lakana xayran lahum wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼin jaʼakum fasiqun binabaʼiin fatabayyanu ʼan tuṣibu qawman bijahalatin fatuṣbiḥu ɛala ma faɛaltum nadimin.

Wa aɛlamu ʼanna fikum rasula Allahi law yuṭiɛukum fi kaṯirin mina al-ʼamri laɛanittum wa lakinna Allaha ḥabbaba ʼilaykum al-ʼimana wa zayyanahu fi qulubikum wa karraha ʼilaykumu al-kufra wa al-fusuqa wa al-ɛiṣyana ʼulaʼika hum ar-racidun.
Faḍlan mina Allahi wa niɛmatan wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.

Wa ʼin ṭaʼifatani mina al-muʼminina aqtatalu faʼaṣliḥu baynahuma faʼin baɣat ʼiḥdahuma ɛala al-ʼuxra faqatilu allati tabɣi ḥatta tafiʼa ʼila ʼamri Allahi faʼin faʼat faʼaṣliḥu baynahuma bil-ɛadli wa ʼaqsiṭu ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muqsiṭin.
ʼinnama al-muʼminuna ʼixwatun faʼaṣliḥu bayna ʼaxawaykum wa attaqu Allaha laɛallakum turḥamun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la yasxar qawmun min qawmin ɛasa ʼan yakunu xayran minhum wa la nisaʼun min nisaʼin ɛasa ʼan yakunna xayran minhunna wa la talmizu ʼanfusakum wa la tanabazu bil-ʼalqabi biʼsa al-aismu al-fusuqu baɛda al-ʼimani wa man lam yatub faʼulaʼika humu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ajtanibu kaṯiran mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣anni ʼinna baɛḍa aḏ̣-ḏ̣anni ʼiṯmun wa la tajassasu wa la yaɣtab baɛḍukum baɛḍan ʼayuḥibbu ʼaḥadukum ʼan yaʼkula laḥma ʼaxihi maytan fakarihtumuhu wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha tawwabun raḥimun.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nasu ʼinna xalaqnakum min ḏakarin wa ʼunṯa wa jaɛalnakum cuɛuban wa qabaʼila litaɛarafu ʼinna ʼakramakum ɛinda Allahi ʼatqakum ʼinna Allaha ɛalimun xabirun.

Qalat al-ʼaɛrabu ʼamanna qul lam tuʼminu wa lakin qulu ʼaslamna wa lamma yadxuli al-ʼimanu fi qulubikum wa ʼin tuṭiɛu Allaha wa rasulahu la yalitkum min ʼaɛmalikum cayʼan ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼinnama al-muʼminuna al-laḏina ʼamanu Billahi wa rasulihi ṯumma lam yartabu wa jahadu biʼamwalihim wa ʼanfusihim fi sabili Allahi ʼulaʼika humu aṣ-ṣadiqun.
Qul ʼatuɛallimuna Allaha bidinikum wa Allahu yaɛlamu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Yamunnuna ɛalayka ʼan ʼaslamu qul la tamunnu ɛalayya ʼislamakum bal Allahu yamunnu ɛalaykum ʼan hadakum lilʼimani ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
ʼinna Allaha yaɛlamu ɣayba as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa Allahu baṣirun bima taɛmalun.
Qaf wa al-qurʼani al-majid.
Bal ɛajibu ʼan jaʼahum munḏirun minhum faqala al-kafiruna haḏa cayʼun ɛajibun.
ʼaʼiḏa mitna wa kunna turaban ḏalika rajɛun baɛidun.
Qad ɛalimna ma tanquṣu al-ʼarḍu minhum wa ɛindana kitabun ḥafiḏ̣un.
Bal kaḏḏabu bil-ḥaqqi lamma jaʼahum fahum fi ʼamrin marijin.
ʼafalam yanḏ̣uru ʼila as-samaʼi fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wa zayyannaha wa ma laha min furujin.
Wa al-ʼarḍa madadnaha wa ʼalqayna fiha rawasiya wa ʼanbatna fiha min kulli zawjin bahijin.
Tabṣiratan wa ḏikra likulli ɛabdin munibin.
Wa nazzalna mina as-samaʼi maʼan mubarakan faʼanbatna bihi jannatin wa ḥabba al-ḥaṣid.
Wa an-naxla basiqatin laha ṭalɛun naḍidun.
Rizqan lilɛibadi wa ʼaḥyayna bihi baldatan maytan kaḏalika al-xuruj.
Kaḏḏabat qablahum qawmu nuḥin wa ʼaṣḥabu ar-rassi wa ṯamud.
Wa ɛadun wa firɛawnu wa ʼixwanu luṭin.
Wa ʼaṣḥabu al-ʼaykati wa qawmu tubbaɛin kullun kaḏḏaba ar-rusula faḥaqqa waɛid.
ʼafaɛayina bil-xalqi al-ʼawwali bal hum fi labsin min xalqin jadidin.
Wa laqad xalaqna al-ʼinsana wa naɛlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wa naḥnu ʼaqrabu ʼilayhi min ḥabli al-warid.
ʼiḏ yatalaqqa al-mutalaqqiyani ɛan al-yamini wa ɛan ac-cimali qaɛidun.
Ma yalfiḏ̣u min qawlin ʼilla ladayhi raqibun ɛatidun.
Wa jaʼat sakratu al-mawti bil-ḥaqqi ḏalika ma kunta minhu taḥid.
Wa nufixa fi aṣ-ṣuri ḏalika yawmu al-waɛid.
Wa jaʼat kullu nafsin maɛaha saʼiqun wa cahidun.
Laqad kunta fi ɣaflatin min haḏa fakacafna ɛanka ɣiṭaʼaka fabaṣaruka al-yawma ḥadidun.
Wa qala qarinuhu haḏa ma ladayya ɛatidun.
ʼalqiya fi jahannama kulla kaffarin ɛanidin.
Mannaɛin lilxayri muɛtadin muribin.
Al-laḏi jaɛala maɛa Allahi ʼilahan ʼaxara faʼalqiyahu fi al-ɛaḏabi ac-cadid.
Qala qarinuhu rabbana ma ʼaṭɣaytuhu wa lakin kana fi ḍalalin baɛidin.
Qala la taxtaṣimu ladayya wa qad qaddamtu ʼilaykum bil-waɛid.
Ma yubaddalu al-qawlu ladayya wa ma ʼana biḏ̣allamin lilɛabid.
Yawma naqulu lijahannama hal amtalaʼti wa taqulu hal min mazidin.
Wa ʼuzlifat al-jannatu lilmuttaqina ɣayra baɛidin.
Haḏa ma tuɛaduna likulli ʼawwabin ḥafiḏ̣in.
Man xaciya ar-raḥmana bil-ɣaybi wa jaʼa biqalbin munibin.
Adxuluha bisalamin ḏalika yawmu al-xulud.
Lahum ma yacaʼuna fiha wa ladayna mazidun.
Wa kam ʼahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ʼacaddu minhum baṭcan fanaqqabu fi al-biladi hal min maḥiṣin.
ʼinna fi ḏalika laḏikra liman kana lahu qalbun ʼaw ʼalqa as-samɛa wa huwa cahidun.
Wa laqad xalaqna as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa wa ma baynahuma fi sittati ʼayyamin wa ma massana min luɣubin.
Faṣbir ɛala ma yaquluna wa sabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭuluɛi ac-camsi wa qabla al-ɣurub.
Wa mina al-layli fasabbiḥhu wa ʼadbara as-sujud.
Wa astamiɛ yawma yunadi al-munadi min makanin qaribin.
Yawma yasmaɛuna aṣ-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqqi ḏalika yawmu al-xuruj.
ʼinna naḥnu nuḥyi wa numitu wa ʼilayna al-maṣir.
Yawma tacaqqaqu al-ʼarḍu ɛanhum siraɛan ḏalika ḥacrun ɛalayna yasirun.
Naḥnu ʼaɛlamu bima yaquluna wa ma ʼanta ɛalayhim bijabbarin faḏakkir bil-qurʼani man yaxafu waɛid.
Wa aḏ-ḏariyati ḏarwan.
Falḥamilati wiqran.
Faljariyati yusran.
Falmuqassimati ʼamran.
ʼinnama tuɛaduna laṣadiqun.
Wa ʼinna ad-dina lawaqiɛun.
Wa as-samaʼi ḏati al-ḥubuk.
ʼinnakum lafi qawlin muxtalifin.
Yuʼfaku ɛanhu man ʼufik.
Qutila al-xarraṣun.
Al-laḏina hum fi ɣamratin sahun.
Yasʼaluna ʼayyana yawmu ad-din.
Yawma hum ɛala an-nari yuftanun.
Ḏuqu fitnatakum haḏa al-laḏi kuntum bihi tastaɛjilun.
ʼinna al-muttaqina fi jannatin wa ɛuyunin.
ʼaxiḏina ma ʼatahum rabbuhum ʼinnahum kanu qabla ḏalika muḥsinin.
Kanu qalilan mina al-layli ma yahjaɛun.
Wa bil-ʼasḥari hum yastaɣfirun.
Wa fi ʼamwalihim ḥaqqun lilssaʼili wa al-maḥrum.
Wa fi al-ʼarḍi ʼayatun lilmuqinin.
Wa fi ʼanfusikum ʼafala tubṣirun.
Wa fi as-samaʼi rizqukum wa ma tuɛadun.
Fawarabbi as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi ʼinnahu laḥaqqun miṯla ma ʼannakum tanṭiqun.
Hal ʼataka ḥadiṯu ḍayfi ʼibrahima al-mukramin.
ʼiḏ daxalu ɛalayhi faqalu salaman qala salamun qawmun munkarun.
Faraɣa ʼila ʼahlihi fajaʼa biɛijlin saminin.
Faqarrabahu ʼilayhim qala ʼala taʼkulun.
Faʼawjasa minhum xifatan qalu la taxaf wa baccaruhu biɣulamin ɛalimin.
Faʼaqbalat amraʼatuhu fi ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhaha wa qalat ɛajuzun ɛaqimun.
Qalu kaḏaliki qala rabbuki ʼinnahu huwa al-ḥakimu al-ɛalim.
Qala fama xaṭbukum ʼayyuha al-mursalun.
Qalu ʼinna ʼursilna ʼila qawmin mujrimin.
Linursila ɛalayhim ḥijaratan min ṭinin.
Musawwamatan ɛinda rabbika lilmusrifin.
Faʼaxrajna man kana fiha mina al-muʼminin.
Fama wajadna fiha ɣayra baytin mina al-muslimin.
Wa tarakna fiha ʼayatan lillaḏina yaxafuna al-ɛaḏaba al-ʼalim.
Wa fi musa ʼiḏ ʼarsalnahu ʼila firɛawna bisulṭanin mubinin.
Fatawalla biruknihi wa qala saḥirun ʼaw majnunun.
Faʼaxaḏnahu wa junudahu fanabaḏnahum fi al-yammi wa huwa mulimun.
Wa fi ɛadin ʼiḏ ʼarsalna ɛalayhimu ar-riḥa al-ɛaqim.
Ma taḏaru min cayʼin ʼatat ɛalayhi ʼilla jaɛalat/hu kalrramim.
Wa fi ṯamuda ʼiḏ qila lahum tamattaɛu ḥatta ḥinin.
Faɛataw ɛan ʼamri rabbihim faʼaxaḏat/hum aṣ-ṣaɛiqatu wa hum yanḏ̣urun.
Fama astaṭaɛu min qiyamin wa ma kanu muntaṣirin.
Wa qawma nuḥin min qablu ʼinnahum kanu qawman fasiqin.
Wa as-samaʼa banaynaha biʼayydin wa ʼinna lamusiɛun.
