Wa laḥmi ṭayrin mimma yactahun.
Wa ḥurun ɛinun.
Kaʼamṯali al-luʼluʼi al-maknun.
Jazaʼan bima kanu yaɛmalun.
La yasmaɛuna fiha laɣwan wa la taʼṯiman.
ʼilla qilan salaman salaman.
Wa ʼaṣḥabu al-yamini ma ʼaṣḥabu al-yamin.
Fi sidrin maxḍudin.
Wa ṭalḥin manḍudin.
Wa ḏ̣illin mamdudin.
Wa maʼin maskubin.
Wa fakihatin kaṯiratin.
La maqṭuɛatin wa la mamnuɛatin.
Wa furucin marfuɛatin.
ʼinna ʼancaʼnahunna ʼincaʼan.
Fajaɛalnahunna ʼabkaran.
Ɛuruban ʼatraban.
Lʼaṣḥabi al-yamin.
Ṯullatun mina al-ʼawwalin.
Wa ṯullatun mina al-ʼaxirin.
Wa ʼaṣḥabu ac-cimali ma ʼaṣḥabu ac-cimal.
Fi samumin wa ḥamimin.
Wa ḏ̣illin min yaḥmumin.
La baridin wa la karimin.
ʼinnahum kanu qabla ḏalika mutrafin.
Wa kanu yuṣirruna ɛala al-ḥinṯi al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa kanu yaquluna ʼaʼiḏa mitna wa kunna turaban wa ɛiḏ̣aman ʼaʼinna lamabɛuṯun.
ʼawa ʼabaʼuuna al-ʼawwalun.
Qul ʼinna al-ʼawwalina wa al-ʼaxirin.
Lamajmuɛuna ʼila miqati yawmin maɛlumin.
Ṯumma ʼinnakum ʼayyuha aḍ-ḍalluna al-mukaḏḏibun.
Laʼakiluna min cajarin min zaqqumin.
Famaliʼuna minha al-buṭun.
Facaribuna ɛalayhi mina al-ḥamim.
Facaribuna curba al-him.
Haḏa nuzuluhum yawma ad-din.
Naḥnu xalaqnakum falawla tuṣaddiqun.
ʼafaraʼaytum ma tumnun.
ʼaʼantum taxluqunahu ʼam naḥnu al-xaliqun.
Naḥnu qaddarna baynakumu al-mawta wa ma naḥnu bimasbuqin.
Ɛala ʼan nubaddila ʼamṯalakum wa nunciʼakum fi ma la taɛlamun.
Wa laqad ɛalimtum an-nacʼata al-ʼula falawla taḏkkarun.
ʼafaraʼaytum ma taḥruṯun.
ʼaʼantum tazraɛunahu ʼam naḥnu az-zariɛun.
Law nacaʼu lajaɛalnahu ḥuṭaman faḏ̣alaltum tafakkahun.
ʼinna lamuɣramun.
Bal naḥnu maḥrumun.
ʼafaraʼaytum al-maʼa al-laḏi tacrabun.
ʼaʼantum ʼanzaltumuhu mina al-muzni ʼam naḥnu al-munzilun.
Law nacaʼu jaɛalnahu ʼujajan falawla tackurun.
ʼafaraʼaytumu an-nara allati turun.
ʼaʼantum ʼancaʼtum cajarataha ʼam naḥnu al-munciʼun.
Naḥnu jaɛalnaha taḏkiratan wa mataɛan lilmuqwin.
Fasabbiḥ biasmi rabbika al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Fala ʼuqsimu bimawaqiɛi an-nujum.
Wa ʼinnahu laqasamun law taɛlamuna ɛaḏ̣imun.
ʼinnahu laqurʼanun karimun.
Fi kitabin maknunin.
La yamassuhu ʼilla al-muṭahharun.
Tanzilun min rabbi al-ɛalamin.
ʼafabihaḏa al-ḥadiṯi ʼantum mud/hinun.
Wa tajɛaluna rizqakum ʼannakum tukaḏḏibun.
Falawla ʼiḏa balaɣati al-ḥulqum.
Wa ʼantum ḥinaʼiḏin tanḏ̣urun.
Wa naḥnu ʼaqrabu ʼilayhi minkum wa lakin la tubṣirun.
Falawla ʼin kuntum ɣayra madinin.
Tarjiɛunaha ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Faʼamma ʼin kana mina al-muqarrabin.
Farawḥun wa rayḥanun wa jannatu naɛimin.
Wa ʼamma ʼin kana min ʼaṣḥabi al-yamin.
Fasalamun laka min ʼaṣḥabi al-yamin.
Wa ʼamma ʼin kana mina al-mukaḏḏibina aḍ-ḍallin.
Fanuzulun min ḥamimin.
Wa taṣliyatu jaḥimin.
ʼinna haḏa lahuwa ḥaqqu al-yaqin.
Fasabbiḥ biasmi rabbika al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Sabbaḥa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi yuḥyi wa yumitu wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Huwa al-ʼawwalu wa al-ʼaxiru wa aḏ̣-ḏ̣ahiru wa al-baṭinu wa huwa bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.

Huwa al-laḏi xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa fi sittati ʼayyamin ṯumma astawa ɛala al-ɛarci yaɛlamu ma yaliju fi al-ʼarḍi wa ma yaxruju minha wa ma yanzilu mina as-samaʼi wa ma yaɛruju fiha wa huwa maɛakum ʼayna ma kuntum wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
Lahu mulku as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa ʼila Allahi turjaɛu al-ʼumur.
Yuliju al-layla fi an-nahari wa yuliju an-nahara fi al-layli wa huwa ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
ʼaminu Billahi wa rasulihi wa ʼanfiqu mimma jaɛalakum mustaxlafina fihi fa-al-laḏina ʼamanu minkum wa ʼanfaqu lahum ʼajrun kabirun.
Wa ma lakum la tuʼminuna Billahi wa ar-rasulu yadɛukum lituʼminu birabbikum wa qad ʼaxaḏa miṯaqakum ʼin kuntum muʼminin.
Huwa al-laḏi yunazzilu ɛala ɛabdihi ʼayatin bayyinatin liyuxrijakum mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼila an-nur wa ʼinna Allaha bikum laraʼufun raḥimun.

Wa ma lakum ʼalla tunfiqu fi sabili Allahi wa Lillahi miraṯu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi la yastawi minkum man ʼanfaqa min qabli al-fatḥi wa qatala ʼulaʼika ʼaɛḏ̣amu darajatan mina al-laḏina ʼanfaqu min baɛdu wa qatalu wa kullan waɛada Allahu al-ḥusna wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabirun.
Man ḏa al-laḏi yuqriḍu Allaha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍaɛifahu lahu wa lahu ʼajrun karimun.
Yawma tara al-muʼminina wa al-muʼminati yasɛa nuruhum bayna ʼaydihim wa biʼaymanihim bucrakumu al-yawma jannatun tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ḏalika huwa al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.

Yawma yaqulu al-munafiquna wa al-munafiqatu lillaḏina ʼamanu anḏ̣uruna naqtabis min nurikum qila arjiɛu waraʼakum faltamisu nuran faḍuriba baynahum bisurin lahu babun baṭinuhu fihi ar-raḥmatu wa ḏ̣ahiruhu min qibalihi al-ɛaḏab.
Yunadunahum ʼalam nakun maɛakum qalu bala wa lakinnakum fatantum ʼanfusakum wa tarabbaṣtum wa artabtum wa ɣarratkumu al-ʼamaniyu ḥatta jaʼa ʼamru Allahi wa ɣarrakum Billahi al-ɣarur.
Falyawma la yuʼxaḏu minkum fidyatun wa la mina al-laḏina kafaru maʼwakumu an-naru hiya mawlakum wa biʼsa al-maṣir.

ʼalam yaʼni lillaḏina ʼamanu ʼan taxcaɛa qulubuhum liḏikri Allahi wa ma nazala mina al-ḥaqqi wa la yakunu kallaḏina ʼutu al-kitaba min qablu faṭala ɛalayhimu al-ʼamadu faqasat qulubuhum wa kaṯirun minhum fasiqun.
Aɛlamu ʼanna Allaha yuḥyi al-ʼarḍa baɛda mawtiha qad bayyanna lakumu al-ʼayati laɛallakum taɛqilun.
ʼinna al-muṣṣaddiqina wa al-muṣṣaddiqati wa ʼaqraḍu Allaha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍaɛafu lahum wa lahum ʼajrun karimun.
Wa al-laḏina ʼamanu Billahi wa rusulihi ʼulaʼika hum aṣ-ṣiddiquna wa ac-cuhadaʼu ɛinda rabbihim lahum ʼajruhum wa nuruhum wa al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biʼayatina ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu al-jaḥim.

Aɛlamu ʼannama al-ḥayatu ad-dunya laɛibun wa lahwun wa zinatun wa tafaxurun baynakum wa takaṯurun fi al-ʼamwli wa al-ʼawladi kamaṯali ɣayṯin ʼaɛjaba al-kuffara nabatuhu ṯumma yahiju fatarahu muṣfarran ṯumma yakunu ḥuṭaman wa fi al-ʼaxirati ɛaḏabun cadidun wa maɣfiratun mina Allahi wa riḍwanun wa ma al-ḥayatu ad-dunya ʼilla mataɛu al-ɣurur.

Sabiqu ʼila maɣfiratin min rabbikum wa jannatin ɛarḍuha kaɛarḍi as-samaʼi wa al-ʼarḍi ʼuɛiddat lillaḏina ʼamanu Billahi wa rusulihi ḏalika faḍlu Allahi yuʼtihi man yacaʼu wa Allahu ḏu al-faḍli al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Ma ʼaṣaba min muṣibatin fi al-ʼarḍi wa la fi ʼanfusikum ʼilla fi kitabin min qabli ʼan nabraʼaha ʼinna ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasirun.
Likayla taʼsaw ɛala ma fatakum wa la tafraḥu bima ʼatakum wa Allahu la yuḥibbu kulla muxtalin faxurin.
Al-laḏina yabxaluna wa yaʼmuruna an-nasa bil-buxli wa man yatawalla faʼinna Allaha huwa al-ɣaniyu al-ḥamid.

Laqad ʼarsalna rusulana bil-bayyinati wa ʼanzalna maɛahumu al-kitaba wa al-mizana liyaquma an-nasu bil-qisṭi wa ʼanzalna al-ḥadida fihi baʼsun cadidun wa manafiɛu lilnnasi wa liyaɛlama Allahu man yanṣuruhu wa rusulahu bil-ɣaybi ʼinna Allaha qawiyun ɛazizun.
Wa laqad ʼarsalna nuḥan wa ʼibrahima wa jaɛalna fi ḏurriyatihima an-nubuwata wa al-kitaba faminhum muhtadin wa kaṯirun minhum fasiqun.

Ṯumma qaffayna ɛala ʼaṯarihim birusulina wa qaffayna biɛisa abni maryama wa ʼataynahu al-ʼinjila wa jaɛalna fi qulubi al-laḏina attabaɛuhu raʼfatan wa raḥmatan wa rahbaniyatan abtadaɛuha ma katabnaha ɛalayhim ʼilla abtiɣaʼa riḍwani Allahi fama raɛawha ḥaqqa riɛayatiha faʼatayna al-laḏina ʼamanu minhum ʼajrahum wa kaṯirun minhum fasiqun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu Allaha wa ʼaminu birasulihi yuʼtikum kiflayni min raḥmatihi wa yajɛal lakum nuran tamcuna bihi wa yaɣfir lakum wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Liʼalla yaɛlama ʼahlu al-kitabi ʼalla yaqdiruna ɛala cayʼin min faḍli Allahi wa ʼanna al-faḍla biyadi Allahi yuʼtihi man yacaʼu wa Allahu ḏu al-faḍli al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Qad samiɛa Allahu qawla allati tujadiluka fi zawjiha wa tactaki ʼila Allahi wa Allahu yasmaɛu taḥawurakuma ʼinna Allaha samiɛun baṣirun.
Al-laḏina yuḏ̣ahiruna minkum min nisaʼihim ma hunna ʼummahatihim ʼin ʼummahatuhum ʼilla al-laʼi waladnahum wa ʼinnahum layaquluna munkaran mina al-qawli wa zuran wa ʼinna Allaha laɛafuwun ɣafurun.
Wa al-laḏina yuḏ̣ahiruna min nisaʼihim ṯumma yaɛuduna lima qalu fataḥriru raqabatin min qabli ʼan yatamassa ḏalikum tuɛaḏ̣una bihi wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabirun.

Faman lam yajid faṣiyamu cahrayni mutatabiɛayni min qabli ʼan yatamassa faman lam yastaṭiɛ faʼiṭɛamu sittina miskinan ḏalika lituʼminu Billahi wa rasulihi wa tilka ḥududu Allahi wa lilkafirina ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yuḥadduna Allaha wa rasulahu kubitu kama kubita al-laḏina min qablihim wa qad ʼanzalna ʼayatin bayyinatin wa lilkafirina ɛaḏabun muhinun.
Yawma yabɛaṯuhum Allahu jamiɛan fayunabbiʼuhum bima ɛamilu ʼaḥṣahu Allahu wa nasuhu wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin cahidun.

ʼalam tara ʼanna Allaha yaɛlamu ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi ma yakunu min najwa ṯalaṯatin ʼilla huwa rabiɛuhum wa la xamsatin ʼilla huwa sadisuhum wa la ʼadna min ḏalika wa la ʼakṯara ʼilla huwa maɛahum ʼayna ma kanu ṯumma yunabbiʼuhum bima ɛamilu yawma al-qiyamati ʼinna Allaha bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.

ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina nuhu ɛan an-najwa ṯumma yaɛuduna lima nuhu ɛanhu wa yatanajawna bil-ʼiṯmi wa al-ɛudwani wa maɛṣiyati ar-rasuli wa ʼiḏa jaʼuka ḥayyawka bima lam yuḥayyika bihi Allahu wa yaquluna fi ʼanfusihim lawla yuɛaḏḏibuna Allahu bima naqulu ḥasbuhum jahannamu yaṣlawnaha fabiʼsa al-maṣir.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa tanajaytum fala tatanajaw bil-ʼiṯmi wa al-ɛudwani wa maɛṣiyati ar-rasuli wa tanajaw bil-birri wa at-taqwa wa attaqu Allaha al-laḏi ʼilayhi tuḥcarun.
ʼinnama an-najwa mina ac-cayṭani liyaḥzuna al-laḏina ʼamanu wa laysa biḍarrihim cayʼan ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkali al-muʼminun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa qila lakum tafassaḥu fi al-majalisi fafsaḥu yafsaḥi Allahu lakum wa ʼiḏa qila ancuzu fancuzu yarfaɛ Allahu al-laḏina ʼamanu minkum wa al-laḏina ʼutu al-ɛilma darajatin wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabirun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa najaytum ar-rasula faqaddimu bayna yaday najwakum ṣadaqatan ḏalika xayrun lakum wa ʼaṭharu faʼin lam tajidu faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼaʼacfaqtum ʼan tuqaddimu bayna yaday najwakum ṣadaqatin faʼiḏ lam tafɛalu wa taba Allahu ɛalaykum faʼaqimu aṣ-ṣalata wa ʼatu az-zakata wa ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa rasulahu wa Allahu xabirun bima taɛmalun.
ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina tawallaw qawman ɣaḍiba Allahu ɛalayhim ma hum minkum wa la minhum wa yaḥlifuna ɛala al-kaḏibi wa hum yaɛlamun.
ʼaɛadda Allahu lahum ɛaḏaban cadidan ʼinnahum saʼa ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Attaxaḏu ʼaymanahum junnatan faṣaddu ɛan sabili Allahi falahum ɛaḏabun muhinun.
Lan tuɣniya ɛanhum ʼamwaluhum wa la ʼawladuhum mina Allahi cayʼan ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari hum fiha xalidun.
Yawma yabɛaṯuhum Allahu jamiɛan fayaḥlifuna lahu kama yaḥlifuna lakum wa yaḥsabuna ʼannahum ɛala cayʼin ʼala ʼinnahum hum al-kaḏibun.
Astaḥwaḏa ɛalayhim ac-cayṭanu faʼansahum ḏikra Allahi ʼulaʼika ḥizbu ac-cayṭani ʼala ʼinna ḥizba ac-cayṭani hum al-xasirun.
ʼinna al-laḏina yuḥadduna Allaha wa rasulahu ʼulaʼika fi al-ʼaḏallin.
Kataba Allahu laʼaɣlibanna ʼana wa rusuli ʼinna Allaha qawiyun ɛazizun.

La tajidu qawman yuʼminuna Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri yuwadduna man ḥadda Allaha wa rasulahu wa law kanu ʼabaʼahum ʼaw ʼabnaʼahum ʼaw ʼixwanahum ʼaw ɛaciratahum ʼulaʼika kataba fi qulubihim al-ʼimana wa ʼayyadahum biruḥin minhu wa yudxiluhum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha raḍiya Allahu ɛanhum wa raḍu ɛanhu ʼulaʼika ḥizbu Allahi ʼala ʼinna ḥizba Allahi hum al-mufliḥun.
Sabbaḥa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.

Huwa al-laḏi ʼaxraja al-laḏina kafaru min ʼahli al-kitabi min diyarihim liʼwwali al-ḥacri ma ḏ̣anantum ʼan yaxruju wa ḏ̣annu ʼannahum maniɛatuhum ḥuṣunuhum mina Allahi faʼatahum Allahu min ḥayṯu lam yaḥtasibu wa qaḏafa fi qulubihim ar-ruɛba yuxribuna buyutahum biʼaydihim wa ʼaydi al-muʼminina faɛtabiru ya ʼuli al-ʼabṣar.
Wa lawla ʼan kataba Allahu ɛalayhim al-jalaʼa laɛaḏḏabahum fi ad-dunya wa lahum fi al-ʼaxirati ɛaḏabu an-nar.
Ḏalika biʼannahum caqqu Allaha wa rasulahu wa man yucaqqi Allaha faʼinna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Ma qaṭaɛtum min linatin ʼaw taraktumuha qaʼimatan ɛala ʼuṣuliha fabiʼiḏni Allahi wa liyuxziya al-fasiqin.
Wa ma ʼafaʼa Allahu ɛala rasulihi minhum fama ʼawjaftum ɛalayhi min xaylin wa la rikabin wa lakinna Allaha yusalliṭu rusulahu ɛala man yacaʼu wa Allahu ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.

Ma ʼafaʼa Allahu ɛala rasulihi min ʼahli al-qura falillahi wa lilrrasuli wa liḏi al-qurba wa al-yatama wa al-masakini wa abni as-sabili kay la yakuna dulatan bayna al-ʼaɣniyaʼi minkum wa ma ʼatakum ar-rasulu faxuḏuhu wa ma nahakum ɛanhu fantahu wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha cadidu al-ɛiqab.
Lilfuqaraʼi al-muhajirina al-laḏina ʼuxriju min diarihim wa ʼamwalihim yabtaɣuna faḍlan mina Allahi wa riḍwanan wa yanṣuruna Allaha wa rasulahu ʼulaʼika hum aṣ-ṣadiqun.

Wa al-laḏina tabawwaʼu ad-dara wa al-ʼimana min qablihim yuḥibbuna man hajara ʼilayhim wa la yajiduna fi ṣudurihim ḥajatan mimma ʼutu wa yuʼṯiruna ɛala ʼanfusihim wa law kana bihim xaṣaṣatun wa man yuqa cuḥḥa nafsihi faʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
Wa al-laḏina jaʼu min baɛdihim yaquluna rabbana aɣfir lana wa liʼaxwanina al-laḏina sabaquna bil-ʼimani wa la tajɛal fi qulubina ɣillan lillaḏina ʼamanu rabbana ʼinnaka raʼufun raḥimun.

ʼalam tara ʼila al-laḏina nafaqu yaquluna liʼxwanihim al-laḏina kafaru min ʼahli al-kitabi laʼin ʼuxrijtum lanaxrujanna maɛakum wa la nuṭiɛu fikum ʼaḥadan ʼabadan wa ʼin qutiltum lananṣurannakum wa Allahu yac/hadu ʼinnahum lakaḏibun.
Laʼin ʼuxriju la yaxrujuna maɛahum wa laʼin qutilu la yanṣurunahum wa laʼin naṣaruhum layuwallunna al-ʼadbara ṯumma la yunṣarun.
Laʼantum ʼacaddu rahbatan fi ṣudurihim mina Allahi ḏalika biʼannahum qawmun la yafqahun.
La yuqatilunakum jamiɛan ʼilla fi quran muḥaṣṣanatin ʼaw min waraʼi judurin baʼsuhum baynahum cadidun taḥsabuhum jamiɛan wa qulubuhum catta ḏalika biʼannahum qawmun la yaɛqilun.
Kamaṯali al-laḏina min qablihim qariban ḏaqu wabala ʼamrihim wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Kamaṯali ac-cayṭani ʼiḏ qala lilʼinsani akfur falamma kafara qala ʼinni bariʼun minka ʼinni ʼaxafu Allaha rabba al-ɛalamin.
Fakana ɛaqibatahuma ʼannahuma fi an-nari xalidayni fiha wa ḏalika jazaʼu aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu attaqu Allaha wa ltanḏ̣ur nafsun ma qaddamat liɣadin wa attaqu Allaha ʼinna Allaha xabirun bima taɛmalun.
Wa la takunu kallaḏina nasu Allaha faʼansahum ʼanfusahum ʼulaʼika hum al-fasiqun.
La yastawi ʼaṣḥabu an-nari wa ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati ʼaṣḥabu al-jannati hum al-faʼizun.
Law ʼanzalna haḏa al-qurʼana ɛala jabalin laraʼaytahu xaciɛan mutaṣaddiɛan min xacyati Allahi wa tilka al-ʼamṯalu naḍribuha lilnnasi laɛallahum yatafakkarun.
Huwa Allahu al-laḏi la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa ɛalimu al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati huwa ar-raḥmanu ar-raḥim.
Huwa Allahu al-laḏi la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa al-maliku al-quddusu as-salamu al-muʼminu al-muhayminu al-ɛazizu al-jabbaru al-mutakabbiru subḥana Allahi ɛamma yucrikun.
Huwa Allahu al-xaliqu al-bariʼu al-muṣawwiru lahu al-ʼasmaʼu al-ḥusna yusabbiḥu lahu ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tattaxiḏu ɛaduwi wa ɛaduwakum ʼawliyaʼa tulquna ʼilayhim bil-mawaddati wa qad kafaru bima jaʼakum mina al-ḥaqqi yuxrijuna ar-rasula wa ʼiyakum ʼan tuʼminu Billahi rabbikum ʼin kuntum xarajtum jihadan fi sabili wa abtiɣaʼa marḍati tusirruna ʼilayhim bil-mawaddati wa ʼana ʼaɛlamu bima ʼaxfaytum wa ma ʼaɛlantum wa man yafɛalhu minkum faqad ḍalla sawaʼa as-sabil.
ʼin yaṯqafukum yakunu lakum ʼaɛdaʼan wa yabsuṭu ʼilaykum ʼaydiyahum wa ʼalsinatahum bis-suʼi wa waddu law takfurun.
Lan tanfaɛakum ʼarḥamukum wa la ʼawladukum yawma al-qiyamati yafṣilu baynakum wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.

Qad kanat lakum ʼuswatun ḥasanatun fi ʼibrahima wa al-laḏina maɛahu ʼiḏ qalu liqawmihim ʼinna buraʼaʼu minkum wa mimma taɛbuduna min duni Allahi kafarna bikum wa bada baynana wa baynakum al-ɛadawatu wa al-baɣḍaʼu ʼabadan ḥatta tuʼminu Billahi waḥdahu ʼilla qawla ʼibrahima liʼabihi laʼastaɣfiranna laka wa ma ʼamliku laka mina Allahi min cayʼin rabbana ɛalayka tawakkalna wa ʼilayka ʼanabna wa ʼilayka al-maṣir.
Rabbana la tajɛalna fitnatan lillaḏina kafaru wa aɣfir lana rabbana ʼinnaka ʼanta al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Laqad kana lakum fihim ʼuswatun ḥasanatun liman kana yarju Allaha wa al-yawma al-ʼaxira wa man yatawalla faʼinna Allaha huwa al-ɣaniyu al-ḥamid.
Ɛasa Allahu ʼan yajɛala baynakum wa bayna al-laḏina ɛadaytum minhum mawaddatan wa Allahu qadirun wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
La yanhakum Allahu ɛan al-laḏina lam yuqatilukum fi ad-dini wa lam yuxrijukum min diyarikum ʼan tabarruhum wa tuqsiṭu ʼilayhim ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-muqsiṭin.
ʼinnama yanhakum Allahu ɛan al-laḏina qatalukum fi ad-dini wa ʼaxrajukum min diyarikum wa ḏ̣aharu ɛala ʼixrajikum ʼan tawallawhum wa man yatawallahum faʼulaʼika hum aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa jaʼakum al-muʼminatu muhajiratin famtaḥinuhunna Allahu ʼaɛlamu biʼimanihinna faʼin ɛalimtumuhunna muʼminatin fala tarjiɛuhunna ʼila al-kuffari la hunna ḥillun lahum wa la hum yaḥilluna lahunna wa ʼatuhum ma ʼanfaqu wa la junaḥa ɛalaykum ʼan tankiḥuhunna ʼiḏa ʼataytumuhunna ʼujurahunna wa la tumsiku biɛiṣami al-kawafiri wa asʼalu ma ʼanfaqtum wa liasʼalu ma ʼanfaqu ḏalikum ḥukmu Allahi yaḥkumu baynakum wa Allahu ɛalimun ḥakimun.
Wa ʼin fatakum cayʼun min ʼazwajikum ʼila al-kuffari faɛaqabtum faʼatu al-laḏina ḏahabat ʼazwajuhum miṯla ma ʼanfaqu wa attaqu Allaha al-laḏi ʼantum bihi muʼminun.

Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu ʼiḏa jaʼaka al-muʼminatu yubayiɛnaka ɛala ʼan la yucrikna Billahi cayʼan wa la yasriqna wa la yaznina wa la yaqtulna ʼawladahunna wa la yaʼtina bibuhtanin yaftarinahu bayna ʼaydihinna wa ʼarjulihinna wa la yaɛṣinaka fi maɛrufin fabayiɛhunna wa astaɣfir lahunna Allaha ʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tatawallaw qawman ɣaḍiba Allahu ɛalayhim qad yaʼisu mina al-ʼaxirati kama yaʼisa al-kuffaru min ʼaṣḥabi al-qubur.
Sabbaḥa Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu lima taquluna ma la tafɛalun.
Kabura maqtan ɛinda Allahi ʼan taqulu ma la tafɛalun.
ʼinna Allaha yuḥibbu al-laḏina yuqatiluna fi sabilihi ṣaffan kaʼannahum bunyanun marṣuṣun.
Wa ʼiḏ qala musa liqawmihi ya qawmi lima tuʼḏunani wa qad taɛlamuna ʼanni rasulu Allahi ʼilaykum falamma zaɣu ʼazaɣa Allahu qulubahum wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma al-fasiqin.

Wa ʼiḏ qala ɛisa abnu maryama ya bani ʼisraʼila ʼinni rasulu Allahi ʼilaykum muṣaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina at-tawrati wa mubacciran birasulin yaʼti min baɛdi asmuhu ʼaḥmadu falamma jaʼahum bil-bayyinati qalu haḏa siḥrun mubinun.
Wa man ʼaḏ̣lamu mimmani aftara ɛala Allahi al-kaḏiba wa huwa yudɛa ʼila al-ʼislami wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Yuriduna liyuṭfiʼu nura Allahi biʼafwahihim wa Allahu mutimmu nurihi wa law kariha al-kafirun.
Huwa al-laḏi ʼarsala rasulahu bil-huda wa dini al-ḥaqqi liyuḏ̣hirahu ɛala ad-dini kullihi wa law kariha al-mucrikun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu hal ʼadullukum ɛala tijaratin tunjikum min ɛaḏabin ʼalimin.
Tuʼminuna Billahi wa rasulihi wa tujahiduna fi sabili Allahi biʼamwalikum wa ʼanfusikum ḏalikum xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.
Yaɣfir lakum ḏunubakum wa yudxilkum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu wa masakina ṭayyibatan fi jannati ɛadnin ḏalika al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa ʼuxra tuḥibbunaha naṣrun mina Allahi wa fatḥun qaribun wa baccir al-muʼminin.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu kunw ʼanṣara Allahi kama qala ɛisa abnu maryama lilḥawariyina man ʼanṣari ʼila Allahi qala al-ḥawariyuna naḥnu ʼanṣaru Allahi faʼamanat ṭaʼifatun min bani ʼisraʼila wa kafarat ṭaʼifatun faʼayyadna al-laḏina ʼamanu ɛala ɛaduwihim faʼaṣbaḥu ḏ̣ahirin.
Yusabbiḥu Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi al-maliki al-quddusi al-ɛazizi al-ḥakim.
Huwa al-laḏi baɛaṯa fi al-ʼummiyina rasulan minhum yatlu ɛalayhim ʼayatihi wa yuzakkihim wa yuɛallimuhum al-kitaba wa al-ḥikmata wa ʼin kanu min qablu lafi ḍalalin mubinin.
Wa ʼaxarina minhum lamma yalḥaqu bihim wa huwa al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.
Ḏalika faḍlu Allahi yuʼtihi man yacaʼu wa Allahu ḏu al-faḍli al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Maṯalu al-laḏina ḥummilu at-tawrata ṯumma lam yaḥmiluha kamaṯali al-ḥimari yaḥmilu ʼasfaran biʼsa maṯalu al-qawmi al-laḏina kaḏḏabu biʼayati Allahi wa Allahu la yahdi al-qawma aḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Qul ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina hadu ʼin zaɛamtum ʼannakum ʼawliya ʼu Lillahi min duni an-nasi fatamannaw al-mawta ʼin kuntum ṣadiqin.
Wa la yatamannawnahu ʼabadan bima qaddamat ʼaydihim wa Allahu ɛalimun biḏ̣-ḏ̣alimin.
Qul ʼinna al-mawta al-laḏi tafirruna minhu faʼinnahu mulaqikum ṯumma turadduna ʼila ɛalimi al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati fayunabbiʼukum bima kuntum taɛmalun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼiḏa nudi lilṣṣalati min yawmi al-jumuɛati fasɛaw ʼila ḏikri Allahi wa ḏaru al-bayɛa ḏalikum xayrun lakum ʼin kuntum taɛlamun.
Faʼiḏa quḍiyat aṣ-ṣalatu fantaciru fi al-ʼarḍi wa abtaɣu min faḍli Allahi wa aḏkuru Allaha kaṯiran laɛallakum tufliḥun.
Wa ʼiḏa raʼaw tijaratan ʼaw lahwan anfaḍḍu ʼilayha wa tarakuka qaʼiman qul ma ɛinda Allahi xayrun mina al-lahwi wa mina at-tijarati wa Allahu xayru ar-raziqin.
ʼiḏa jaʼaka al-munafiquna qalu nac/hadu ʼinnaka larasulu Allahi wa Allahu yaɛlamu ʼinnaka larasuluhu wa Allahu yac/hadu ʼinna al-munafiqina lakaḏibun.
Attaxaḏu ʼaymanahum junnatan faṣaddu ɛan sabili Allahi ʼinnahum saʼa ma kanu yaɛmalun.
Ḏalika biʼannahum ʼamanu ṯumma kafaru faṭubiɛa ɛala qulubihim fahum la yafqahun.
Wa ʼiḏa raʼaytahum tuɛjibuka ʼajsamuhum wa ʼin yaqulu tasmaɛ liqawlihim kaʼannahum xucubun musannadatun yaḥsabuna kulla ṣayḥatin ɛalayhim hum al-ɛaduwu faḥḏarhum qatalahum Allahu ʼanna yuʼfakun.
Wa ʼiḏa qila lahum taɛalaw yastaɣfir lakum rasulu Allahi lawwaw ruʼsahum wa raʼaytahum yaṣudduna wa hum mustakbirun.
Sawaʼun ɛalayhim ʼastaɣfarta lahum ʼam lam tastaɣfir lahum lan yaɣfira Allahu lahum ʼinna Allaha la yahdi al-qawma al-fasiqin.
Hum al-laḏina yaquluna la tunfiqu ɛala man ɛinda rasuli Allahi ḥatta yanfaḍḍu wa Lillahi xazaʼinu as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa lakinna al-munafiqina la yafqahun.
Yaquluna laʼin rajaɛna ʼila al-madinati layuxrijanna al-ʼaɛazzu minha al-ʼaḏalla wa Lillahi al-ɛizzatu wa lirasulihi wa lilmuʼminina wa lakinna al-munafiqina la yaɛlamun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu la tulhikum ʼamwalukum wa la ʼawladukum ɛan ḏikri Allahi wa man yafɛal ḏalika faʼulaʼika hum al-xasirun.
Wa ʼanfiqu min ma razaqnakum min qabli ʼan yaʼtiya ʼaḥadakum al-mawtu fayaqula rabbi lawla ʼaxxartani ʼila ʼajalin qaribin faʼaṣṣaddaqa wa ʼakun mina aṣ-ṣaliḥin.
Wa lan yuʼaxxira Allahu nafsan ʼiḏa jaʼa ʼajaluha wa Allahu xabirun bima taɛmalun.
Yusabbiḥu Lillahi ma fi as-samawati wa ma fi al-ʼarḍi lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-ḥamdu wa huwa ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Huwa al-laḏi xalaqakum faminkum kafirun wa minkum muʼminun wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna baṣirun.
Xalaqa as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍa bil-ḥaqqi wa ṣawwarakum faʼaḥsana ṣuwarakum wa ʼilayhi al-maṣir.
Yaɛlamu ma fi as-samawati wa al-ʼarḍi wa yaɛlamu ma tusirruna wa ma tuɛlinuna wa Allahu ɛalimun biḏati aṣ-ṣudur.
ʼalam yaʼtikum nabaʼu al-laḏina kafaru min qablu faḏaqu wabala ʼamrihim wa lahum ɛaḏabun ʼalimun.
Ḏalika biʼannahu kanat taʼtihim rusuluhum bil-bayyinati faqalu ʼabacarun yahdunana fakafaru wa tawallaw wa astaɣna Allahu wa Allahu ɣaniyun ḥamidun.
Zaɛama al-laḏina kafaru ʼan lan yubɛaṯu qul bala wa rabbi latubɛaṯunna ṯumma latunabbaʼuunna bima ɛamiltum wa ḏalika ɛala Allahi yasirun.
Faʼaminu Billahi wa rasulihi wa an-nur al-laḏi ʼanzalna wa Allahu bima taɛmaluna xabirun.

Yawma yajmaɛukum liyawmi al-jamɛi ḏalika yawmu at-taɣabuni wa man yuʼmin Billahi wa yaɛmal ṣaliḥan yukaffir ɛanhu sayyiʼatihi wa yudxilhu jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ʼabadan ḏalika al-fawzu al-ɛaḏ̣im.
Wa al-laḏina kafaru wa kaḏḏabu biʼayatina ʼulaʼika ʼaṣḥabu an-nari xalidina fiha wa biʼsa al-maṣir.
Ma ʼaṣaba min muṣibatin ʼilla biʼiḏni Allahi wa man yuʼmin Billahi yahdi qalbahu wa Allahu bikulli cayʼin ɛalimun.
Wa ʼaṭiɛu Allaha wa ʼaṭiɛu ar-rasula faʼin tawallaytum faʼinnama ɛala rasulina al-balaɣu al-mubin.
Allahu la ʼilaha ʼilla huwa wa ɛala Allahi falyatawakkali al-muʼminun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu ʼinna min ʼazwajikum wa ʼawladikum ɛaduwan lakum faḥḏaruhum wa ʼin taɛfu wa taṣfaḥu wa taɣfiru faʼinna Allaha ɣafurun raḥimun.
ʼinnama ʼamwalukum wa ʼawladukum fitnatun wa Allahu ɛindahu ʼajrun ɛaḏ̣imun.
Fattaqu Allaha ma astaṭaɛtum wa asmaɛu wa ʼaṭiɛu wa ʼanfiqu xayran liʼnfusikum wa man yuqa cuḥḥa nafsihi faʼulaʼika hum al-mufliḥun.
ʼin tuqriḍu Allaha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍaɛifhu lakum wa yaɣfir lakum wa Allahu cakurun ḥalimun.
Ɛalimu al-ɣaybi wa ac-cahadati al-ɛazizu al-ḥakim.

Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu ʼiḏa ṭallaqtum an-nisaʼ faṭalliquhunna liɛiddatihinna wa ʼaḥṣu al-ɛiddata wa attaqu Allaha rabbakum la tuxrijuhunna min buyutihinna wa la yaxrujna ʼilla ʼan yaʼtina bifaḥicatin mubayyinatin wa tilka ḥududu Allahi wa man yataɛadda ḥududa Allahi faqad ḏ̣alama nafsahu la tadri laɛalla Allaha yuḥdiṯu baɛda ḏalika ʼamran.

Faʼiḏa balaɣna ʼajalahunna faʼamsikuhunna bimaɛrufin ʼaw fariquhunna bimaɛrufin wa ʼac/hidu ḏawa ɛadlin minkum wa ʼaqimu ac-cahadata Lillahi ḏalikum yuɛaḏ̣u bihi man kana yuʼminu Billahi wa al-yawmi al-ʼaxiri wa man yattaqi Allaha yajɛal lahu maxrajan.
Wa yarzuqhu min ḥayṯu la yaḥtasibu wa man yatawakkal ɛala Allahi fahuwa ḥasbuhu ʼinna Allaha baliɣu ʼamrihi qad jaɛala Allahu likulli cayʼin qadran.

Wa al-laʼi yaʼisna mina al-maḥiḍi min nisaʼikum ʼin artabtum faɛiddatuhunna ṯalaṯatu ʼac/hurin wa al-laʼi lam yaḥiḍna wa ʼulatu al-ʼaḥmali ʼajaluhunna ʼan yaḍaɛna ḥamlahunna wa man yattaqi Allaha yajɛal lahu min ʼamrihi yusran.
Ḏalika ʼamru Allahi ʼanzalahu ʼilaykum wa man yattaqi Allaha yukaffir ɛanhu sayyiʼatihi wa yuɛḏ̣im lahu ʼajran.

ʼaskinuhunna min ḥayṯu sakantum min wujdikum wa la tuḍarruhunna lituḍayyiqu ɛalayhinna wa ʼin kunna ʼulati ḥamlin faʼanfiqu ɛalayhinna ḥatta yaḍaɛna ḥamlahunna faʼin ʼarḍaɛna lakum faʼatuhunna ʼujurahunna wa ʼtamiru baynakum bimaɛrufin wa ʼin taɛasartum fasaturḍiɛu lahu ʼuxra.
Liyunfiq ḏu saɛatin min saɛatihi wa man qudira ɛalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma ʼatahu Allahu la yukallifu Allahu nafsan ʼilla ma ʼataha sayajɛalu Allahu baɛda ɛusrin yusran.
Wa kaʼayyin min qaryatin ɛatat ɛan ʼamri rabbiha wa rusulihi faḥasabnaha ḥisaban cadidan wa ɛaḏḏabnaha ɛaḏaban nukran.
Faḏaqat wabala ʼamriha wa kana ɛaqibatu ʼamriha xusran.
ʼaɛadda Allahu lahum ɛaḏaban cadidan fa attaqu Allaha ya ʼuli al-ʼalbabi al-laḏina ʼamanu qad ʼanzala Allahu ʼilaykum ḏikran.

Rasulan yatlu ɛalaykum ʼayati Allahi mubayyinatin liyuxrija al-laḏina ʼamanu wa ɛamilu aṣ-ṣaliḥati mina aḏ̣-ḏ̣ulumati ʼila an-nur wa man yuʼmin Billahi wa yaɛmal ṣaliḥan yudxilhu jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu xalidina fiha ʼabadan qad ʼaḥsana Allahu lahu rizqan.
Allahu al-laḏi xalaqa sabɛa samawatin wa mina al-ʼarḍi miṯlahunna yatanazzalu al-ʼamru baynahunna litaɛlamu ʼanna Allaha ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun wa ʼanna Allaha qad ʼaḥaṭa bikulli cayʼin ɛilman.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu lima tuḥarrimu ma ʼaḥalla Allahu laka tabtaɣi marḍata ʼazwajika wa Allahu ɣafurun raḥimun.
Qad faraḍa Allahu lakum taḥillata ʼaymanikum wa Allahu mawlakum wa huwa al-ɛalimu al-ḥakim.

Wa ʼiḏ ʼasarra an-nabiyu ʼila baɛḍi ʼazwajihi ḥadiṯan falamma nabbaʼat bihi wa ʼaḏ̣harahu Allahu ɛalayhi ɛarrafa baɛḍahu wa ʼaɛraḍa ɛan baɛḍin falamma nabbaʼaha bihi qalat man ʼanbaʼaka haḏa qala nabbaʼani al-ɛalimu al-xabir.
ʼin tatuba ʼila Allahi faqad ṣaɣat qulubukuma wa ʼin taḏ̣ahara ɛalayhi faʼinna Allaha huwa mawlahu wa jibrilu wa ṣaliḥu al-muʼminina wa al-malaʼikatu baɛda ḏalika ḏ̣ahirun.
Ɛasa rabbuhu ʼin ṭallaqakunna ʼan yubdilahu ʼazwajan xayran minkunna muslimatin muʼminatin qanitatin taʼibatin ɛabidatin saʼiḥatin ṯayyibatin wa ʼabkaran.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu qu ʼanfusakum wa ʼahlikum naran waquduha an-nasu wa al-ḥijaratu ɛalayha malaʼikatun ɣilaḏ̣un cidadun la yaɛṣuna Allaha ma ʼamarahum wa yafɛaluna ma yuʼmarun.
Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina kafaru la taɛtaḏiru al-yawma ʼinnama tujzawna ma kuntum taɛmalun.

Ya ʼayyuha al-laḏina ʼamanu tubu ʼila Allahi tawbatan naṣuḥan ɛasa rabbukum ʼan yukaffira ɛankum sayyiʼatikum wa yudxilakum jannatin tajri min taḥtiha al-ʼanharu yawma la yuxzi Allahu an-nabiya wa al-laḏina ʼamanu maɛahu nuruhum yasɛa bayna ʼaydihim wa biʼaymanihim yaquluna rabbana ʼatmim lana nurana wa aɣfir lana ʼinnaka ɛala kulli cayʼin qadirun.
Ya ʼayyuha an-nabiyu jahidi al-kuffara wa al-munafiqina wa aɣluḏ̣ ɛalayhim wa maʼwahum jahannamu wa biʼsa al-maṣir.
